title: GLM-5 Serving Parameter Tuning for OpenClaw: Single-Deployment MaaS Inference Optimization for Long-Context Agent Workloads
authors: Minjie Hua, Ning Wang, Peijun Yang, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian
abstract:
OpenClaw requests are dominated by long, tool-augmented prefixes, including system prompts, conversation history, and tool outputs fed back into the context window. For this workload, with about 28k-30k input tokens and 500 output tokens per request, serving quality is governed by throughput, TTFT, and tail latency rather than short-prompt throughput alone.
  This report studies GLM-5 serving-parameter tuning within a MaaS multi-model inference optimization architecture. The scope is the Single-Node Optimization block of the inference-optimization layer, where chunked prefill, tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and request concurrency are tuned for one GLM-5 serving deployment; in this report, "Single-Node Optimization" denotes the architecture block, while experiments run on a two-node, sixteen-GPU cluster.
  Within the tested space, the best configuration is chunked-prefill-size=3072, tp=4, pp-size=4, and max-running-requests=24. Compared with the conservative 2048/4/4/16 baseline, it increases request throughput from 0.43 to 0.48 req/s and total token throughput from 9029.64 to 9993.23 tok/s, while reducing average TTFT from 8.98 to 6.69 s and latency P90 from 40.23 to 32.64 s. Under the same hardware footprint, this corresponds to an estimated 10.4% lower serving cost per request and 9.6% lower cost per token. The results show that the optimum is workload-specific: larger chunk sizes and deeper queueing do not monotonically improve performance. We therefore recommend 3072 / tp4 / pp4 / max24 as the default OpenClaw deployment profile.

title: Kotlin-MP: DSL and IR Transformer for Parallelism
authors: Ruikai Huang
abstract:
While Kotlin provides exceptional abstractions for asynchronous concurrency (like Coroutines for I/O), it lacks low-overhead, directive-based constructs for true hardware parallelism. When developers attempt to parallelize compute-bound mathematical loops using standard task-parallel libraries, they encounter significant runtime overhead such as lambda allocations and state-machine generation due to the abstraction layers, and face difficulties in ensuring readability, reliability and maintainability in implementing them.
  To address this, this project proposes Kotlin-MP, a native Kotlin Domain-Specific Language (DSL) paired with a custom Intermediate Representation (IR) transformer as a Kotlin compiler plugin. The DSL provides an intuitive, OpenMP-like syntax for developers to denote parallel regions, schedules, and critical sections. Instead of acting as a standard runtime wrapper, the IR transformer intercepts this DSL at compile-time and structurally rewrites the code. It lowers the parallelized sections directly into optimized \textit{java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool} tasks, automatically managing loop chunking, performing thread scheduling, and injecting hardware synchronization and mutual exclusion.

title: Tile-Level Activation Overlap for Efficient LLM Inference
authors: Abhinav Jangda, Tyler Sorensen, Sebastian Burckhardt, Jianlan YE, Chaoyin Li, Atul Gupta
abstract: SwiGLU is the dominant MLP activation in modern large language models, yet its intermediate tensor materialization costs 9-37% of MLP execution time. We present two complementary CUTLASS-based SM90 kernels that fuse SwiGLU into GeMM at the tile level. Kernel-1 overlaps Swish computation on the Gate accumulator with Up-tile loading using the Pingpong warp-specialized schedule; Kernel-2 interleaves SwiGLU with tile stores via a custom Epilogue Visitor Tree. Evaluated on Qwen-2.5 models (0.5B-72B) on NVIDIA H100, our kernels achieve up to 2.47x speedup over PyTorch, shifting workloads from memory-bound to compute-bound and reaching 79.5% peak BF16 utilization. We demonstrate that torch.compile cannot replicate this fusion (3-7x slower than our kernels), validating the need for hand-crafted tile-level design. Our fused kernels are also numerically superior, achieving zero mismatches compared to 4.5-11% for cuBLAS.

title: AutoResearch: An Execution-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Research Workflow Automation
authors: Rajesh Kumar, Waqar Ali, Junaid Ahmed, Abdullah Aman Khan, Shaoning Zeng
abstract: Automated research agents increasingly generate code, retrieve literature, and draft scientific artifacts, but they often fail to verify whether generated experiments execute correctly or whether cited sources support generated claims. We present AutoResearch, an execution-grounded multi-agent framework for reliable research workflow automation. AutoResearch couples sandboxed Python/PyTorch execution, iterative code repair, citation verification, claim-support auditing, decision control, and structured \LaTeX{} artifact generation. The system treats runtime errors, citation-verification failures, and review-agent feedback as practical filtering signals for generated research artifacts. In controlled evaluations on HumanEval, MBPP, a SciCode subset, citation-validation tasks, claim-support auditing, and small end-to-end workflow stress tests, AutoResearch improves execution success, citation validity, local claim support, and workflow completion relative to directly comparable baselines. Code-oriented agents are reported separately as partial comparisons. AutoResearch is intended as a reliability-oriented research assistant, not as a fully autonomous scientist or a standalone manuscript-quality benchmark. Source Code: https://github.com/raja21068/AutoResearch

title: Multi-Turn Distributed Inference with Mixture of Experts for 6G Edge--Cloud Networks
authors: Bo Liu, Haiyuan Li, Yuelin Liu, Yulei Wu, Rasheed Hussain, Shadi Moazzeni, Dimitra Simeonidou
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are increasingly deployed across 6G edge--cloud networks, where sparse activation reduces the computational footprint of each inference to only a fraction of the full expert set. However, MoE inference in edge-cloud networks creates a tension between KV state locality and elastic expert dispatch. KV state relocation incurs substantial transfer overhead, while expert computation benefits from spreading across the network to exploit available capacity. This tension is amplified in multi-turn inference, where each turn extends the KV state that must persist across the dialogue. To this end, we present StateFlow, a distributed inference policy that decouples persistent KV state from transient sparse computation. StateFlow pins KV state at a sticky serving site for cross-turn reuse and jointly optimizes expert dispatch and aggregation placement across the network. We further implement a real-world testbed with kernel-level network emulation and experimental results show that StateFlow sustains more than $2\times$ higher stable dialogue concurrency than the distributed baseline solutions and reduces turn-level p95 latency under multi-turn inference by 53.0\%.

title: Edge-Deployable LLM Fine-Tuning on a Single GPU for Telecom Network Troubleshooting
authors: Chenhua Shi, Bhavika Jalli, John Zou, Gregor Macdonald, Wanlu Lei, Mridul Jain, Joji Philip
abstract: Telecom troubleshooting at edge sites requires low-latency model responses and localized model adaptation to satisfy operational and data sovereignty requirements. However, deploying large language models (LLMs) at telecom edge sites is constrained by limited power, cooling, space, and weight budgets for GPU infrastructure. These challenges are further amplified by human-patterned Radio Access Network (RAN) traffic that often results in low GPU utilization and poor return on investment, as well as by architectural mismatches between deterministic ASIC-based telecom processing and GPU-oriented AI workloads. Consequently, single-GPU fine-tuning becomes a practical requirement for scalable edge AI deployment rather than merely a resource limitation. This paper presents a GPU profiling study of LLM fine-tuning using the Unsloth framework on a single edge-class accelerator. We systematically analyze the effects of maximum sequence length, GPU memory utilization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) rank, and generation count on training stability and resource efficiency. We further investigate trade-offs in KV cache usage, activation memory overhead, and runtime stability under inductor compilation. In addition, we show that reasoning and non-reasoning model architectures exhibit substantially different behaviors during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) because of differences in chat template structures, reasoning tags, and control flags. Experiments are conducted on a telecom troubleshooting dataset consisting of question-answer pairs augmented with top-3 retrieved contextual documents. The results provide practical configuration guidelines for stable, efficient, and resource-aware LLM fine-tuning in telecom edge environments.

title: SWIFT: Spatio-temporal Wavelet Integrated Forecasting Framework for Workload Traces
authors: Zeyuan Ding, Lingfeng Zheng, Dian Ding, Guangtao Xue
abstract: Accurate cloud workload forecasting is pivotal for efficient resource management but remains challenging as workloads are highly volatile and prone to sudden bursts. Although wavelets preserve temporal locality, rigid fixed bases struggle with complex patterns and isolated processing neglects critical spatial dependencies. To address this, we propose SWIFT, a pure convolutional framework designed for high-efficiency workload forecasting. We introduce a Learnable Cascaded Wavelet Path that reformulates the traditional fixed wavelet bases into adaptive convolutional operators, enabling precise, data-driven feature peeling. Complementing this, our Multivariate Interaction Module sequentially models inter-variable spatial and intra-variable feature interactions to stabilize and refine noisy workload states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SWIFT achieves SOTA accuracy with linear O(L) complexity, reducing prediction error by up to 31.04% while cutting latency by 79.74%.

title: PEEK: Predictive Queue-Informed KV Cache Management for LLM Serving
authors: Bing Xie, Zhipeng Wang, Masahiro Tanaka, Zheng Zhen
abstract:
We present PEEK, a lightweight scheduling and eviction framework for both online (streaming) and offline (batch) LLM serving; this paper focuses on the online regime. PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue, exposing
  prefix-sharing clusters no existing engine surfaces. A low-overhead dual-walk matches the tree against the engine's prefix cache to yield longest-prefix-match for every waiting request; PEEK then admits cluster pioneers first so siblings
  inherit the freshly cached prefix, a co-designed eviction hook protects blocks ancestral to queued demand, and a multi-lane stride scheduler bounds starvation. On SGLang and vLLM across five workloads up to 4$\times$H100 (DP=2 over TP=2),
  PEEK delivers up to 3.0$\times$/2.6$\times$ cache hit, 7.9$\times$/7.1$\times$ TTFT, 6.7$\times$/5.5$\times$ E2E, and 3.6$\times$/4.5$\times$ throughput gains over each engine's strongest stock baseline (SGLang/vLLM), while matching
  baselines within noise on workloads with no exploitable prefix structure. Wins hold as KV-cache pressure and inference parallelism scale.
comment: 26 pages, 21 figures, 21 tables. Preprint, under review
zh_title: PEEK：面向LLM服务的预测性队列感知KV缓存管理
translation: 我们提出了PEEK，这是一个针对在线（流式）和离线（批处理）大语言模型（LLM）服务的轻量级调度和驱逐框架；本文重点关注在线场景。PEEK在等待队列上维护一个增量基数树，从而暴露出目前没有任何现有引擎能够呈现的前缀共享集群。一种低开销的双向遍历将该树与引擎的前缀缓存进行匹配，为每个等待的请求产生最长前缀匹配；然后，PEEK首先准入集群先驱（pioneers），以便同胞请求能够继承新鲜缓存的前缀，一个协同设计的驱逐钩子保护了队列需求祖先的块，而一个多通道步幅调度器则限制了饥饿。在跨越五个工作负载、高达4个H100（DP=2，TP=2）的SGLang和vLLM上，PEEK相比于每个引擎最强的原生基线（SGLang/vLLM），分别实现了高达3.0倍/2.6倍的缓存命中率、7.9倍/7.1倍的TTFT（首字时间）、6.7倍/5.5倍的端到端（E2E）以及3.6倍/4.5倍的吞吐量提升，而在没有可利用前缀结构的工作负载上，其表现与基线在噪声范围内持平。随着KV缓存压力和推理并行度的扩展，这些优势依然成立。
tldr: PEEK通过在等待队列上维护基数树来识别前缀共享，并协同设计调度与驱逐机制，使LLM推理的缓存命中率提升高达3倍，吞吐量提升高达4.5倍。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将等待队列中的未来请求信息（通过增量基数树）与当前的缓存驱逐和调度决策进行深度协同，打破了传统LLM引擎中调度与缓存管理相互孤立的局限。其设计的双向遍历、先驱优先调度以及保护祖先块的驱逐钩子非常巧妙，在具有前缀共享的工作负载下实现了巨大的性能提升，且在无共享场景下没有带来明显的开销，具有极高的实用和推广价值。
motivation: 现有的LLM推理引擎无法有效识别和利用等待队列中请求之间的前缀共享（prefix-sharing）集群，导致KV缓存利用率低，从而限制了首字时间（TTFT）和系统吞吐量的进一步提升。
method:
1. 在等待队列上维护一个增量基数树（incremental radix tree），以识别和暴露请求之间的前缀共享集群。
2. 采用低开销的双向遍历（dual-walk）算法，将基数树与引擎的前缀缓存进行匹配，为每个等待的请求获取最长前缀匹配。
3. 优先准入集群先驱（cluster pioneers），使后续的同胞请求能够直接继承新鲜缓存的前缀。
4. 协同设计驱逐钩子（eviction hook），保护队列中待处理请求的祖先块不被驱逐。
5. 引入多通道步幅调度器（multi-lane stride scheduler）以限制请求饥饿。
results: 在SGLang和vLLM上运行五个工作负载（最高使用4xH100，DP=2, TP=2）的测试表明，PEEK相比于各引擎最强的原生基线，分别实现了高达3.0倍/2.6倍的缓存命中率提升、7.9倍/7.1倍的TTFT提升、6.7倍/5.5倍的端到端（E2E）延迟降低，以及3.6倍/4.5倍的吞吐量提升。在没有可利用前缀结构的工作负载上，其性能与基线相当。
conclusion: PEEK是一个高效且轻量级的LLM服务KV缓存管理和调度框架，通过预测性地感知等待队列中的前缀共享结构，显著提升了在线LLM推理服务的性能，并能很好地适应KV缓存压力和并行度的扩展。

title: The Hidden Water Geography of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers in the AI Era
authors: Gianluca Guidi, Francesca Dominici
abstract: Water use by data centers is routinely reported as a single footprint, but water is consumed through two physically distinct pathways: at the site for cooling and in the power system that generates electricity. We mapped both pathways for 472 U.S. hyperscale facilities by linking facility locations to electricity regions, hydrologic basins, and water-stress data. Under baseline assumptions, operational water consumption totals approximately 300 GL yr^-1 (range 205-451 across scenarios), with electricity-related water contributing three-quarters of the total. The two pathways produce different hotspot geographies: direct cooling burdens concentrate in stressed western and south-central basins, whereas electricity-related burdens concentrate in a few eastern grid regions with fossil-heavy supply. Just 3 of 24 hosting balancing authorities account for 59% of electricity-related water. Separating pathways identifies which decisions matter where: cooling design and water sourcing locally, electricity planning and procurement regionally
zh_title: AI时代美国超大规模数据中心的隐性水资源地理学
translation: 数据中心的水资源使用通常被报告为单一足迹，但水是通过两个物理上截然不同的途径消耗的：用于现场冷却和用于发电的电力系统。我们通过将设施位置与电力区域、水文流域和水资源压力数据相联系，绘制了美国472个超大规模设施的这两种途径。在基准假设下，运营水消耗总量约为每年300 GL（不同情景下的范围为205-451），其中与电力相关的耗水占总量的四分之三。这两种途径产生了不同的热点地理分布：直接冷却负担集中在面临压力的西部和中南部流域，而电力相关负担则集中在少数化石能源供应沉重的东部电网区域。在24个托管平衡当局中，仅有3个就占了电力相关耗水的59%。区分这两种途径可以确定哪些决策在何处起作用：本地的冷却设计和水源选择，以及区域的电力规划和采购。
tldr: 本研究揭示了美国472个超大规模数据中心的年运营耗水约300 GL，其中发电耗水占75%。直接冷却耗水集中在缺水的西部和中南部，而发电耗水集中在东部少数化石燃料电网区，强调了本地冷却设计与区域电力规划需协同优化。
ai_comments: 本研究在AI和云计算爆发式增长的背景下，聚焦于数据中心这一高耗能、高耗水实体的环境影响，具有极强的现实意义。其创新之处在于打破了以往将数据中心水足迹视为单一整体的局限，将其拆分为“现场冷却”和“发电耗水”两个物理途径，并揭示了它们在地理空间上的非对称分布（西部面临本地冷却水压力，东部面临发电间接水压力）。这为政策制定者和科技企业提供了更精准的优化路径。局限性在于研究基于基准场景和模型估算，未来可进一步结合实际运行数据进行动态验证。
motivation: 虽然数据中心的水资源使用通常被简单地报告为单一的整体足迹，但实际上其水资源消耗是通过现场冷却和发电系统这两个物理上完全不同的途径发生的。以往的研究未能区分这两者，导致无法针对性地解决不同区域的水资源压力问题。
method: 通过将美国472个超大规模数据中心设施的具体位置，与电力区域、水文流域以及水资源压力数据进行关联映射，对现场冷却和发电系统耗水这两个独立途径进行了量化和空间制图分析。
results: 在基准假设下，美国超大规模数据中心的运营水消耗总量约为每年300 GL（不同情景下为205-451 GL），其中发电相关耗水占总量的四分之三。两者的地理热点截然不同：直接冷却负担集中在面临水资源压力的西部和中南部流域，而发电耗水负担则集中在少数化石能源占比高的东部电网区域（仅3个平衡当局就占了发电相关耗水的59%）。
conclusion: 区分数据中心的两种耗水途径，能够明确不同地理尺度上的关键决策方向：在本地层面应优化冷却设计和水源选择，在区域层面则应加强电力规划与清洁能源采购。

title: Operational Memory Architecture for Kubernetes: Evidence Horizon Taxonomy and Extended Causal Pattern Preservation
authors: Shamsher Khan
abstract:
Kubernetes clusters generate rich operational events during pod lifecycle transitions, yet the platform's native event retention model systematically discards the most diagnostically valuable context through multiple evidence destruction mechanisms operating on deterministic schedules. We formalize these mechanisms as an evidence horizon taxonomy: five distinct boundaries after which specific categories of diagnostic context become permanently unrecoverable from the Kubernetes API. H1(LastTerminationState rotation, ~90s) destroys container failure forensics; H2 (scheduler event pruning, 1hr/1000-event cluster limit) destroys placement rationale; H3 (ephemeral container exit, immediate) destroys debug session context; H4 (kubelet reconciliation gap) destroys in-memory operational state; and H5 (scrape-interval blind spot) renders sub-interval pod lifetimes invisible to poll-based observability tools.
  This paper extends the Operational Memory Architecture (OMA) to address the full evidence horizon taxonomy. Two new causal patterns are defined: P004 (Scheduler Decision Provenance) captures FailedScheduling predicate failures before kube-apiserver TTL pruning and demonstrates the first cross-horizon causal chain linking scheduler evidence to downstream OOMKill failures.
  Two new Go watchers (EventWatcher, EphemeralWatcher) and two new storage tables (scheduler_events, ephemeral_exits) extend the original architecture. Validated on Minikube (3-node) and AKS 1.32.10. The original 30-run statistical latency analysis (242 edges, intra-cycle mean 0.702ms) and stress evaluation (2.86 events/sec at 20 pods, 8.8MB RAM) are carried forward and augmented with H2, H3, and H5 results.
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Extends arXiv:2605.18755 (cs.DC) with evidence horizon taxonomy (H1-H5), two new causal patterns (P004, P005), and empirical validation on Minikube and AKS 1.32.10. Implementation: https://github.com/opscart/k8s-causal-memory
zh_title: Kubernetes的操作内存架构：证据视界分类学与扩展因果模式保留
translation:
Kubernetes集群在Pod生命周期过渡期间会产生丰富的运维事件，然而该平台的原生事件保留模型会通过在确定性时间表上运行的多种证据销毁机制，系统性地丢弃最具诊断价值的上下文。我们将这些机制正式定义为“证据视界分类学”：即五个不同的边界，越过这些边界后，特定类别的诊断上下文将从Kubernetes API中永久无法恢复。H1（LastTerminationState轮转，约90秒）销毁了容器失效取证；H2（调度器事件修剪，1小时/1000个事件的集群限制）销毁了调度合理性依据；H3（临时容器退出，立即）销毁了调试会话上下文；H4（kubelet对账间隙）销毁了内存中的运维状态；H5（抓取间隔盲区）使子间隔内的Pod生命周期对基于轮询的观测工具不可见。
本文扩展了操作内存架构（OMA）以应对完整的证据视界分类。定义了两个新的因果模式：P004（调度器决策出处）在kube-apiserver TTL修剪之前捕获FailedScheduling断言失败，并演示了首个将调度器证据与下游OOMKill失败联系起来的跨视界因果链。
两个新的Go语言监听器（EventWatcher、EphemeralWatcher）和两个新的存储表（scheduler_events、ephemeral_exits）对原始架构进行了扩展。在Minikube（3节点）和AKS 1.32.10上进行了验证。延续了原始的30次运行统计延迟分析（242个边，周期内平均0.702ms）和压力评估（20个Pod下2.86个事件/秒，8.8MB内存），并增加了H2、H3和H5的结果。
tldr: 本文扩展了Kubernetes操作内存架构（OMA），提出“证据视界分类学”以解决原生K8s丢弃关键诊断数据的问题，并通过新增的Go监听器和因果模式，在极低开销下成功保留了原本会丢失的故障上下文。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统性地提出了Kubernetes中诊断数据丢失的“证据视界分类学”（H1-H5），这为云原生系统的可观测性提供了一个非常清晰且实用的理论框架。通过扩展操作内存架构（OMA）并引入轻量级的Go监听器，成功解决了原生Kubernetes在事件修剪、临时容器退出等场景下的上下文丢失问题，且实验表明其性能开销极低，在生产环境的故障排查中具有很高的应用价值。
motivation: Kubernetes原生事件保留机制会根据确定性的时间表自动丢弃极具诊断价值的上下文信息（如容器失效、调度决策等），导致运维人员在事后进行故障排查时无法获取完整的证据链。
method:
1. 提出了“证据视界分类学”，定义了五个导致诊断上下文永久丢失的边界（H1至H5）。
2. 扩展了操作内存架构（OMA），引入两个新的因果模式（如P004：调度器决策出处）。
3. 实现了两个新的Go语言监听器（EventWatcher、EphemeralWatcher）以及两个新的存储表（scheduler_events、ephemeral_exits）来捕获并保存这些即将丢失的数据。
results: 在Minikube（3节点）和AKS 1.32.10上进行了验证。30次运行的统计延迟分析显示，在242个边中，周期内平均延迟仅为0.702ms；在20个Pod的压力测试下，事件处理速率为2.86个/秒，仅消耗8.8MB内存，并成功补充了H2、H3和H5视界的数据保留结果。
conclusion: 扩展后的操作内存架构（OMA）能够有效应对全部五个证据视界，通过保存跨视界的因果链，在极低的性能开销下保留了原本会丢失的关键Kubernetes运维上下文，为集群的深度诊断提供了支持。

title: RepliCore: Reproducible Parallel Simulation under Asynchronous Browser Runtimes
authors: Anqing Chen
abstract: Browser-based simulations execute over asynchronous runtime mechanisms including event loops, rendering callbacks, and independently scheduled Web Workers, causing simulation progression to depend on runtime timing and callback scheduling behavior. RepliCore addresses this problem by separating asynchronous runtime progression from externally observable logical-state visibility. Runtime-visible simulation states are exposed only after logical-state progression becomes externally stable, preventing asynchronous runtime activities from observing partially updated simulation progression. The framework prevents rendering callbacks and asynchronous runtime tasks from observing transient intermediate logical states during parallel progression. This organization maintains consistency between parallel and sequential execution. Based on this model, we implement RepliCore, a browser-oriented deterministic parallel simulation framework for reproducible large-scale simulation under asynchronous browser runtimes. Experiments in real browser environments produce bitwise-identical outputs across varying worker configurations, scheduling conditions, and rendering frequencies while remaining practical for large-scale browser-oriented workloads. Additional ablation experiments show systematic state divergence after relaxing key execution constraints. These results indicate that reproducible asynchronous parallel simulation can be achieved through controlled logical-state visibility stabilization without relying on execution replay or explicit schedule control.
zh_title: RepliCore：异步浏览器运行时下可重现的并行仿真
translation: 浏览器端仿真在事件循环、渲染回调和独立调度的Web Workers等异步运行时机制下执行，导致仿真进程依赖于运行时时序和回调调度行为。RepliCore通过将异步运行时进程与外部可观察的逻辑状态可见性分离来解决此问题。运行时可见的仿真状态仅在逻辑状态进程外部稳定后才暴露，从而防止异步运行时活动观察到部分更新的仿真进程。该框架防止渲染回调和异步运行时任务在并行进程中观察瞬态中间逻辑状态。这种组织方式在并行和顺序执行之间保持了一致性。基于此模型，我们实现了RepliCore，一个面向浏览器的确定性并行仿真框架，用于在异步浏览器运行时下进行可重现的大规模仿真。在真实浏览器环境中的实验表明，在不同的worker配置、调度条件和渲染频率下，RepliCore能产生位级一致的输出，同时对于大规模浏览器端工作负载仍然实用。额外的消融实验表明，在放松关键执行约束后，系统状态会发生系统性分歧。这些结果表明，通过受控的逻辑状态可见性稳定化，可以在不依赖执行重放或显式调度控制的情况下实现可重现的异步并行仿真。
tldr: RepliCore是一个浏览器端确定性并行仿真框架，通过控制逻辑状态可见性，解决了异步浏览器运行时中仿真结果不可重现的问题，实现了大规模仿真的位级一致性输出。
ai_comments: RepliCore的创新点在于其通过“受控逻辑状态可见性稳定化”来解决异步环境中并行仿真的可重现性问题，避免了传统上依赖执行重放或显式调度控制的复杂性。这对于浏览器端大规模、高并发的仿真应用具有重要意义，因为它为开发者提供了一个可靠的工具来确保仿真结果的一致性。该方法对于理解和构建更可靠的分布式或异步系统也有潜在的借鉴价值。
motivation: 浏览器端仿真在异步运行时机制（如事件循环、渲染回调和独立的Web Workers）下执行时，仿真进程依赖于运行时时序和回调调度行为，导致仿真结果不可重现。
method: RepliCore通过将异步运行时进程与外部可观察的逻辑状态可见性分离来解决此问题。运行时可见的仿真状态仅在逻辑状态进程外部稳定后才暴露，从而防止异步运行时活动观察到部分更新的仿真进程。该框架防止渲染回调和异步运行时任务在并行进程中观察瞬态中间逻辑状态，从而在并行和顺序执行之间保持一致性。
results: 在真实浏览器环境中的实验表明，RepliCore在不同的Worker配置、调度条件和渲染频率下产生位级一致的输出，同时对于大规模浏览器端工作负载仍然实用。额外的消融实验表明，在放松关键执行约束后，系统状态会发生系统性分歧。
conclusion: 这些结果表明，通过受控的逻辑状态可见性稳定化，可以在不依赖执行重放或显式调度控制的情况下实现可重现的异步并行仿真。

title: Beyond Satisfaction: Learning Associations Between Content, Reviews, and Well-Being
authors: Aaron Marker, Joel Lehman, H. Andrew Schwartz
abstract: Digital platforms commonly optimize for satisfaction using signals such as ratings, likes, and sentiment, implicitly treating satisfaction as a proxy for user well-being. Psychological theory, however, characterizes well-being as a multidimensional construct that extends beyond satisfaction or short-term positivity. In this paper, we examine whether commonly used satisfaction signals capture expressions of well-being, and what types of content are associated with different well-being outcomes. Our study focuses on book consumption, a convenient domain wherein users engage substantially with fixed pieces of content and sometimes provide nuanced long-form feedback. Our results show that (a) rating scales and sentiment only loosely correlate with most facets of psychological well-being and (b) ratings and sentiment are more closely aligned with immediate and hedonic as opposed to enduring and eudaimonic expressions of well-being. Further, by linking reviews to book content, we find that themes related to values, and institutions like religion (Pearson r = 0.35) or human drives (r=.26) are associated with higher meaning and accomplishment respectively, while incivility (avg r = -.15) and past-focused language (avg r = -.12) are associated with lower well-being. These findings motivate richer outcome targets for content recommendation systems beyond satisfaction alone.
zh_title: 超越满意度：学习内容、评论与幸福感之间的关联
translation: 数字平台通常使用评分、点赞和情感等信号来优化满意度，隐含地将满意度视为用户幸福感的代理。然而，心理学理论将幸福感描述为一个超越满意度或短期积极性的多维度概念。在本文中，我们研究了常用的满意度信号是否能捕捉到幸福感的表达，以及哪些类型的内容与不同的幸福感结果相关联。我们的研究重点是书籍消费，这是一个方便的领域，用户在其中大量接触固定的内容，有时会提供细致的长篇反馈。我们的结果表明：(a) 评分量表和情感与心理幸福感的大多数方面仅松散相关；(b) 评分和情感更倾向于即时享乐型而非持久幸福型的幸福感表达。此外，通过将评论与书籍内容联系起来，我们发现与价值观和宗教等机构（皮尔逊r = 0.35）或人类驱动力（r=.26）相关的主题分别与更高的意义和成就感相关，而不文明行为（平均r = -.15）和以过去为中心的语言（平均r = -.12）则与较低的幸福感相关。这些发现促使内容推荐系统在满意度之外，寻求更丰富的目标。
tldr: 数字平台常以满意度为用户幸福感代理，但本研究发现满意度信号与心理幸福感的大多数方面仅松散相关，且更侧重即时享乐而非持久幸福。内容主题与幸福感特定维度有更强关联，提示推荐系统应超越满意度。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于挑战了数字平台普遍将满意度等同于用户幸福感的假设，并提供了实证证据表明两者之间存在复杂且不完全重叠的关系。它提醒我们，优化用户体验应考虑幸福感的多维度特性，而不仅仅是短期的积极反馈。研究方法通过分析书籍评论内容与幸福感维度的关联，为推荐系统提供了更精细的优化方向。其局限性可能在于研究领域仅限于书籍消费，结果的普适性需进一步验证。
motivation: 数字平台通常以满意度为优化目标，并将其视为用户幸福感的代理。然而，心理学理论认为幸福感是多维度的，超越了满意度和短期积极性。本研究旨在检验常用的满意度信号是否能捕捉幸福感的表达，以及不同类型的内容与哪些幸福感结果相关联。
method: 本研究以书籍消费为研究领域，分析用户对固定内容的参与和长篇反馈（评论）。通过关联评论与书籍内容，研究了评分量表、情感与心理幸福感不同方面之间的相关性。
results: 结果显示，评分量表和情感与心理幸福感的大多数方面仅松散相关。评分和情感更倾向于即时享乐型而非持久幸福型的幸福感表达。此外，与价值观和宗教等机构（r = 0.35）或人类驱动力（r=.26）相关的主题分别与更高的意义和成就感相关，而不文明行为（平均r = -.15）和以过去为中心的语言（平均r = -.12）则与较低的幸福感相关。
conclusion: 常用的满意度信号（如评分和情感）不足以全面捕捉用户幸福感。内容主题与幸福感的特定维度存在更强的关联。这些发现促使内容推荐系统在满意度之外，寻求更丰富的用户幸福感目标。

title: Cybercrime Victimization Among Young Adult Males Aged 18--20: A Post-Pandemic Analysis of Converging Risk Factors
authors: Anveeksh Mahesh Rao
abstract: Cybercrime victimization among young adult males aged 18--20 has become an increasingly urgent public safety concern in the post-pandemic digital environment. From 2022 to 2024, individuals aged 20--29 submitted 191,787 complaints to the FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3), reporting combined losses of more than $1.28 billion. Although this population represents a substantial share of cybercrime victims, the 18--20 male sub-cohort remains insufficiently examined as a distinct demographic group within cybercrime victimization research. This study presents an original risk factor analysis and theoretical synthesis, representing the first integration of criminological, neurological, and behavioral evidence for this specific demographic sub-cohort. Drawing on FBI IC3 and FTC Consumer Sentinel Network data from 2022--2024 alongside European cybersecurity threat intelligence from ENISA, the study develops a unified risk profile centered on three intersecting vulnerability factors: a guardianship gap created by the transition into unsupervised digital independence, heightened behavioral exposure to online risk, and reduced impulse regulation associated with ongoing prefrontal cortex development. The findings show a 49.7% increase in reported losses among the 20--29 age group between 2023 and 2024 and identify financial sextortion, phishing, task scams, in-game currency fraud, and dark web grooming as major attack typologies exploiting this risk convergence. The study offers implications for targeted cybersecurity awareness campaigns, digital literacy education, and policy interventions designed for this high-risk demographic.
zh_title: 后疫情时代18-20岁年轻男性网络犯罪受害情况分析
translation: 网络犯罪受害在后疫情时代的数字环境中已成为18-20岁年轻男性群体日益紧迫的公共安全问题。从2022年到2024年，20-29岁年龄段的个人向FBI互联网犯罪投诉中心（IC3）提交了191,787起投诉，报告的损失总额超过12.8亿美元。尽管这一群体占网络犯罪受害者的很大一部分，但在网络犯罪受害研究中，18-20岁的男性亚群体作为一个独特的群体仍然研究不足。本研究提出了一个原创的风险因素分析和理论综合，首次将犯罪学、神经学和行为学证据整合到这一特定人口亚群体中。本研究利用2022-2024年的FBI IC3和FTC消费者哨兵网络数据以及ENISA的欧洲网络安全威胁情报，构建了一个以三个相互关联的脆弱性因素为中心的统一风险概况：由向无监督数字独立过渡造成的监护差距、增加的行为风险暴露以及与持续的前额叶皮层发育相关的冲动调节能力降低。研究结果显示，20-29岁年龄组在2023年至2024年间的报告损失增加了49.7%，并确定金融性勒索、网络钓鱼、任务诈骗、游戏内货币欺诈和暗网诱骗是利用这种风险聚合的主要攻击类型。本研究为针对这一高风险人群的定向网络安全宣传活动、数字素养教育和政策干预提供了启示。
tldr: 这项研究首次整合了犯罪学、神经学和行为学证据，分析了后疫情时代18-20岁年轻男性群体网络犯罪受害的风险因素，发现监护缺失、高风险行为暴露和冲动控制能力不足是主要脆弱性因素，并指出了金融性勒索、网络钓鱼、任务诈骗、游戏内货币欺诈和暗网诱骗是主要的攻击类型。
ai_comments: 该研究填补了在网络犯罪受害研究中对18-20岁男性这一特定亚群体的关注空白，具有重要的现实意义。研究方法整合了多方面的数据和理论，试图提供一个全面的风险分析。然而，研究结果的普适性和长期有效性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 18-20岁男性群体在网络犯罪受害研究中是一个被忽视的群体，尽管他们占有相当大的受害者比例，但对其进行独立的研究不足。
method: 本研究整合了来自FBI IC3、FTC消费者哨兵网络以及ENISA的欧洲网络安全威胁情报数据，从犯罪学、神经学和行为学角度分析了18-20岁男性群体在网络犯罪受害中的风险因素。
results: 研究发现，20-29岁年龄组在2023年至2024年间的报告损失增加了49.7%。主要攻击类型包括金融性勒索、网络钓鱼、任务诈骗、游戏内货币欺诈和暗网诱骗。研究识别出三个相互关联的脆弱性因素：数字独立带来的监护缺失、高风险行为暴露以及与前额叶皮层发育相关的冲动控制能力降低。
conclusion: 研究结果为针对18-20岁年轻男性这一高风险群体制定有针对性的网络安全宣传活动、数字素养教育和政策干预提供了依据。

title: Adaptive Enhanced Quantum-inspired Simulated Bifurcation Algorithm for Population State Perception
authors: Dongmei Liu, Jian Li, Xiubo Chen, JinTao Wang
abstract: Existing quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation algorithms rely on dynamic scheduling methods but lack the ability to adapt effectively to different problem instances. Additionally, during the evolutionary stage, balancing exploration and exploitation remains challenging. The fundamental issue stems from the widespread use of static preset parameters and globally uniform strategies, which can diminish algorithm effectiveness and lead to result homogenization. This article proposes an Adaptive Enhanced Quantum-inspired Simulated Bifurcation (AE-QSB) framework driven by population states. By leveraging perception indicators of four distinct population states, the QSB algorithm establishes a closed-loop strategy encompassing perception, decision-making, and execution. Within this framework, we introduce three complementary algorithms spanning a spectrum from efficient extremum seeking (ME-BSB), through population-level uniform refinement (SE-DSB), to density-aware adaptive scheduling (SG-DSB). On the medium-sized graph G22, both SE-DSB and SG-DSB achieve a mean gap below 0.05\%, while ME-BSB attains the optimal trade-off between runtime and solution quality with a gap of 0.26\% and the shortest single-run time. We compared AE-QSB variants with other algorithms across all benchmark graphs from G1 to G81. The results demonstrate that AE-QSB achieved the lowest mean gap on 74.6\% of the graphs and the highest average approximation rate on 84.5\% of the graphs. Ablation experiments further revealed that subgroup exploration and rescue mechanisms play crucial roles in both multifactor and single-factor components. This study demonstrates that population statistical information during dynamic evolution provides a computable and effective foundation for adaptive control, enabling quantum-inspired optimization methods to transition from fixed scheduling to data-driven closed-loop control.
zh_title: 面向种群状态感知的自适应增强量子启发模拟分岔算法
translation: 现有的量子启发式模拟分岔算法依赖于动态调度方法，但缺乏对不同问题实例的有效适应能力。此外，在进化阶段，平衡探索与开发仍然具有挑战性。根本问题在于广泛使用静态预设参数和全局统一策略，这可能会降低算法的有效性并导致结果同质化。本文提出了一种由种群状态驱动的自适应增强量子启发式模拟分岔（AE-QSB）框架。通过利用四种不同种群状态的感知指标，QSB算法建立了一个包含感知、决策和执行的闭环策略。在该框架内，我们引入了三种互补算法，涵盖了从高效极值搜索（ME-BSB）、种群级均匀细化（SE-DSB）到密度感知自适应调度（SG-DSB）的范围。在中型图G22上，SE-DSB和SG-DSB的平均间隙均低于0.05%，而ME-BSB以0.26%的间隙和最短的单次运行时间实现了运行时间和解质量之间的最优权衡。我们将AE-QSB变体与G1到G81所有基准图上的其他算法进行了比较。结果表明，AE-QSB在74.6%的图上实现了最低的平均间隙，在84.5%的图上实现了最高的平均近似率。消融实验进一步揭示了子群探索和救援机制在多因素和单因素组件中都起着至关重要的作用。本研究表明，动态进化过程中的种群统计信息为自适应控制提供了可计算且有效的基础，使量子启发式优化方法能够从固定调度转向数据驱动的闭环控制。
tldr: 提出了一种基于种群状态感知的自适应量子启发模拟分岔算法（AE-QSB），通过闭环控制有效提升了算法在不同优化问题中的性能与适应性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入基于种群状态感知的闭环控制机制，成功解决了量子启发式模拟分岔算法在不同问题实例中参数固定及探索与开发平衡困难的问题，为该类算法从静态调度向数据驱动的自适应控制转型提供了重要思路。
motivation: 现有的量子启发模拟分岔算法依赖动态调度方法，但缺乏对不同问题的自适应能力，且在进化过程中难以平衡探索与开发，主要原因是普遍使用静态预设参数和全局统一策略。
method: 提出了一种基于种群状态感知的自适应增强量子启发模拟分岔（AE-QSB）框架。该框架包含感知、决策和执行的闭环策略，并引入了三种互补算法：ME-BSB（高效极值搜索）、SE-DSB（种群级均匀细化）和SG-DSB（密度感知自适应调度）。
results: 在G22图上，SE-DSB和SG-DSB的平均间隙低于0.05%；在G1-G81基准测试中，AE-QSB在74.6%的图上取得了最低平均间隙，在84.5%的图上取得了最高平均近似率。
conclusion: AE-QSB框架通过实时监测种群状态并动态调整策略，显著提升了算法在多种图论基准测试中的寻优能力与效率，证明了数据驱动的闭环控制在量子启发式优化中的有效性。

title: Static PTX Metrics Track Structural Kernel Regressions but Miss Semantic Ones
authors: Dipankar Sarkar
abstract: We pair each GPU kernel's static PTX metrics (registers, spills, instruction count) with CUDA-event-timed runtime on five GPU classes: RTX 3060, A10, L40S, A100 SXM4, and H100 NVL. In this corpus and toolchain the static and measured signals separate cleanly along one axis. Per-pair Delta-regs and Delta-instrs are identical across all five GPUs for any given (correct, buggy) pair. Measured Delta-perf% is not. Structural bugs that change the kernel's work are unambiguous in the static signal. The gelu_triton_buggy variant, which drops a leading 0.5 factor, removes 8 instructions and 8 registers. The corresponding measured Delta-perf% on RTX 3060 is +3.2%, within the run-to-run noise band at the sub-millisecond scale these corpus kernels occupy. Semantic bugs that swap one constant for another are invisible to the static signal. The softmax_triton_buggy variant, which substitutes other=0.0 for -inf on the masked load, compiles to byte-identical PTX. The paper's bounded claim is that, for this corpus and toolchain, a static-PTX delta gate is a portable pre-filter that separates structural from semantic changes; measured runtime deltas at this scale are hardware- and noise-sensitive and are not a substitute.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, LNCS format. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.20128 (P1). Additional companions (P2, P3) to follow on arXiv this week; IDs will be added in a v2 replace
zh_title: 静态PTX指标能追踪结构性内核回归，但会遗漏语义性回归
translation: 我们将每个GPU内核的静态PTX指标（寄存器、溢出、指令计数）与CUDA事件计时的运行时配对，在五种GPU类别上进行：RTX 3060、A10、L40S、A100 SXM4和H100 NVL。在此语料库和工具链中，静态和测量的信号沿一个轴清晰分离。对于任何给定的（正确、有bug）对，每对的Delta-regs和Delta-instrs在所有五种GPU上都是相同的。但测量的Delta-perf%则不同。改变内核工作的结构性bug在静态信号中是明确的。例如，`gelu_triton_buggy`变体（删除了一个前导的0.5因子）减少了8条指令和8个寄存器。在RTX 3060上，相应的测量Delta-perf%为+3.2%，这在这些语料库内核所占据的亚毫秒级规模的运行间噪声范围内。将一个常量替换为另一个常量的语义性bug对静态信号是不可见的。例如，`softmax_triton_buggy`变体（在掩码加载时将other=0.0替换为-inf）编译为字节相同的PTX。本文的有限主张是，对于此语料库和工具链，静态PTX增量门是一个可移植的预过滤器，用于区分结构性变化和语义性变化；在此规模下，测量的运行时增量对硬件和噪声敏感，不能作为替代。
tldr: 静态PTX指标可以检测GPU内核的结构性变化，但无法检测语义性变化，从而将其与对硬件和噪声敏感的运行时性能差异区分开来。
ai_comments: 这篇论文强调了静态分析在检测不改变编译PTX的细微语义bug方面的实际局限性。它提出静态PTX增量分析作为结构性变化的一个有价值、可移植的预过滤器，可以补充但不能替代更深入的语义分析或全面的运行时测试以发现性能回归。结构性变化和语义性变化之间的区别，以及静态指标对前者的可靠性与运行时指标在亚毫秒级尺度上对后者的不可靠性，是一个关键的见解。
motivation: 研究静态PTX指标在追踪GPU内核回归方面的有效性，并与运行时性能测量进行比较，特别是区分结构性变化和语义性变化。
method: 将每个GPU内核的静态PTX指标（寄存器、溢出、指令计数）与CUDA事件计时的运行时配对，并在五种GPU类别（RTX 3060、A10、L40S、A100 SXM4、H100 NVL）上进行测试。分析了（正确、有bug）对的“Delta-regs”、“Delta-instrs”和“Measured Delta-perf%”，并检查了`gelu_triton_buggy`（结构性）和`softmax_triton_buggy`（语义性）等示例。
results: 静态和测量的信号清晰分离。对于任何给定的（正确、有bug）对，每对的Delta-regs和Delta-instrs在所有五种GPU上都是相同的，但测量的Delta-perf%则不同。改变内核工作的结构性bug（例如`gelu_triton_buggy`）在静态信号中是明确的，而相应的测量Delta-perf%通常在噪声范围内。语义性bug（例如`softmax_triton_buggy`）对静态信号是不可见的，因为它们编译为字节相同的PTX。
conclusion: 对于本研究的语料库和工具链，静态PTX增量门是一个可移植的预过滤器，用于区分结构性变化和语义性变化。在此规模下，测量的运行时增量对硬件和噪声敏感，不能作为替代。

title: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni Technical Report
authors: Yuan Zhang, Jingfei Ni, Guanchen Lu, Shiqi Zhang, Qingshan Xu, Chi Liu, Xin Nie, Wenjie Xu, Lin Gao, Zhiyuan Cheng, Mingxin Zhou, Jiajia Wu, Diyuan Liu, Jia Pan, Chao Ji
abstract: General-purpose embodied agents must understand multimodal instructions, anticipate how their environment will evolve, and produce precise control actions over extended horizons. Existing approaches typically specialize in visual-language reasoning, video-based world modeling, or action generation, while cascaded pipelines that first synthesize future observations and then infer actions can introduce interface bottlenecks and compound prediction errors. We present iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni, a unified multimodal foundation model that jointly models vision(videos and images), language, and action within a single Omni framework. Its modality-specific visual-language, video-generation, and action-generation components communicate through shared multimodal self-attention. This design establishes brain-cerebellum collaboration: the vision-language modeland video generation model form a high-level brain for instruction understanding, task planning, progress tracking, and future visual-state prediction, whereas the action generation modelserves as a low-level cerebellum that directly converts planned subgoals and shared multimodal context into executable action chunks. To develop these capabilities, we combine action-annotated and action-free embodied videos from human demonstrations and robot interactions with embodied reasoning, embodied perception, and general-purpose image-text data to construct a comprehensive dataset. We further adopt a four-stage strategy that progressively trains the VLM, VGM, and AGM before jointly fine-tuning the complete model.
zh_title: 科大讯飞具身智能统一大模型（iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni）技术报告
translation: 通用具身智能体必须理解多模态指令、预测环境将如何演变，并在长时程内产生精确的控制动作。现有方法通常专注于视觉-语言推理、基于视频的世界建模或动作生成，而先合成未来观测再推断动作的级联管道可能会引入接口瓶颈并累积预测误差。我们提出了 iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni，这是一个在单一 Omni 框架内对视觉（视频和图像）、语言和动作进行联合建模的统一多模态基座模型。其特定模态的视觉-语言、视频生成和动作生成组件通过共享的多模态自注意力机制进行通信。这种设计建立了“大脑-小脑”协同：视觉-语言模型和视频生成模型构成了用于指令理解、任务规划、进度跟踪和未来视觉状态预测的高层“大脑”，而动作生成模型则作为低层“小脑”，直接将规划的子目标和共享的多模态上下文转化为可执行的动作块。为了开发这些能力，我们结合了来自人类演示和机器人交互的有动作标注和无动作标注的具身视频，以及具身推理、具身感知和通用图文数据，构建了一个全面的数据集。我们进一步采用了一种四阶段策略，在联合微调完整模型之前，逐步训练 VLM、VGM 和 AGM。
tldr: 本文提出了iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni，一个将视觉、语言和动作统一在单一框架下的具身智能多模态基座模型，通过“大脑-小脑”协同机制实现了高效的指令理解、环境预测和动作生成。
ai_comments: 该技术报告的创新之处在于提出了一种新颖的“大脑-小脑”协同架构，通过共享自注意力机制将高层认知（推理、规划、视频预测）与低层控制（动作生成）统一在单个多模态模型中，有效避免了传统级联系统的接口瓶颈和误差累积。然而，摘要中未提供具体的定量实验结果和基准测试表现，其在实际物理机器人上的部署效果和实时性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的具身智能方法通常局限于单一的视觉语言推理、视频世界建模或动作生成。若采用先合成未来观测再推断动作的级联管道，会引入接口瓶颈并累积预测误差。因此，需要一个能够联合建模视觉、语言和动作的统一模型。
method: 提出iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni统一多模态基座模型。该模型通过共享的多模态自注意力机制连接视觉语言（VLM）、视频生成（VGM）和动作生成（AGM）组件。其中，VLM和VGM作为高层“大脑”负责指令理解、任务规划、进度跟踪和未来视觉状态预测；AGM作为低层“小脑”将规划的子目标和共享多模态上下文转化为可执行动作。训练上，构建了结合人类演示和机器人交互的具身数据集，并采用四阶段渐进式训练策略（先分别训练VLM、VGM、AGM，最后联合微调）。
results: 成功构建并训练了iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni多模态基座模型，实现了视觉、语言和动作在单一框架下的联合建模，克服了传统级联管道的接口瓶颈与误差累积问题（摘要中未提及具体的量化实验结果）。
conclusion: 统一的Omni框架通过共享多模态自注意力实现了视觉-语言、视频生成和动作生成组件的高效协同，为构建具有“大脑-小脑”协作能力的通用具身智能体提供了一种有效的多模态基座模型方案。

title: Not Every Sync Is Safe: Calibrated DiLoCo Scheduling for Shared AI Infrastructure
authors: Maxwell Twelftree, David Lemphers, An-chi He, Yue Yang
abstract: DiLoCo-style training reduces communication by letting learner islands train locally before occasional outer synchronization, making it attractive for fragmented industrial AI fleets where training shares hardware with latency-sensitive serving. The question for such fleets is when an outer merge is worth its system cost, and whether choosing \emph{which} windows to defer matters at all. Existing scheduling studies evaluate workload-aware policies against fixed-period baselines, but most omit the control that isolates timing from budget: matched random deferral, which inherits the controller's synchronization budget but is not itself deployable. This omission is consequential: across controlled stress tests and real vLLM sidecar replays, matched random ties or beats every forecast-free policy we test, so gains reported against weaker baselines cannot be attributed to window choice. We fill this gap with Workload-Aware DiLoCo (WA-DiLoCo), a score-based controller that weighs learner progress against fleet pressure, and a calibration protocol that determines when matched random can be beaten, then demonstrate that it can. In the bursty regime where calibration exposes request-overlap structure, adding a one-step EWMA burst forecast to the online controller beats matched random in real vLLM sidecar replay, reducing SLO violations from 6.54\% to 5.09\% (8 of 10 seeds, $p=0.021$); offline Calibrated-WA, a non-deployable bound, shows the remaining headroom at 4.45\% versus 6.26\%. The deployable lesson remains the protocol: report real-sidecar effect-size transfer, a no-sync load match, and a matched-random envelope before claiming serving-SLO improvement.
zh_title: 并非所有同步都安全：共享AI基础设施的校准DiLoCo调度
translation: DiLoCo风格的训练通过让学习器孤岛在偶尔的外部同步前进行局部训练来减少通信，这使其对碎片化的工业AI集群具有吸引力，因为在这些集群中，训练与对延迟敏感的服务共享硬件。对于此类集群而言，问题在于何时进行外部合并值得其系统成本，以及选择哪些窗口进行延迟是否重要。现有调度研究评估了工作负载感知策略与固定周期基线，但大多数都忽略了将时序与预算隔离开的控制：匹配随机延迟，它继承了控制器的同步预算，但本身不可部署。这种遗漏是重要的：在受控压力测试和真实的vLLM sidecar重放中，匹配随机策略与我们测试的每一个无预测策略打平或击败它们，因此报告的相对于较弱基线的收益不能归因于窗口选择。我们通过工作负载感知DiLoCo（WA-DiLoCo）填补了这一空白，它是一个基于分数的控制器，权衡学习器进度与集群压力，以及一个校准协议，用于确定何时可以击败匹配随机，然后证明了这一点。在校准暴露请求重叠结构的突发模式下，将单步EWMA突发预测添加到在线控制器中，在真实的vLLM sidecar重放中击败了匹配随机，将SLO违规率从6.54%降低到5.09%（10个种子中的8个，p=0.021）；离线Calibrated-WA，一个不可部署的上限，显示剩余的改进空间为4.45%对比6.26%。可部署的经验教训仍然是该协议：在声称服务SLO改进之前，报告真实sidecar效应大小转移、无同步负载匹配和匹配随机包络。
tldr: 现有DiLoCo调度基线过于薄弱；本文引入了一个更强的基线（匹配随机），并提出了一种新的校准调度器（WA-DiLoCo），该调度器能够超越匹配随机，从而减少共享AI基础设施中的服务水平目标（SLO）违规。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个更强的调度基线——匹配随机延迟，并强调了其重要性，挑战了现有研究的结论。WA-DiLoCo控制器结合校准协议和突发预测，提供了一种在复杂共享AI环境中有效降低SLO违规的方法。其核心贡献在于不仅提出了新方法，更重要的是确立了一个更严谨的评估框架，对于未来DiLoCo调度研究具有指导意义，避免了因基线选择不当而导致的误导性结论。
motivation: 在碎片化的工业AI集群中，训练与对延迟敏感的服务共享硬件，DiLoCo风格的训练面临挑战。研究动机在于确定何时进行外部合并值得其系统成本，以及选择哪些窗口进行延迟是否重要。此外，还旨在纠正现有调度研究中忽略强大基线（如匹配随机延迟）的问题。
method: 本文提出了Workload-Aware DiLoCo (WA-DiLoCo)，一个基于分数的控制器，用于权衡学习器进度与集群压力，并设计了一个校准协议来确定何时可以超越匹配随机。实验通过受控压力测试和真实的vLLM sidecar重放进行，将WA-DiLoCo与匹配随机延迟策略进行比较，并在突发模式下加入了单步EWMA突发预测。
results: 匹配随机延迟策略在所有无预测策略中表现最佳或持平。在真实的vLLM sidecar重放中，将单步EWMA突发预测添加到在线控制器中的WA-DiLoCo能够击败匹配随机，将SLO违规率从6.54%降低到5.09%（10个种子中的8个，p=0.021）。不可部署的离线界限Calibrated-WA显示，剩余的改进空间为4.45%对比6.26%。
conclusion: 可部署的经验教训在于一个协议：在声称服务SLO改进之前，应报告真实sidecar效应大小转移、无同步负载匹配和匹配随机包络。

title: Learning 3D Affordances for Blade Insertion in Cluttered Stowing
authors: Tianyu Li, Harpreet Sawhney, Minju Jung, Aditya Mehrotra, Kunal Mehrotra, Mudit Agrawal
abstract: Many manipulation tasks require reasoning about free-space affordances: discovering volumes where an extended rigid tool can safely navigate, complementary to surface contact affordances for grasping. Robotic stowing is a canonical instance, where a blade must sweep items aside inside cluttered fabric bins to create insertion space. Production stow systems generate millions of such episodes, but standard approaches with unimodal data infer affordances as SE(3) pose distributions, a geometric question asked in the wrong domain. VulcanVoxel keeps inference spatial: a masked autoencoder over 3D occupancy fields reconstructs blade occupancy conditioned on scene geometry, computing feasibility locally at each voxel and recovering multi-modal predictions from unimodal data. Blade affordances are spatial objects, subsets of 3D space defined by geometric feasibility. Pose parameters carry no structure for reasoning whether unobserved placements are feasible, and standard generative objectives including flow matching faithfully learn the unimodal distribution produced by execution policies and cannot recover geometric alternatives. Trained on 10,000 real warehouse stow episodes without human annotation, VulcanVoxel achieves top-5 coverage of 0.89 versus 0.71 for the best pose-based baseline, with a distilled student providing RGB-to-voxel inference in 30 ms. vs. 1.4 s. for voxel-to-voxel. We have released a dataset of real blade insertion cycles with RGB-D observations and pose trajectories at https://www.armbench.com/blade_insertion. html.
zh_title: 在杂乱堆放场景中学习用于叶片插入的3D示能表示
translation: 许多操作任务需要对自由空间示能（free-space affordances）进行推理：发现延伸的刚性工具可以安全导航的空间体积，这与用于抓取的表面接触示能相辅相成。机器人堆叠是一个典型的例子，其中叶片必须在杂乱的织物箱内将物品扫到一边，以创造插入空间。生产堆叠系统会产生数百万个这样的片段，但使用单模态数据的标准方法将示能推断为SE(3)姿态分布，这是一个在错误领域中提出的几何问题。VulcanVoxel保持了推理的空间性：一个基于3D占据场的掩码自编码器在场景几何的约束下重建叶片占据情况，在每个体素处局部计算可行性，并从单模态数据中恢复多模态预测。叶片示能是空间对象，是由几何可行性定义的3D空间的子集。姿态参数不携带用于推理未观察到的放置是否可行的结构，包括流匹配在内的标准生成目标忠实地学习了执行策略产生的单模态分布，无法恢复几何替代方案。在没有人工标注的10,000个真实仓库堆叠片段上进行训练后，VulcanVoxel实现了0.89的Top-5覆盖率，而最佳的基于姿态的基线方法为0.71；此外，一个蒸馏后的学生模型提供了30毫秒的RGB到体素推理，而体素到体素的推理需要1.4秒。我们已经发布了一个包含RGB-D观测和姿态轨迹的真实叶片插入周期数据集，网址为 https://www.armbench.com/blade_insertion.html。
tldr: 本文提出了VulcanVoxel，一种基于3D占据场的掩码自编码器方法，用于在杂乱堆放中学习叶片插入的3D空间示能，避免了传统SE(3)姿态估计的局限性，实现了高精度、多模态且极快速的实时推理。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于跳出了传统的将示能（affordances）建模为SE(3)姿态分布的局限，而是将其视为3D空间中的几何实体，直接在3D占据场上进行空间推理。这种方法巧妙地解决了标准生成模型无法从单模态执行数据中恢复多模态几何替代方案的问题。同时，利用知识蒸馏技术将推理时间缩短至30毫秒，使其非常适合实时机器人控制，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 在机器人堆叠任务中，传统的示能推理方法将可行空间预测为SE(3)姿态分布，这在几何推理上是不合适的，因为姿态参数无法反映未观察到的放置是否可行，且标准的生成目标（如流匹配）容易陷入单模态分布，无法恢复几何上的替代方案。
method: 提出了VulcanVoxel方法：利用基于3D占据场的掩码自编码器，在给定场景几何的条件下重建叶片的占据状态，从而在每个体素（voxel）上局部计算可行性，并从单模态数据中恢复多模态预测。此外，还通过知识蒸馏（distilled student）实现了快速的RGB到体素推理。
results: 在10,000次真实仓库堆叠事件的训练下，VulcanVoxel实现了0.89的Top-5覆盖率，显著优于最佳姿态基线方法的0.71。此外，蒸馏后的学生模型提供了仅需30毫秒的RGB到体素推理，而体素到体素的推理则需要1.4秒。研究团队还发布了相关的真实数据集。
conclusion: 将叶片插入的示能推理保持在空间域（基于3D体素占据场）比将其建模为SE(3)姿态更有效。该方法不仅能更好地处理多模态几何可行性，还能通过知识蒸馏在保证高覆盖率的同时实现极快的实时推理速度。

title: ETALE: Evolving Topology with Accelerated Lock-free Execution for Dynamic Graph ANN Search on GPUs
authors: Dongfang Zhao
abstract: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes on the GPU are originally built for static collections and must reconstruct the affected window to absorb any update, while the dynamic graph indexes that update incrementally run on the CPU and cannot exploit GPU parallelism. This paper presents a new ANN index, namely ETALE (Evolving Topology with Accelerated Lock-free Execution), which is among the first GPU-native graph ANN indexes to support streaming insertion and deletion without a global rebuild. The core of ETALE is a lock-free copy-on-write slab graph whose deletion state and adjacency share a single atomically published word, which yields a provable deletion-monotonicity invariant together with a bounded reclaim of GPU memory that is sublinear in accumulated deletions. We have implemented ETALE in CUDA and evaluate it on five diverse multimodal datasets against four state-of-the-art indexes: Tagore (GPU static, SIGMOD'26), DIGRA (CPU dynamic, SIGMOD'26), CAGRA (GPU static, ICDE'24), and HNSW (CPU dynamic, TPAMI'20). Under continuous churn, ETALE maintains the index in hundreds of milliseconds per round at recall above $0.95$, which is $4.8$--$8.8\times$ faster than CAGRA's per-window rebuild, $1.8$--$2.5\times$ faster than the more recent Tagore, and $3.3$--$147\times$ faster than the CPU dynamic indexes. In addition, the memory footprint of ETALE stays bounded where tombstone-only systems grow indefinitely.
zh_title: ETALE：用于 GPU 上动态图 ANN 搜索的带加速无锁执行的演进拓扑索引
translation: GPU 上的基于图的近似最近邻 (ANN) 索引最初是为静态集合构建的，必须重建受影响的窗口以吸收任何更新，而增量更新的动态图索引运行在 CPU 上，无法利用 GPU 的并行性。本文提出了一种新的 ANN 索引，即 ETALE（具有加速无锁执行的演进拓扑），它是首批支持流式插入和删除而无需全局重建的 GPU 原生图 ANN 索引之一。ETALE 的核心是一个无锁写时复制平板图，其删除状态和邻接关系共享一个原子发布的字，这产生了一个可证明的删除单调性不变量，以及相对于累积删除次数呈次线性的 GPU 内存回收。我们用 CUDA 实现了 ETALE，并在五个不同的多模态数据集上与四种最先进的索引进行了评估：Tagore（GPU 静态，SIGMOD'26）、DIGRA（CPU 动态，SIGMOD'26）、CAGRA（GPU 静态，ICDE'24）和 HNSW（CPU 动态，TPAMI'20）。在持续变动下，ETALE 在召回率高于 0.95 的情况下，每轮维护索引仅需数百毫秒，这比 CAGRA 的每窗口重建快 4.8-8.8 倍，比更新的 Tagore 快 1.8-2.5 倍，比 CPU 动态索引快 3.3-147 倍。此外，ETALE 的内存占用保持在有限范围内，而仅使用墓碑机制的系统内存占用会无限增长。
tldr: ETALE 是一种首创的 GPU 原生动态图 ANN 索引，通过无锁写时复制机制实现流式增删，在保持高召回率的同时，更新速度比现有方案快数倍且内存占用可控。
ai_comments: 该论文针对GPU上动态图ANN搜索面临的性能瓶颈，提出了一种创新性的无锁写时复制机制，成功解决了动态更新与GPU并行性之间的矛盾，在保持高召回率的同时显著提升了更新速度，具有极高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的 GPU 图 ANN 索引主要针对静态数据集，更新时需要重建索引，开销巨大；而现有的动态索引多运行在 CPU 上，无法充分利用 GPU 的大规模并行计算能力。
method: 提出了一种名为 ETALE 的 GPU 原生图 ANN 索引，采用无锁写时复制（copy-on-write）平板图结构，将删除状态和邻接表合并在单个原子发布字中，并实现了一种次线性内存回收机制。
results: 在五种多模态数据集上的实验表明，ETALE 在持续更新场景下，能够以超过 0.95 的召回率在数百毫秒内完成更新，比现有最先进的 GPU 静态重建索引快 4.8-8.8 倍，比 CPU 动态索引快 3.3-147 倍，且内存占用保持稳定。
conclusion: ETALE 证明了在 GPU 上实现高性能、动态可更新的图 ANN 索引是可行的，通过创新的无锁机制，在处理高频数据流时实现了比现有静态重建方法和 CPU 动态方法更优的性能与内存效率。

title: DELTAVID: Enhancing Fine-Grained Spatiotemporal Perception with Cross-Video Differences
authors: Yankai Yang, Yancheng Long, Bin Wen, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao, Han Li, Shuo Yang
abstract: Video multimodal large language models have made strong progress on open-ended video understanding, but they still lack precise local spatiotemporal perception. When two videos share almost the same global semantics and differ only in a short time span or a small region, current models often fail to find the change and provide reliable evidence. We propose DELTAVID, a verifiable proxy-task framework that enhances fine-grained spatiotemporal perception with cross-video differences. The key idea is to turn cross-video spot-the-difference into a trainable perception signal, where a model identifies local changes, judges temporal boundaries, and organizes spatial evidence by comparing similar videos. To make this signal scalable to train and reliable to evaluate, we further introduce DELTAVID-10K and DELTAVID-Bench, which convert controllable local differences in real videos into evidence-labeled training and test samples. Experiments show that DELTAVID substantially improves performance on cross-video difference understanding and transfers the learned local evidence ability to general video understanding benchmarks, including MMVU, MLVU, Video-MME, VideoHolmes, VideoMMMU, LVBench, TempCompass, and LongVideoBench. These results show that cross-video differences are not only an effective way to diagnose fine-grained perception failures, but also a scalable proxy supervision that moves Video MLLMs from coarse semantic understanding toward fine-grained spatiotemporal evidence reasoning.
zh_title: DELTAVID：利用跨视频差异增强细粒度时空感知
translation: 视频多模态大模型在开放式视频理解方面取得了巨大进展，但它们仍然缺乏精确的局部时空感知能力。当两个视频共享几乎相同的全局语义，仅在短时间跨度或小区域内存在差异时，当前模型往往无法发现这些变化并提供可靠的证据。我们提出了DELTAVID，这是一个可验证的代理任务框架，通过跨视频差异增强细粒度时空感知。其核心思想是将跨视频的“找不同”转化为一种可训练的感知信号，模型通过比较相似视频来识别局部变化、判断时间边界并组织空间证据。为了使该信号具备可扩展的训练和可靠的评估能力，我们进一步引入了DELTAVID-10K和DELTAVID-Bench，将真实视频中可控的局部差异转化为带有证据标签的训练和测试样本。实验表明，DELTAVID显著提升了模型在跨视频差异理解上的表现，并将学到的局部证据能力迁移到了包括MMVU、MLVU、Video-MME、VideoHolmes、VideoMMMU、LVBench、TempCompass和LongVideoBench在内的通用视频理解基准上。这些结果表明，跨视频差异不仅是诊断细粒度感知缺陷的有效途径，也是一种可扩展的代理监督方法，推动视频多模态大模型从粗粒度语义理解向细粒度时空证据推理演进。
tldr: 针对视频多模态大模型难以捕捉细微时空变化的问题，DELTAVID提出了一种通过“跨视频找不同”来训练模型进行精细化时空推理的框架及数据集。
ai_comments: 该论文通过“找不同”这一代理任务，巧妙地解决了当前视频多模态大模型（Video MLLMs）在细粒度时空感知上的不足。其创新点在于将对比学习与具体的时空证据推理相结合，并提供了高质量的数据集支持，为模型从粗粒度语义理解向细粒度推理转型提供了切实可行的方法。
motivation: 当前视频多模态大模型在处理全局语义相似但局部时空存在细微差异的视频时，往往无法准确定位变化或提供可靠证据，缺乏细粒度的时空感知能力。
method: 提出了DELTAVID框架，通过跨视频“找不同”任务训练模型识别局部变化、判断时间边界并组织空间证据；同时构建了DELTAVID-10K训练集和DELTAVID-Bench测试集，将真实视频中的局部差异转换为带标签的证据样本。
results: DELTAVID显著提升了模型对跨视频差异的理解能力，并将这种细粒度证据推理能力成功迁移至MMVU、MLVU、Video-MME等多个通用视频理解基准测试中，表现优异。
conclusion: DELTAVID通过跨视频差异学习，有效提升了视频多模态大模型的细粒度时空感知能力，并能将其泛化至各类通用视频理解任务中，是迈向更精细、可解释视频理解的重要一步。

title: Enabling Fast, Efficient, and Low-Cost Genomic and Metagenomic Analyses via Storage-Centric System Designs
authors: Nika Mansouri Ghiasi, Onur Mutlu
abstract:
Due to the challenges of analyzing and storing massive volumes of genomic and metagenomic sequence data, significant efforts have been made to accelerate (meta)genomic analyses and store sequence data compressed. Despite the benefits of these techniques, we identify two major outstanding problems in accessing stored sequence data and supplying it to the analysis units: (i) the data movement bottleneck due to moving large amounts of low-reuse data from storage and the unnecessary burden on the rest of the system, and (ii) the data preparation bottleneck, where compressed sequence data needs to be first decompressed and formatted before analysis.
  We present customized storage-centric systems, which efficiently (i) analyze (meta)genomic data inside storage, and (ii) enable highly-compressed storage and high-performance access of large-scale sequence data, thereby alleviating the overheads of data movement, computation, and data preparation. First, we introduce GenStore, an in-storage processing system that filters genomic data not requiring expensive computation directly inside storage. Second, we propose MegIS, an in-storage processing system that significantly reduces the data movement overhead of metagenomic analysis. Third, we introduce GRAINS, a storage-centric system for analysis on large-scale (meta)genomic graphs in storage. Fourth, we propose SAGe, an algorithm-architecture co-design for highly-compressed storage and high-performance access of sequence data.
  We demonstrate that the proposed systems significantly (e.g., by one to two orders of magnitude) improve performance, energy efficiency, and cost-efficiency, all at the same time. We hope these systems facilitate broader adoption of (meta)genomics and inspire research on other data-intensive domains in health and life sciences.

In the same venue, a completely different paper (arXiv:2606.22685) presents our vision for computer architecture for health- and life science-related applications. No AI or LLM help was used in creating this work. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2606.22685
zh_title: 通过以存储为中心的系统设计实现快速、高效且低成本的基因组和宏基因组分析
translation:
由于分析和存储海量基因组及宏基因组序列数据面临的挑战，人们在加速（宏）基因组分析和压缩存储序列数据方面做出了巨大努力。尽管这些技术带来了诸多益处，但我们发现在访问存储的序列数据并将其提供给分析单元时，仍存在两个主要的突出问题：（i）由于从存储中移动大量低重用性数据而导致的数据移动瓶颈，这给系统其余部分带来了不必要的负担；（ii）数据准备瓶颈，即压缩的序列数据在分析前需要先进行解压缩和格式化。
我们提出了定制的以存储为中心的系统，这些系统能够高效地：（i）在存储内部对（宏）基因组数据进行分析，以及（ii）实现大规模序列数据的高压缩存储和高性能访问，从而减轻数据移动、计算和数据准备的开销。首先，我们引入了 GenStore，这是一种近存储处理系统，可直接在存储内部过滤掉不需要昂贵计算的基因组数据。其次，我们提出了 MegIS，这是一种近存储处理系统，可显著降低宏基因组分析的数据移动开销。第三，我们引入了 GRAINS，这是一种用于在存储中对大规模（宏）基因组图进行分析的以存储为中心的系统。第四，我们提出了 SAGe，这是一种针对序列数据高压缩存储和高性能访问的算法-架构协同设计。
我们表明，所提出的系统同时显著提高了性能、能效和成本效益（例如，提高了一到两个数量级）。我们希望这些系统能促进（宏）基因组学的更广泛采用，并启发健康和生命科学中其他数据密集型领域的研究。
tldr: 提出了一系列以存储为中心的系统设计（GenStore、MegIS、GRAINS和SAGe），通过在存储内处理和优化数据访问，将（宏）基因组分析的性能和能效提升了一到两个数量级。
ai_comments: 该研究非常具有前瞻性和实用价值。它敏锐地指出了传统计算架构在处理海量生物信息数据时的痛点——数据搬运和预处理开销。通过提出GenStore、MegIS等一系列针对特定任务（过滤、宏基因组、图分析、高压缩）定制的近存储计算系统，展现了极强的软硬件协同设计能力。这种“以存储为中心”的范式不仅大幅提升了基因组分析效率，也为未来解决其他数据密集型科学计算（如大模型、图计算）的I/O瓶颈提供了重要参考。
motivation: 面对海量（宏）基因组序列数据的分析与存储挑战，现有技术存在两大突出瓶颈：一是由于从存储中移动大量低重用率数据导致的数据移动瓶颈，给系统带来了不必要的负担；二是由于压缩数据在分析前需要先解压和格式化导致的数据准备瓶颈。
method: 提出了一系列定制的以存储为中心的系统，包括：（1）GenStore：在存储内直接过滤无需复杂计算的基因组数据的近存储处理系统；（2）MegIS：减少宏基因组分析中数据移动开销的近存储处理系统；（3）GRAINS：在存储中分析大规模（宏）基因组图的系统；（4）SAGe：用于高压缩存储和高性能访问的算法-架构协同设计。
results: 所提出的系统在性能、能效和成本效益方面均实现了显著提升，通常可达到一到两个数量级的改善。
conclusion: 这些以存储为中心的系统能够促进（宏）基因组学的更广泛应用，并为健康和生命科学等其他数据密集型领域的研究提供启发。

title: Do Diabetic Foot Ulcer Segmentation Models Generalize? A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of CNN and Transformer Architectures
authors: Abderrahmane Benfatah
abstract: Deep learning models for diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) segmentation routinely report high accuracy, but they are almost always trained and tested on the same dataset, leaving their behaviour on data from a different clinical source largely unmeasured. We benchmark three representative segmentation architectures -- U-Net and DeepLabV3+ (convolutional) and SegFormer-B2 (Transformer) -- under an identical, leakage-screened protocol: training on the combined FUSeg/AZH wound data and evaluating, without fine-tuning, on two independent external datasets (DFUC2022 and Medetec). All models achieve strong in-domain performance (Dice 0.80--0.83) but degrade substantially across datasets. The degradation is, however, architecture-dependent: SegFormer-B2 generalizes best on both external sets (DFUC2022 Dice 0.557, Medetec Dice 0.786), outperforming both convolutional models, while the more complex DeepLabV3+ generalizes worse than the simpler U-Net. Per-image failure analysis on 2,160 images across both external test sets confirms that SegFormer-B2 produces the fewest catastrophic failures on DFUC2022 (31.1%), compared with U-Net (38.5%) and DeepLabV3+ (43.0%). The consistent ranking across two independent external sources, confirmed by Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (p < 0.001 on both datasets), indicates that architecture family, not model complexity, drives cross-hospital generalization.
zh_title: 糖尿病足溃疡分割模型具有泛化能力吗？卷积神经网络与Transformer架构的跨数据集基准测试
translation: 深度学习糖尿病足溃疡（DFU）分割模型通常报告出高准确率，但它们几乎总是在相同数据集上进行训练和测试，导致它们在来自不同临床来源的数据上的表现很大程度上未被测量。我们在一个相同的、经过泄露筛查的协议下对三种代表性的分割架构——U-Net和DeepLabV3+（卷积）以及SegFormer-B2（Transformer）——进行了基准测试：在合并的FUSeg/AZH伤口数据上进行训练，并在两个独立的外部数据集（DFUC2022和Medetec）上进行评估（无需微调）。所有模型在域内均取得了强大的性能（Dice 0.80--0.83），但在跨数据集时性能显著下降。然而，这种下降是与架构相关的：SegFormer-B2在两个外部数据集上泛化效果最好（DFUC2022 Dice 0.557，Medetec Dice 0.786），优于两种卷积模型，而更复杂的DeepLabV3+比简单的U-Net泛化效果更差。对两个外部测试集上2,160张图像的逐图故障分析证实，与U-Net（38.5%）和DeepLabV3+（43.0%）相比，SegFormer-B2在DFUC2022上产生的灾难性故障最少（31.1%）。通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验（两个数据集上p < 0.001）确认，在两个独立外部来源上的一致排名表明，架构族而非模型复杂度驱动了跨医院的泛化。
tldr: 研究发现Transformer架构在糖尿病足溃疡分割的跨数据集泛化性能上优于CNN架构，且架构类型是影响泛化效果的关键因素。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了医学图像分割模型在跨数据集场景下的泛化能力瓶颈，强调了模型架构（Transformer vs CNN）而非模型复杂度对泛化性能的关键影响。其创新点在于通过严格的交叉验证流程揭示了Transformer架构在处理临床数据异质性方面的优势。
motivation: 当前的糖尿病足溃疡分割模型多局限于单一数据集的评估，缺乏对跨临床来源数据集泛化能力的系统性研究。
method: 在FUSeg/AZH数据集上训练U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer-B2三种模型，并在未经过微调的情况下，在DFUC2022和Medetec两个独立外部数据集上进行性能评估和交叉对比分析。
results: 所有模型在域内表现良好，但在跨数据集测试中性能显著下降；SegFormer-B2表现出最优的泛化能力，且产生灾难性故障的比例最低。
conclusion: 在糖尿病足溃疡分割任务中，Transformer架构（SegFormer-B2）在跨数据集泛化性能上显著优于CNN架构，且模型架构类型是影响泛化能力的核心因素。

title: Interpretable machine learning predicts Parkinson's disease severity using motion-corrected QSM MRI and multiband multiecho fMRI features
authors: Aixa X. Andrade
abstract:
Introduction: Objective neuroimaging biomarkers may improve Parkinson's disease motor assessment by capturing brain variation not directly observable from clinical examination. We used interpretable machine learning to predict current motor severity, measured by MDS-UPDRS Part III, from QSM and multiband multi-echo resting-state fMRI-derived ReHo features.
  Methods: Regional QSM and ReHo features were extracted from 28 participants, including 24 individuals with Parkinson's disease and 4 controls. Thirteen feature-set experiments evaluated imaging-only, clinical-only, imaging-plus-clinical, full, reduced, and multimodal inputs. Support vector regression, Elastic Net, Random Forest, and XGBoost models were trained using nested cross-validation. Performance was assessed using pooled held-out R^2, RMSE, MAE, Pearson correlation, permutation testing, and the proportion of participants predicted within +/-5 MDS-UPDRS Part III points.
  Results: Imaging-only models carried meaningful predictive signal, whereas the clinical-only model performed weakly. Full fMRI, full QSM, and clinical variables provided the strongest global fit, explaining 45.4% of variance in motor severity. Selected QSM plus clinical variables produced the most clinically close predictions, with 75.0% of participants predicted within +/-5 points and the lowest MAE among top-performing models. SHAP highlighted cerebellar, thalamic, striatal, insular, and motor cortical features.
  Conclusion: QSM and multiband multi-echo fMRI-derived ReHo capture distinct, interpretable dimensions of Parkinson's disease motor severity. These findings show that structural and functional imaging contribute differently depending on the clinical prediction goal.

zh_title: 使用运动校正的QSM MRI和多波段多回波fMRI特征，利用可解释机器学习预测帕金森病严重程度
translation: 引言：客观的神经影像生物标志物可以通过捕捉临床检查中无法直接观察到的脑部变化，从而改善帕金森病的运动评估。我们利用可解释的机器学习，通过QSM和多波段多回波静息态fMRI衍生的ReHo特征，预测了以MDS-UPDRS第三部分衡量的当前运动严重程度。方法：从28名参与者（24名帕金森病患者和4名对照组）中提取了区域QSM和ReHo特征。通过13个特征集实验评估了仅成像、仅临床、成像加临床、全特征、简化特征和多模态输入。使用嵌套交叉验证训练了支持向量回归、弹性网络、随机森林和XGBoost模型。通过汇总的留出法R^2、RMSE、MAE、皮尔逊相关性、置换检验以及预测在+/-5分MDS-UPDRS III以内的参与者比例来评估性能。结果：仅成像模型携带了有意义的预测信号，而仅临床模型表现较弱。完整的fMRI、QSM和临床变量提供了最强的全局拟合，解释了45.4%的运动严重程度方差。选定的QSM加临床变量产生了最接近临床的预测，75%的参与者预测在+/-5分以内，且在表现最好的模型中MAE最低。SHAP分析突出了小脑、丘脑、纹状体、脑岛和运动皮层的特征。结论：QSM和多波段多回波fMRI衍生的ReHo捕捉到了帕金森病运动严重程度的不同且可解释的维度。这些发现表明，结构和功能成像根据临床预测目标的不同有不同的贡献。
tldr: 研究通过整合QSM和fMRI成像特征，利用可解释机器学习模型成功预测帕金森病患者的运动严重程度，为临床评估提供了客观的神经影像参考。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了QSM（定量磁化率成像）和多波段多回波fMRI的ReHo特征，并利用可解释性机器学习（SHAP）揭示了神经影像特征在预测帕金森病运动严重程度中的具体贡献。局限性在于样本量较小（28名参与者），且对照组人数极少，未来需要更大规模的研究来验证其临床普适性。
motivation: 现有的临床检查无法直接观察到所有脑部变化，旨在通过客观的神经影像生物标志物来改善帕金森病运动严重程度的评估。
method: 研究对28名参与者进行QSM和ReHo特征提取，构建了包含影像学、临床以及多模态输入的13种特征集实验。利用支持向量回归、弹性网络、随机森林和XGBoost等模型进行训练，并通过嵌套交叉验证及多项指标（R^2, RMSE, MAE, Pearson相关性等）评估性能，最后使用SHAP进行可解释性分析。
results: 成像数据包含重要的预测信号，结合临床变量后效果更佳。最佳模型解释了45.4%的运动严重程度方差，其中QSM加临床变量在临床预测精度上表现最优，75%的参与者预测误差在+/-5分以内。SHAP分析指出小脑、丘脑、纹状体、脑岛和运动皮层特征对预测贡献显著。
conclusion: QSM和fMRI衍生的ReHo特征能捕捉到帕金森病运动严重程度的不同且可解释的维度，证明了多模态影像在辅助临床评估中的潜力和差异化价值。

title: Reliability-Aware Monocular Depth Supervision for Sparse-View Neural Reconstruction
authors: Wei-Teng Chu, Yashasvini Gopalan, Changju Yuan
abstract: Sparse-view neural reconstruction is challenging in outdoor driving scenes, where cameras usually move along a narrow forward-facing trajectory and provide limited multi-view overlap. Although monocular depth estimators can provide dense geometric priors, their predictions are noisy, and not uniformly reliable across image regions. In this work, we study monocular depth supervision for sparse-view neural reconstruction. We use Depth Anything V2 as a dense monocular depth prior, align its predictions to metric depth using scale-shift fitting, and apply depth supervision selectively through photometric masks generated from an RGB-only baseline model. We evaluate this strategy on two representative scene representations: Mip-NeRF-360 and Splatfacto. On KITTISeq02 under an every2 sparse-view setting, masked monocular depth supervision gives only marginal rendering gains for Mip-NeRF-360 and does not improve metric geometry. In contrast, Splatfacto benefits more clearly, improving PSNR from 14.903 to 15.932 and reducing RMSE from 0.542 to 0.100. Additional KITTISeq05 experiments and matched-ratio mask ablations further show that the gains for Splatfacto come from selecting reliable low-error regions rather than simply reducing the number of depth-supervised pixels. Additional experiments on the Bicycle scene show that depth supervision can improve geometry while hurting RGB rendering quality when multi-view coverage is already strong. Overall, our results suggest that monocular depth priors are useful for under-constrained sparse-view reconstruction, but should be applied selectively and with moderate weighting.
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. All authors contributed equally
zh_title: 稀疏视角神经重建中的可靠性感知单目深度监督
translation: 稀疏视角神经重建在户外驾驶场景中具有挑战性，其中相机通常沿着狭窄的前向轨迹移动，并提供有限的多视角重叠。尽管单目深度估计器可以提供密集的几何先验，但其预测是嘈杂的，并且在图像区域中并非均匀可靠。在这项工作中，我们研究了稀疏视角神经重建的单目深度监督。我们使用Depth Anything V2作为密集的单目深度先验，通过尺度-偏移拟合将其预测与度量深度对齐，并通过从仅RGB基线模型生成的光度掩码选择性地应用深度监督。我们在两种代表性场景表示上评估了这种策略：Mip-NeRF-360和Splatfacto。在KITTISeq02的每2个稀疏视角设置下，掩码单目深度监督对Mip-NeRF-360的渲染增益微乎其微，并且没有改善度量几何。相比之下，Splatfacto受益更明显，PSNR从14.903提高到15.932，RMSE从0.542降低到0.100。额外的KITTISeq05实验和匹配比例掩码消融进一步表明，Splatfacto的增益来自选择可靠的低误差区域，而不仅仅是减少深度监督的像素数量。在Bicycle场景上的额外实验表明，当多视角覆盖已经很强时，深度监督可以改善几何，但会损害RGB渲染质量。总的来说，我们的结果表明，单目深度先验对于欠约束的稀疏视角重建是有用的，但应选择性地应用并采用适度的权重。
tldr: 本文研究了稀疏视角神经重建中单目深度监督的应用，发现结合可靠性感知选择性监督可以显著改善Splatfacto的性能，尤其是在几何方面，但对Mip-NeRF-360的提升不明显。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了可靠性感知的单目深度监督策略，通过选择性地应用深度监督来提高稀疏视角神经重建的性能。其重要性在于为解决户外驾驶场景中稀疏数据下的三维重建问题提供了有效途径，尤其是在几何精度方面。论文的局限性在于该方法对不同神经渲染模型的提升效果不一致，且在某些情况下可能损害渲染质量，这提示未来研究需进一步探索更普适且鲁棒的监督策略。
motivation: 在户外驾驶场景中，由于相机运动轨迹狭窄且多视角重叠有限，稀疏视角神经重建具有挑战性。尽管单目深度估计器可以提供密集的几何先验，但其预测存在噪声且在图像区域间可靠性不均匀。因此，需要研究如何有效地利用单目深度监督来解决稀疏视角重建的挑战。
method: 本文使用Depth Anything V2作为密集单目深度先验，通过尺度-偏移拟合将其预测与度量深度对齐。然后，通过从仅RGB的基线模型生成的光度掩码选择性地应用深度监督。该策略在Mip-NeRF-360和Splatfacto两种场景表示上进行了评估。
results: 在KITTISeq02的每2个稀疏视角设置下，掩码单目深度监督对Mip-NeRF-360的渲染增益微乎其微，并且没有改善度量几何。相反，Splatfacto受益更明显，PSNR从14.903提高到15.932，RMSE从0.542降低到0.100。额外的KITTISeq05实验和匹配比例掩码消融进一步表明，Splatfacto的增益来自选择可靠的低误差区域，而不仅仅是减少深度监督的像素数量。在Bicycle场景上的额外实验表明，当多视角覆盖已经很强时，深度监督可以改善几何，但会损害RGB渲染质量。
conclusion: 单目深度先验对于欠约束的稀疏视角重建是有用的，但应选择性地应用并采用适度的权重。

title: MLSYSIM: First-Principles Infrastructure Modeling for Machine Learning Systems
authors: Vijay Janapa Reddi
abstract: As machine learning shifts from laboratory curiosity to critical infrastructure, the systems that sustain it span an extraordinary range, from sub-milliwatt microcontrollers to multi-gigawatt datacenter fleets. Reasoning across this range is hard: empirical profiling requires the target hardware in hand, while cycle-accurate simulation costs hours per configuration, leaving no tool for rapid, full-stack architectural reasoning. We present MLSYSIM (Machine Learning Systems Infrastructure Modeling), a first-principles analytical framework that formalizes the "physics of systems" into a dimensionally-strict Python engine. MLSysim is built on a demand-supply abstraction that decouples computational demand from silicon supply and environmental context, and it enforces unit integrity at runtime so the silent conversion errors that plague ad-hoc modeling cannot occur. Every input is drawn from a typed, provenance-tracked registry, so no number enters an analysis without a documented source. On this engine we codify a taxonomy of 22 "Systems Walls" resolved by 28 composable models and solvers, enabling sub-second design-space exploration that identifies binding constraints and synthesizes ideal hardware specifications across the entire ML systems lifecycle.
zh_title: 机器学习系统基础设施建模：面向机器学习系统的第一性原理基础设施建模
translation: 随着机器学习从实验室的好奇心转变为关键基础设施，支撑它的系统范围极其广泛，从亚毫瓦的微控制器到十亿瓦特的数据中心集群。跨越这个范围进行推理是困难的：经验分析需要实际的目标硬件，而周期精确模拟则需要数小时的配置时间，这使得快速、全栈架构推理的工具变得稀缺。我们提出了MLSYSIM（机器学习系统基础设施建模），一个第一性原理分析框架，将“系统物理学”形式化为一个维度严格的Python引擎。MLSysim建立在供需抽象之上，将计算需求与硅供应和环境背景分离开来，并在运行时强制执行单元完整性，因此困扰随意建模的无声转换错误不会发生。每个输入都来自一个类型化、可追溯来源的注册表，因此没有数字会在没有记录来源的情况下进入分析。在这个引擎上，我们编码了22个“系统墙”的分类，这些分类由28个可组合的模型和求解器解决，实现了亚秒级的设计空间探索，识别了约束条件，并合成了跨越整个ML系统生命周期的理想硬件规格。
tldr: MLSYSIM是一个第一性原理分析框架，通过解耦计算需求、硅供应和环境背景，实现对机器学习系统跨越微控制器到数据中心的全栈架构进行亚秒级设计空间探索。
ai_comments: MLSYSIM提供了一种创新的方法来解决机器学习系统设计中的复杂性，通过第一性原理建模和亚秒级的设计空间探索，有望加速和优化从边缘设备到数据中心的各种ML硬件的开发。其对单元完整性和数据来源的严格要求，提高了建模的准确性和可靠性。
motivation: 机器学习系统日益复杂，从微控制器到数据中心，需要一种能够快速进行全栈架构推理的工具，以克服传统方法（如硬件在手进行经验分析或耗时的周期精确模拟）的局限性。
method: MLSYSIM是一个基于第一性原理的分析框架，采用维度严格的Python引擎，建立在解耦计算需求与硅供应和环境背景的供需抽象之上。它通过类型化、可追溯来源的注册表输入，并强制执行单元完整性，利用22个“系统墙”的分类和28个可组合模型/求解器，实现亚秒级设计空间探索。
results: MLSYSIM能够实现亚秒级的设计空间探索，识别约束条件，并合成跨越整个机器学习系统生命周期的理想硬件规格。
conclusion: MLSYSIM通过第一性原理建模，为跨越不同规模的机器学习系统提供了一种快速、全栈的架构推理和设计空间探索方法。

title: How many labels do you need? A decision framework for cross-habitat marine species recognition
authors: Alzayat Saleh, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi
abstract:
Automated image recognition is increasingly used to scale ecological monitoring beyond manual annotation, yet ecologists lack evidence-based guidance on how much labelling effort reliable deployment at new sites requires. We present a decision framework quantifying the trade-off between labelling effort and recognition accuracy when transferring vision systems across marine habitats. The benchmark spans five datasets, three oceans, and three taxonomic groups (fish, corals, invertebrates), from tropical reefs in the Great Barrier Reef and French Polynesia to a temperate Danish fjord. We evaluated four recognition models (DINOv2, CLIP, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B4) under four adaptation strategies (linear probing, LoRA, Visual Prompt Tuning, full fine-tuning) across three protocols: within-habitat transfer across 20 reef sites (240 runs), cross-dataset geographic transfer along a difficulty gradient (40 runs), and few-shot adaptation curves with 0-100 labelled samples per class (648 runs). Frozen self-supervised foundation features (DINOv2 + linear classifier, 1,538 trainable parameters) generalised to unseen reef sites at least as well as fully fine-tuned convolutional baselines four orders of magnitude larger; they learned species-diagnostic, habitat-invariant representations, whereas baselines encoded habitat-specific shortcuts that fail at new sites. As few as 10-20 labelled images per species sufficed to deploy reliable recognition at a new site, cutting annotation effort by roughly an order of magnitude.
  Solution. Programmes expanding to new sites can deploy reliable recognition by pairing a frozen, open foundation model (DINOv2) with a simple linear classifier and annotating only 10-20 images per species - roughly 1-4 hours per site. The framework lets programmes budget labelling effort against expected accuracy across sites, ecosystems, and platforms.
comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary appendix
zh_title: 你需要多少标注？一种用于跨生境海洋物种识别的决策框架
translation: 自动化图像识别正越来越多地用于扩展超越人工标注的生态监测，但生态学家缺乏基于证据的指导，即在新的地点进行可靠部署需要多少标注工作量。我们提出了一个决策框架，量化了在海洋生境间迁移视觉系统时，标注工作量与识别准确率之间的权衡。该基准跨越了5个数据集、3个海洋和3个分类群（鱼类、珊瑚、无脊椎动物），从大堡礁和法属波利尼西亚的热带礁石到丹麦的温带峡湾。我们评估了4种识别模型（DINOv2、CLIP、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B4）在4种适配策略（线性探测、LoRA、视觉提示微调、全微调）下的表现，并采用了3种协议：20个礁石点内的跨生境迁移、沿难度梯度的跨数据集地理迁移，以及每个类别0-100个标注样本的少样本适配曲线。冻结的自监督基础特征（DINOv2 + 线性分类器，1,538个可训练参数）在未见过的礁石点上的泛化能力至少与大四个数量级的全微调卷积基线一样好；它们学习了物种诊断性的、生境不变的表征，而基线则编码了在新地点失效的生境特定捷径。每个物种仅需10-20张标注图像就足以在新地点部署可靠的识别，将标注工作量减少了大约一个数量级。解决方案：扩展到新地点的项目可以通过将冻结的开放基础模型（DINOv2）与简单的线性分类器配对，并仅为每个物种标注10-20张图像（每个地点约1-4小时）来部署可靠的识别系统。该框架使项目能够根据不同地点、生态系统和平台，权衡标注工作量与预期准确率。
tldr: 研究发现，利用冻结的DINOv2模型配合每个物种仅10-20张的标注样本，即可实现高效、可靠的跨生境海洋物种自动识别。
ai_comments: 该研究通过实证分析为生态学家提供了极具价值的指导，解决了自动物种识别在跨生境迁移中“需要多少标注数据”这一核心痛点。其创新之处在于证明了冻结的自监督预训练模型（如DINOv2）在捕获物种诊断特征方面的优势，有效避免了传统模型对生境特定特征的依赖，为大规模生态监测提供了高效、经济的解决方案。
motivation: 生态学家在将自动图像识别系统部署到新地点时，缺乏关于需要多少标注工作量才能保证识别可靠性的实证指导。
method: 构建了一个涵盖5个数据集、3个海洋和3个分类群的评估框架，对比了4种识别模型（DINOv2, CLIP, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B4）在4种适配策略下的表现，并进行了跨生境迁移、跨数据集地理迁移及少样本适配曲线的实验。
results: 冻结的DINOv2基础模型在跨生境识别中表现优异，其仅需极少量参数即可达到甚至超过全微调的大型卷积模型的性能；仅需每个物种10-20张图片即可实现可靠部署，将标注工作量减少了一个数量级。
conclusion: 研究表明，利用冻结的DINOv2基础模型配合简单的线性分类器，仅需每个物种10-20张标注图片即可实现可靠的跨生境物种识别，显著降低了生态监测的标注成本。

title: Inpainting U-Net for seamless pedestrian-level wind prediction across urban morphologies
authors: Jingzi Huang, Claire E. Heaney, Tao Li, Xinzhe Li, Graham O. Hughes, Maarten van Reeuwijk
abstract: Pedestrian-level wind prediction is essential for urban design and wind-comfort assessment, but high-fidelity simulations such as LES remain computationally expensive for rapid evaluation. This study develops a two-stage U-Net framework for efficient prediction of time-averaged pedestrian-level wind speed over realistic urban morphologies. The model is trained and evaluated using the UrbanTALES dataset, which contains realistic city configurations under different approaching wind directions. In the first stage, a baseline U-Net model (M1) predicts wind fields patch-by-patch from normalised building height and fetch information. This formulation allows application to urban domains of arbitrary size, but independent patch inference can introduce discontinuities at patch boundaries. To address this, a second U-Net model (M2) is introduced as an inpainting-based refinement model. M2 uses a larger contextual window containing the initial M1 prediction and local morphology to reduce discontinuities using neighbouring flow information. During full-field inference, M2 is applied iteratively using a Gauss-Seidel scheme until convergence. Results show that M1 captures the main spatial distribution of pedestrian-level wind speed and performs well in low- and moderate-velocity regions, although high-velocity peaks are less accurate. M2 substantially reduces patch-boundary artefacts and improves spatial coherence. Across unseen urban cases, the framework reproduces mean velocity and spatial variability reasonably well, while maximum velocities remain underestimated. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and flexible surrogate model for high-resolution pedestrian-level wind prediction across realistic urban morphologies.
zh_title: 基于图像修复U-Net的跨城市形态无缝行人高度风速预测
translation: 行人高度风速预测对于城市设计和风舒适度评估至关重要，但大涡模拟（LES）等高保真度模拟在进行快速评估时计算成本仍然过高。本研究开发了一个两阶段的U-Net框架，用于高效预测实际城市形态上随时间平均的行人高度风速。该模型使用UrbanTALES数据集进行训练和评估，该数据集包含不同来流风向下的实际城市配置。在第一阶段，基线U-Net模型（M1）根据归一化的建筑物高度和fetch（风区）信息，逐块（patch-by-patch）预测风场。这种构建方式允许应用于任意大小的城市区域，但独立的分块推理可能会在分块边界处引入不连续性。为了解决这个问题，引入了第二个U-Net模型（M2）作为基于图像修复的精细化模型。M2使用包含初始M1预测和局部形态的更大上下文窗口，利用邻近的流动信息来减少不连续性。在全场推理期间，M2使用Gauss-Seidel方案迭代应用直至收敛。结果表明，M1捕获了行人高度风速的主要空间分布，并在中低流速区域表现良好，尽管高流速峰值的准确度较低。M2实质上减少了分块边界的伪影并提高了空间连贯性。在未见过的城市案例中，该框架能较好地重现平均速度和空间变异性，而最大速度仍被低估。总的来说，所提出的框架为跨实际城市形态的高分辨率行人高度风预测提供了一个高效且灵活的代理模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段U-Net框架，通过结合图像修复技术和迭代算法，实现了高效、无缝且适用于任意尺寸城市形态的行人高度风速预测。
ai_comments: 该论文创新地将图像修复（Inpainting）技术与Gauss-Seidel迭代方案相结合，巧妙地解决了深度学习模型在对大区域进行分块预测时常见的边界不连续性（伪影）问题。其局限性在于对高流速峰值的预测仍不够准确，未来可能需要结合物理信息神经网络（PINN）或对抗损失来进一步优化极值预测。
motivation: 行人高度风预测对于城市设计和风舒适度评估非常重要，但传统的大涡模拟（LES）等高保真度模拟计算成本极高，无法满足快速评估的需求。
method: 提出一个两阶段的U-Net框架：第一阶段（M1）基于归一化建筑高度和风区信息进行逐块（patch-by-patch）风场预测，以适应任意尺寸的城市区域；第二阶段（M2）作为图像修复精细化模型，利用更大的上下文窗口并采用Gauss-Seidel方案进行迭代计算，以消除分块边界的不连续性。
results: 第一阶段模型（M1）能较好地捕获中低流速区域的风速空间分布，但对高流速峰值的预测不够准确；第二阶段模型（M2）显著减少了分块边界的伪影，提高了风场预测的空间连贯性。尽管最大风速仍被低估，但框架在未见过的城市案例中表现出了良好的平均流速和空间变异性重现能力。
conclusion: 该两阶段U-Net框架为实际城市形态下的高分辨率行人高度风速预测提供了一种高效、灵活且高空间连贯性的代理模型，能够大幅降低计算成本。

title: Attention Dynamics in Diffusion Models: A Visual Analytics Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
authors: Yiran Xiao, George Legrady
abstract: Diffusion-based text-to-image models can synthesize complex and highly structured visual content, yet the emergence and evolution of semantic structure remain difficult to interpret. Many existing workflows rely on aggregated attention or scalar summaries that separate temporal change from image-space evidence. To address this gap, we present a visual analytics framework for exploring attention dynamics in diffusion models: the step-indexed evolution of token-level cross-attention maps, their temporal concentration, and their spatial relationships. Our approach enables structured analysis of attention behavior across generation steps by integrating quantitative measures with data-driven stage identification in an interactive workflow. Case studies on a structured 60-prompt Stable-Diffusion-class benchmark illustrate recurring, interpretable patterns within this setting and show how linked temporal and spatial views facilitate the observation and discussion of generative processes, supporting more effective human-AI collaboration.
zh_title: 扩散模型中的注意力动力学：用于人机协同的视觉分析框架
translation: 基于扩散的文本到图像模型能够合成复杂且高度结构化的视觉内容，然而其语义结构的出现和演变仍然难以解释。许多现有的工作流依赖于聚合注意力或标量总结，这使得时间变化与图像空间证据相分离。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个用于探索扩散模型中注意力动力学的视觉分析框架：包括词元级交叉注意力图的步进式演化、它们的时间聚集度以及它们的空间关系。我们的方法通过在交互式工作流中将定量测量与数据驱动的阶段识别相结合，实现了对跨生成步骤的注意力行为的结构化分析。在结构化的60提示词Stable Diffusion类基准上的案例研究展示了在此设置下循环出现的、可解释的模式，并表明了关联的时间和空间视图如何促进对生成过程的观察和讨论，从而支持更有效的人机协同。
tldr: 本文提出了一个视觉分析框架，通过整合步进式交叉注意力图演化、时空关系及定量测量，帮助用户探索和解释扩散模型中的注意力动力学，从而促进更有效的人机协同。
ai_comments: 本文针对扩散模型黑盒特性中的“注意力演变”问题，提出了一个创新性的可视化分析框架。将时间维度的步进变化与空间维度的注意力图相结合，为理解生成式AI的内部机制提供了直观且结构化的工具。其重要性在于推动了可解释AI（XAI）在生成模型中的应用，不过其局限性可能在于对非专业用户而言，理解和操作复杂的交互式视觉界面仍存在一定的学习门槛。
motivation: 基于扩散的文本到图像模型虽然能合成复杂的视觉内容，但其语义结构的出现和演化过程难以解释。现有的分析方法多依赖于聚合注意力或标量总结，这割裂了时间变化与图像空间证据之间的联系。
method: 提出一种用于探索扩散模型注意力动力学的视觉分析框架。该方法在交互式工作流中将定量测量与数据驱动的阶段识别相整合，分析词元级交叉注意力图的步进式演化、它们的时间聚集度以及空间关系。
results: 在包含60个结构化提示词的Stable Diffusion类基准上进行了案例研究，结果展示了在生成过程中循环出现的、可解释的模式，并证明了关联的时间和空间视图能有效促进对生成过程的观察与讨论。
conclusion: 该框架通过关联的时间和空间视图，促进了对生成过程的观察和讨论，从而支持了更有效的人机协同。

title: Entropy-Coded MS-VQ-VAE with Learned Priors for Ultra-Low Bitrate Video Compression
authors: Manikanta Kotthapalli, Banafsheh Rekabdar
abstract:
Learned video codecs based on continuous latent representations struggle to operate reliably below 0.1 bits per pixel~(bpp): without a differentiable rate signal, Lagrangian optimisation cannot effectively trade reconstruction quality for bitrate at extreme compression ratios. We demonstrate that discrete latent representations sidestep this limitation entirely. In a vector-quantized~(VQ) codec, the codebook size~$K$ imposes a hard information ceiling of $\log_2 K$ bits per symbol; a learned autoregressive prior then exploits the non-uniform distribution of code usage -- which we show follows a power law -- to push actual bitrates well below this ceiling, without any rate-penalty tuning.
  Building on the MS-VQ-VAE architecture introduced in~\cite{kotthapalli2026msvqvae}, we sweep $K \in \{128, 256, 512, 1024\}$ under a uniform training protocol to trace four operating points on the rate-distortion~(RD) curve. We identify and resolve a critical training instability: gradient-based VQ collapses catastrophically at $K \leq 512$, whereas EMA-stabilised codebook updates with dead-code restart maintain full utilisation across all configurations. On 500 UCF101 test clips ($64\!\times\!64$, 32~frames), our models operate at 0.043-0.064~bpp -- 3.3-5$\times$ below H.264's practical floor and $5$-$7.6\times$ below H.265's floor at this resolution. Every MS-VQ-VAE configuration outperforms H.265 CRF\,36 on perceptual quality (LPIPS) despite using $5$-$7.6\times$ fewer bits. At $K{=}1024$, the model surpasses H.265 CRF\,36 on LPIPS by a margin of 0.072 absolute while using $5.1\times$ fewer bits. Codebook analysis confirms power-law index distributions and 70-85\% entropy efficiency, establishing the pipeline as a principled learned entropy coder.
zh_title: 具有学习先验的熵编码MS-VQ-VAE用于超低比特率视频压缩
translation: 基于连续潜在表示的学习视频编解码器在低于0.1 bits per pixel (bpp) 时难以可靠运行：由于缺乏可微的速率信号，拉格朗日优化无法在极高压缩比下有效地权衡重建质量与比特率。我们证明了离散潜在表示完全规避了这一限制。在矢量量化 (VQ) 编解码器中，代码本大小 $K$ 强制设定了每个符号 $\log_2 K$ 比特的硬信息上限；随后，学习到的自回归先验利用代码使用频率的非均匀分布（我们证明其遵循幂律）将实际比特率推至该上限之下，且无需任何速率惩罚调整。基于 MS-VQ-VAE 架构，我们在统一训练协议下对 $K \in \{128, 256, 512, 1024\}$ 进行了测试，以追踪速率-失真 (RD) 曲线上的四个操作点。我们识别并解决了关键的训练不稳定性：基于梯度的 VQ 在 $K \leq 512$ 时会发生灾难性崩溃，而带有死码重启的 EMA 稳定代码本更新在所有配置下都保持了充分的利用率。在 500 个 UCF101 测试片段（64×64，32 帧）上，我们的模型运行在 0.043-0.064 bpp，比特率比 H.264 的实际下限低 3.3-5 倍，比 H.265 的下限低 5-7.6 倍。尽管比特率减少了 5-7.6 倍，但每个 MS-VQ-VAE 配置在感知质量 (LPIPS) 上均优于 H.265 CRF 36。在 $K=1024$ 时，该模型在感知质量上以 0.072 的绝对优势超过了 H.265 CRF 36，同时比特率降低了 5.1 倍。代码本分析证实了幂律索引分布和 70-85% 的熵效率，确立了该流水线作为一种有原则的学习型熵编码器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散潜在表示和自回归先验的视频编码框架，在极低比特率（<0.1 bpp）下实现了优于H.265的感知质量，解决了极低带宽下的压缩难题。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地利用离散潜在表示（VQ）规避了连续潜在表示在极低比特率下难以进行拉格朗日优化的痛点。通过引入自回归先验和EMA稳定化更新机制，在超低比特率（<0.1 bpp）下实现了显著的性能提升，且在感知质量上大幅超越了传统的H.265编码器，为极低带宽视频传输提供了有力的解决方案。
motivation: 现有基于连续潜在表示的学习视频编码器在极低比特率（<0.1 bpp）下难以有效优化，缺乏可微的速率信号，导致重建质量与比特率的权衡困难。
method: 基于MS-VQ-VAE架构，利用离散潜在表示规避连续表示的优化限制；引入学习的自回归先验以利用代码使用频率的幂律分布；采用EMA稳定化代码本更新及死码重启策略以解决训练不稳定性。
results: 在UCF101数据集上，模型在0.043-0.064 bpp下运行，比特率比H.264低3.3-5倍，比H.265低5-7.6倍，且在感知质量（LPIPS）上全面超越H.265 CRF 36。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于学习先验的熵编码MS-VQ-VAE框架，通过离散潜在表示和自回归建模，成功在超低比特率下实现了优于传统编码器（H.264/H.265）的感知质量，证明了其作为高效、有原则的视频压缩方案的潜力。

title: Double-Helix Active Geometry: LiDAR-Anchored Multi-View Depth with Selective Abstention
authors: Jinwen Wen
abstract: Consumer depth sensors such as the LiDAR scanner on recent iPhones provide metric range, but their useful range is short and their returns are sparse. We present DH-Active, a lightweight, training-free geometry back-end that treats the sensor as a metric ruler rather than the sole source of depth. Near-field returns anchor the metric relative pose of two views through PnP; visually trackable samples without a valid depth return are then triangulated under that pose. A parallax/reprojection gate abstains wherever the geometry is ill-conditioned, leaving an explicit hole and a selective score instead of forcing an estimate. The measured core front end, including spiral sampling, sparse back-projection, and hole taxonomy but excluding preprocessing and multi-view recovery, runs at 1.11 ms median latency on CPU (OpenCV using 14 threads), about 38 times faster than a DINOv2-L visual branch on GPU in our timing setup. Across two iPhone captures and the public TUM RGB-D and ARKitScenes benchmarks, held-out depth is recovered at 1.4 to 6.7 percent median relative error. In a controlled ARKitScenes protocol that uses only returns within 2 m to set scale and an independent laser scan as ground truth, DH-Active achieves 64.2 percent scene-median coverage of evaluable far-field candidates at 13.4 percent scene-median relative error; direct triangulation from the device trajectory is not usable. We also report the alternatives that failed in our tests: single-frame defocus, classical focus-stack depth, defocus-LiDAR fusion, point-to-point ICP over a good visual-inertial track, and attention-to-holes resampling. A 1.26 B learned model remains more accurate after oracle scale alignment. The contribution here is narrower: metric sparse depth, explicit abstention, zero learned parameters, and near-millisecond CPU cost.
zh_title: 双螺旋主动几何：基于LiDAR锚定与选择性弃权的多视图深度估计
translation: 诸如新款iPhone上的LiDAR扫描仪等消费级深度传感器虽然能提供度量范围，但其有效距离短且返回数据稀疏。我们提出了DH-Active，这是一个轻量级、无需训练的几何后端，它将传感器视为度量标尺，而不是唯一的深度来源。通过PnP算法，近场返回数据锚定了两个视角的度量相对位姿；随后，在已知位姿下对没有有效深度返回但视觉可追踪的样本进行三角测量。视差/重投影门控机制在几何条件不佳时选择弃权，留下明确的空洞和选择性得分，而不是强行进行估计。该测量核心前端在CPU上（使用14线程的OpenCV）的中间延迟为1.11毫秒，比我们测试设置中GPU上的DINOv2-L视觉分支快约38倍。在两次iPhone采集以及公开的TUM RGB-D和ARKitScenes基准测试中，保留深度的恢复中位数相对误差在1.4%到6.7%之间。在一个受控的ARKitScenes协议中（仅使用2米以内的返回数据来设定尺度，并以独立的激光扫描作为地面真实值），DH-Active在13.4%的场景中位数相对误差下，实现了64.2%的场景中位数可评估远场候选点覆盖率；而直接从设备轨迹进行三角测量是不可用的。我们还报告了在测试中失败的替代方案：单帧散焦、经典对焦堆栈深度、散焦-LiDAR融合、基于良好视觉惯性跟踪的点对点ICP以及针对空洞的注意力重采样。一个12.6亿参数的学习模型在Oracle尺度对齐后仍然更准确。本文的贡献更聚焦：度量稀疏深度、显式弃权、零学习参数以及近毫秒级的CPU成本。
tldr: 一种无需训练、超轻量级的实时深度估计方法，利用LiDAR作为度量标尺，在CPU上仅需1毫秒即可完成高精度深度恢复。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种无需训练、轻量级的几何后端方法（DH-Active），通过将LiDAR作为度量标尺而非唯一深度来源，极大地提高了计算效率。其“选择性弃权”机制有效地处理了不确定性，是实时AR应用的一个实用且高效的解决方案，优于许多复杂的深度学习模型。
motivation: 现有消费级LiDAR传感器存在作用距离短、数据稀疏的问题，而现有的深度估计方法往往计算成本过高，无法满足移动设备实时处理的需求。
method: 提出了DH-Active框架，利用LiDAR的近场数据通过PnP算法确定视角间的度量相对位姿，对无深度信息的视觉样本进行三角测量，并引入视差/重投影门控机制进行选择性弃权。
results: 在CPU上实现了1.11毫秒的极低延迟，比GPU上的视觉模型快38倍；在多个基准测试中，中位数相对误差控制在1.4%至6.7%之间，并能有效处理远场深度估计。
