title: FDR-Occ: Factorized Dense Routing for Full-Spectrum 3D Occupancy Prediction
authors: Dubing Chen, Huan Zheng, Tianyi Yan, Yucheng Zhou, Runzhou Tao, Zhongying Qiu, Jianfei Yang, Jianbing Shen
abstract: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction fundamentally relies on the 2D-to-3D view transformation. Current paradigms predominantly utilize explicit physical projection, which artificially restricts the routing matrix to strict, sparse camera rays. While computationally efficient, this imposes a severe Locality Bottleneck, preventing the network from constructing holistic contextual understanding and degrading sharply when camera extrinsics are unreliable or absent. To break this bottleneck, we abstract view transformation as unconstrained bipartite routing and propose Factorized Dense Routing (FDR). By approximating dense 2D-to-3D mixing through hierarchical tensor contractions, FDR guarantees a fully-global receptive field with tractable, sub-quadratic complexity. Crucially, the mandatory spatial contraction in dense routing exposes a fundamental Resolution-Context Trade-off. To address this, we introduce a Resolution-Context Decoupled Architecture. We factorize the 3D space into a global macroscopic topological anchor (via FDR) and precise local geometric planes (via explicit projection). This decoupling enables global semantic inference and exact surface localization to complement each other without mutual compromise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Occ3D-nuScenes and Occ3D-Waymo benchmarks. More notably, in an uncalibrated setting where physical extrinsics are withheld, our global routing internalizes the implicit multi-camera rig topology and exhibits substantially stronger structural robustness than physical-projection baselines under the same protocol.

title: DualView: Preventing Indirect Prompt Injection in Personal AI Agents
authors: Juhee Kim, Woohyuk Choi, Taehyun Kang, Youngmin Kim, Byoungyoung Lee
abstract:
Personal AI agents that run on the user's local machine, such as OpenClaw, automate daily tasks including web search, email, and file management. Their access to computer resources, including the network, file system, and shell, exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks. Prior Dual LLM defenses block IPI by replacing untrusted data with symbols that the agent can reference but not read. However, they track untrusted data only inside the agent's context, so when the agent saves and later rereads untrusted data, that data, possibly an attacker's prompt, can return as trusted data rather than as a symbol, which we call stored IPI.
  Operating on the user's real environment, which humans and programs share, is what makes agents like OpenClaw practical, and is exactly why a defense that ignores it is incomplete. Preserving symbols in such an environment is hard, because humans and programs need original data. We present DualView, which extends untrusted data tracking from the agent's context to the user's environment, including the file system, shell, network, and other agents, by giving each channel two views. In AgentView, the agent sees untrusted data as symbols even after writing it out and reading it back, blocking stored IPI, while HumanView preserves original data for humans and tools. DualView routes each tool call to the right view and synchronizes data across the two views. DualView deploys as an OpenClaw plugin using only tool hooks, without changing the agent's tool-call logic or tool implementations. Since DualView isolates untrusted data by design, its protection is not limited to known attack templates. In our evaluation on an IPI benchmark and PinchBench, DualView blocked every IPI attack, including stored IPI, while keeping utility close to the unprotected baseline.

title: Q-TriM: Question-Guided Tri-Modal Attention for Audio-Visual Question Answering
authors: SungHun Kim, SeungJun Baek
abstract: Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) extends classical VQA by requiring joint reasoning over video and synchronized audio. However, many AVQA systems rely on deeply stacked layers of self- and cross attention across text, video, and audio. Such sequential stacking may incur loss of information such as subtle inter-modal cues over the layers, causing errors to accumulate across sequential attention layers during the fusion. We introduce Q-TriM which performs multi-modal fusion in a shallow and parallel manner instead of a deep and sequential manner. For Q-TriM, we propose a novel framework for attention operation incorporating video and audio conditioned on text. As a result, we obtain not only standard cross attention outputs but also Tri-Modal Attention representations in which Query, Key, and Value come from distinct modalities. These attention representations are combined in parallel at a single stage, thus avoiding the multi-modal fusion with deep stacks in order to mitigate error accumulation and depth-induced issues. Q-TriM achieves state-of-the-art performance on three AVQA benchmarks, including substantial gains on MUSIC-AVQA-R, which demonstrates its robustness and out-of-distribution generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/Sunghun95/Q-TriM

title: Discretisation of Eulerian nonlinear elasticity and diffusion using gradient flows
authors: Andrea Zafferi, Dirk Peschka
abstract: In this study, we introduce a general energy-based modelling approach for viscous poroelastic materials that feature diffusive transport in both Lagrangian and Eulerian frames. Our research produces refined weak formulations by using the reference map concept within the Eulerian configuration. We propose and implement a novel structure-preserving discretisation strategy, utilising mixed finite element methods. This paper highlights the spatial and temporal numerical convergence of our methods through a comparative analysis of Lagrangian and Eulerian schemes, thereby proving the robustness and usability of our approach. Furthermore, in the context of Eulerian multiphase flow, specifically of the quasi-static Euler-Euler type, our study demonstrates the existence of solitary fluid waves within poroviscoelastic media. This energy-based approach forms a basis for a deeper understanding of thermodynamical modelling and corresponding discretisation schemes for coupled poroelasticity, flow, and diffusion.

title: ObjRetarget: An Object-Aware Motion Retargeting Framework with Anthropomorphic Arm Constraints and Polyhedral Hand Modeling
authors: Yuanchuan Lai, Qing Gao, Ziyan Liang, Junjie Hu, Zhaojie Ju
abstract: Learning robot dexterous manipulation from human manipulation videos requires reliably retargeting human intent to executable robot actions while maintaining stable hand-object contact, which remains a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing retargeting methods often ignore explicit contact modeling or rely on reinforcement learning, resulting in limited accuracy and generalization. To address this, we propose ObjRetarget, a human-to-robot motion retargeting framework for learning robot dexterous manipulation from human videos, which integrates anthropomorphic arm trajectory constraints with structured hand-object geometric modeling. For arm motion, reference trajectories extracted from human videos are used for initialization, followed by anthropomorphic constraints and redundancy-aware optimization to generate natural and accurate movements. For hand manipulation, ObjRetarget represents multi-finger contacts using polytope clusters and preserves contact structure through geometric invariants to improve stability. Experiments on real robots show that ObjRetarget improves manipulation success rates and contact stability across multiple dexterous tasks, and generalizes well to different demonstrations, object poses, and task settings.

title: Enactive Drift Regulation and the Emergence Machine: A Framework for Coherent Adaptation Through Regulated Interaction
authors: Nicholas Davis
abstract: Adaptive systems increasingly operate in environments characterized by persistent non-stationarity, where patterns reorganize rather than merely vary. While existing approaches such as online learning, continual learning, and adaptive filtering address performance degradation under changing data distributions, they typically treat drift as noise, error, or distribution shift to be corrected. This paper argues that such framings miss a more fundamental challenge: the loss of organizational coherence over time. We introduce Enactive Drift Regulation (EDR) as a general adaptive principle that treats drift as a regulatory signal indicating breakdowns in coherence between a system's internal organization and its environment. Rather than treating prediction optimization or retraining as sufficient, EDR reframes adaptation as the regulation of structure-maintaining, reorganizing, or transitioning internal dynamics to sustain viable operation under change. We present the Emergence Machine as an architectural instantiation of EDR, organized around regimes, attractors, coherence measures, reorganization dynamics, and memory across regimes. By shifting the focus from error minimization to coherence regulation, this work provides a principled framework for long-duration adaptation under non-stationarity and offers a bridge between adaptive control and enactive accounts of cognition.

title: How Do Diffusion Classifiers Decide? A Bias-Centric Evaluation
authors: Saba Fathi, Fardin Ayar, Maryam Abdolali, Ehsan Javanmardi, Manabu Tsukada, Mahdi Javanmardi
abstract: Diffusion models have recently been repurposed for zero-shot classification, giving rise to diffusion classifiers that identify the best-matching text prompt by minimizing the noise-prediction error. Despite their growing adoption, how these models make classification decisions remains poorly understood. We introduce ASOB-Bench, a bias evaluation for diffusion classifiers along three dimensions: Attribute binding, Size-Order bias, and Background dependency. These dimensions serve not as an exhaustive taxonomy but as targeted probes of how the text-conditioned reconstruction-error score reaches a decision. Such a perspective is well studied for discriminative vision-language models, yet remains overlooked for diffusion classifiers. Extending an existing framework with five new attribute categories on newly constructed datasets, we find diffusion classifiers are less prone to attribute misbinding than an OpenCLIP baseline; on the established ComCo benchmark they are substantially more susceptible to size-order shortcuts; and on ImageNet-B they suffer far larger accuracy drops, revealing heavy reliance on background over foreground cues. Reconstruction-error heatmaps and U-Net cross-attention visualizations expose the mechanism behind each bias. Because diffusion classifiers share the same denoiser as text-to-image models, these single-pass diagnostics also point toward analogous failure modes in generation. Overall, diffusion classifiers exhibit a distinct bias profile from vision-language models, offering guidance for building more robust diffusion-based models.

title: Beyond Static Rules: Automated Discovery of Latent Vulnerabilities in Text-to-SQL
authors: Hanqing Wang, Yongdong Chi, Jian Yang, Lei Yang, Jiehui Zhao, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Text-to-SQL tasks, their deployment in real-world environments is hindered by latent reliability issues. Identifying these latent weaknesses is critical for building trustworthy database interfaces, yet current diagnostic approaches rely heavily on static, expert-defined rules, which lack the capability for systematic and automated exploration. To bridge this gap, we propose SAGE (Systematic Automated Guided Exploration), a novel framework designed to autonomously uncover latent failure patterns in LLM-based Text-to-SQL generation. Specifically, SAGE generates vulnerability hypotheses for given samples and references a continuously evolving Vulnerability Codex to design targeted perturbations, thereby iteratively verifying and documenting potential defects. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art open-source LLMs demonstrate that SAGE uncovers a substantial number of failure cases, highlighting the significant fragility of current models. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the Vulnerability Codex exhibits strong cross-model transferability, indicating that the discovered patterns represent generalized structural weaknesses. Finally, we explore SAGE's potential for remediation. Although preliminary, lightweight fine-tuning on the generated samples yields promising improvements, suggesting a scalable pathway for closing the reliability loop in future work.

title: Weave: Verified Netlist-to-Schematic Conversion via Layered Graph Layout
authors: Senol Gulgonul
abstract: Converting a SPICE netlist into a human-readable schematic is a longstanding problem in electronic design automation: simulators and machine-learning pipelines readily produce netlists, but designers reason about circuits through diagrams. Recent learning-based approaches translate netlists into schematics probabilistically, yet they provide no guarantee that the generated drawing preserves the original connectivity, and their accuracy degrades sharply as circuits grow. We present Weave, a deterministic converter that turns a SPICE netlist into an LTspice .asc schematic using a layered (Sugiyama-style) graph layout, and that certifies every output by a round-trip connectivity check: the generated schematic is re-parsed into a netlist and compared, net for net, against the input. A result is reported as correct only when the two partitions are identical, giving a binary correctness certificate rather than a similarity score. Weave runs entirely client-side as a single dependency-free file and embeds a pin table for 5093 LTspice symbols. On the identical public Circuits-LTSpice test set used by the state-of-the-art LLM converter Schemato (117 circuits, netlisted with LTspice itself), Weave achieves 100% compilation and 100% round-trip-verified connectivity equivalence, compared with Schemato's reported 76% compilation and a graph-edit-distance similarity of 0.35; notably, 73% of that set exceeds the five-component threshold beyond which Schemato reports losing connectivity accuracy. On a larger and harder corpus, the 3460 netlistable circuits of the official Analog Devices LTspice demo collection, Weave verifies exact connectivity for 88.4% of circuits, with the remaining failures concentrated in a single, well-characterized class of dense multi-pin power modules.

title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
authors: Nguyen Kim Hai Bui, Md. Easin Arafat, Tamás Gábor Orosz, Mufti Mahmud
abstract: Despite remarkable progress in machine translation, Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle on historical manuscripts, a domain that stresses core Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities: low-resource transliteration, archaic vocabulary, and noisy input signals. We present a systematic framework for evaluating the full image-to-translation pipeline on medieval Latin manuscripts, a setting in which scribal shorthand, ligatures, and parchment degradation expose failure modes that are invisible in clean-text benchmarks. Benchmarking on the CATMuS Latin dataset reveals a specialization gap: domain-specific Optical Character Recognition (OCR) models reduce character error rate by up to 4.3$\times$ compared to general-purpose VLMs, despite operating at orders of magnitude fewer parameters. We introduce the Interpres-Parallel-Corpus (IPC), a novel dataset comprising 1,383 aligned manuscript image lines, transcriptions, and expert translations, the first of its kind for medieval Latin. Our experiments uncover a complexity paradox: the simplest pipeline, a specialized OCR model feeding directly into a VLM, outperforms all multi-component variants. Adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or post-OCR correction introduces prompt saturation and error propagation that degrade aggregate translation quality. These findings offer both a new benchmark and practical guidance for deploying translation systems in low-resource historical settings.

title: Adversarial LassoNet: Robust Feature Selection via Stability-Driven Sparse Learning
authors: Zhen Huang, Peicheng Xu, Junbiao Pang, Yulong Zheng
abstract: Sparse feature selection is critical for high-dimensional machine learning, yet traditional $\ell_1$-regularized methods are often brittle under observational noise and spurious correlations, leading to unstable feature supports and degraded generalization. Although adversarial training has been widely used to improve model robustness, its interaction with hierarchical sparse feature selection remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Adversarial LassoNet (AdLNet), a stability-driven sparse feature selection framework that integrates input-space adversarial perturbations with the hierarchical sparsity mechanism of LassoNet. We derive a tractable first-order adversarial approximation under local smoothness assumptions and provide an NTK-inspired spectral analysis to characterize how perturbation-driven training can reduce gradient concentration. Experiments on high-dimensional SERS data, six public benchmark datasets, and ColoredMNIST show that AdLNet maintains competitive sparse-selection performance while improving out-of-distribution robustness by 4.4\% and feature support reproducibility by 6.3\% under nearly matched support sparsity on ColoredMNIST. On the high-dimensional lung cancer screening dataset, AdLNet achieves a 5.3\% test accuracy gain and a 6.0\% AUC improvement over vanilla LassoNet. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/719573/Adversarial-LassoNet.

title: EEG-Based Imagined Speech Decoding Using a Hybrid CNN-SNN Architecture
authors: Fatima Shalhoub, Mariam Al Mawla, Kabalan Chaccour, Iván López-Espejo, Hoda Fares
abstract: Imagined speech decoding using EEG signals has emerged as a promising frontier in brain-computer interface (BCI) research, particularly to restore communication for individuals with severe speech impairments. However, decoding imagined speech remains a complex task due to the non-stationary, low-amplitude, and highly variable nature of EEG signals. Existing methods often rely on classical machine learning or deep learning models that fail to exploit spike-based temporal dynamics or event-driven firing mechanisms of biological neurons, which are naturally modeled by spiking neural networks (SNNs). In this study, we propose a hybrid decoding pipeline that extracts temporal representations using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) followed by biologically inspired temporal classification via SNNs. To our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate SNNs into EEG-based imagined speech decoding. Experimental results show that the proposed CNN-SNN architecture achieves an accuracy of 80.13% on the 2020 BCI Competition III benchmark, surpassing existing methods reported in the literature (up to 70.19%) under comparable evaluation settings. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of spike-based temporal decoding for imagined speech, highlighting the promise of biologically grounded pipelines for next generation neuromorphic BCI applications.

title: Virtual element methods for a class of fully nonlinear elliptic PDEs
authors: Guillaume Bonnet, Andrea Cangiani, Andreas Dedner, Ricardo H. Nochetto
abstract: We study virtual element discretizations of a well-known variational formulation in $H^2$ of Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman and Isaacs equations with Cordes coefficients. We show that the use of $H^2$ conforming virtual element spaces leads to a relatively simple analysis, bypassing the need for discrete Miranda-Talenti estimates that typically arises when using nonconforming schemes. We investigate how the polynomial degree of projection operators, especially for lower order terms, affects both the error analysis and robustness of the proposed schemes. We also show the possibility of imposing weakly the Dirichlet boundary condition, which simplifies the implementation of the method in some virtual element codes. Our results are complemented by numerical experiments in which we compare the convergence of different variants of the scheme for some test problems.

title: NeSy-CSA: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Open-Ended Critical Scenario Attribution
authors: Qitong Chu, Xunjie He, Chen Deng, Huaxin Pei, Yufeng Yue
abstract: Understanding why discovered scenarios become critical in scenario-based testing is essential for effectively leveraging them in decision-making systems. Reasoning about such criticality can be formulated as an attribution problem. However, across different decision-making tasks, the causes of criticality may involve diverse state variables, interaction patterns, and failure mechanisms, making attribution an inherently open-ended problem beyond predefined explanation spaces. Existing attribution methods still struggle to balance open-ended reasoning flexibility with the interpretability and traceability required for critical scenario reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose NeSy-CSA, a neuro-symbolic framework that transforms open-ended critical scenario attribution from unconstrained explanation generation into structured and traceable reasoning. NeSy-CSA narrows the attribution space by selecting relevant factors, makes the reasoning process traceable through a dependency-aware evidence graph, and executes symbolic reasoning procedures derived from atomic operations, coordinated with evidence-constrained neural inference to support flexible open-ended attribution. We further introduce a process-level and result-level assessment module to evaluate the structural validity of the attribution process and the behavioral effectiveness of the attribution results under controlled interventions. Experiments across four decision-making environments show that NeSy-CSA improves two intervention-based measures of attribution effectiveness by 18.32% and 13.67% over LLM-based baselines. These results demonstrate its potential to transform discovered critical scenarios into reusable knowledge for subsequent testing and safety analysis.

title: ContiStain: Cross-Domain Relation-Preserving Distillation for Continual Multi-Domain Virtual IHC Staining
authors: Fuqiang Chen, Yifeng Wang, Hongpeng Wang, Yongbing Zhang
abstract: A unified multiplex virtual staining model enables scalable and non-destructive multiplex analysis from H&E slides while promoting parameter efficiency, shared pathological knowledge, and consistent cross-biomarker representations. However, in clinical practice, data for new biomarkers are typically acquired sequentially over time. Fine-tuning on such temporally arriving data leads to severe performance degradation on previously learned biomarkers, as sequential optimization disrupts the structured relationships among biomarker representations in the latent space. To address this issue, we propose ContiStain, an IHC multi-domain relational distillation framework for continual virtual staining. We first (i) construct a domain-aware structured feature space using a mixture-of-experts (MoE) feature extractor to reduce representation interference across biomarker domains. Based on this stabilized feature space, we then (ii) propose a relation-preserving distillation strategy that explicitly enforces the consistency of cross-domain token-level cosine similarity matrices between learned biomarker domains during continual adaptation. By maintaining cross-domain structural coherence, ContiStain mitigates forgetting while retaining adaptability to new domains. Experiments on the MIST dataset under a four-domain sequential virtual IHC staining setting show improved stability, reducing FID and ConchFID by 11.1 and 60.9 compared to sequential fine-tuning, enabling scalable and robust multi-domain virtual staining. Code is released at https://github.com/ccitachi/ContiStain.

title: CogRad: A Cognitively-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for Radiology Report Generation
authors: Saif Ur Rehman Khan, Hasaan Maqsood, Sebastian Vollmer, Andreas Dengel, Muhammad Nabeel Asim
abstract: Automated radiology report generation (RRG) can ease radiologist workload, yet most existing systems produce a report in a single forward pass, with no mechanism to check a claim against the image or revisit a finding once stated. We present CogRad, a cognitively inspired multi-agent framework that structures generation around four stages of a radiologist's reading process. A Scout agent discovers anatomical regions directly from image patches via slot attention and assigns region and disease-level triage scores; an Investigator agent concentrates representational capacity on the regions Scout flags as suspicious; a Writer agent compiles these signals into a disease gated visual prefix for a large language model; and a Verifier agent supervises training with a visual entailment loss and, at inference, re-examines its own draft sentence by sentence, regenerating any report it judges insufficiently grounded. On CheXpert Plus, CogRad attains a BLEU-4 of 0.316 and a CIDEr of 0.322, the best scores among the methods we compare against. On IU X-Ray, it attains a BLEU-4 of 0.201 and a CIDEr of 0.724, leading every baseline on every standard NLG metric. We further evaluate CogRad with RadGraph F1, CheXbert F1, and a hallucination analysis to assess clinical accuracy beyond standard text-overlap metrics, complemented by ablation studies and Grad-CAM-based visualizations that characterize each agent's contribution and the model's visual grounding.

title: Function-Correcting Codes for Sum-Rank Metric
authors: Santhi Kumari Kammila, B. Sundar Rajan
abstract: Function-Correcting Codes (FCCs) are a class of codes designed to protect the evaluation of a specific function of a message against channel errors at a higher level than the level of protection for the message, while requiring significantly less redundancy than conventional error-correcting codes. In this paper, we study function-correcting codes under the sum-rank metric, which is a natural generalization of both the Hamming metric and the rank-metric and also we derive general upper and lower bounds on the optimal redundancy of FCCs in the sum-rank metric. In particular, we establish a Plotkin-like bound for irregular-distance codes in sum-rank metric. Furthermore, we present explicit construction of function-correcting sum-rank metric codes (FCSRCs) for locally binary functions with optimal redundancy.

title: PRISM3D: Probabilistic Refinement and Robust Initialization for Physically Consistent Scene Modeling under Extreme Motion Blur
authors: Gopi Raju Matta, Reddypalli Trisha, Vemunuri Divya Madhuri, Kaushik Mitra
abstract: We address the inverse problem of blind 3D scene reconstruction from extremely motion-blurred images, a scenario where traditional Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines fail. Existing approaches typically circumvent this bottleneck by relying on impractical sharp-image supervision. In this work, we introduce PRISM3D, a unified framework enabling robust reconstruction directly from severely degraded inputs. To overcome the lack of a reliable starting point, we propose a Robust Initialization strategy utilizing deep dense tracking method (VGGSfM) to recover global topology where feature matching fails. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to effectively leverage this paradigm to bootstrap 3D Gaussian Splatting from extreme motion blur. However, while robust, this initialization yields sparse and noisy geometry that causes deterministic optimization to diverge. To resolve this, we propose a coupled solution driven by probability and physics: we adopt a probabilistic formulation for geometric densification via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to robustly populate the sparse priors, while simultaneously modeling physical image formation via continuous Bezier Trajectories. Furthermore, while PRISM3D establishes a highly robust standalone pipeline, the availability of complementary event streams offers an opportunity to push the reconstruction fidelity further. To exploit this, we introduce PRISM3D-E, a multi-modal (RGB + Events) extension that seamlessly integrates high-temporal-resolution events as structural priors to maximize geometric recovery. Because existing datasets lack paired event streams under such severe degradation, we concurrently contribute the PRISM3D-E Benchmark to facilitate rigorous evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that both our standalone RGB framework and its multi-modal extension establish new state-of-the-art performance.

title: A Unified Framework for Quantized and Continuous Strong Lottery Tickets
authors: Aakash Kumar, Emanuele Natale
abstract: The Strong Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (SLTH) asserts that sufficiently overparameterized, randomly initialized neural networks contain sparse subnetworks that, even without any training, can match the performance of a small trained network on a given dataset. A key mathematical tool in the theoretical study of SLTH has been the Random Subset Sum Problem (RSSP). The SLTH has recently been extended to the quantized setting, where the network weights are sampled from a discrete set rather than from a continuous interval. These new results are however far from those in arbitrary-precision setting in several ways. In this work, we provide an analysis of the RSSP in the discrete setting, and use it to derive tight SLTH guarantees in the quantized case. Our analysis obtain tight bounds on the failure probability of finding a strong lottery ticket in the quantized regime, providing an exponential improvement over previous results. Most importantly, it unifies the literature by showing that both approximate representations in the continuous setting and exact representations in quantized settings naturally emerge as limiting cases of our results. This perspective not only sharpens existing bounds but also provides a cohesive framework that simultaneously handles approximation and rounding errors.
zh_title: 量化与连续强彩票假说的统一框架
translation: 强彩票假说（SLTH）认为，足够过度参数化的随机初始化神经网络中包含稀疏子网络，这些子网络即使不经过任何训练，也能在给定数据集上达到与小型训练网络相当的性能。在SLTH的理论研究中，一个关键的数学工具是随机子集和问题（RSSP）。最近，SLTH被扩展到了量化设置，其中网络权重是从离散集合而非连续区间中采样的。然而，这些新结果在几个方面与任意精度设置下的结果相去甚远。在这项工作中，我们提供了离散设置下RSSP的分析，并利用它推导出量化情况下紧致的SLTH保证。我们的分析获得了在量化机制下寻找强彩票失败概率的紧致界限，相比先前的结果提供了指数级的改进。最重要的是，它统一了文献，表明连续设置中的近似表示和量化设置中的精确表示都自然地作为我们结果的极限情况出现。这一视角不仅收紧了现有的界限，而且提供了一个同时处理近似和舍入误差的凝聚框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，通过分析离散随机子集和问题，为量化和连续设置下的强彩票假说提供了紧致的理论保证，并将失败概率界限实现了指数级改进。
ai_comments: 该论文通过深入分析离散随机子集和问题（RSSP），成功填补了量化强彩票假说与连续强彩票假说之间的理论鸿沟。其最大创新点在于将两者统一到一个数学框架内，并实现了指数级的失败概率界限提升，这对于理解超参数化神经网络的剪枝和低比特量化具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 强彩票假说（SLTH）最近被扩展到了量化设置，但现有的量化结果与任意精度（连续）设置下的结果之间仍存在较大差距。因此，需要一个统一的框架来消除这些差距，并同时处理近似误差和舍入误差。
method: 对离散设置下的随机子集和问题（RSSP）进行了深入的数学分析，并利用该分析推导出了量化情况下紧致的强彩票假说（SLTH）保证。
results: 获得了在量化机制下寻找强彩票失败概率的紧致界限，相比先前结果实现了指数级改进。此外，证明了连续设置中的近似表示和量化设置中的精确表示均可作为该研究结果的极限情况自然呈现。
conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个统一的理论框架，不仅收紧了现有的SLTH界限，还能够同时处理近似和舍入误差，将连续和量化的强彩票假说研究进行了有机统一。

title: Approximate Dynamic Optimization via Deep Neural Operators
authors: Amin Nassaji, Ilias Mitrai, Prodromos Daoutidis
abstract: This paper addresses the solution of nonlinear dynamic optimization problems that compute optimal manipulated input profiles to enforce desired output profiles. Such trajectory optimization problems commonly arise in chemical process applications, for example, batch processes where optimal temperature or feeding profiles (in case of fed-batch processes) are calculated to enforce time-varying product quality profiles, tightly controlling the reaction rate or rate of heat generation. We propose deep neural operators that approximate function to function mappings as surrogates for the solution of such dynamic optimization problems. We specifically employ deep operator networks (DeepONets) and Fourier-enhanced DeepONets in a batch polymerization reactor case study for which number-average and weight-average molecular weight profiles, together with a final conversion target, are enforced through an optimal temperature program. Our results show that the Fourier-enhanced DeepONet architecture performs very well in approximating the solution of the dynamic optimization problem for different instances, achieving a lower prediction error compared to the standard DeepONet architecture and standard feedforward neural networks.
zh_title: 基于深度神经算子的近似动态优化
translation: 本文解决了非线性动态优化问题的求解，该问题通过计算最优的操纵输入曲线来强制执行所需的输出曲线。此类轨迹优化问题通常出现在化学过程应用中，例如间歇过程，其中需要计算最优的温度或加料曲线（在补料分批过程中）以强制执行随时间变化的产品质量曲线，从而密切控制反应速率或产热速率。我们提出了深度神经算子，它近似函数到函数的映射，以此作为此类动态优化问题求解的代理模型。我们具体在间歇聚合反应器案例研究中采用了深度算子网络（DeepONet）和傅里叶增强的DeepONet，其中通过最优温度方案来强制执行数均和重均分子量曲线以及最终转化率目标。我们的结果表明，傅里叶增强的DeepONet架构在近似不同实例的动态优化问题求解方面表现非常好，与标准DeepONet架构和标准前馈神经网络相比，实现了更低的预测误差。
tldr: 本文提出使用傅里叶增强的深度算子网络（DeepONet）作为代理模型来近似求解复杂的非线性动态优化问题，在化学反应器控制案例中取得了比传统神经网络更低的预测误差。
ai_comments: 该研究将先进的神经算子（Neural Operators）引入到化学工程中的动态优化与轨迹规划问题中，展示了算子学习在处理复杂的函数到函数（轨迹到轨迹）映射方面的巨大潜力。特别是傅里叶增强的DeepONet设计，通过捕获频域特征，显著提升了时变轨迹近似的精度，这对于需要快速响应的实时控制和在线优化具有重要的实际应用价值。不过，该方法的泛化能力以及在面对更大规模、多变量耦合的非线性系统时的计算稳定性仍需进一步探讨。
motivation: 在化学工艺等应用中，求解非线性动态优化问题（如计算最优控制输入轨迹以满足期望的输出轨迹）计算复杂度高，因此需要开发高效的代理模型来快速近似这些复杂的函数映射关系。
method: 提出采用深度神经算子作为代理模型来近似函数到函数的映射，以求解动态优化问题。具体应用并对比了深度算子网络（DeepONet）和傅里叶增强的DeepONet（Fourier-enhanced DeepONets），并在一个间歇聚合反应器案例中，通过优化温度曲线来控制分子量分布和最终转化率。
results: 在间歇聚合反应器的案例研究中，傅里叶增强的DeepONet架构在近似动态优化问题的解方面表现极佳。与标准DeepONet架构及标准前馈神经网络相比，它实现了更低的预测误差。
conclusion: 傅里叶增强的深度神经算子（DeepONet）能够高效且高精度地近似求解非线性动态优化问题，是替代传统高计算量优化算法的有效手段。

title: Beam Hopping Low Earth Orbit Satellite Resource Allocation for Differentiated Services and Robustness Analysis under Model Attacks
authors: Shuang Zheng, Xing Zhang, Quan Z. Sheng, Haixu Wang, Wenbo Wang
abstract: Beam hopping (BH)-enabled Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites play a pivotal role in next-generation communication networks by providing global coverage, improving spectrum efficiency, and supporting flexible adaptation to heterogeneous service demands. To fully exploit these capabilities, artificial intelligence (AI) techniques are increasingly employed for dynamic resource allocation and power management. However, limited onboard resources and potential adversarial perturbations pose challenges to both efficiency and robustness. To address these issues, we leverage digital twin technology to accurately capture the spatio-temporal dynamics of user-satellite visibility, thereby providing precise state information for decision-making. Building on this, we formulate a joint optimization framework for BH scheduling and power allocation as a Markov Decision Process and propose BRIDGE, i.e., BH with Reinforcement learning incorporating Integrated Dirichlet and Gumbel-TopK Exploration, which integrates a quality of service (QoS)-driven subchannel scheduling mechanism to ensure efficient and differentiated resource allocation. The robustness of the model is systematically evaluated under three classical adversarial attacks. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior energy efficiency, service throughput, and fairness, while the robustness analysis shows stable performance under the considered bounded adversarial perturbations.
zh_title: 面向差异化服务和模型攻击下鲁棒性分析的波束跳跃低轨卫星资源分配
translation: 采用波束跳跃（BH）技术的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星在下一代通信网络中发挥着关键作用，它们能够提供全球覆盖、提高频谱效率并支持对异构服务需求的灵活适应。为了充分利用这些能力，人工智能（AI）技术正越来越多地应用于动态资源分配和功率管理。然而，有限的星载资源和潜在的对抗性扰动对效率和鲁棒性都提出了挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们利用数字孪生技术来精确捕获用户与卫星可见性的时空动态，从而为决策提供精确的状态信息。在此基础上，我们将波束跳跃调度和功率分配的联合优化框架构建为马尔可夫决策过程，并提出了BRIDGE，即结合集成Dirichlet和Gumbel-TopK探索的强化学习波束跳跃算法，该算法集成了一种服务质量（QoS）驱动的子信道调度机制，以确保高效且差异化的资源分配。在三种经典对抗攻击下系统地评估了该模型的鲁棒性。仿真结果表明，所提方法实现了优异的能源效率、服务吞吐量和公平性，同时鲁棒性分析显示，在所考虑的有界对抗扰动下，该方法表现出稳定的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合数字孪生与强化学习的BRIDGE算法，用于优化低轨卫星波束跳跃与功率分配，在实现高效差异化服务的同时，展示了对抗攻击下的强鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将数字孪生技术与强化学习（特别是引入Dirichlet和Gumbel-TopK探索的BRIDGE算法）相结合，解决了低轨卫星资源分配中的动态性和不确定性问题。此外，针对AI模型在卫星通信中可能面临的安全威胁，文章系统地分析了其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，这在卫星通信资源分配领域具有重要意义。局限性在于摘要未详细说明对抗攻击的具体类型以及在实际星载受限硬件上的部署开销。
motivation: 在利用人工智能技术进行低轨卫星动态资源分配和功率管理时，星载资源有限以及潜在的对抗性扰动对系统的运行效率和安全鲁棒性带来了严峻挑战。
method: 1. 利用数字孪生技术精确捕获用户与卫星可见性的时空动态。2. 将波束跳跃（BH）调度和功率分配的联合优化问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程。3. 提出BRIDGE方法，即融合集成Dirichlet和Gumbel-TopK探索的强化学习波束跳跃算法。4. 集成服务质量（QoS）驱动的子信道调度机制，实现差异化资源分配。5. 在三种经典对抗攻击下系统评估模型的鲁棒性。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提方法在能源效率、服务吞吐量和公平性方面均表现优异；同时，鲁棒性分析显示，在面临有界对抗扰动时，该模型依然能够保持稳定的性能。
conclusion: 所提出的BRIDGE方法能够有效应对低轨卫星资源受限和对抗性扰动带来的挑战，在保证高效差异化资源分配（高能效、高吞吐量和公平性）的同时，对有界对抗攻击具有较强的鲁棒性。

title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
authors: Yuran Chen, Xinye Cai, Zhonglin Gong, Yang Huang
abstract: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have advanced robotic visuomotor policies by modeling multimodal action distributions, but their multi-step sampling or ODE solving introduces inference latency. Existing one-step acceleration methods often compress the whole generation process into a single large update, leading to spatial deviation, frequency distortion, and mode averaging. This paper proposes a high-fidelity one-step generative visuomotor policy framework that addresses these issues with three complementary mechanisms. Recursive Consistent Action Flow (RCAF) uses recursive correction to compensate for spatial truncation errors and align one-step predictions with refined flow trajectories. Dual-Timestep Frequency Consistency (DTFC) preserves high-frequency manipulation details through adaptive spectral consistency across flow timesteps. Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM) separates entangled action flows with a margin-based repulsive objective, reducing ambiguous actions in multimodal manipulation. Experiments on RoboTwin, RoboTwin 2.0, Adroit, DexArt, and real-world robot platforms show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong 10-step generative policy baselines while requiring only one forward pass (1 NFE), enabling low-latency visuomotor control.
zh_title: 通过递归修正、频率一致性和对比流匹配的高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略
translation: 扩散模型和流匹配等生成模型通过对多模态动作分布进行建模，推进了机器人视觉运动策略的发展，但它们的多步采样或ODE求解引入了推理延迟。现有的一步加速方法通常将整个生成过程压缩为单个大更新，从而导致空间偏差、频率失真和模式均值化。本文提出了一种高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略框架，通过三种互补的机制来解决这些问题。递归一致动作流（RCAF）利用递归修正来补偿空间截断误差，并将单步预测与细化的流轨迹对齐。双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）通过跨流时间步的自适应谱一致性来保留高频操作细节。对比流匹配（CFM）使用基于边界的排斥目标来分离纠缠的动作流，从而减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。在RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt和真实世界机器人平台上的实验表明，该方法在仅需单次前向传播（1 NFE）的情况下，达到了与强10步生成策略基线竞争或更优的性能，从而实现了低延迟的视觉运动控制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种高保真的一步生成式机器人视觉运动策略，通过递归修正、频率一致性和对比流匹配，在仅需1次前向传播（1 NFE）的情况下实现了低延迟且高性能的控制。
ai_comments:
创新点：该论文通过引入递归修正（RCAF）、频域一致性（DTFC）和对比学习（CFM）三项技术，巧妙地解决了生成式机器人策略在一步生成（1 NFE）时面临的空间偏差、频率失真和多模态动作纠缠问题。
重要性：将生成式策略的推理步数压缩至1步，同时保持甚至超越10步基线的性能，这对于需要极低延迟、高频交互的真实世界机器人实时控制具有重要意义。
局限性：摘要中未提及该方法在训练阶段的计算开销（如对比学习和递归训练的复杂度），以及在面对极度复杂、长程操作任务时的鲁棒性表现。
motivation: 传统的扩散和流匹配等生成式机器人策略由于需要多步采样或求解ODE，存在较高的推理延迟。而现有的一步加速方法往往会将整个生成过程压缩为单个大更新，从而导致空间偏差、频率失真和模式均值化（无法很好处理多模态动作）。
method:
该论文提出了一种高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略框架，包含三个核心机制：
1. 递归一致动作流（RCAF）：利用递归修正补偿空间截断误差，并将单步预测与精细化的流轨迹对齐。
2. 双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）：通过跨流时间步的自适应谱一致性，保留高频操作细节。
3. 对比流匹配（CFM）：采用基于边界的排斥目标分离纠缠的动作流，减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。
results: 在RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt以及真实世界机器人平台上的实验表明，该方法仅需单次前向传播（1 NFE），即可取得与强10步生成式策略基线相当或更优的性能，显著降低了视觉运动控制的延迟。
conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略框架，通过创新的三项机制克服了一步生成方法的常见缺陷，在保证极低推理延迟（1 NFE）的同时，实现了与多步生成策略相当或更优的控制性能。

title: Rethinking Scientific Discovery in an Agentic Era
authors: Yining Zheng, Yuxin Wang, Jiahao Lu, Shicheng Fang, Weiyi Wang, Yongzhuo Yang, Bowen Li, Haochen Ma, Chen Hu, Bowen Chen, Yang Wang, Huanhui Chen, Yitong Chen, Jiajun Chen, Zhiyuan Li, Yanlin Li, Zhuo Yang, Qifeng Wu, Jiaying He, Zhijie Jinluo, Xiaohu Xu, Yi Feng, Juncheng Qian, Yizhou Chen, Yang Cheng, Tong Zhu, Tianlei Ying, Hongyu Yu, Hongjun Xiang, Xipeng Qiu
abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced scientific discovery, but most AI4Science systems remain fragmented tools that rely on humans to coordinate problem formulation, literature grounding, model use, simulation, validation, and knowledge reuse. This paper presents \textbf{SCION (Scientific Collaborative Innovation with Agentic Organizational Nexus)}, an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an \textbf{organizational nexus}. Through a Science Agent serving as a \textbf{Meta-Harness}, SCION connects scientific tasks, tools, agents, artifacts, and memory, transforming research into an executable, auditable, and reusable operational process. At its core is the \textbf{Research Execution Plan (REP)}, which compiles high-level scientific intent into staged objectives, dependencies, verification checkpoints, tool requirements, expected artifacts, and fallback conditions. SCION further integrates hierarchical multi-agent execution, profile-driven specialization, selective context construction, governed delegation, and layered epistemic memory to support long-horizon scientific work. We formulate discovery under SCION as \textbf{Target-conditioned Inverse Search} and extend it to hidden-target settings through batch active search under finite experimental budgets. Applications in materials analysis, molecule design, and protein or antibody screening, together with experiments on scientific reading, idea generation, molecule generation, and antibody screening, show that SCION outperforms existing autonomous research-agent baselines, especially in decomposition, verification, refinement, and memory reuse. Overall, SCION shifts AI from isolated tools toward a coordinated operational layer for traceable and reusable scientific innovation.
zh_title: 重新思考智能体时代下的科学发现
translation: 人工智能已经推动了科学发现，但大多数AI4Science系统仍然是碎片化的工具，依赖人类来协调问题构建、文献奠基、模型使用、模拟、验证和知识重用。本文提出了SCION（基于智能体组织枢纽的科学协同创新系统），这是一个充当“组织枢纽”的智能体科学操作系统。通过一个作为“元装具”（Meta-Harness）的科学智能体，SCION连接了科学任务、工具、智能体、制品和记忆，将研究转化为可执行、可审计和可重用的操作过程。其核心是研究执行计划（REP），它将高层科学意图编译为阶段性目标、依赖关系、验证检查点、工具需求、预期制品和退路条件。SCION进一步集成了分层多智能体执行、档案驱动的专业化、选择性上下文构建、受控授权和分层认识记忆，以支持长周期的科学工作。我们将SCION下的发现过程表述为“目标条件逆向搜索”，并在有限的实验预算下，通过批次主动搜索将其扩展到隐秘目标设置中。在材料分析、分子设计、蛋白质或抗体筛选中的应用，以及在科学阅读、创意生成、分子生成和抗体筛选上的实验表明，SCION的性能优于现有的自主研究智能体基线，尤其是在分解、验证、细化和记忆重用方面。总的来说，SCION将人工智能从孤立的工具转变为一个用于可追踪和可重用科学创新的协同操作层。
tldr: 本文提出了SCION，一个将碎片化AI工具整合为可协同、可审计、可重用操作流程的智能体科学操作系统，在多项科学研究任务中显著超越了现有自主智能体基线。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将AI4Science从单一的辅助工具（如文献检索或分子生成模型）提升为系统化的“科学操作系统”（SCION），通过研究执行计划（REP）和多智能体协同架构，实现了科研全流程的自动化、标准化和可追溯性。其重要性在于为解决长周期、高复杂度的科学探索任务提供了一个可落地的系统级框架。局限性方面，由于其高度依赖多智能体协同和复杂的上下文构建，可能存在较高的计算开销，且其效果在很大程度上仍受限于底层大语言模型的规划与推理能力。
motivation: 尽管人工智能促进了科学发现，但目前大多数AI4Science系统仍是碎片化的工具，严重依赖人类来协调问题构建、文献奠基、模型使用、模拟、验证以及知识重用。
method: 提出SCION（基于智能体组织枢纽的科学协同创新系统），一个充当“组织枢纽”的智能体科学操作系统。它以科学智能体作为“元装具”（Meta-Harness），连接科学任务、工具、智能体、制品和记忆。其核心是研究执行计划（REP），将高层科学意图编译为阶段性目标、依赖关系和验证检查点；并集成了分层多智能体执行、档案驱动的专业化、选择性上下文构建、受控授权和分层认识记忆。此外，将发现过程表述为目标条件逆向搜索，并在有限实验预算下将其扩展到隐秘目标设置中。
results: 在材料分析、分子设计、蛋白质或抗体筛选等应用，以及科学阅读、创意生成、分子生成和抗体筛选的实验中，SCION的表现均优于现有的自主研究智能体基线，特别是在任务分解、验证、细化和记忆重用方面表现突出。
conclusion: SCION成功将人工智能在科学领域的应用从孤立的辅助工具，转变为一个用于可追踪和可重用科学创新的协同操作层。

title: Ghosts Beneath Textures: Texture-Relation Cues for Cross-Paradigm AI-Generated Image Detection
authors: Haoyu Wang, Yiming Qin, Zhongjie Ba, Ziping Dong, Jishen Zeng, Peng Cheng, Kui Ren
abstract: AI-generated images have proliferated rapidly, motivating extensive research. Most existing AI-generated image detectors are developed and evaluated under image-free generation paradigms, such as noise-based or text-guided generation. However, image-conditioned generation has become increasingly important in practical applications, as it enables more fine-grained control over generated content. Detecting AI-generated images across these two paradigms creates a critical cross-paradigm detection problem that has long been overlooked. To study this problem, we construct ConImageGen, a benchmark for cross-paradigm AI-generated image detection. Evaluations on ConImageGen show that existing detectors fail to generalize reliably across image-free and image-conditioned generation. To address this failure, this paper identifies a cross-paradigm forensic cue and provides a new perspective for generalized AI-generated image detection. Specifically, by suppressing semantic interference, we visualize, for the first time, semantics-irrelevant texture patterns across generation paradigms. These patterns exhibit structured local-global texture relations, indicating a generalizable form of forensic evidence. Motivated by this finding, we shift the focus from directly exploiting explicit artifacts to modeling texture relations and propose DTS-Det, a detection framework that captures and leverages such relations for generalized AI-generated image detection. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our method. DTS-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse evaluation settings, reaching 99.6% ACC on ConImageGen with a 10.5% gain over the best baseline. It also achieves 93.2%/94.1% ACC in cross-dataset evaluation on PicoBanana/RAID and maintains detection rates of 95.2%/88.1% under reconstruction attacks and black-box adversarial attacks, respectively.
zh_title: 纹理之下的魅影：跨范式AI生成图像检测的纹理关系线索
translation: AI生成的图像迅速激增，激发了广泛的研究。大多数现有的AI生成图像检测器都是在无图像生成范式（如基于噪声或文本引导的生成）下开发和评估的。然而，图像条件生成在实际应用中变得越来越重要，因为它能够对生成内容进行更细粒度的控制。在这两种范式之间检测AI生成的图像构成了一个关键的、长期被忽视的跨范式检测问题。为了研究这个问题，我们构建了ConImageGen，一个用于跨范式AI生成图像检测的基准。在ConImageGen上的评估表明，现有的检测器无法在无图像生成和图像条件生成之间可靠地泛化。为了解决这一失效问题，本文确定了一种跨范式取证线索，并为通用AI生成图像检测提供了一个新视角。具体而言，通过抑制语义干扰，我们首次可视化了跨生成范式的语义无关纹理模式。这些模式表现出结构化的局部-全局纹理关系，表明这是一种可泛化的取证证据。受此发现启发，我们将重点从直接利用显式伪影转移到建模纹理关系上，并提出了DTS-Det，这是一个捕获并利用此类关系进行通用AI生成图像检测的检测框架。广泛的实验验证了我们方法的有效性。DTS-Det在多种评估设置下实现了最先进的性能，在ConImageGen上达到99.6%的准确率（比最佳基线提升10.5%）。它在PicoBanana/RAID的跨数据集评估中也达到了93.2%/94.1%的准确率，并在重建攻击和黑盒对抗攻击下分别保持了95.2%/88.1%的检测率。
tldr: 本文构建了跨范式AI生成图像检测基准ConImageGen，并提出DTS-Det框架，通过捕捉语义无关的局部-全局纹理关系，实现了极高泛化性与鲁棒性的AI生成图像检测。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于敏锐地指出了现有AI生成图像检测器在“无图像生成”和“图像条件生成”之间的跨范式泛化缺陷，并构建了相应的基准ConImageGen。其核心贡献是通过抑制语义干扰，首次发现了跨范式通用的局部-全局纹理关系。这一发现将检测焦点从容易失效的显式伪影引向了更本质的纹理结构关系，实验结果在准确率和鲁棒性（抗重建及黑盒对抗攻击）方面均表现极其优异，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的AI生成图像检测器主要针对无图像生成范式（如基于噪声或文本引导）进行开发，而无法可靠地泛化到在实际应用中越来越重要的图像条件（image-conditioned）生成范式，导致跨范式检测性能失效。这一关键问题长期被学术界忽视。
method:
1. 构建了跨范式AI生成图像检测基准ConImageGen；
2. 提出了一种通过抑制语义干扰来可视化跨范式“语义无关纹理模式”的方法，并发现了其具有的结构化局部-全局纹理关系；
3. 提出DTS-Det检测框架，将研究重心从显式伪影转移到对这些局部-全局纹理关系的建模与利用上，以实现通用检测。
results:
1. DTS-Det在ConImageGen基准上达到了99.6%的准确率（比最佳基线提升10.5%）；
2. 在PicoBanana/RAID的跨数据集评估中分别达到93.2%和94.1%的准确率；
3. 在面对重建攻击和黑盒对抗攻击时，分别保持了95.2%和88.1%的高检测率。
conclusion: 跨范式AI生成图像检测是一个关键但长期被忽视的问题。通过抑制语义干扰并关注语义无关的局部-全局纹理关系，可以为通用且鲁棒的AI生成图像检测提供强有力的可泛化取证证据。

title: A Gradient Flow Perspective on Minimum MMD Estimation
authors: Sophia Seulkee Kang, Louis Sharrock, Xiaoyuan Cheng, François-Xavier Briol, Zonghao Chen
abstract: Minimum maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) estimation has emerged as a robust and likelihood-free alternative to maximum likelihood estimation for parameter estimation. Yet, despite its practical success, the associated optimization problem remains poorly understood, with theoretical guarantees for existing algorithms hinging on convexity assumptions that rarely hold in practice. We address this gap by proposing a preconditioned gradient descent (PGD) scheme, establishing its asymptotic \emph{global} convergence under explicit gradient-dominance and projection-residual conditions. Our approach is inspired by recent progress on MMD gradient flows, a nonparametric descent scheme on the space of probability measures. We provide extensive empirical evidence that our PGD scheme outperforms standard gradient descent across a range of challenging parameter estimation and composite hypothesis testing problems.
zh_title: 最小最大均值差异（MMD）估计的梯度流视角
translation: 最小最大均值差异（MMD）估计已成为参数估计中最大似然估计的一种鲁棒且无似然的替代方法。然而，尽管它在实践中取得了成功，但相关的优化问题仍未得到充分理解，现有算法的理论保证往往依赖于在实践中极少成立的凸性假设。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种预条件梯度下降（PGD）方案，并在显式的梯度支配和投影残差条件下确立了其渐近全局收敛性。我们的方法受到MMD梯度流最新进展的启发，MMD梯度流是概率测度空间上的一种非参数下降方案。我们提供了广泛的实证证据，表明我们的PGD方案在一系列具有挑战性的参数估计和复合假设检验问题中优于标准的梯度下降。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受MMD梯度流启发的预条件梯度下降（PGD）方案，用于解决非凸最小MMD估计问题，并证明了其全局收敛性，实证表明其性能优于标准梯度下降。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于巧妙地将非参数的MMD梯度流理论引入到参数化的最小MMD估计中，设计了预条件梯度下降（PGD）算法，并突破了传统优化算法依赖的凸性假设限制，证明了全局收敛性。这对于无似然推断和鲁棒统计领域具有重要的理论与应用价值。其潜在的局限性在于，理论收敛性所依赖的“显式梯度支配和投影残差条件”在实际复杂、高维的非凸模型中是否易于满足或验证，仍需进一步探讨。
motivation: 尽管最小最大均值差异（MMD）估计在实践中非常成功，但其相关的优化问题仍缺乏深入理解，现有算法的理论保证高度依赖于在实际中极少成立的凸性假设。本研究旨在解决这一理论与实践之间的脱节。
method: 受概率测度空间上非参数下降方案（MMD梯度流）的启发，提出了一种预条件梯度下降（PGD）方案，并在显式的梯度支配和投影残差条件下，确立了其渐近全局收敛性。
results: 大量的实证结果表明，所提出的PGD方案在一系列具有挑战性的参数估计和复合假设检验问题中，性能均显著优于标准的梯度下降算法。
conclusion: 本研究成功为非凸最小MMD估计问题提供了一种具有全局收敛保证的预条件梯度下降（PGD）算法，填补了该领域长期存在的理论空白，并在实际任务中验证了其优越性。

title: Evaluating LLM Uncertainty in Long-Form Generation Using Deterministic Ground Truth
authors: Ido Amit, Ido Galil, Ran El-Yaniv
abstract: As LLMs generate increasingly long outputs, effective uncertainty estimation must identify errors at fine-grained levels rather than discard entire responses. While such methods exist, evaluating uncertainty at any resolution (token to an entire generation) is challenging and highly sensitive to label imperfections, making zero-noise benchmarks essential; yet, long-form generation benchmarks tend to rely on fallible labels rather than deterministic ground truth. We introduce Single-answer Atomic Long-form Target (SALT), a benchmark of six procedurally generated tasks with single deterministic long textual ground truths, enabling unit-level evaluation of correctness, calibration, and ranking without external judges. Equipped with SALT, our analysis of 50+ LLMs reveals key insights: We identify which confidence functions dominate each uncertainty aspect and show that confidence ranking largely breaks at atomic resolution, even when clearer separability emerges at coarser line-level units. SALT further enables controlled atom-level interventions throughout generation, revealing two separable drivers of future errors: propagation from corrupted prefixes, dominated by global context correctness, and bounded degradation from increasing answer-context length. Finally, we demonstrate that reasoning, via Chain-of-Thought prompting or internalized through training, introduces a trade-off, improving accuracy while degrading confidence ranking. These findings directly impact risk-critical applications requiring reliable error identification and mitigation.
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Code available at https://github.com/IdoAmit198/SALT
zh_title: 使用确定性真实标签评估长文本生成中的大语言模型不确定性
translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）生成的输出越来越长，有效的不确定性估计必须在细粒度级别识别错误，而不是丢弃整个响应。虽然存在此类方法，但在任何分辨率（从词元到整个生成）下评估不确定性都是具有挑战性的，并且对标签的不完美性高度敏感，这使得零噪声基准至关重要；然而，长格式生成基准往往依赖于容易出错的标签，而不是确定性的真实标签（ground truth）。我们引入了单答案原子长格式目标（SALT），这是一个由六个程序化生成的任务组成的基准，具有单一的确定性长文本真实标签，从而无需外部裁判即可进行单元级别的正确性、校准和排序评估。借助 SALT，我们对 50 多个 LLM 的分析揭示了关键见解：我们确定了哪些置信度函数在每个不确定性方面占主导地位，并表明即使在更粗糙的行级单位上出现更清晰的可分性，置信度排序在原子分辨率下也基本失效。SALT 进一步允许在整个生成过程中进行受控的原子级干预，揭示了未来错误的两个可分离驱动因素：来自受损前缀的传播（由全局上下文正确性主导）以及来自增加的答案-上下文长度的边界退化。最后，我们证明，通过思维链提示或通过训练内化的推理引入了一种权衡，即在提高准确性的同时降低了置信度排序。这些发现直接影响了需要可靠错误识别和缓解的风险关键型应用。
tldr: 本文提出SALT基准，利用确定性真实标签评估大模型在长文本生成中的不确定性，发现推理能力虽然提高了生成准确性，但会降低置信度排序的质量。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于构建了无需外部裁判（如GPT-4或人工标注）的确定性长文本评估基准SALT，从而消除了标签噪声对不确定性评估的干扰。其重要发现（如置信度排序在原子分辨率下的失效，以及推理能力在提高准确率的同时会损害置信度排序）对于安全关键型应用中大模型的错误识别与缓解具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 随着大模型生成的文本变长，需要在细粒度层面评估其不确定性并识别错误。然而，现有的不确定性评估方法对标签缺陷高度敏感，而现有的长文本生成基准往往依赖容易出错的标签，缺乏零噪声的确定性真实标签基准。
method: 引入了SALT（单答案原子长格式目标）基准，该基准由六个程序生成的、具有单一确定性长文本真实标签的任务组成。通过SALT对50多个大模型进行分析，并在生成过程中进行受控的原子级干预。
results: 1. 识别了主导不同不确定性维度的置信度函数；2. 发现置信度排序在原子分辨率下基本失效，但在较粗的行级单位上表现出更好的可分性；3. 揭示了未来错误的两个独立驱动因素：受损前缀的传播和随答案上下文长度增加的有限退化；4. 发现推理能力（通过思维链提示或训练内化）存在权衡，即在提高准确性的同时会降低置信度排序的质量。
conclusion: SALT基准和相关发现为长文本生成中的不确定性估计提供了更准确的衡量标准，对需要高可靠性错误识别和缓解的风险关键型应用具有直接影响。

title: GeoSelect: Spatial-Program Execution for Training-Free Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
authors: Yuhang Jiang, Guohui Deng, Miaozhong Xu, Chao Ruan, Jinling Zhao, Linsheng Huang
abstract: Referring remote sensing image segmentation isolates the object named by a natural-language expression in an aerial image. Existing training-free methods resolve the expression through implicit vision-language activations or region-text similarity, which gives weak control over the spatial, comparative, and ordinal relations that dominate aerial referring: they cannot represent constructions such as the largest ship or the second court from the left. We propose GeoSelect, a training-free pipeline that reframes referring as the execution of a typed spatial program. A frozen, text-only language model synthesises the expression into a small domain-specific language, a well-formedness checker accepts the program, and a deterministic executor runs it. The central abstraction is a single scored candidate set type under which every operator composes: continuous geometric fields realise position and proximity as dense pixel-level maps, while discrete set and order operators add the extremum, ordinal, counted-union, and relational constructions that fields alone cannot express. Because execution is explicit, every intermediate program, field, and ranking is inspectable, and a reliability ladder degrades any failing program to a field-only special case, so every expression returns an answer. GeoSelect attains 58.86 mIoU on RRSIS-D test and 55.27 mIoU on RISBench test, more than twice the best prior training-free method on RRSIS-D, with no referring supervision and on a single GPU. A controlled comparison with candidates and segmenter fixed attributes the gain to explicit execution, not the backbone; an oracle decomposition localises the residual gap to detection recall on RRSIS-D and selection on RISBench, and an exposure audit confirms robustness to pretraining leakage. Code will be released upon acceptance at the project page https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoSelect/.
zh_title: GeoSelect：用于免训练指代遥感图像分割的空间程序执行方法
translation: 指代遥感图像分割旨在隔离航空图像中由自然语言表达式命名的目标。现有的免训练方法通过隐式视觉-语言激活或区域-文本相似度来解析表达式，这对于在航空指代中占主导地位的空间、比较和序数关系（它们无法表示诸如“最大的船”或“左边第二个球场”之类的结构）控制力较弱。我们提出了 GeoSelect，这是一种免训练的流水线，它将指代重构为类型化空间程序的执行。一个冻结的、纯文本的语言模型将表达式合成为一种小型领域特定语言，一个合规性检查器接受该程序，并由一个确定性执行器运行它。核心抽象是一个单一的评分候选集类型，每个算子都在其下进行组合：连续几何场将位置和邻近度实现为稠密的像素级映射，而离散集合和顺序算子则添加了场本身无法表达的极值、序数、计数并集和关系结构。由于执行是显式的，每个中间程序、场和排名都是可检查的，并且一个可靠性阶梯可以将任何失败的程序降级为仅使用场的特例，因此每个表达式都会返回一个答案。GeoSelect 在 RRSIS-D 测试集上获得了 58.86 mIoU，在 RISBench 测试集上获得了 55.27 mIoU，在 RRSIS-D 上是之前最佳免训练方法的两倍以上，且无需指代监督，仅需单张 GPU。将候选对象和分割器固定的控制对比表明，性能提升归功于显式执行，而非骨干网络；甲骨文（oracle）分解将残留差距定位在 RRSIS-D 上的检测召回率和 RISBench 上的选择上，而曝光审计证实了对预训练泄漏的鲁棒性。代码将在录用后在项目页面 https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoSelect/ 发布。
tldr: 提出 GeoSelect，一种通过将语言查询转化为特定空间程序并显式执行的免训练遥感图像指代分割方法，在无监督和单GPU下将现有免训练方法的性能提升了一倍以上。
ai_comments:
**创新性**：该论文将指代遥感图像分割任务重构为“空间程序执行”问题，利用冻结的纯文本LLM将自然语言转化为特定领域语言（DSL）程序并显式执行。这种将连续几何场与离散逻辑算子结合的设计非常新颖。
**重要性**：在无需任何指代微调和额外训练的情况下，其性能在 RRSIS-D 数据集上达到了前代免训练方法的两倍以上，显著提升了处理复杂空间、比较和序数关系（如“最大的”、“左起第二个”）的能力。
**局限性**：方法的性能高度依赖于前端检测器的召回率以及LLM程序合成的准确性；此外，对于极其复杂的非结构化场景，DSL的表达能力可能存在上限。
motivation: 现有的免训练遥感图像指代分割方法主要依赖隐式的视觉-语言激活或区域-文本相似度，这导致它们对航空指代中常见的空间、比较和序数关系（例如“最大的船”、“左边第二个球场”）缺乏控制能力。
method: 提出 GeoSelect 流水线，将指代分割重构为类型化空间程序的执行。首先利用冻结的纯文本语言模型将语言表达式合成为小型领域特定语言（DSL）程序，经合规性检查后由确定性执行器运行。核心抽象是单一评分候选集类型：通过连续几何场实现位置和邻近度，通过离散集合和顺序算子实现极值、序数、计数并集等复杂关系。同时引入可靠性阶梯，在程序出错时降级执行以确保总有输出。
results: 在 RRSIS-D 测试集上达到 58.86 mIoU，在 RISBench 测试集上达到 55.27 mIoU。其中在 RRSIS-D 上的表现是此前最佳免训练方法的两倍以上，且无需指代监督，仅需单张 GPU。控制变量对比证实增益源自显式执行，且该方法对预训练泄漏具有鲁棒性。
conclusion: GeoSelect 证明了通过将指代查询转化为显式的类型化空间程序并进行确定性执行，可以在完全无需训练的情况下，大幅提升遥感图像指代分割在处理复杂空间、序数和比较关系时的准确性、鲁棒性与可解释性。

title: SharpSplat: Edge-Regularized 3D Gaussian Splatting for High Fidelity Urban Building Reconstruction from UAV images
authors: Porus Vaid, Shivam Chopra, Vaibhav Kumar
abstract: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D building models from UAV imagery is essential for large-scale digital twin development. However, existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) techniques often struggle with building facades, failing to capture sharp geometric transitions. To address this, we propose a semantic edge regularization framework that supervises 3DGS to produce crisp architectural boundaries. Our method leverages SAM 3 to generate precise building masks, from which we extract architecturally significant edges. During training, we align rendered image gradients with these extracted edges, forcing the Gaussians to converge into sharp structural geometries. Evaluations across campus environments, dense urban centers, and custom residential datasets demonstrate significant improvements in edge fidelity without requiring architectural modifications to the 3DGS pipeline. Our approach proves robust across diverse building types, roof geometries, and urban densities.
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) - 2026
zh_title: SharpSplat：用于无人机图像高保真城市建筑重建的边缘正则化3D高斯泼溅
translation: 从无人机图像中重建高保真三维建筑模型对于大规模数字孪生的开发至关重要。然而，现有的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术在处理建筑外立面时往往表现不佳，无法捕捉到锋利的几何过渡。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种语义边缘正则化框架，通过监督3DGS来产生清晰的建筑边界。我们的方法利用SAM 3生成精确的建筑掩膜，并从中提取具有建筑学意义的边缘。在训练过程中，我们将渲染图像的梯度与这些提取的边缘进行对齐，从而迫使高斯分布收敛成锋利的结构几何。在校园环境、密集城市中心和自定义住宅数据集上的评估表明，在不需要对3DGS管线进行架构修改的情况下，边缘保真度得到了显著提升。我们的方法在不同的建筑类型、屋顶几何形状和城市密度中均表现出极强的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出SharpSplat框架，利用SAM 3提取建筑边缘并在训练中进行梯度对齐，在不修改3DGS架构的前提下显著提升了无人机建筑重建的边缘保真度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将先进的分割模型（SAM 3）与3D高斯泼溅技术巧妙结合，通过引入语义边缘正则化，在不修改3DGS基础架构的前提下，显著提升了建筑边缘的重建精度。这种非侵入式的约束方法具有很强的实用性和通用性。其局限性可能在于高度依赖SAM 3生成掩膜的准确性，在阴影、遮挡或低对比度区域，边缘提取的质量可能会影响最终的重建效果。
motivation: 现有的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术在处理建筑外立面时表现不佳，难以捕捉到锋利的几何过渡（如清晰的建筑边界），这限制了其在构建高保真城市数字孪生中的应用。
method: 提出了一种语义边缘正则化框架。该方法首先利用SAM 3生成精确的建筑掩膜，并从中提取具有建筑学意义的边缘；接着在训练过程中，将渲染图像的梯度与这些提取的边缘进行对齐，从而约束并引导高斯分布收敛为锋利的结构几何。
results: 在校园环境、密集城市中心和自定义住宅数据集上的评估表明，该方法在不改变3DGS流水线结构的前提下，显著提高了建筑边缘的保真度，并在不同建筑类型、屋顶几何形状和城市密度下表现出强大的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 提出的SharpSplat框架成功克服了传统3DGS在重建锋利建筑边缘时的缺陷，为利用无人机图像进行大规模、高保真的城市建筑三维重建提供了一种高效、鲁棒且无需修改网络架构的解决方案。

title: MACRO: Training-free Multi-plane Attention for Closeup Render Optimization
authors: Nitzan Hodos, Roy Amoyal, Lior Fritz, Ianir Ideses, Sagie Benaim, Netalee Efrat
abstract: Close-up rendering, zooming into a scene well beyond any training camera, is important for virtual production and interactive 3D content, yet remains an open challenge. 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity, real-time novel view synthesis, but its rendering quality degrades at close range. Recent diffusion-based methods that enhance the rendering by conditioning on reference images from the training set produce significant artifacts in this setting. We analyze this failure and identify its root cause: the scale gap between the close-up and reference views. We show that the features in reference-conditioned enhancement models are not scale-invariant, causing cross-view attention to retrieve incorrect correspondences when the same content appears at different scales, and that this mismatch cannot be corrected in latent space because the VAE encoder is not scale-equivariant. Building on this analysis we introduce MACRO, Multi-plane Attention for Closeup Render Optimization, a training-free method for high-quality close-up novel view synthesis from 3DGS. MACRO resolves the scale gap by leveraging the scene's known 3D structure: it decomposes the close-up into depth planes, crops and resizes references in image space to match the scale of each plane before encoding, and applies a depth-aware attention mask so each token attends only to scale-matched references. The method requires no architectural changes or additional training. We further contribute two new close-up novel view synthesis benchmarks, the first standardized evaluation protocol for this setting, and demonstrate state-of-the-art results on both, outperforming existing 3DGS and diffusion-based methods on both reconstruction and perceptual metrics. Project page: https://nitzanhod.github.io/MACRO
zh_title: MACRO：用于特写渲染优化的免训练多平面注意力机制
translation: 特写渲染（将场景放大到远超出任何训练相机的范围）对于虚拟制作和交互式3D内容至关重要，但仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够实现高保真度、实时的全新视角合成，但其渲染质量在近距离时会下降。最近基于扩散的方法通过以训练集中的参考图像为条件来增强渲染，但在这种设置下会产生显著的伪影。我们分析了这一失败并确定了其根本原因：特写视图与参考视图之间的尺度差异。我们表明，以参考为条件的增强模型中的特征不是尺度不变的，导致当相同内容以不同尺度出现时，跨视图注意力会检索到错误的对应关系，并且这种不匹配无法在潜在空间中得到纠正，因为VAE编码器不是尺度等变的。基于这一分析，我们引入了MACRO（用于特写渲染优化的多平面注意力），这是一种用于从3DGS进行高质量特写新视角合成的免训练方法。MACRO通过利用场景已知的3D结构来解决尺度差异：它将特写分解为深度平面，在编码前在图像空间中裁剪并调整参考图像的大小以匹配每个平面的尺度，并应用深度感知注意力掩码，使每个token仅关注尺度匹配的参考。该方法不需要架构更改或额外的训练。我们还贡献了两个新的特写新视角合成基准，这是该设置的第一个标准化评估协议，并在两者上展示了最先进的结果，在重建和感知指标上均优于现有的3DGS和基于扩散的方法。
tldr: 本文提出MACRO，一种无需训练的多平面注意力机制方法，通过利用3D结构解决特写与参考视图之间的尺度差异，从而显著提升了3DGS特写新视角合成的质量。
ai_comments: 该论文深入分析了基于扩散的渲染增强方法在特写场景下失效的底层原因（尺度不变量和VAE编码器的非尺度等变性），并针对性地提出了一种优雅的、无需训练（training-free）的几何辅助解决方案。这种结合3D几何先验与2D扩散模型注意力机制的设计非常巧妙，不仅有效解决了实际应用中的痛点，还避免了昂贵的重新训练成本。此外，开源的新基准和评估协议也将极大地推动该细分领域的发展。
motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在特写镜头（超出训练相机范围的缩放）下渲染质量会退化，而现有的基于扩散的增强方法在特写场景下会产生明显的伪影。其根本原因在于特写视图与参考视图之间的尺度差异，使得参考条件增强模型中的特征不具备尺度不变性，且无法在VAE潜在空间中被纠正。
method: 提出MACRO（Multi-plane Attention for Closeup Render Optimization），一种免训练的方法。它利用场景已知的3D结构，将特写视图分解为多个深度平面，在编码前于图像空间中对参考图像进行裁剪和缩放以匹配每个平面的尺度，并应用深度感知的注意力掩码，使每个token仅关注尺度匹配的参考图像。
results: 在贡献的两个全新特写新视角合成基准测试上取得了最先进的（SOTA）结果，在重建和感知指标上均优于现有的3DGS和基于扩散的方法。
conclusion: MACRO成功解决了特写渲染中的尺度差异问题，无需任何架构修改或额外训练即可实现高质量的特写新视角合成，并在新提出的基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。

title: AdaptiveSD A Stability-Aware, Runtime-Adaptive Speculative Decoding Framework with Multi-Policy Orchestration for CPU-Constrained LLM Inference
authors: Sadra Saremi
abstract: With the rise of small quantized GGUF-based language models and their increasing use for on-device inference tasks, we have seen the growing need for an approach capable of reliably delivering these models at scale even under severe memory bandwidth constraints such as those imposed by pure CPU implementations. Fixed-depth speculative decoding has emerged as one promising technique, but in practice, it often leads to performance degradation due to either bandwidth saturation, instability, or even catastrophic resource exhaustion resulting in system failure. To overcome this problem, we introduce AdaptiveSD, a fully runtime-adaptive speculative decoding framework aimed at ensuring robust, reliable execution across the spectrum of model types and workloads. Our solution consists of four tightly-coupled components working together in a continuous feedback loop: a Runtime Monitoring Engine tracking multiple signals relevant to ongoing computation, an Adaptive Draft Controller enforcing an eleven rule policy hierarchy prioritizing system resource preservation over raw draft count, a Dynamic Policy Engine employing a suite of heuristic and reinforcement learning techniques to dynamically modify policies depending upon workload behavior, and finally, a KV Cache Coordination Layer managing cache states with fine-grained control through INT8 shadow buffers and position aware evictions. While conventional approaches focus solely on maximizing throughput, we instead assess the effectiveness of our approach based on several key metrics including wasted drafted compute and inter-token latency dispersion alongside standard measures of speculative efficiency.
zh_title: AdaptiveSD：一种面向CPU受限LLM推理的稳定性感知、运行时自适应、多策略协同推测解码框架
translation: 随着小型量化GGUF语言模型及其在设备上推理任务中使用的增加，我们看到越来越需要一种方法，即使在纯CPU实现所施加的严重内存带宽限制下，也能可靠地大规模交付这些模型。固定深度推测解码已成为一种有前景的技术，但在实践中，它常常因带宽饱和、不稳定性甚至灾难性的资源耗尽导致系统故障，从而导致性能下降。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了AdaptiveSD，一个完全运行时自适应的推测解码框架，旨在确保在各种模型类型和工作负载下实现鲁棒、可靠的执行。我们的解决方案由四个紧密耦合的组件组成，它们在一个持续的反馈循环中协同工作：一个运行时监控引擎，跟踪与正在进行的计算相关的多个信号；一个自适应草稿控制器，执行一个11条规则的策略层次结构，优先考虑系统资源保护而非原始草稿数量；一个动态策略引擎，采用一系列启发式和强化学习技术，根据工作负载行为动态修改策略；最后，一个KV缓存协调层，通过INT8影子缓冲区和位置感知驱逐进行细粒度缓存状态管理。虽然传统方法只专注于最大化吞吐量，但我们Instead根据几个关键指标评估我们方法的有效性，包括浪费的草稿计算和token间延迟分散以及推测效率的标准度量。
tldr: AdaptiveSD是一个运行时自适应的推测解码框架，通过多策略协调解决CPU受限LLM推理中固定深度推测解码的性能退化和系统失败问题，旨在确保鲁棒可靠的执行。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的、针对CPU受限LLM推理的推测解码框架AdaptiveSD，其亮点在于强调“稳定性感知”和“运行时自适应”，通过多策略协调和细粒度的资源管理来克服传统方法的局限性。特别是在移动和边缘设备上部署LLM的背景下，这种方法对于提高可靠性和效率具有重要意义。引入强化学习和启发式策略动态调整，以及对浪费计算和延迟分散等新指标的关注，都体现了其先进性。
motivation: 随着小型量化GGUF语言模型在设备上推理任务中的应用日益增多，需要一种能在内存带宽受限（如纯CPU实现）环境下可靠扩展这些模型的方法。传统的固定深度推测解码方法常因带宽饱和、不稳定性或资源耗尽导致性能下降甚至系统故障。
method: 论文引入了AdaptiveSD，一个完全运行时自适应的推测解码框架。它由四个紧密耦合的组件组成：1) 运行时监控引擎，跟踪计算相关的多个信号；2) 自适应草稿控制器，执行一个11条规则的策略层次结构，优先考虑系统资源保护；3) 动态策略引擎，利用启发式和强化学习技术根据工作负载行为动态修改策略；4) KV缓存协调层，通过INT8影子缓冲区和位置感知驱逐进行细粒度缓存状态管理。
conclusion: 该论文旨在通过引入AdaptiveSD框架，解决传统固定深度推测解码在CPU受限LLM推理中遇到的性能下降和系统不稳定性问题，从而确保在各种模型类型和工作负载下实现鲁棒、可靠的执行。

title: SGF-CDNet: A Consistency-Discrepancy Graph Network over Semantic-Geometric Fused Nodes for Face Forgery Detection
authors: Jiayao Jiang, Bin Liu, Nenghai Yu
abstract: The rapid advancement of deepfakes necessitates robust face forgery detection. Although forged faces may lack obvious artifacts, they often contain subtle disharmony among different facial regions. We propose SGF-CDNet, a Consistency-Discrepancy Graph Network (CD-GNN) over Semantic-Geometric Fused (SGF) nodes. First, SGF-CDNet constructs SGF nodes by deeply fusing semantic regions from face parsing with geometric information from facial landmarks, allowing nodes to capture both high-level concepts and precise geometric constraints. Next, a dual-path CD-GNN performs parallel relational reasoning on these nodes across two dimensions: consistency and discrepancy. The consistency path evaluates if facial components follow natural biological patterns, while the discrepancy path mines for structural tensions and feature conflicts introduced by forgeries. By integrating these processes, our model effectively identifies disharmonious relationships between facial components. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that SGF-CDNet achieves superior performance, establishing it as a reliable solution for face forgery detection.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This work has been accepted at ICMEW 2026
zh_title: SGF-CDNet：一种基于语义-几何融合节点的面部伪造检测一致性-差异图网络
translation: 深度伪造技术的快速发展使得鲁棒的面部伪造检测变得必要。尽管伪造面部可能缺乏明显的伪影，但它们通常在不同面部区域之间包含细微的不协调。我们提出了SGF-CDNet，一个基于语义-几何融合（SGF）节点的一致性-差异图网络（CD-GNN）。首先，SGF-CDNet通过深度融合面部解析的语义区域和面部标志的几何信息来构建SGF节点，使节点能够捕获高级概念和精确的几何约束。接下来，一个双路径CD-GNN在这些节点上沿着两个维度并行执行关系推理：一致性和差异性。一致性路径评估面部组件是否遵循自然的生物模式，而差异性路径则挖掘伪造引入的结构张力和特征冲突。通过整合这些过程，我们的模型有效地识别面部组件之间的不协调关系。在公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，SGF-CDNet取得了卓越的性能，使其成为面部伪造检测的可靠解决方案。
tldr: SGF-CDNet是一种用于面部伪造检测的图网络，它通过融合语义和几何信息构建节点，并使用双路径图网络检测面部组件之间的一致性和差异性，以识别伪造。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于其SGF节点的构建，通过深度融合语义和几何信息，使节点能够全面表示面部特征。此外，双路径CD-GNN的设计，同时从一致性和差异性两个维度进行推理，能够更精细地捕获深度伪造引入的细微不协调，提供了一种更全面和鲁棒的面部伪造检测方法。
motivation: 深度伪造技术的快速发展使得鲁棒的面部伪造检测成为必要。伪造面部通常在不同面部区域之间存在细微的不协调，这为检测提供了依据。
method: SGF-CDNet首先通过深度融合面部解析的语义区域和面部标志的几何信息来构建语义-几何融合（SGF）节点，以捕获高级概念和精确几何约束。然后，一个双路径一致性-差异图网络（CD-GNN）在这些SGF节点上并行执行关系推理。一致性路径评估面部组件是否遵循自然生物模式，而差异性路径则挖掘伪造引入的结构张力和特征冲突。通过整合这些过程，模型有效识别面部组件间的不协调关系。
results: 在公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，SGF-CDNet取得了卓越的性能。
conclusion: SGF-CDNet是面部伪造检测的可靠解决方案。

title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
authors: Diego Cerda-Mardini, Sarath Chandar, Sreenath Madathil
abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstream model has produced probabilistic outputs characterized by their likelihood and uncertainty, and LLMs are tasked with selecting an appropriate verbal descriptor for each. We simulate predictions from an upstream model by taking samples from a Beta distribution parameterized by its mode and prior sample size. We then prompt LLMs to explain these predictions under six domain contexts and with ten temperature settings, and repeating each experiment ten times. We find that LLMs are generally consistent but miscalibrated, with substantially weaker performance on uncertainty than on likelihood tasks. Providing models with precomputed summary statistics (mode and prior sample size) reduced sensitivity to contextual framing but did not resolve the underlying miscalibration, suggesting that the bottleneck resides in the verbalization step itself. These findings indicate that current LLMs do not yet constitute reliable zero-shot standalone risk communication tools for probabilistic predictions.
zh_title: 一致但未校准：评估大语言模型在自然语言风险沟通中的局限性
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为AI生成输出的事后解释器，但它们是否能够可靠地在自然语言中传达概率信息仍不清楚。为了使这一角色可行，模型必须对相同的输入产生相同的语言描述，并选择能够准确反映底层数值大小的描述。我们评估了九个LLM在两阶段预测管道中是否满足这些要求，其中上游模型产生了以可能性和不确定性为特征的概率输出，而LLM的任务是为每个输出选择合适的语言描述符。我们通过从以众数和先验样本量为参数的Beta分布中提取样本，来模拟上游模型的预测。然后，我们在六个领域背景和十个温度设置下提示LLM解释这些预测，并将每个实验重复十次。我们发现，LLM通常是一致的，但未经过校准，在不确定性任务上的表现明显弱于可能性任务。向模型提供预先计算的汇总统计数据（众数和先验样本量）降低了对上下文框架的敏感性，但并未解决潜在的校准偏差，这表明瓶颈在于语言化步骤本身。这些发现表明，当前的LLM还不能成为针对概率预测的可靠、零样本、独立的风险沟通工具。
tldr: 评估发现，LLM在将概率和不确定性数值转化为自然语言描述时，虽然能保持较高的一致性，但存在严重的校准偏差（尤其在表达不确定性时），表明目前LLM还不能作为可靠的零样本独立风险沟通工具。
ai_comments: 这项研究具有很强的现实意义。随着LLM被广泛用作决策支持系统和AI输出的解释器，它们如何向人类传达概率和不确定性（即风险沟通）至关重要。本文的创新之处在于系统评估了LLM在此任务中的“一致性”与“校准性”，并指出其主要瓶颈在于“数值到语言的转换（verbalization）”这一步骤，这为未来改进LLM在风险沟通中的表现提供了清晰的研究方向。
motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作AI生成输出的事后解释器，但目前尚不清楚它们能否在自然语言中可靠地传达概率信息。可靠的风险沟通要求模型对相同的输入产生一致的口头描述，且描述必须准确反映底层数值的大小。
method: 在两阶段预测管道中评估了9个LLM。首先，通过从由众数和先验样本量参数化的Beta分布中采样来模拟上游模型的概率输出（包含可能性和不确定性）。然后，提示LLM在6个领域上下文和10个温度设置下为这些预测选择合适的口头描述符，并重复实验10次。此外，还测试了向模型提供预计算的汇总统计数据（众数和先验样本量）的效果。
results: LLM在描述上通常是一致的，但存在严重的未校准问题（miscalibrated），且在不确定性任务上的表现明显弱于可能性任务。提供预计算的汇总统计数据虽然降低了模型对上下文框架的敏感性，但并未解决底层的未校准问题，这表明瓶颈存在于语言化（verbalization）步骤本身。
conclusion: 当前的LLM还无法作为针对概率预测的可靠、零样本、独立的风险沟通工具。

title: Next-Gen Sponsored Search: Crafting the Perfect Query with Inventory-Aware RAG (InvAwr-RAG) Based GenAI
authors: Md Omar Faruk Rokon, Weizhi Du, Zhaodong Wang, Musen Wen
abstract: Sponsored search plays a crucial role in e-commerce revenue generation, where advertisers strategically bid on keywords to capture the attention of users through relevant search queries. However, the process of identifying pertinent keywords for a given query presents significant challenges because of a vast and evolving keyword landscape, ambiguous intentions, and topic diversity. This paper highlights an opportunity for to earn a considerable amount of Ads revenue and user engagement where a significant proportion of queries fail to retrieve any sponsored ads. To utilize this opportunity, we introduce the Inventory-Aware RAG-based Generative AI model (InvAwr-RAG), which integrates advanced semantic retrieval and real-time inventory data. This model combines dynamically generated and historically successful queries to align with available inventory and ad campaigns while diversifying rewritten queries to enhance relevance and user engagement. Preliminary results show a significant 68% increase in fill rate and balanced relevance metrics, indicating a strong potential for increased ad revenue. The InvAwr-RAG model sets a new standard in dynamic query optimization, significantly improving ad relevancy, advertiser ROI, and user experience on Walmart's digital platform.
zh_title: 下一代赞助搜索：利用库存感知RAG（InvAwr-RAG）生成式AI构建完美查询
translation: 赞助搜索在电子商务收入生成中扮演着关键角色，广告商通过对关键词进行战略性竞价，通过相关的搜索查询吸引用户注意力。然而，由于庞大且不断变化的关键词格局、模糊的意图和主题多样性，为给定查询识别相关关键词的过程带来了巨大的挑战。本文强调了一个机会，即在很大一部分查询未能检索到任何赞助广告的情况下，可以获得可观的广告收入和用户参与度。为了利用这一机会，我们引入了库存感知RAG生成式AI模型（InvAwr-RAG），该模型整合了先进的语义检索和实时库存数据。该模型结合了动态生成和历史上成功的查询，以与可用库存和广告活动保持一致，同时使重写查询多样化，以增强相关性和用户参与度。初步结果显示，填充率显著增加了68%，并且相关性指标保持平衡，这预示着广告收入有巨大增长潜力。InvAwr-RAG模型为动态查询优化设定了新标准，显著提高了沃尔玛数字平台上的广告相关性、广告商投资回报率和用户体验。
