Single-cell perturbation data violates this assumption: two perturbations can produce different populations of cells while overlapping so much that an individual cell could belong to either. Per-cell accuracy then measures this overlap rather than model quality. We see this on Tahoe-100M and the Virtual Cell Challenge, where a linear classifier, an MLP, and a Transformer all plateau near macro-F1 0.2-0.3 even though almost every pair of perturbations is statistically distinguishable.
  The fix is to score perturbations across the whole population rather than cell by cell. We average a classifier's per-cell probability vectors over all cells of a perturbation to form a population profile, then rank candidate perturbations by this profile; we call the resulting score the Classifier Discrimination Score (CDS). Taking the top-ranked class recovers the winning perturbation. It needs no retraining, costs linear time in the number of cells, and recovers near-perfect identification from the same weak models. CDS differs from the pseudobulk-based Perturbation Discrimination Score (PDS) used in recent benchmarks only in where the average is taken, raw gene expression for PDS versus a learned discriminative space for CDS, and identifies the true perturbation more reliably on both datasets, with the gap widening as cells grow scarce. Because a metric that misranks the ground truth will misrank the models scored against it, per-cell accuracy and raw-pseudobulk scores should be used with caution when comparing perturbation models.
zh_title: 不是细胞，而是分数分布：评估类重叠下的单细胞扰动
translation:
大多数分类问题假设类别大致是可分的，因此单个样本通常可以归为一个类别。单细胞扰动数据违反了这一假设：两种扰动可能产生不同的细胞群体，但重叠程度很高，以至于单个细胞可能属于任何一类。因此，单细胞准确率衡量的往往是这种重叠度，而非模型质量。我们在 Tahoe-100M 和虚拟细胞挑战赛中观察到，线性分类器、MLP 和 Transformer 的宏 F1 分数均停滞在 0.2-0.3 左右，尽管几乎每一对扰动在统计上都是可区分的。
解决方法是跨整个群体而不是逐个细胞地对扰动进行评分。我们将分类器对扰动中所有细胞的逐个细胞概率向量取平均，形成一个群体分布，然后根据该分布对候选扰动进行排序；我们将所得分数称为分类器区分度评分（CDS）。选取排名最高的类别即可恢复正确的扰动。该方法无需重新训练，计算复杂度随细胞数量呈线性增长，并能从相同的弱模型中恢复出近乎完美的识别结果。CDS 与近期基准测试中使用的基于伪块（pseudobulk）的扰动区分评分（PDS）的区别仅在于取平均的位置不同：PDS 基于原始基因表达，而 CDS 基于学习到的判别空间。CDS 在两个数据集上都能更可靠地识别真实扰动，且随着细胞数量的减少，其优势越明显。由于衡量指标若无法准确排序真实结果，则会导致评估模型时出现偏差，因此在比较扰动模型时，应谨慎使用单细胞准确率和原始伪块评分。
tldr: 针对单细胞扰动数据中类重叠导致评估失效的问题，本文提出了一种基于群体分布评分（CDS）的新方法，能显著提升扰动识别的准确性和评估的可靠性。
ai_comments: 该论文敏锐地指出了单细胞扰动数据中“类重叠”导致的评估偏差问题，提出了基于群体分布而非单个细胞的评估指标（CDS）。其创新点在于从“分类准确率”转向“群体区分度”，对于评估大规模单细胞模型具有重要的参考价值。局限性在于其主要针对扰动分类任务，未探讨在基因表达预测或生成任务中的适用性。
motivation: 现有的单细胞扰动分类方法假设类别可分，但实际数据中不同扰动产生的细胞群体存在严重重叠，导致传统的单细胞分类准确率无法真实反映模型质量。
method: 提出了“分类器区分度评分（Classifier Discrimination Score, CDS）”。该方法首先计算单个细胞的概率向量，然后对扰动内的所有细胞取平均值形成群体分布，通过比较群体分布进行扰动识别，而非依赖单个细胞的分类准确率。
results: 使用 CDS 指标后，即使是弱模型也能在 Tahoe-100M 和 Virtual Cell Challenge 数据集上实现近乎完美的扰动识别，性能显著优于传统的 per-cell 准确率和基于原始基因表达的 PDS 指标。
conclusion: 在单细胞扰动分析中，基于群体分布的评价指标（如 CDS）显著优于传统的单细胞分类准确率，能更有效地处理类重叠问题并准确识别扰动。

title: The Double-edged Effect of Banning Generative AI on Online Question-and-Answer Communities: Evidence from Stack Exchange
authors: Yuanhong Ma, Qinglai He, Xitong Li, Lynn Wu
abstract: We investigate how banning generative artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) affects knowledge seeking, knowledge contribution, and contribution efficiency in online question-and-answer communities. After the launch of ChatGPT in late November 2022, several Stack Exchange communities implemented official bans on AIGC over concerns such as less reliable and socially engaged content. Leveraging data from the full network of Stack Exchange communities, we employ a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to examine the impacts of these bans. Our results reveal a double-edged impact: while the AIGC ban increases knowledge seeking, as evidenced by a higher volume of posted questions, it simultaneously reduces contribution efficiency, reflected in a lower proportion of questions receiving satisfactory answers within the expected time frame. Notably, these impacts are only evident in non-STEM communities. We take a socio-technical perspective to explore information reliability and social interactivity as two plausible underlying factors driving the observed changes. Our mechanism exploration reveals that the AIGC ban spurs question volume in topics where AIGC is less reliable and where social interaction is highly expected. In contrast, the ban hampers answer efficiency in communities where LLMs are capable of producing reliable answers and where social interactivity is minimal. Additionally, our results indicate the increased human involvement from knowledge seekers and contributors following the ban. They adapt their behavior by posting questions and answers that are more informationally rich and socially engaging. Overall, our findings offer actionable implications for platform managers, community moderators, and policymakers of online Q&A communities.
zh_title: 禁用生成式人工智能对在线问答社区的双刃剑效应：来自Stack Exchange的证据
translation: 我们研究了在在线问答社区中禁用生成式人工智能生成内容（AIGC）如何影响知识寻求、知识贡献以及贡献效率。在2022年11月下旬ChatGPT发布后，出于对内容可靠性较低和社交参与度不足等问题的担忧，几个Stack Exchange社区对AIGC实施了官方禁令。利用来自Stack Exchange社区完整网络的数据，我们采用双重差分（DID）方法来检验这些禁令的影响。我们的结果揭示了双刃剑式的影响：虽然禁用AIGC增加了知识寻求（表现为发布的提问量增加），但它同时降低了贡献效率（表现为在预期时间内获得满意答案的提问比例降低）。值得注意的是，这些影响仅在非STEM社区中显现。我们从社会技术视角出发，探讨了信息可靠性和社交互动性作为推动这些观察到的变化的两个潜在因素。我们的机制探索表明，在AIGC可靠性较低且对社交互动期望较高的主题中，禁用AIGC激发了提问量。相反，在大型语言模型（LLM）能够产生可靠答案且社交互动极少的社区中，该禁令阻碍了回答效率。此外，我们的结果表明，禁令实施后，求知者和贡献者的真人参与度有所增加。他们通过发布信息更丰富、更具社交互动性的问题和答案来调整自己的行为。总体而言，我们的研究结果为在线问答社区的平台管理者、社区版主和政策制定者提供了可操作的启示。
tldr: 研究表明，在Stack Exchange中禁用生成式AI是一把双刃剑：它在非STEM社区中促进了提问数量和真人互动，但同时也降低了问题得到及时、满意解答的效率。
ai_comments: 本研究非常具有时效性和现实意义，深入探讨了生成式AI治理对在线社区生态的深远影响。研究采用双重差分法（DID）提供了坚实的因果推断证据。其创新之处在于提出了“双刃剑”效应，并从社会技术视角（信息可靠性与社交互动性）解释了其背后的作用机制。局限性在于研究样本仅局限于Stack Exchange，对于其他类型或规则不同的在线问答社区，其结论的推广性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 探讨在ChatGPT发布后，在线问答社区官方禁用生成式人工内容（AIGC）对社区内知识寻求、知识贡献及贡献效率的具体影响。
method: 基于Stack Exchange社区完整网络的数据，采用双重差分（DID）实证方法进行分析。
results: 研究发现禁用AIGC具有双刃剑效应：一方面增加了求知行为（提问数量增加），另一方面降低了回答效率（在预期内获得满意答案的比例下降），且这些影响仅在非STEM社区中显著。机制分析表明，在AI内容不可靠且社交互动需求高的主题中，禁令促进了提问；而在LLM能提供可靠答案且互动需求低的社区中，禁令降低了效率。此外，禁令促使真人用户更积极地参与，发布更具信息量和社交互动性的内容。
conclusion: 禁用生成式AI对在线问答社区具有复杂的双重影响。虽然它能促进用户的求知欲和更深层次的真人互动，但同时也牺牲了回答的效率。这表明平台在制定AI治理政策时需要平衡内容质量、互动体验与响应速度。

title: Do All Visual Tokens Matter Equally? Object-Evidence Preserving Token Merging for Vision-Language Retrieval
authors: Suhyeong Park, Junha Jung, Jungwoo Park, Jaewoo Kang
abstract: Multi-vector vision-language retrieval preserves fine-grained visual evidence through maximum-similarity late interaction, but dense image-side tokens make storage and scoring expensive. Existing token compression methods reduce this cost, yet they can remove or collapse object- and region-level evidence that future query tokens may need to select. We propose SaMer, an object-aware token merging framework that compresses image-side post-projector tokens into $K$ representative centroids while preserving the original late-interaction interface. SaMer uses object annotations only during training as a merge prior to discourage cross-instance mixing, requires no ground-truth bounding boxes or detectors at inference time, and adapts only the shared projection layer with frozen vision and language backbones. With $K=64$, SaMer removes more than 93% of image-side tokens and reduces ColPali storage by $16.09\times$, while improving R@1 on Flickr30K and MSCOCO. These gains arise because object-aware merging preserves query-selectable object evidence that pruning or feature-only pooling can remove or collapse. SaMer also outperforms compression baselines and shows stronger phrase-level grounding, suggesting that efficient multi-vector retrieval depends not only on reducing token count, but on preserving the evidence future query tokens need to select.
zh_title: 所有视觉Token的重要性都一样吗？用于视觉语言检索的对象证据保留Token合并方法
translation: 多向量视觉语言检索通过最大相似度后期交互来保留细粒度视觉证据，但密集的图像侧Token使得存储和评分成本高昂。现有的Token压缩方法降低了这些成本，但它们可能会移除或合并未来查询Token可能需要的对象级和区域级证据。我们提出了SaMer，一个对象感知的Token合并框架，它将图像侧投影后的Token压缩为K个代表性质心，同时保留了原始的后期交互接口。SaMer仅在训练期间使用对象标注作为合并先验以抑制跨实例混合，在推理时不需要地面真值边界框或检测器，并且仅适配共享投影层，同时冻结视觉和语言骨干网络。当K=64时，SaMer移除了超过93%的图像侧Token，并将ColPali存储减少了16.09倍，同时提高了Flickr30K和MSCOCO上的R@1。这些收益源于对象感知合并保留了剪枝或仅特征池化可能移除或合并的、可供查询选择的对象证据。SaMer还超越了压缩基线并显示出更强的短语级定位能力，这表明高效的多向量检索不仅取决于减少Token数量，还取决于保留未来查询Token需要选择的证据。
tldr: SaMer通过对象感知策略压缩视觉Token，在大幅降低存储成本的同时，通过保留关键对象证据提升了检索性能。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入对象感知先验来改进视觉语言检索中的Token合并技术，不仅解决了存储和计算开销问题，还巧妙地平衡了压缩率与检索性能，为多向量检索的效率优化提供了新的思路。其核心创新在于证明了保留“查询可选择的对象证据”对于维持检索准确性的重要性。
motivation: 现有的视觉Token压缩方法容易丢失或混淆对象级/区域级证据，导致后续查询无法准确匹配，且高密度的视觉Token带来了高昂的存储和计算成本。
method: 提出SaMer框架，在训练阶段利用对象标注作为合并先验，通过将图像Token压缩为K个代表性质心，同时保持原有的后期交互接口；推理阶段无需检测器或边界框，仅微调共享投影层。
results: 在K=64的情况下，SaMer移除了超过93%的图像Token，将ColPali存储需求降低了16.09倍，并同时提升了Flickr30K和MSCOCO数据集上的R@1指标。
conclusion: SaMer通过对象感知合并策略，在大幅减少视觉Token数量的同时，有效保留了关键的视觉证据，显著提升了多向量视觉语言检索的效率与性能。

title: LCPNet: Latent Consistent Proximal Unfolding Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
authors: Tianfang Zhang, Fengyi Wu, Lei Li, Chang Liu, Zhenming Peng, Huaping Zhang, Xiangyang Ji
abstract: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to identify long distance small targets from complex infrared backgrounds, and is a fundamental task in remote sensing. Deep learning methods have improved IRSTD by learning discriminative image-to-mask mappings, but such feed-forward designs often underuse physical decomposition structure between targets and backgrounds. Deep unfolding methods partially address this issue by embedding model-driven iterations into neural networks, yet existing designs still operate mainly in image domain and use updates and memory mechanisms that are not fully coupled with underlying optimization process. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Consistent Proximal unfolding network (LCPNet). First, we verify that low-rank prior remains valid in latent representations and perform unfolding in this space, preserving physical constraint while avoiding repeated compression of intermediate states. Second, we derive a Latent Consistent Proximal (LCP) solver that evolves each latent variable from its previous state rather than reconstructing through an indirect residual, and stabilizes small target updates through task-adaptive normalization and gain control. Third, we introduce Shared Optimization Memory (SOM), a common historical state shared by all decomposition variables to provide coordinated guidance across unfolding stages. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that LCPNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods while achieving accurate and robust detection with low false alarms and competitive efficiency. Model and code are available at https://github.com/Tianfang-Zhang/LCPNet.
zh_title: LCPNet：用于红外小目标检测的潜在一致近端展开网络
translation: 红外小目标检测（IRSTD）旨在从复杂的红外背景中识别远距离小目标，是遥感领域的一项基础任务。深度学习方法通过学习判别性的图像到掩模映射改进了IRSTD，但这种前馈设计通常未能充分利用目标和背景之间的物理分解结构。深度展开方法通过将模型驱动的迭代嵌入神经网络中，部分解决了这个问题，但现有设计仍主要在图像域操作，并且更新和记忆机制与底层优化过程未完全耦合。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了潜在一致近端展开网络（LCPNet）。首先，我们验证了低秩先验在潜在表示中仍然有效，并在此空间中进行展开，从而保留了物理约束，同时避免了中间状态的重复压缩。其次，我们推导了一个潜在一致近端（LCP）求解器，该求解器使每个潜在变量从其先前的状态演变，而不是通过间接残差进行重建，并通过任务自适应归一化和增益控制来稳定小目标更新。第三，我们引入了共享优化记忆（SOM），这是一个所有分解变量共享的共同历史状态，旨在为展开阶段提供协调指导。在四个公共基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，LCPNet的性能优于现有最先进的方法，同时实现了准确、鲁棒的检测，具有低误报率和有竞争力的效率。模型和代码可在https://github.com/Tianfang-Zhang/LCPNet获取。
tldr: LCPNet通过在潜在空间进行展开、使用潜在一致近端求解器和共享优化记忆，提高了红外小目标检测的准确性和鲁棒性。
ai_comments: LCPNet的创新性在于将深度展开方法与潜在空间处理相结合，并引入了潜在一致近端求解器和共享优化记忆。这种设计不仅解决了传统深度学习和深度展开方法在利用物理分解结构和优化过程耦合上的不足，而且通过在潜在空间操作，有效避免了重复压缩，提升了小目标检测的稳定性和鲁棒性。其性能超越现有SOTA方法，证明了其在红外小目标检测领域的先进性和实用性。
motivation: 现有的深度学习红外小目标检测方法未能充分利用目标与背景之间的物理分解结构，而深度展开方法虽有所改进，但仍在图像域操作，且更新和记忆机制与底层优化过程耦合不足。
method: LCPNet首先验证了低秩先验在潜在表示中依然有效，并在潜在空间进行展开。其次，它推导了一个潜在一致近端（LCP）求解器，该求解器通过从前一状态演变每个潜在变量来稳定小目标更新，并采用任务自适应归一化和增益控制。最后，它引入了共享优化记忆（SOM），作为所有分解变量共享的共同历史状态，为展开阶段提供协调指导。
results: 在四个公共基准测试中，LCPNet的性能优于现有最先进的方法，实现了准确、鲁棒的检测，具有低误报率和有竞争力的效率。
conclusion: LCPNet通过在潜在空间进行展开、设计潜在一致近端求解器和引入共享优化记忆，有效解决了现有红外小目标检测方法的局限性，实现了卓越的检测性能。

title: Integrated Forward-Inverse Network for Lensless Image Reconstruction
authors: Donggeon Bae, Jaewoo Jung, Yong Guk Kang, Kyung Chul Lee, Taeyoung Kim, Jongho Kim, Sangjun Byun, Joonsik Park, Seung Ah Lee
abstract: Lensless imaging enables compact and versatile computational cameras by replacing bulky optics with thin coded elements. However, reconstruction from the resulting measurements is challenging: large-footprint point-spread functions (PSFs) produce highly multiplexed observations, making inversion severely ill-conditioned and sensitive to calibration errors and model mismatch. While deep learning approaches, including hybrid models that incorporate physics priors, have shown promise, explicitly maintaining data fidelity throughout the network hierarchy remains difficult. Here, we propose the Integrated Forward-Inverse Network (IFIN), a physics-guided architecture that interleaves differentiable forward projections with learnable inverse updates at every scale, enabling complementary cues to be exploited jointly in the measurement and image domains. This bidirectional coupling supports progressive, physics-consistent refinement and permits system-constrained PSF kernel adaptation under model uncertainty. On challenging lensless benchmarks, including a newly introduced dataset, IFIN achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. We further observe competitive performance on Gaussian deblurring and simulated inline holography reconstruction, suggesting that the same interleaving principle can extend beyond lensless cameras.
zh_title: 用于无透镜图像重建的集成前向-逆向网络
translation: 无透镜成像通过用薄编码元件代替笨重的光学器件，实现了紧凑且多功能的计算相机。然而，从所得测量结果中进行重建具有挑战性：大尺寸的点扩散函数（PSF）会产生高度复用的观测结果，使得反演过程严重病态，并对校准误差和模型不匹配非常敏感。虽然包括结合物理先验的混合模型在内的深度学习方法显示出了潜力，但在整个网络层级中显式维持数据保真度仍然很困难。在此，我们提出了集成前向-逆向网络（IFIN），这是一种物理引导架构，它在每个尺度上交替进行可微前向投影和学习型逆向更新，使得测量域和图像域的互补线索能够被联合利用。这种双向耦合支持渐进的、物理一致的细化，并允许在模型不确定性下进行系统约束的PSF核自适应。在包括一个新引入数据集在内的具有挑战性的无透镜基准测试中，IFIN实现了最先进的重建质量。我们进一步观察到其在高斯去模糊和模拟在线全息重建方面具有竞争力的表现，这表明相同的交替原理可以扩展到无透镜相机之外。
tldr: 提出了一种将物理模型与深度学习交替集成的架构，解决了无透镜成像中反演困难及模型不匹配问题，实现了高质量重建。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种双向耦合的物理引导架构，通过在网络各层交替进行可微前向投影和学习型逆向更新，解决了无透镜成像中数据保真度难以维持的问题。其泛化能力强，不仅适用于无透镜成像，还可扩展至去模糊和全息成像任务。
motivation: 无透镜成像中点扩散函数（PSF）覆盖范围大，导致观测高度复用，使得反演过程病态且对校准误差和模型不匹配高度敏感，现有的深度学习方法难以在网络层级中显式维持数据保真度。
method: 提出了一种集成前向-逆向网络（IFIN），在网络的每个尺度上交替执行可微前向投影与学习型逆向更新，实现测量域与图像域的联合优化，并支持系统约束下的PSF核自适应。
results: 在无透镜成像基准测试中达到了最先进的重建质量，并在高斯去模糊和模拟在线全息重建任务中表现出极强的竞争力和通用性。
conclusion: IFIN通过将物理模型与深度学习深度集成，实现了更鲁棒、高质量的图像重建，证明了在网络层级中保持物理一致性的重要性。

title: RoboVista: Evaluating Vision Language Models for Diverse Robot Applications
authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Ziyang Chen, Simeon Adebola, Yixuan Huang, Zehan Ma, Tianshuang Qiu, Wentao Yuan, Dhruv Shah, Pannag R. Sanketi, Ken Goldberg
abstract: Diverse applications for robotics, such as industry and agriculture, require robots to operate across various embodiments, changing visual conditions, and complex planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for general-purpose and interpretable robotic reasoning. Aligning VLMs with diverse robot applications requires a modular understanding of the individual decision components that underlie robotic behavior. Capturing such structure is challenging for conventional robot benchmarks that are primarily based on teleoperated, end-to-end datasets. We propose Robot Question Answering (RQA), a modular evaluation framework and RoboVista, a benchmark curated from real robotic systems, research papers, and expert annotations. RoboVista contains 474 Visual Question Answering (VQA) instances with human annotated reasoning and covers 39 unique task types in agricultural, industrial, domestic, surgical robotics, autonomous driving, and open robot datasets. Experiments on RoboVista show that state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial gaps. Physical robot experiments suggest strong correlation between RoboVista performance and real-world task execution.
zh_title: RoboVista：评估用于多样化机器人应用的视觉语言模型
translation: 工业和农业等多样化的机器人应用要求机器人在不同的实体、变化的视觉条件和复杂的规划中运行。视觉语言模型（VLM）为通用和可解释的机器人推理提供了一个有前景的基础。将VLM与多样化的机器人应用对齐，需要对机器人行为底层的各个决策组件进行模块化理解。对于主要基于远程操作的端到端数据集的传统机器人基准测试来说，捕捉这种结构具有挑战性。我们提出了机器人问答（RQA），这是一个模块化评估框架，以及RoboVista，一个从真实机器人系统、研究论文和专家注释中策划的基准测试。RoboVista包含474个带有专家推理注释的视觉问答（VQA）实例，涵盖了农业、工业、家庭、手术机器人、自动驾驶和开放机器人数据集中的39种独特任务类型。在RoboVista上的实验表明，最先进的VLM表现出巨大的差距。物理机器人实验表明，RoboVista的表现与真实世界的任务执行之间存在很强的相关性。
tldr: 本文提出了RoboVista基准测试和RQA框架，通过模块化评估视觉语言模型在多样化机器人任务中的推理能力，并验证了其与真实机器人执行性能的相关性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入模块化评估框架（RQA）和数据集（RoboVista），解决了现有机器人基准测试在评估视觉语言模型（VLM）决策推理能力方面的局限性。其创新点在于将机器人任务拆解为可解释的决策环节，并证明了该基准测试与真实世界机器人任务执行效果的高度相关性，为评估通用机器人模型提供了重要工具。
motivation: 现有的机器人基准测试多基于远程操作的端到端数据集，难以评估VLM在复杂机器人应用中所需的模块化推理能力，且无法有效衡量模型在不同视觉条件和机器人实体下的泛化能力。
method: 1. 提出机器人问答（RQA）模块化评估框架；2. 构建RoboVista基准数据集，包含474个带有推理注释的视觉问答实例，涵盖39种机器人任务类型；3. 对现有顶尖VLM进行性能评估，并与物理机器人实验结果进行对比验证。
results: 实验表明，现有的顶尖VLM在RoboVista上表现出明显的性能差距；同时，RoboVista的评估得分与真实世界中机器人的任务执行成功率呈现出强相关性。
conclusion: RoboVista填补了当前机器人领域对VLM评估的空白，证明了现有的顶尖VLM在处理复杂机器人推理任务时仍存在显著差距，并证实了该基准测试在预测真实机器人性能方面的有效性。

title: SEAM: Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion for Vision-Language-Action Policies
authors: Dijia Zhan, Xuemiao Xu, Jinyi Li, Jie Tang
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that execute fixed-length action chunks can exhibit multimodal bifurcation: a cross-chunk inconsistency in which adjacent chunks generated from independent Gaussian latents can converge to incompatible trajectory modes, producing abrupt discontinuities at chunk boundaries. Existing remedies either require backpropagation through the policy at each denoising step, rely on rejection sampling, or require retraining, each trading computational cost or task reliability for smoother transitions. We propose SEAM (Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion), a training-free inference-time method for flow matching VLAs. SEAM exploits a simple synchronous-execution insight: after the robot consumes the executed prefix, the previous chunk's unexecuted tail is already available as an analytic consistency reference. Its core mechanism, Velocity-guided Loss Steering (VLS), derives a time-dependent target from this tail and applies a closed-form correction after each Euler step without backpropagating through the policy network. On LIBERO-10 with pi_0.5, SEAM reduces boundary jerk by 28%, reduces chunk transition discontinuity by 27%, preserves baseline-level task success, and keeps denoising-loop cost near the unguided baseline.
zh_title: SEAM：视觉-语言-动作策略中动作分块运动的平滑执行
translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略执行固定长度动作分块时，可能表现出多模态分叉：一种跨分块不一致性，其中由独立的 Gaussian 潜在变量生成的相邻分块可能收敛到不兼容的轨迹模式，从而在分块边界处产生突然的不连续性。现有的补救措施要么需要在每个去噪步骤中通过策略进行反向传播，要么依赖于拒绝采样，要么需要重新训练，每种方法都以计算成本或任务可靠性为代价来换取更平滑的过渡。我们提出了 SEAM（Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion），这是一种用于流匹配 VLA 的无需训练的推理时方法。SEAM 利用一个简单的同步执行洞察力：在机器人消耗了执行前缀之后，前一个分块未执行的尾部已经作为分析一致性参考可用。其核心机制，速度引导损失转向（VLS），从这个尾部导出一个时间依赖性目标，并在每个欧拉步之后应用闭式校正，而无需通过策略网络进行反向传播。在 LIBERO-10 与 pi_0.5 的测试中，SEAM 将边界跳动减少了 28%，将分块过渡不连续性减少了 27%，保持了基线水平的任务成功率，并使去噪循环成本接近未引导的基线水平。
tldr: SEAM是一种无需训练的推理时方法，用于解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中动作分块运动的跨块不一致问题，通过速度引导损失转向机制，显著减少了分块边界的跳动和不连续性，同时保持任务成功率和低计算成本。
ai_comments: SEAM的创新之处在于它提供了一种无需训练、在推理时解决VLA策略中分块不连续性的有效方法，避免了现有方案的计算开销或重新训练需求。其核心VLS机制利用了前一块的未执行部分作为实时参考，这种利用现有信息进行动态校正的思路非常巧妙且高效。该方法对于提高机器人动作规划的流畅性和可靠性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行固定长度动作分块时，会出现多模态分叉现象，即相邻分块可能收敛到不兼容的轨迹模式，导致分块边界处出现突然的不连续性。现有的解决方案需要高计算成本（如每次去噪步骤的策略反向传播、拒绝采样）或需要重新训练，牺牲了计算成本或任务可靠性来换取平滑过渡。
method: 本文提出了SEAM（Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion），这是一种用于流匹配VLA的无需训练的推理时方法。SEAM利用同步执行的洞察力：在机器人执行完前缀后，前一个分块中未执行的尾部可作为分析一致性参考。其核心机制是速度引导损失转向（VLS），该机制从该尾部导出一个时间依赖性目标，并在每次欧拉步后应用闭式校正，而无需通过策略网络进行反向传播。
results: 在LIBERO-10与pi_0.5的测试中，SEAM将边界跳动减少了28%，将分块过渡不连续性减少了27%，保持了基线水平的任务成功率，并使去噪循环成本接近未引导的基线水平。
conclusion: SEAM提供了一种在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中实现动作分块运动平滑执行的有效方法，它在推理时无需训练，显著减少了分块边界的不连续性，同时保持了任务性能和计算效率。

title: G2VD: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection via Counterfactual Intervention and Causal Disentanglement
authors: Meng Du, Hongchang Chen, Ran Li, Junjie Zhang, Qi Ouyang, Shuxin Liu
abstract: The rapid advancement of AI-generated videos poses increasing security risks and calls for robust detectors with strong cross-domain generalization. Although existing methods achieve promising results under in-domain evaluation, their performance often degrades substantially when tested on unseen generators. A key reason is shortcut learning, where detectors rely on domain-specific spurious cues, such as generator-dependent fingerprints and generation styles, instead of intrinsic forgery traces. To address this issue, we propose G2VD, a Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection framework based on counterfactual intervention and causal disentanglement. First, G2VD introduces a counterfactual intervention pipeline (CFIPipeline) that generates controlled counterfactual samples via variational autoencoders (VAEs), followed by frequency-domain and pixel-domain alignment, thereby encouraging the detector to focus on generator-intrinsic cues. Building on this intervention process, we further design a causal disentanglement classifier consisting of two domain-anchored branches with distinct classification objectives, combined with an HSIC-based independence constraint to encourage the separation of task-relevant cues from domain-specific bias. Across four public datasets, G2VD shows strong average cross-domain performance and consistent gains over matched backbones. On the challenging GenVidBench cross-domain setting, it exceeds 90% accuracy and reaches an AUC close to 0.95. Notably, this performance is obtained using only 10% of the original training data. The code is available at https://github.com/dumeng98/G2VD.
zh_title: G2VD：基于反事实干预与因果解耦的可泛化AI生成视频检测
translation: AI生成视频的快速发展带来了日益增加的安全风险，需要具有强大跨域泛化能力的鲁棒检测器。尽管现有方法在域内评估中取得了令人满意的结果，但当在未知的生成器上进行测试时，其性能通常会大幅下降。一个关键原因在于快捷学习，即检测器依赖于特定域的虚假线索（例如依赖于生成器的指纹和生成风格），而不是内在的伪造痕迹。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了G2VD，一个基于反事实干预和因果解耦的可泛化AI生成视频检测框架。首先，G2VD引入了反事实干预流水线（CFIPipeline），通过变分自编码器（VAEs）生成受控的反事实样本，随后进行频域和像素域对齐，从而鼓励检测器关注生成器内在的线索。在此干预过程的基础上，我们进一步设计了一个因果解耦分类器，该分类器由两个具有不同分类目标的域锚定分支组成，并结合基于HSIC的独立性约束，以促进任务相关线索与域特定偏置的分离。在四个公开数据集上，G2VD展示了强大的平均跨域性能，并比匹配的基线模型取得了持续的提升。在具有挑战性的GenVidBench跨域设置中，它实现了超过90%的准确率，且AUC接近0.95。值得注意的是，这一性能仅使用了原始训练数据的10%就已达到。代码可在 https://github.com/dumeng98/G2VD 获取。
tldr: 提出了G2VD框架，通过反事实干预和因果解耦解决快捷学习问题，仅用10%的训练数据即可实现超90%的跨域视频检测准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将因果推断（反事实干预和因果解耦）引入到AI生成视频检测中，从根本上缓解了检测器因“快捷学习”而过度依赖生成器特定指纹的问题。其最大亮点在于极高的数据效率，仅需10%的训练数据即可在跨域测试中达到极高的准确率。局限性在于，摘要未提及VAEs生成反事实样本的计算开销，以及该方法对最新高保真视频生成器的敏感度。
motivation: 现有的AI生成视频检测方法在面对未知的生成器时性能大幅下降。这是因为检测器容易陷入“快捷学习”（shortcut learning），依赖于特定域的虚假线索（如生成器指纹和风格），而不是本质的伪造痕迹。
method: 提出G2VD框架，其包含：（1）反事实干预流水线（CFIPipeline），通过变分自编码器（VAEs）生成受控的反事实样本，并进行频域和像素域对齐，引导检测器关注生成器内在特征；（2）因果解耦分类器，由两个具有不同分类目标的域锚定分支组成，并结合基于HSIC（希尔伯特-施密特独立性指标）的独立性约束，将任务相关线索与域特定偏置进行分离。
results: 在四个公开数据集上，G2VD表现出强大的平均跨域性能。在具有挑战性的GenVidBench跨域设置中，仅使用10%的原始训练数据，其准确率就超过了90%，且AUC接近0.95。
conclusion: G2VD通过反事实干预和因果解耦，成功克服了AI视频检测中的快捷学习问题，用极少的数据量实现了卓越的跨域泛化性能。

title: StructuredEdit: Constraint-Aware Graphic Design Editing via Differentiable Parameter Propagation
authors: Veeramanohar Avudaiappan, Ritwik Murali
abstract: Graphic design editing requires precise manipulation of typography, layout, and visual hierarchy under strict design constraints. Following the introduction of large language models, organizations have increasingly promoted vision-language models to enhance productivity. However, current models operate on pixels and achieve only 52% constraint satisfaction on structured design edits, thereby limiting their reliability for professional workflows. We present StructuredEdit, a pipeline that reframes design editing as parameter manipulation rather than pixel generation. Our core technical contribution is Differentiable Parameter Propagation (DPP), a training method that embeds hard design constraints into vision-language model fine-tuning by backpropagating pixel-level constraint violations through a lightweight differentiable rasterizer. A hybrid candidate-and-filter pipeline produces 125k validated edit triplets. The resulting system reaches 89% constraint satisfaction versus 52% for GPT-4V, 0.82 matched-element Intersection over Union, and 76% top-1 font accuracy over the 100 most-frequent design typefaces. In a user study (N=35), editing time drops 33% and correction iterations drop 44% relative to a GPT-4V baseline.
comment: 3 page poster short paper.2 Figures, 2 Tables. Planned to submit to SIGGRAPH Asia
zh_title: StructuredEdit：基于可微参数传播的约束感知图形设计编辑
translation: 图形设计编辑需要在严格的设计约束下对排版、布局和视觉层级进行精确操作。随着大语言模型的引入，各机构越来越多地推广视觉语言模型以提高生产力。然而，当前模型基于像素进行操作，在结构化设计编辑中仅能达到 52% 的约束满足率，从而限制了其在专业工作流中的可靠性。我们提出了 StructuredEdit，这是一个将设计编辑重构为参数操作而非像素生成的流水线。我们的核心技术贡献是可微参数传播 (DPP)，这是一种通过轻量级可微光栅化器将像素级约束违规反向传播，从而将硬设计约束嵌入视觉语言模型微调的训练方法。一个混合候选-过滤流水线生成了 125k 个经过验证的编辑三元组。最终系统达到了 89% 的约束满足率（对比 GPT-4V 的 52%）、0.82 的匹配元素交并比，以及在 100 种最常见设计字体中 76% 的 Top-1 字体准确率。在一项用户研究（N=35）中，相对于 GPT-4V 基准，编辑时间下降了 33%，修正迭代次数下降了 44%。
tldr: StructuredEdit 将图形设计编辑从像素生成重构为参数操作，通过 DPP 技术将设计约束嵌入模型，显著提升了编辑的精确度与专业工作流的效率。
ai_comments: 该研究创新地将图像编辑任务从传统的像素生成转向参数操作，解决了视觉语言模型在处理结构化设计约束时的短板。通过可微参数传播（DPP）技术，将硬约束嵌入模型训练，显著提升了专业设计工作流的可靠性，具有很高的实际应用价值。
motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在图形设计编辑中仅能达到 52% 的约束满足率，无法满足专业工作流对排版、布局和视觉层级精确操作的需求。
method: 提出 StructuredEdit 流水线，将设计编辑重构为参数操作；核心采用可微参数传播 (DPP) 技术，通过轻量级可微光栅化器将硬约束反向传播至视觉语言模型微调过程；构建了一个包含 125k 验证编辑三元组的混合候选-过滤流水线。
results: 约束满足率提升至 89%（对比 GPT-4V 的 52%）；匹配元素交并比（IoU）达到 0.82；前 100 种常用字体的 Top-1 准确率达到 76%；用户研究显示编辑时间减少 33%，修正迭代次数减少 44%。
conclusion: StructuredEdit 成功证明了通过参数化操作和可微约束训练，可以显著提高视觉语言模型在图形设计编辑中的约束满足度和准确性，为专业设计工具的自动化提供了有效方案。

title: Beyond Compliance: A Large Scale Study on the Completeness and Consistency of the GitHub SBOMs
authors: Kawsar Ahmed Bhuiyan, Mohamed Bilel Besbes, Rachna Raj, Adam Al Assil, Diego Elias Costa
abstract: Modern software development relies heavily on open-source components. Reusing components accelerates innovation but increases exposure to supply-chain attacks exploiting known vulnerabilities. Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) improve software supply chain transparency by enumerating components, their versions, and their provenance. GitHub, the largest open-source development hosting platform, now automatically generates SBOMs for repositories, providing valuable metadata for risk assessment. Yet, it is unclear whether GitHub SBOMs can serve as a reliable source for vulnerability and license analysis, and how incomplete or inconsistent metadata may affect different programming ecosystems. To address this, we conduct a large-scale analysis of 10,000 GitHub repositories across ten programming language ecosystems, evaluating GitHub SBOMs against three other popular SBOM generators: Syft, Trivy, and the Microsoft SBOM Tool. Our study finds a lack of NTIA compliance in GitHub SBOMs, though core metadata is consistently present. We also find that component version and license information availability is highly dependent on the programming ecosystem. Compared with the other three tools, GitHub yields results similar to the Microsoft SBOM Tool and often outperforms Syft and Trivy in providing version and license information. Finally, we discuss potential shortcomings of the GitHub SBOM Tool, directly related to how each ecosystem manages its dependencies.
zh_title: 超越合规：一项关于 GitHub SBOM 完整性和一致性的大规模研究
translation: 现代软件开发严重依赖开源组件。重用组件可以加速创新，但也增加了暴露于利用已知漏洞的供应链攻击的风险。软件物料清单 (SBOM) 通过枚举组件、它们的版本和来源来提高软件供应链的透明度。GitHub，最大的开源开发托管平台，现在为存储库自动生成 SBOM，为风险评估提供有价值的元数据。然而，目前尚不清楚 GitHub SBOM 是否能作为漏洞和许可证分析的可靠来源，以及不完整或不一致的元数据可能如何影响不同的编程生态系统。为了解决这个问题，我们对横跨十种编程语言生态系统的 10,000 个 GitHub 存储库进行了大规模分析，并将 GitHub SBOM 与其他三个流行的 SBOM 生成器：Syft、Trivy 和 Microsoft SBOM Tool 进行了评估。我们的研究发现 GitHub SBOM 缺乏 NTIA 合规性，尽管核心元数据是一致存在的。我们还发现组件版本和许可证信息的可用性高度依赖于编程生态系统。与其他三个工具相比，GitHub 的结果与 Microsoft SBOM Tool 相似，并且在提供版本和许可证信息方面通常优于 Syft 和 Trivy。最后，我们讨论了 GitHub SBOM 工具的潜在缺点，这些缺点直接与其如何管理每个生态系统的依赖项有关。
tldr: GitHub 自动生成的 SBOM 在合规性方面存在不足，但核心元数据基本一致，组件版本和许可证信息的可用性因编程语言生态系统而异。与 Syft 和 Trivy 相比，GitHub SBOM 工具在提供版本和许可证信息方面通常优于它们，但仍存在一些与生态系统依赖管理相关的潜在问题。
ai_comments: 该研究为理解 GitHub SBOM 的实际应用价值提供了重要的实证依据。研究方法采用了大规模、跨生态系统的比较分析，具有较高的可信度。然而，研究的结论也指出了当前 GitHub SBOM 工具在合规性和生态系统适应性方面存在的局限性，这为未来的工具改进和标准制定提供了方向。
motivation: 评估 GitHub 自动生成的 SBOM 在软件供应链风险评估方面的可靠性，以及元数据不完整或不一致可能对不同编程生态系统产生的影响。
method: 对 10,000 个 GitHub 存储库进行大规模分析，涵盖十种编程语言生态系统，并将 GitHub SBOM 与 Syft、Trivy 和 Microsoft SBOM Tool 进行比较。
results: GitHub SBOM 在符合 NTIA 标准方面存在不足，但核心元数据一致性较高。组件版本和许可证信息的可用性高度依赖于编程生态系统。与 Syft 和 Trivy 相比，GitHub SBOM 工具在提供版本和许可证信息方面表现更好，与 Microsoft SBOM Tool 结果相似。
conclusion: GitHub SBOM 工具在合规性方面存在不足，但其核心元数据的一致性较好，并且在版本和许可证信息方面优于某些竞争对手。然而，其有效性受到各生态系统依赖管理方式的影响，需要进一步改进。

title: Governed Individuation: Cryptographically Decoupling an Agent's Learning from Its Authority
authors: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li
abstract: Autonomous agents are moving from sandboxed text generators to operators of code, data, and physical infrastructure, and they increasingly learn while deployed. This reopens a question that alignment techniques answer only probabilistically: after an agent has adapted in the field, is the running system still confined to what its operator authorised? Here we show that confinement can be guaranteed as an invariant of the agent's execution architecture rather than a probabilistic outcome of its training. Governed individuation binds an agent at boot to a cryptographically frozen identity digest, and routes every action through a gate defined over the semantic effect of the action rather than its name. We prove that no amount of learning, skill acquisition, or self-induced governance abstraction can widen the agent's permitted authority without an operator-signed change to its identity; the guarantee holds even when the agent induces its own safety principle and that principle is wrong. Empirically, in an open-ended tool-use benchmark where a large action space rules out name-based blocking, ungoverned software agents under reward pressure attempt to tamper with their own evaluation at a task-dependent rate that reaches every run on the hardest task, whereas the gate reduces executed forbidden effects to zero as a verified property of the construction while preserving task success. An adversarial evaluation of monitors of increasing semantic depth shows false-allows falling from 75% (name-based gating) to zero (dynamic effect tracing), and refusal history transfers compliance to held-out red-line families. Trust in a deployed learning agent shifts from a wager on its continued alignment to a check anyone can run at boot.
zh_title: 受控个体化：将智能体的学习与其权限进行密码学解耦
translation: 自主智能体正从沙盒化的文本生成器转变为代码、数据和物理基础设施的操作员，并且它们在部署期间越来越多地进行学习。这重新提出了一个对齐技术只能给出概率性回答的问题：在智能体于实际环境中进行自适应后，运行中的系统是否仍被限制在操作员授权的范围内？在本文中，我们证明了这种限制可以作为智能体执行架构的隐式不变性（invariant）得到保证，而不是其训练的概率性结果。受控个体化（Governed individuation）在启动时将智能体绑定到一个密码学冻结的身份摘要上，并将每个操作路由到一个基于操作的语义效果（而非其名称）定义的网关。我们证明，在没有操作员签名的身份变更的情况下，任何程度的学习、技能获取或自我诱导的治理抽象都无法扩大智能体被允许的权限；即使在智能体推导出自己的安全原则且该原则错误的情况下，该保证依然成立。在实证方面，在一个开放式工具使用基准测试中（其中庞大的操作空间排除了基于名称的阻断），处于奖励压力下的未受控软件智能体试图篡改自身评估的频率与任务相关，在最难的任务中这一比例达到100%，而该网关在保持任务成功的同时，将执行的禁用效果降至零（作为该构建的验证属性）。对具有递增语义深度的监控器进行的对抗性评估显示，误允许率从75%（基于名称的网关）下降到零（动态效果追踪），并且拒绝历史将合规性转移到了留存的红线类别中。对部署的学习智能体的信任，从对其持续对齐的赌注，转变为任何人都能在启动时进行的检查。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“受控个体化”的架构，通过密码学手段将智能体的学习与操作员授权隔离开来，确保智能体在部署后的学习和行为不会超出预设的权限边界。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将智能体的安全对齐问题从“概率性的模型训练对齐”转变为“确定性的系统架构约束”。通过密码学手段和动态语义效果追踪，为自主智能体的安全部署提供了一种硬性的安全边界。其局限性可能在于对“语义效果”的定义和实时监控需要极高的精度，在极其复杂或未知的动作空间中，如何确保语义追踪的完备性和低延迟仍是一个挑战。
motivation: 随着自主智能体在部署中不断学习，传统的对齐技术只能概率性地保证其行为不越界。当智能体在实际应用中自适应后，如何确保运行中的系统仍局限在操作员授权的范围内，是一个亟待解决的安全问题。
method: 提出“受控个体化”（Governed Individuation）执行架构。该架构在启动时将智能体绑定到一个密码学冻结的身份摘要上，并将智能体的每个操作路由到一个基于操作“语义效果”（而非操作名称）定义的网关（gate）中进行过滤和控制。
results: 在开放式工具使用基准测试中，未受控的智能体在奖励压力下会尝试篡改评估，而该网关将执行的禁用效果降低至零，同时保持任务成功率。对抗性评估显示，误允许率（false-allows）从基于名称过滤的75%降至动态效果追踪的0%，且拒绝历史能将合规性转移到留存的红线类别中。
conclusion: 通过密码学和语义网关的设计，将对部署后学习智能体的信任，从对其持续对齐的“赌注”转变为任何人都可以在启动时运行的“确定性检查”。

title: SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing
authors: Stone Tao, Jie Xu, Hesam Rabeti, Yashraj Narang, Yijie Guo, Iretiayo Akinola
abstract: Linear-deformable manipulation remains challenging due to the complex deformations of objects such as cables and ropes. Prior data-driven approaches, particularly imitation learning, have shown some promise in narrowly defined settings but typically require thousands of demonstrations for specific tasks and cable types, limiting scalability and generalization. We introduce a sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework for multi-stage cable routing that leverages GPU-parallelized simulation to approximate linear deformable behaviors. Training across thousands of parallel simulations enables the learned policies to generalize across diverse cable geometries and deformation patterns. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we propose a novel deployment strategy that combines a Simulation In the LOop (SILO) execution framework, localized RL policies, and robust cable state estimation. On real-world cable routing tasks, our approach achieves higher success rates and 2x reduction in cycle times compared to prior state-of-the-art learning methods. To our knowledge, this is the first successful sim-to-real transfer of RL policies for multi-stage cable routing. Videos and additional visualizations are available at https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/
zh_title: SILO：用于多阶段线缆布线的仿真在环Sim-to-Real迁移研究
translation: 线性可变形物体（如线缆和绳索）的操作因其复杂的变形特性而极具挑战性。先前的基于数据的方法，特别是模仿学习，在狭窄的设定下显示出一定的前景，但通常需要针对特定任务和线缆类型进行数千次演示，限制了其可扩展性和泛化能力。我们引入了一种用于多阶段线缆布线的Sim-to-Real强化学习（RL）框架，该框架利用GPU并行仿真来近似线性可变形行为。通过在数千个并行仿真中进行训练，使得学习到的策略能够推广到不同的线缆几何形状和变形模式。为了弥合Sim-to-Real差距，我们提出了一种新颖的部署策略，该策略结合了仿真在环（SILO）执行框架、局部RL策略和鲁棒的线缆状态估计。在真实世界的线缆布线任务中，与现有的最先进学习方法相比，我们的方法实现了更高的成功率，并将周期时间缩短了2倍。据我们所知，这是首次成功将强化学习策略应用于多阶段线缆布线的Sim-to-Real迁移。视频和更多可视化内容可在 https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/ 查看。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于复杂线缆布线任务的强化学习框架，通过大规模并行仿真训练与SILO部署策略，实现了高效的Sim-to-Real迁移，显著提升了操作成功率并降低了时间成本。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将GPU并行仿真与“仿真在环（SILO）”部署策略相结合，克服了传统模仿学习数据需求量大且泛化能力差的痛点。其贡献在于首次实现了多阶段线缆布线的Sim-to-Real强化学习迁移，显著提升了效率，为处理复杂柔性物体操作提供了可扩展的路径。
motivation: 现有的数据驱动方法（如模仿学习）在处理线缆等线性可变形物体时，存在需要大量演示、泛化能力差且难以扩展的问题。
method: 提出了一种基于GPU并行仿真的强化学习框架，并结合了SILO（Simulation In the LOop）执行策略、局部强化学习策略以及鲁棒的线缆状态估计方法来弥合仿真与现实间的差距。
results: 在真实世界的线缆布线任务中，该方法相比现有的最先进学习方法，不仅提高了成功率，还将操作周期缩短了2倍。
conclusion: SILO框架成功实现了强化学习在多阶段线缆布线任务中的Sim-to-Real迁移，在保持高成功率的同时，大幅缩短了操作周期。

title: CARD: Cross-component Audio Representation Distillation for Encoder-Free Audio Captioning
authors: Ganesh Pavan Kartikeya Bharadwaj Kolluri, Yuchen Zhang, Michael Kampouridis, Ravi Shekhar
abstract: Modern automated audio captioning systems pair a frozen audio encoder with a large language model (LLM) via a trainable projector, incurring the encoder's inference cost and bottlenecking the model through its fixed acoustic features. We present CARD, an encoder-free audio captioning model that removes the encoder at inference: a 13.2M projector feeds a frozen LLM with merged LoRA adapters, while the teacher used to train it is discarded. CARD distills a pretrained audio teacher (CLAP-HTSAT) into the model, but rather than injecting it into the LLM alone, it routes the teacher's representations across components: perceptual stages to the projector and semantic stages to the LLM. This placement improves CIDEr-D by +12.18 over an LLM-only distilled model on AudioCaps and by +5.21 on Clotho, reaching 55.4 against a 66.4 encoder-kept upper bound with no encoder at inference, showing that where a teacher's knowledge is placed matters as much as its presence.
zh_title: CARD：用于无编码器音频描述的跨组件音频表示蒸馏
translation: 现代自动音频描述系统通过可训练的投影器将冻结的音频编码器与大语言模型（LLM）配对，这不仅带来了编码器的推理成本，还通过其固定的声学特征限制了模型性能。我们提出了CARD，一种在推理时移除编码器的音频描述模型：一个13.2M参数的投影器配合合并了LoRA适配器的冻结LLM，而训练时使用的教师模型在推理时被丢弃。CARD将预训练的音频教师模型（CLAP-HTSAT）蒸馏到模型中，但它没有仅仅将知识注入LLM，而是将教师的表示跨组件路由：感知阶段特征传给投影器，语义阶段特征传给LLM。这种布局使AudioCaps上的CIDEr-D比仅蒸馏到LLM的模型提高了+12.18，Clotho上提高了+5.21，在推理时没有编码器的情况下达到了55.4的得分（保留编码器的上限为66.4），这表明教师知识放置的位置与知识本身同样重要。
tldr: CARD通过跨组件蒸馏将音频教师模型的知识注入投影器和LLM，消除了推理时对音频编码器的依赖，实现了高效且高性能的音频描述。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了“无编码器”（encoder-free）的音频描述架构，通过跨组件知识蒸馏有效地将音频特征注入大语言模型。这不仅降低了推理成本，还证明了教师模型知识在不同组件（投影器与LLM）间的精细化分配对于提升模型性能至关重要。
motivation: 现有的音频描述系统依赖于冻结的音频编码器，导致推理成本高昂且受限于固定的声学特征，无法充分发挥大语言模型的潜力。
method: 提出CARD框架，移除了推理阶段的音频编码器。采用跨组件蒸馏策略，将预训练音频教师模型（CLAP-HTSAT）的感知阶段特征输入投影器，语义阶段特征输入大语言模型，并结合LoRA适配器进行微调。
results: 在AudioCaps和Clotho数据集上，CARD相比仅蒸馏到LLM的模型分别提升了12.18和5.21的CIDEr-D分数，在移除编码器的情况下实现了强劲的性能表现。
conclusion: CARD成功移除了推理时的音频编码器，通过跨组件蒸馏策略在保持较低计算开销的同时，实现了显著的性能提升，为轻量化音频描述系统提供了新思路。

title: MRMS: A Multi-Resolution Memory Substrate for Long-Lived AI Agents
authors: Jizhizi Li, Amy Shi-Nash
abstract: Long-lived AI agents require continuity across interactions, but continuity cannot be obtained by simply extending the prompt window. An agent must preserve useful prior experience, retrieve it selectively, distinguish personal context from external evidence, and revise memory when the underlying situation changes. We propose an architectural memory substrate organized along two orthogonal axes: a representational axis spanning structured records, vector representations, and graph relations; and a temporal axis spanning short-term traces, medium-term abstractions, and long-term semantic commitments. Its key design constraint is synchronized structured-vector-graph memory: structured records govern eligibility, vector representations support recall, and graph relations adjudicate support, contradiction, and supersession before gated context projection. Its central claim is that reliable personalization is a memory design problem: useful memory is structured, selectively exposed, continuously consolidated, and epistemically labeled rather than stored as undifferentiated conversation history. Beyond the framework, we instantiate MRMS as a lightweight prototype implementing structured records, vector retrieval, temporal policies, and graph-based revision. The prototype exercises the core substrate mechanisms through pre-generation memory selection, revision, boundary enforcement, and evidence attribution under controlled long-lived interaction scenarios with explicit evidence requirements.
zh_title: 多分辨率记忆基底：面向长时AI代理
translation: 长时AI代理需要跨交互的连续性，但仅通过扩展提示窗口无法获得连续性。代理必须保存有用先验经验、选择性检索、区分个人上下文与外部证据，并在底层情况变化时修订记忆。我们提出了一个沿两个正交轴组织的架构化记忆基底：沿表征轴跨越结构化记录、向量表示和图关系；沿时间轴跨越短期痕迹、中期抽象和长期语义承诺。其关键设计约束是同步的结构化-向量-图记忆：结构化记录管理资格，向量表示支持检索，图关系在门控上下文投影前裁决支持、矛盾和替代。其核心论点是，可靠的个性化是一个记忆设计问题：有用的记忆是结构化的、选择性公开的、持续巩固的，并且是认识论上标记过的，而不是作为未区分的对话历史存储。除了框架之外，我们实例化了MRMS作为一个轻量级原型，实现了结构化记录、向量检索、时间策略和基于图的修订。该原型在具有明确证据要求的受控长时交互场景下，通过预生成记忆选择、修订、边界执行和证据归因，演练了核心基底机制。
tldr: 长时AI代理需要跨交互的连续性，这不能仅通过扩展提示窗口实现。MRMS提出了一种沿表征（结构化记录、向量表示、图关系）和时间（短期、中期、长期）两个维度组织的记忆基底，解决了经验保存、选择性检索、区分个人上下文与外部证据以及情境变化时的记忆修订问题。其核心设计约束是同步的结构化-向量-图记忆，并通过轻量级原型MRMS进行了实例化。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的多分辨率记忆基底（MRMS），为解决长时AI代理的连续性问题提供了重要的理论和实践指导。MRMS在表征和时间两个维度上对记忆进行组织，并通过结构化-向量-图的同步机制，有效解决了经验的存储、检索和修订问题。其核心论点——个性化是记忆设计问题——具有深刻的洞察力。轻量级原型的实现和实验验证增加了该研究的实际价值。然而，关于该基底在处理更复杂、动态变化的环境中的可扩展性和鲁棒性仍有待进一步研究。
motivation: 长时AI代理需要跨交互的连续性，而仅仅扩展提示窗口无法实现这一点。代理需要能够保存有用先验经验、选择性检索、区分个人上下文与外部证据，并在底层情况变化时修订记忆。
method: 提出了一种沿表征（结构化记录、向量表示、图关系）和时间（短期痕迹、中期抽象、长期语义承诺）两个正交轴组织的架构化记忆基底。其关键设计约束是同步的结构化-向量-图记忆，其中结构化记录管理资格，向量表示支持检索，图关系在门控上下文投影前裁决支持、矛盾和替代。
results: 实例化了一个轻量级原型MRMS，实现了结构化记录、向量检索、时间策略和基于图的修订。该原型通过预生成记忆选择、修订、边界执行和证据归因，在具有明确证据要求的受控长时交互场景中，对核心基底机制进行了演练。
conclusion: 可靠的个性化是一个记忆设计问题，有用的记忆应该是结构化的、选择性公开的、持续巩固的，并且是认识论上标记过的，而不是作为未区分的对话历史存储。

title: DIVO: Continuous-time DVL-Inertial-Visual Odometry for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
authors: Kyungmin Jung, Angad Bajwa, Junha Yoo, Arturo Del Castillo Bernal, James Richard Forbes
abstract: This paper presents a novel acoustic-visual-inertial odometry solution leveraging a continuous-time trajectory estimation framework for unmanned underwater vehicles. Underwater environments present unique challenges for visual localization and mapping, such as light attenuation, illumination variance, and the presence of particulate matter. This motivates the use of additional sensing modalities and a visual tracking pipeline that is robust to diverse subsea conditions. The proposed system is the first continuous-time trajectory estimation framework based on Gaussian processes to fuse asynchronous measurements from a Doppler velocity log, a stereo camera, and an inertial measurement unit. Additionally, a novel visual frontend is proposed, incorporating learning-based feature extraction and matching that is robust to the specific challenges that subsea environments present. The proposed framework enables seamless integration of additional sensor modalities in continuous-time and is adaptable to different environments without reconfiguration. The proposed system is extensively tested on real-world underwater inspection datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art visual-inertial and acoustic-visual-inertial SLAM algorithms in accuracy, robustness, and trajectory coverage. Notably, the proposed system outperforms the state-of-the-art despite only forming short-term visual data associations.
zh_title: 无人无畏载具的连续时间多普勒计程仪-惯性-视觉里程计：DIVO
translation: 本文提出了一种利用连续时间轨迹估计框架的新型声学-视觉-惯性里程计解决方案，用于无人水下航行器。水下环境对视觉定位和建图提出了独特的挑战，例如光线衰减、照度变化和悬浮颗粒物的存在。这促使我们使用额外的传感模态和对各种水下条件具有鲁棒性的视觉跟踪流程。本系统是第一个基于高斯过程的连续时间轨迹估计框架，用于融合来自多普勒计程仪、立体相机和惯性测量单元的异步测量数据。此外，还提出了一种新颖的视觉前端，其中包含基于学习的特征提取和匹配，能够对水下环境提出的具体挑战具有鲁棒性。所提出的框架能够无缝地将额外的传感器模态集成到连续时间中，并且可以适应不同的环境而无需重新配置。所提出的系统在真实世界的水下检测数据集上得到了广泛的测试，在精度、鲁棒性和轨迹覆盖范围方面均优于最先进的视觉-惯性（VI）和声学-视觉-惯性（AVI）SLAM算法。值得注意的是，尽管所提出的系统仅进行了短期视觉数据关联，但其性能优于最先进的技术。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为DIVO的新型水下航行器声学-视觉-惯性里程计系统，采用连续时间高斯过程轨迹估计框架，融合了多普勒计程仪、立体相机和惯性测量单元的异步测量数据。该系统具有学习型特征提取和匹配的前端，能够应对水下复杂环境的挑战，并在真实数据集上超越了现有技术。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的DIVO系统在解决水下复杂环境的视觉里程计问题上取得了显著进展，其创新的连续时间高斯过程框架和鲁棒的视觉前端是关键亮点。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索其在大规模、长期水下任务中的表现，以及在更广泛的水下传感器组合下的适应性。
motivation: 水下环境对视觉定位和建图提出了独特的挑战，如光线衰减、照度变化和悬浮颗粒物，因此需要利用额外的传感模态和鲁棒的视觉跟踪流程。
method: 提出了一种基于高斯过程的连续时间轨迹估计框架，融合了多普勒计程仪、立体相机和惯性测量单元的异步测量数据。该方法还包含了一个新颖的视觉前端，采用了基于学习的特征提取和匹配技术，以提高对水下环境挑战的鲁棒性。
results: 在真实世界的水下检测数据集上进行了广泛测试，DIVO在精度、鲁棒性和轨迹覆盖范围方面均优于最先进的视觉-惯性（VI）和声学-视觉-惯性（AVI）SLAM算法，尽管它只进行了短期视觉数据关联。
conclusion: DIVO是一个创新的连续时间多普勒计程仪-惯性-视觉里程计系统，通过融合多种传感器数据和鲁棒的视觉前端，有效解决了水下环境的挑战，并在性能上超越了现有技术。

title: Markov Decision Process Approximation Methods for Water Distribution Network Inspection and Maintenance: A Case Study of the U.S. Virgin Islands
authors: Minsuk Seo, Daniel A. Eisenberg, Jefferson Huang
abstract: We develop a repair-oriented inspection and maintenance decision framework for water distribution networks. This work is motivated by utilities operating in data-sparse environments, such as in remote locations like the U.S. Virgin Islands, where data collection about network state and underground pipeline outages is limited to above-ground and easy to access information (e.g., water tank levels and pump operations). We formulate the problem as a discounted Markov decision process and integrate it with high-fidelity hydraulic simulation. The model captures latent system dynamics without requiring pipe-level sensing. The results reveal state-dependent optimal policies and heterogeneous failure characteristics across pipes, including rare but high-impact behaviors. We further show that certain observable system states uniquely correspond to specific pipe failures, enabling a form of virtual sensing. These findings demonstrate that system-level dynamics can support inspection planning and maintenance decisions under uncertainty in resource-constrained settings.
zh_title: 水分配网络检查与维护的马尔可夫决策过程近似方法：以美属维尔京群岛为例
translation: 我们开发了一个面向维修的供水网络检查与维护决策框架。这项工作源于在数据稀缺环境（如美属维尔京群岛等偏远地区）运营的公用事业机构的需求，这些地区关于网络状态和地下管道故障的数据收集仅限于地面及易于获取的信息（如水箱水位和泵运行）。我们将该问题建模为折扣马尔可夫决策过程，并将其与高保真水力仿真相结合。该模型在无需管道级传感的情况下捕捉了潜在的系统动态。结果揭示了状态依赖的最优策略以及各管道之间异构的故障特征，包括罕见但高影响的行为。我们进一步证明，某些可观测的系统状态与特定的管道故障存在唯一对应关系，从而实现了一种虚拟传感形式。这些发现表明，在资源受限的情况下，系统级动态可以支持不确定性环境下的检查规划和维护决策。
tldr: 在缺乏传感器的情况下，利用水箱和泵的运行数据，通过马尔可夫决策过程实现对水管网的虚拟传感与维护决策优化。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用系统级可观测数据（如水箱水位和泵运行情况）通过马尔可夫决策过程推断地下管网的潜在状态，这为数据匮乏地区的资产管理提供了一种低成本的“虚拟传感”解决方案。其局限性可能在于模型对复杂管网的扩展性以及对高保真水力模拟的依赖程度。
motivation: 在美属维尔京群岛等偏远地区，由于数据匮乏且缺乏管道级传感器，公用事业部门难以制定有效的管网检查与维护计划。
method: 将管网维护问题建模为折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并结合高保真水力仿真，利用系统级可观测指标（如水箱水位、泵运行）捕捉潜在的管网状态动态。
results: 研究发现存在状态依赖的最优策略，揭示了不同管道的异构故障特征，并证明了通过观测系统级状态可以实现对特定管道故障的“虚拟传感”。
conclusion: 本研究证明了在资源受限的环境下，利用系统级动态特征进行管网检查和维护决策是可行且有效的，为解决数据缺失问题提供了新路径。

title: Hierarchical Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Long Document Understanding
authors: Junyu Xiong, Yonghui Wang, Rongjian Gu, Chenyu Liu, Bing Yin, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) streamlines long-document understanding by leveraging retrieval mechanisms to restrict input images to a highly curated subset. However, existing multimodal RAG pipelines primarily face two critical challenges: first, standard semantic similarity retrievers frequently fetch topically overlapping yet answer-void distractor pages that mislead downstream generation; second, rigid single-pass pipelines heavily depend on initial retrieval success, where any omission of core evidence inevitably causes cascading errors. To address these challenges, we introduce HIEVI-RAG, a hierarchical, evidence-driven multimodal RAG framework for closed-domain document understanding. HIEVI-RAG systematically factorizes complex queries into a cooperative four-stage pipeline: (1) hierarchical question decomposition to break multi-hop root queries into atomic child questions; (2) coarse visual page retrieval leveraging a multimodal retriever to fetch candidate pages based on semantic similarity; (3) fine-grained page verification via EVIAGENT, a specialized multi-page verifier trained with GRPO to execute cross-page reasoning over multi-image blocks; and (4) memory-guided iterative generation that leverages accumulated sub-question context to execute multi-round, dynamic reasoning over the prioritized sequence. Extensive evaluations across four benchmarks demonstrate the robust efficacy and synergy of our framework, which significantly outperforms existing open-source baselines and exceeds the strongest reported baseline by an average of 8.05% in accuracy.
zh_title: 面向长文档理解的层次化证据驱动推理
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过利用检索机制将输入图像限制在高度精选的子集中，从而简化了长文档的理解。然而，现有的多模态RAG管道主要面临两个关键挑战：首先，标准的语义相似度检索器经常检索到主题重叠但答案为空的干扰页面，从而误导下游生成；其次，僵化的单通道管道在很大程度上依赖于初始检索的成功，任何核心证据的遗漏都不可避免地会导致级联错误。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了HIEVI-RAG，一个用于闭域文档理解的层次化、证据驱动的多模态RAG框架。HIEVI-RAG系统地将复杂查询分解为合作的四阶段管道：（1）层次化问题分解，将多跳根查询分解为原子子查询；（2）粗粒度视觉页面检索，利用多模态检索器基于语义相似度获取候选页面；（3）细粒度页面验证，通过EVIAGENT，一个使用GRPO训练的专用多页面验证器，对多图像块执行跨页面推理；（4）记忆引导的迭代生成，利用累积的子问题上下文执行对优先级序列的多轮动态推理。在四个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，我们的框架具有强大的有效性和协同作用，其准确率显著优于现有的开源基线，平均比最强的报告基线高出8.05%。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为HIEVI-RAG的框架，用于解决长文档理解中的多模态检索增强生成（RAG）问题。该框架通过层次化问题分解、粗粒度视觉页面检索、细粒度页面验证（利用EVIAGENT和GRPO进行跨页面推理）以及记忆引导的迭代生成，克服了现有RAG方法容易检索到无关信息和对初始检索依赖过强的缺点。实验结果表明，HIEVI-RAG在准确率上显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的HIEVI-RAG框架在长文档理解领域具有重要意义，通过引入层次化和证据驱动的方法，有效解决了现有RAG模型的局限性。特别是EVIAGENT和GRPO的应用，以及多阶段的推理过程，展示了在处理复杂、多模态信息方面的创新性。然而，框架的计算复杂度和在不同领域文档上的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 现有基于检索增强生成（RAG）的多模态长文档理解方法面临两大挑战：1. 标准的语义相似度检索器常检索到主题重叠但无答案的干扰页面；2. 僵化的单通道流水线严重依赖初始检索的成功，一旦遗漏核心证据就会导致级联错误。
method: 提出了一种名为HIEVI-RAG的层次化、证据驱动的多模态RAG框架。该框架包含四个阶段：1. 层次化问题分解，将复杂查询分解为原子子问题；2. 粗粒度视觉页面检索，利用多模态检索器获取候选页面；3. 细粒度页面验证，通过名为EVIAGENT的专用多页面验证器，利用GRPO进行多图像块的跨页面推理；4. 记忆引导的迭代生成，利用累积的子问题上下文进行多轮动态推理。
results: 在四个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，HIEVI-RAG框架具有强大的有效性和协同作用，其准确率显著优于现有的开源基线，平均比最强的报告基线高出8.05%。
conclusion: HIEVI-RAG框架通过其层次化、证据驱动的方法，有效解决了长文档理解中多模态RAG面临的挑战，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Can LLMs Really Recover Microservice Failures? A Recovery-Aware Evaluation of Diagnosis-to-Action Reasoning
authors: Jiaxing Qi, Zhongzhi Luan, Hongyu Zhang, Shaohan Huang, Carol Fung, Yongxin Tong, Hailong Yang, Depei Qian
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret operational evidence and assist incident response in cloud-native microservice systems. However, recovery-oriented use cases require more than identifying a root cause. After observing symptoms and diagnosing a fault, an operator or agent must translate the diagnosis into a concrete recovery action, apply it to an admissible target, and verify that service health has been restored. Existing RCA and log-analysis evaluations are well-suited to diagnosis, but they do not characterize this subsequent action decision. This paper presents R2Act, a recovery-action evaluation framework for post-diagnosis incident response. R2Act defines an incident schema, quality gate, action-space representation, recovery-validity metrics, offline evaluator, and live-replay protocol. We instantiate the framework as a benchmark dataset of 302 quality-audited Kubernetes incidents from \system. Each incident provides synchronized multi-modal observations, root-cause labels, an incident-specific action space, and annotated valid and invalid recovery plans. We evaluate heuristic, supervised, RCA-oriented, deep log, and LLM-based methods. The strongest RAG-based LLMs reach 91.4\%--99.7\% root-cause service accuracy, yet their recovery validity remains only 36.8\%--60.3\%. Even when both the root-cause service and fault type are correct, recovery-oriented methods still choose invalid actions for 39.5\%--62.0\% of correctly diagnosed incidents. Overall, this work reveals that many recovery failures arise not from missing diagnostic knowledge, but from the difficulty of translating diagnostic evidence into valid recovery actions and admissible targets. This work provides a reproducible, simplified starting point for research and evaluation.
zh_title: LLM真的能修复微服务故障吗？一种面向恢复的诊断到行动推理评估方法
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于解释运营证据并协助云原生微服务系统中的事件响应。然而，面向恢复的用例需要的不仅仅是识别根本原因。在观察到症状并诊断出故障后，操作员或代理必须将诊断结果转化为具体的恢复行动，将其应用于可接受的目标，并验证服务健康状况是否已恢复。现有的RCA（根因分析）和日志分析评估非常适合诊断，但它们没有描述这种后续的行动决策。本文提出了R2Act，一个用于诊断后事件响应的恢复行动评估框架。R2Act定义了事件模式、质量门控、动作空间表示、恢复有效性指标、线下评估器和实时重放协议。我们将该框架实例化为一个基准数据集，包含302个来自系统的质量审计Kubernetes事件。每个事件都提供了同步的多模态观察、根本原因标签、特定于事件的动作空间以及标注的有效和无效恢复计划。我们评估了启发式方法、监督学习方法、面向RCA的方法、深度日志分析方法和基于LLM的方法。最强的基于RAG的LLM达到了91.4%--99.7%的根本原因服务准确率，但它们的恢复有效性仅为36.8%--60.3%。即使根本原因服务和故障类型都正确，面向恢复的方法在39.5%--62.0%的正确诊断事件中仍然选择了无效的恢复行动。总的来说，这项工作表明，许多恢复失败并非源于诊断知识的缺失，而是源于将诊断证据转化为有效恢复行动和可接受目标的困难。这项工作为研究和评估提供了一个可重复、简化的起点。
tldr: LLM虽然擅长定位微服务故障根因，但在将其转化为有效的恢复行动方面表现欠佳，诊断正确率与恢复成功率之间存在显著差距。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了LLM在微服务运维领域的一个关键痛点：从“诊断”到“行动”的鸿沟。尽管模型在根因分析上表现出色，但在制定可执行、有效的恢复方案上仍存在严重不足，这为后续研究提供了明确的方向（即不仅要提高诊断精度，更要增强行动推理能力）。
motivation: 现有的故障诊断评估主要集中在根因分析（RCA）和日志分析，缺乏对诊断后“采取恢复行动”这一关键环节的系统性评估，导致模型在实际场景中难以有效执行恢复任务。
method: 提出了R2Act评估框架，包含事件模式、质量门控、动作空间表示、恢复有效性指标及线下/线上评估协议；并基于302个Kubernetes故障案例构建了基准数据集。
results: 实验表明，尽管LLM在根因定位上达到了91.4%至99.7%的准确率，但其恢复动作的有效性仅为36.8%至60.3%；即便诊断完全正确，仍有高达39.5%至62.0%的情况会选择无效的恢复行动。
conclusion: LLM在微服务故障恢复任务中表现出诊断能力与行动能力严重失衡的现象，仅靠提升诊断准确率无法解决恢复有效性问题，未来研究需重点关注诊断到行动的映射逻辑。

title: Formal Disco: Scalable Open-Ended Generation of Formally Verified Programs
authors: Gabriel Poesia, Simon Henniger, Tzu-Han Hsu, Yilun Du, Nada Amin
abstract: The cost of producing code is rapidly diminishing with increasingly capable AI agents, while quality assurance of generated programs has not kept pace. Formal verification provides the strongest possible guarantees, but the ability of AI models to work with verification-aware languages is hindered by the scarcity of human-written examples of programs in those languages. To tackle this prevalent data scarcity issue, we propose Formal Disco: a distributed system for coordination of LLM-based workers that can be easily applied to open-ended synthetic data generation at scale. We use Formal Disco to share tasks and programs between three classes of workers: "initiators", which read random READMEs from open-source repositories and documentation snippets to sketch a related verified program, "fixers" which take compiler and verifier feedback and attempt to resolve issues, and "extenders" that take working programs and propose patches to expand them. Formal Disco records all agent-generated traces and uses them both for initial distillation from a stronger model as well as self-improvement. We also propose a principle of maximum entropy for synthetic program generation, and use entropy maximization via iterative supervised fine-tuning to learn to generate increasingly diverse programs over time. We release large datasets of synthetic verified programs in three languages - Dafny, Verus, and Frama-C -, and fine-tune open models for verification-relevant tasks, often matching or exceeding the performance of Claude Opus 4.5. Overall, our work offers a path to create synthetic data at scale for formal reasoning domains and overcome the long-standing data barrier.

title: Exploiting Structural Properties for Efficient Constraint-Aware HNSW Hyperparameter Tuning
authors: Geon Choi, Hoeun Lee, Jaeyoung Do
abstract: Vector databases (VectorDBs) are a core component of modern retrieval systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is critical. Among ANNS algorithms, Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs are widely adopted for their strong recalllatency trade-off. However, configuring HNSW remains challenging: its hyperparameters jointly affect search quality, latency, build time, and index size in nonlinear ways, while production deployments impose strict resource and tuning-time constraints.We study HNSW hyperparameter tuning from a systems perspective and show that its configuration space exhibits strong structural regularities. Specifically, we identify monotonic, dominant unimodal, and separable relationships among search-time and construction-time parameters, which induce feasibility boundaries under performance and resource constraints. Building on this insight, we propose CHAT, a constraint-aware tuning framework for HNSW. Unlike generic black-box optimizers, CHAT exploits HNSW-specific structure to perform deterministic, sample-efficient search and prune resource-infeasible configurations before full index construction. Across multiple datasets and HNSW-based vector search engines, CHAT identifies configurations that maximize recall or throughput while satisfying constraints on accuracy, latency, build time, index size, and tuning budget. Compared to strong baselines, CHAT achieves up to 45% higher throughput or 11% higher recall, and converges up to 44x faster. These results show that principled, structure-aware tuning enables efficient and robust HNSW deployment beyond generic black-box optimization.
comment: This paper has been accepted to ACM SIGMOD 2027

title: Governed Caste Reassignment in Heterogeneous Swarms: An Asymmetric-Trust Protocol with Audited Operator Countersignature
authors: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li
abstract: In heterogeneous robot swarms, caste reassignment (rebinding a robot to a new capability-bound role) is a high-frequency runtime event driven by battery, payload, and priority changes. Existing approaches treat it as an internal allocation algorithm and do not expose the reassignment to external authority. We argue that for regulated embodied deployments a caste change that elevates a robot's privilege envelope is a governance event that must be auditable and externally authorised. We propose an asymmetric-trust protocol: auto-tightening reassignments (to safer, lower-privilege castes) are admitted automatically, while bounded relaxation (to higher-privilege castes) requires an operator countersignature against a per-axis budget. Each transition carries a signed cause-chain, committed to a hash-chained Merkle audit log that an offline auditor verifies from an operator-signed identity manifest alone. We evaluate a reference implementation with real Ed25519 signatures over fleets up to 100 robots: auto-tightening completes in single-digit to low-double-digit milliseconds, and the governed protocol refuses four explicit attacks (caste laundering, repeated-relaxation escalation, operator impersonation, cause-chain forgery) by construction, with a partially-governed baseline isolating which gate stops which attack and a randomized fuzz adversary finding no admission. A distributed audit layer replicates the log across N per-member replicas with quorum-committed total order and cryptographic fork exclusion; we prove agreement and fork exclusion and validate them both in simulation and as a real multi-process deployment over TCP sockets (up to 100 real processes) with a Byzantine equivocator, on which every honest replica agrees, detects the equivocation, and commits no fork. The construction generalises a single-agent persona-mutation governance gate to swarm-level caste governance.

title: Reliability and Identifiability in Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Variance Decomposition, Stability Bounds, and the Identifiability of Heterogeneous News Reaction
authors: Salavat Ishbulatov
abstract:
Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC) estimates distributions of market-outcome functionals by repeatedly simulating limit-order-book interaction among $K$ neural policy bots whose behavioral personas are drawn from a learned heterogeneity distribution $\mathcal{P}$. This paper develops the statistical theory that makes the word "reliable" precise for such estimators.
  We decompose estimator variance into a persona-draw component $σ_P^2$ and a within-run component $σ_w^2$, give unbiased ANOVA estimators of both, and derive the variance-optimal allocation of a fixed compute budget between outer persona draws and inner replications. A coupling-based stability bound quantifies how misestimation of $\mathcal{P}$ and error in the trained policy propagate into the estimand, yielding a three-term total-error budget whose terms are separately estimable; a uniform-in-horizon version holds under a Doeblin condition on the market chain.
  The main contribution is an identification theory for heterogeneous news reaction: under a fixed response nonlinearity, the aggregate impact curve $A(z)=\mathbb{E}_Q[g(ηz)]$ detects heterogeneous news sensitivity through a strict Jensen gap and identifies the distribution $Q$ locally via odd moments and Hausdorff determinacy, with sharp failure when the response family is unknown. We provide $\sqrt{n}$-consistent estimators and a boundary-corrected test of homogeneous news reaction. Two separation theorems delimit when PTMC is provably preferable to homogeneous-population simulators and reduced-form forecasters, formalizing an irreducible Jensen bias floor and the Lucas critique as a minimax limit on intervention extrapolation. All proofs are given in full; guarantees are classified as unconditional (Monte Carlo convergence), conditional worst-case (the error budget), or open (the large-$K$ mean-field limit).
comment: 29 pages. Companion theory paper to arXiv:2606.29556 (framework specification, "Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Estimating Market-Outcome Distributions via Swarms of Persona-Conditioned Neural Policy Bots in a Limit Order Book"). Theory-only: all proofs given in full, no simulation results reported
zh_title: Persona训练蒙特卡洛模拟中的可靠性与可识别性：方差分解、稳定性界限及异质性新闻反应的可识别性
translation: Persona训练蒙特卡洛（PTMC）通过重复模拟$K$个行为人格取自学习到的异质性分布$\mathcal{P}$的神经策略机器人的限价订单簿交互，来估计市场结果函数的分布。本文发展了使此类估计量“可靠”一词精确化的统计理论。我们对方差进行了人格抽取分量$\sigma_P^2$和运行内分量$\sigma_w^2$的分解，给出了两者的无偏ANOVA估计量，并推导了固定计算预算在外部人格抽取和内部复制之间的方差最优分配。基于耦合的稳定性界限量化了$\mathcal{P}$的误估计和训练策略中的误差如何传播到估计量中，产生了可分别估计的三项总误差预算；在市场链的Doeblin条件下，该结论在时间跨度上是一致的。主要贡献在于异质性新闻反应的识别理论：在固定的响应非线性下，聚合影响曲线$A(z)=\mathbb{E}_Q[g(\eta z)]$通过严格的Jensen间隙检测异质性新闻敏感度，并通过奇数矩和Hausdorff确定性局部识别分布$Q$，但在响应族未知时识别会发生尖锐失败。我们提供了$\sqrt{n}$-一致性估计量和同质性新闻反应的边界校正检验。两个分离定理划定了PTMC在何种情况下被证明优于同质总体模拟器和简化形式预测器，将不可约的Jensen偏差底线和卢卡斯批判形式化为干预外推的极小极大极限。所有证明均已给出；保证分为无条件（蒙特卡洛收敛）、条件最坏情况（误差预算）或开放（大$K$均值场极限）。
tldr: 本文为Persona-Trained Monte Carlo方法构建了严谨的统计理论框架，解决了方差分解与计算分配问题，并证明了该方法在识别异质性市场行为方面的有效性与局限性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过严谨的统计框架为“Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC)”奠定了理论基础，不仅解决了方差分解和计算预算分配问题，还通过Jensen间隙理论在异质性新闻反应识别方面取得了重要进展。其局限在于对大$K$均值场极限的分析仍处于开放状态。
motivation: 现有Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC) 方法缺乏严谨的统计可靠性定义，且在处理代理人异质性及新闻反应识别方面缺乏理论支撑，亟需建立误差界限与识别理论。
method: 1. 对方差进行方差分析（ANOVA）分解；2. 利用耦合（coupling）技术推导稳定性界限；3. 基于Jensen间隙和Hausdorff确定性理论建立异质性新闻反应的识别理论；4. 提供$\sqrt{n}$一致性估计量及同质性反应的边界校正检验。
results: 1. 给出了方差分解及其最优计算预算分配策略；2. 推导了包含模型错误、策略误差和采样误差的总误差预算；3. 证明了通过聚合冲击曲线可识别异质性新闻敏感度；4. 确立了PTMC优于同质化模拟器的分离定理。
conclusion: 本文为PTMC方法提供了完整的统计可靠性理论，明确了其在处理异质性行为模拟时的误差来源与识别边界，并证明了在特定条件下PTMC优于传统同质化模拟器。

title: Aperture-aware Dispersion 5-D Light-field Imaging Spectrometer
authors: Chenglong Huang, Tao Lv, Jianing Yang, Chongde Zi, Linsen Chen, Xun Cao
abstract: Enhancing perceptual dimensions while miniaturizing imaging systems presents significant challenges for high-dimensional visual sensing. Conventionally, the acquisition of the 5D (x,y,u,v,λ) spectral light field (5D-SLF) data cube relies on bulky and expensive camera arrays, which are impractical for widespread application. Existing single-detector systems are fundamentally limited by a trade-off between the resolutions of different dimensions owing to insufficient coding capabilities. Here we introduce an Aperture-aware Dispersion Light-field Imaging Spectrometer (ADLIS), that targets a synergy between compactness and resolution through aperture-multiplexed modulation, leveraging the inherent spectral-filtering properties of birefringent material. Using only a manufacturing-friendly and cost-effective phase plate made of birefringent quartz crystal, the aperture of the proposed ADLIS enables compact angular-spectral encoding that is highly sensitive to both the incident angle and spectrum of incoming light. In contrast to the viewpoint-separation approach of microlens arrays, ADLIS employs aperture encoding to superimpose all viewpoints onto each sensor pixel. This shifts the design paradigm from spatial division to encoding integration, aiming to achieve full-resolution light field recovery. Thus, we develop the Aperture-aware Dispersion Light-field Imaging (ADLI) framework, which optimizes the aperture design and 5D-SLF reconstruction in an end-to-end (E2E) manner. Trained by simulation data and validated through real-world experiments, our system achieves robust high-performance 5D-SLF imaging while maintaining full spatial resolution.

title: PixelPilot: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
authors: Pin Tang, Guoqing Wang, Xiangxuan Ren, Zhongdao Wang, Guodongfang Zhao, Bailan, Chao Ma
abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs), which leverage the advanced reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show promising generalization in complex autonomous driving scenarios. Existing VLAs typically predict and optimize 3D trajectories from 2D images. While intuitive, this 2D-to-3D prediction is inherently entangled with camera parameters, leading to limited data scalability across heterogeneous driving datasets. Moreover, directly optimizing in 3D space induces severe convergence to trivial solutions, where VLAs rely on ego-status rather than visual scene understanding. To address these issues, we propose PixelPilot, a novel VLA featuring a decoupled planning and lifting paradigm. In the planning phase, PixelPilot reformulates scene understanding and trajectory prediction as sensor-agnostic 2D-to-2D tasks in the image plane, thereby facilitating scalable training across diverse datasets. The planned 2D trajectories are then deterministically lifted to 3D only during inference, ensuring the full exploitation of visual cues and generalization across different vehicles. To realize this paradigm, we propose a knowledge-instilled policy learning strategy that applies dense, intermediate rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enforce a rigorous causal chain from visual perception to spatial planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PixelPilot achieves state-of-the-art performance in both open-loop and closed-loop settings, validating its superior scalability and visual reasoning capabilities.

title: Enhancing Large Multimodal Models in Key Information Extraction via Scene-Aware Document Synthesis
authors: Zhipeng Xu, Zulong Chen, Qing Liu, Junhao Ji, Jinxin Hu, Yipeng Yu, Jianqiang Wan, Jun Tang, Zhao Li
abstract: Key Information Extraction (KIE) converts visually rich documents into structured data, but practical deployment remains challenging: strong performance often relies on costly on-server Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), while compact locally deployable models lack sufficient KIE supervision. We present SAYRE, a scene-aware document synthesis framework for generating scalable KIE training data without hand-crafted template design. Given a few exemplar documents, SAYRE captures category-specific content patterns and layout conventions to synthesize document-schema-annotation triples. It further introduces error-driven generation, which expands real-world failure cases into hard training examples while preserving their structural patterns. Experiments on constrained- and open-category KIE show that SAYRE consistently improves Qwen3-VL backbones and achieves the strongest overall performance among on-device LMMs. Data scaling experiments show an overall upward trend as more synthesized data is introduced, especially for smaller models and open-category extraction. Error analysis further shows that synthesized training reduces field-level errors by improving schema-aware extraction over dense tables, business identifiers, and contract clauses. These results establish scene-aware synthesis as an effective data-centric approach for improving practical multimodal KIE.

title: Learning Structured Visual Compositional Representations for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
authors: Lian Xu, Mohammed Bennamoun, Farid Boussaid, Hamid Laga, Yulan Guo, Dan Xu
abstract: Referring expression comprehension (REC) aims to localize the object in an image described by natural language. In Weakly supervised REC (WREC), existing approaches primarily operate on anchor-level visual representations. Even when enriched with auxiliary cues, relational interactions remain implicitly encoded within individual anchor features. The resulting visual representation remains flat and unary-only, limiting its ability to align with the structured nature of language. In this work, we propose a Structured Visual Compositional Representation (SVCR) learning framework for WREC. Rather than implicitly encoding relations within unary anchors, the proposed SVCR explicitly models both unary object embeddings and pairwise relational embeddings, forming a structured visual representation space. We further introduce a compositional alignment mechanism that matches unary and pairwise visual representations with their corresponding textual embeddings in a unified manner, enabling compositional visual-textual matching under weak supervision. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg show that the proposed SVCR achieves state-of-the-art performance. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit structured visual representations and visual-textual alignment for WREC.

title: Wrong Before Right: Late Rescue and Interface Failure in Aligned Language Models
authors: Jiaqi Deng
abstract: We study how correctness is assembled inside aligned language models, not only whether the final answer is right. Using layer-wise difference-in-differences (DiD) trajectories over polarity-controlled minimal pairs, we identify the wrong-dip: in mid layers (25-90% depth), internal preference transiently commits to the incorrect answer and is rescued only by late-layer correction. We verify this causally with patchscope-style activation transplantation across 17 models, three families, and 64x scale (0.5B-32B). Four findings follow. (1) Alignment amplification of the causal wrong-dip is recipe-specific and emergent: it emerges at 3B in Qwen2.5, remains high, and peaks at 32B (paired t up to 9.7), reverses in Llama-3-8B (t=-2.31), and sits between for Mistral-7B. (2) The dip predicts real compression failures: high-dip items are 3-7x more likely to flip under late-layer low-rank compression, block dropping, or structured pruning, while quantization flips are dip-blind, a double dissociation confirmed by late-layer ablation. (3) The dip is trainable: a LoRA fine-tune with a mid-layer wrong-margin penalty matches output-only SFT accuracy while cutting the causal dip by 67-70% and improving compression robustness; output-only SFT worsens the causal dip by up to 2.8x at perfect surface accuracy. (4) With controlled readouts, the phenomenon survives natural-language I/O: dip stratification of structural-damage failures is significant on naturalistic vignettes, and free-form fragility separates into a dip-auditable late-rescue layer and a dip-blind interface layer. Together, output-level correctness can hide a late-rescue process that governs compression risk, post-training quality, and evaluation distortion.
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures. Code to be released

title: Learning Flexible Generalization in Video Quality Assessment by Bringing Device and Viewing Condition Distributions
authors: Nikolay Safonov, Dmitriy S. Vatolin
abstract: Video quality assessment (VQA) plays a critical role in optimizing video delivery systems. While numerous objective metrics have been proposed to approximate human perception, the perceived quality strongly depends on viewing conditions and display characteristics. Factors such as ambient lighting, display brightness, and resolution significantly influence the visibility of distortions. In this work, we address the question of the multi-screen quality assessment on mobile devices, as this area still tends to be under-covered. We introduce a first large-scale subjective dataset collected across more than different 300 Android devices, accompanied by metadata on viewing conditions and display properties. We propose a strategy for aggregated score extraction and adaptation of VQA models to device-specific quality estimation. Our results demonstrate that incorporating device and context information enables more accurate and flexible quality prediction, offering new opportunities for fine-grained optimization in streaming services. Ultimately, this work advances the development of perceptual quality models that bridge the gap between laboratory evaluations and the diverse conditions of real-world media consumption. We made the dataset and the code available at https://videoprocessing.github.io/device-viewing-conditions.

title: KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation
authors: Xinyu Shao, Keru Zhou, Guowei Huang, Yajun Gao, Tongtong Cao, Xiu Li
abstract: Learning manipulation from few demonstrations requires visual priors that capture not only where to interact, but also how the interaction should begin; static priors such as segmentation masks encode only the former. We present KAM-WM, a framework that extracts a coarse directional interaction cue from a frozen latent video world model without rollout or world-model fine-tuning. KAM-WM queries a Flow Matching image-to-video backbone once and interprets its single-step latent velocity as a Kinematic Affordance Map (KAM), which provides task-conditioned interaction regions and coarse motion structure. A lightweight Perceiver compresses KAM into tokens that condition a diffusion policy together with RGB observations and proprioception. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, KAM-WM reaches 90.6% average success on LIBERO and achieves 65.7% and 22.4% success rates in the Easy and Hard settings on RoboTwin2.0, respectively. Controlled comparisons against a zero-order mask prior suggest that part of the gains comes from directional information beyond spatial localization alone. These results indicate that, in the evaluated settings, a frozen video model can provide a useful first-order visual prior for control without the test-time cost of future rollout.

title: Retroactive Chain-of-Thought (RetroCoT): Forensic Reconstruction Prompts as a Safety Diagnostic Across Model Generations
authors: Samira Hajizadeh
abstract: Safety alignment in large language models is typically evaluated against direct, imperative harmful requests. We show that this alignment is highly conditioned on pragmatic register: models that refuse a direct request frequently comply when the same underlying objective is expressed through a different communicative stance. This suggests that current alignment policies are not invariant to semantic equivalence, but remain sensitive to how a request is pragmatically framed. We introduce Retroactive Chain-of-Thought (RetroCoT), a single-turn attack that reframes harmful requests as forensic reconstruction tasks. Rather than requesting harmful instructions directly, RetroCoT presupposes that the harmful outcome has already occurred and asks the model, acting as a forensic analyst, to reconstruct in reverse the causal chain that produced it. On AdvBench (n=50), RetroCoT achieves attach success rate of 58% on gpt-4o and 52% on gpt-4o-mini, compared with direct-request baselines of 0% and 4%, respectively. We further identify a pronounced generation gap: GPT-5-family models refuse RetroCoT entirely, explicitly identifying the reconstruction premise in their refusal rationales, consistent with explicit coverage of this reconstruction register. However, this robustness does not generalize across pragmatic forms. A single adversarial feedback turn presenting an existing forensic reconstruction response alongside evaluator critique raises ASR from 0% to 48% on GPT-5.4-mini and from 58% to 94% on GPT-4o; a control condition omitting the fabricated low score achieves 85% on GPT-5.4-mini, indicating that the operative element is pragmatic continuation within the established forensic frame rather than score manipulation. These results suggest that frontier-model alignment remains conditioned on pragmatic framing rather than semantic intent, and that new pragmatic registers can continue to expose a...

title: Enhancing Video Physical Consistency via Role-aware Joint Training and Modality-decoupled Denoising
authors: Guangting Zheng, Haojing Chen, Hao Li, Jingtao Zhang, Zhen Yang, Xiaosong Jia, Xue Yang, Shaofeng Zhang, Yanyong Zhang
abstract: While modern video diffusion models excel in visual fidelity, maintaining long-range physical consistency remains a formidable challenge. Conventional pixel-reconstruction objectives mainly focus on appearance details and often fail to capture the underlying dynamics of a scene. To mitigate this, recent efforts have integrated auxiliary modalities (e.g., optical flow) to introduce physics priors via joint training with video appearance. However, these methods have three main limitations: (1) they do not distinguish the different motion patterns of different entity types; (2) joint modeling of visual and auxiliary modalities can cause capacity conflicts and weaken the pretrained visual prior; and (3) auxiliary modalities may accumulate errors during inference. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{VPT}, a fine-tuning framework for improving physical consistency in video diffusion models. VPT introduces a role-aware signal that groups entities into agents, controlled objects, passive objects, and background, so that different physical roles can be modeled more clearly. We further propose a modality-decoupled denoising strategy, where the visual and auxiliary channels are assigned independent noise levels. Together with a loss-weight decay strategy, this design makes auxiliary modalities serve as soft constraints rather than strong dependencies, mitigating recursive prediction errors during inference. We also introduce cross-step auto-guidance to further strengthen physical dynamics. Experiments show that VPT improves physical consistency while preserving visual quality, achieving relative gains of 39.4\% in SA and 17.9\% in PC on VideoPhy benchmark over Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and consistent improvements on VideoPhy-2 benchmark. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/VPT.

title: Machine Learning for Depression Screening and Intervention: an Original Circadian Rhythm Score-based Methodology
authors: Bin Wang, Shuo Lian, Yuanyuan Hou, Dexian Wang, Peilan He, Feng Hong, Yanwei Yu, Tianrui Li
abstract: Depression screening from large-scale behavioral data is challenged by fragmented circadian indicators, limited interpretability, and the lack of intervention-oriented analysis. Existing approaches typically analyze sleep, activity, and social behaviors in isolation, failing to capture their joint circadian structure. To address this limitation, we first propose the Circadian Rhythm Score (CRS), a composite index that compresses multi-domain daily behaviors into a unified representation of circadian rhythm. CRS is constructed to maximize discriminative power for depression screening while preserving behavioral semantics through non-negativity constraints. Empirical results demonstrate near-lossless compression, where a single CRS retains almost the full predictive capability compared with multiple raw behavioral indicators. Building upon CRS, we develop an interpretable depression screening framework based on gradient-boosted trees and SHAP analysis, revealing nonlinear and saturation-like associations between circadian rhythm and depression risk. Beyond risk prediction, we further integrate interaction modeling and counterfactual regression to estimate heterogeneous and dose-dependent behavioral effects, enabling intervention-oriented reasoning under different circadian contexts. Experiments on the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS, n=15,233), demonstrate robust screening performance (ROC-AUC=0.825) and identify actionable behavioral thresholds, including a minimum effective exercise dose of approximately 300 MET-min/week and an optimal restorative nap duration of approximately 65 minutes for sleep-deprived individuals. By bridging supervised representation learning and interpretable modeling, this work provides a scalable framework for depression screening and intervention-aware healthcare data mining.

title: FormalRx: Rectify and eXamine Semantic Failures in Autoformalization
authors: Haocheng Wang, Baiyu Huang, Yingjia Wan, Xiao Zhu, Xiaoyang Liu, Yinya Huang, Zhijiang Guo
abstract: The veracious semantic alignment in autoformalization is significant for formal mathematical reasoning. However, existing evaluations provide only opaque binary verdicts or scalar scores, offering no interpretable insight into where or why translations fail. This opacity severely limits both human understanding and automated system improvement. To bridge this gap, we introduce FormalRx, a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation framework that transforms autoformalization assessment from black-box judgments into actionable feedback. At its core is SCI Error Taxonomy, a hierarchical classification scheme decomposing autoformalization errors into 28 distinct categories with strict priority ordering. Building on this taxonomy, FormalRx provides four critical diagnostic capabilities: alignment verdicts, error categorization, error localization, and correction. We instantiate the framework with a diagnostic model FormalRx-8B, trained on 56,287 NL-FL pairs with fine-grained diagnostic annotations, and release FormalRx-Test as the first fine-grained diagnostic benchmark. FormalRx-8B achieves F1-scores of 0.88 (verdict) and 0.71 (categorization), along with accuracies of 0.75 (localization) and 0.73 (correction), substantially outperforming both general-purpose LLMs and specialized baselines. By connecting evaluation with actionable insights, FormalRx enables systematic diagnosis and improvement of autoformalization systems.
comment: 44 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)

title: Targeted Structure Completion for Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction in Autonomous Driving
authors: Guoqing Wang, Pin Tang, Xiangxuan Ren, Liping Hou, Chao Ma
abstract: Reconstructing 3D scene structures from sparse, low-overlap observations remains a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving.
