Recent state-of-the-art frameworks achieve promising results by incorporating voxel-based Gaussians, but incur substantial computational redundancy due to a uniform volumetric processing strategy. To bridge the gap between the efficiency of pixel-based Gaussian methods and the structural completeness of voxel-based Gaussian approaches, we propose FocusGS, a simple yet effective framework that shifts the paradigm from global densification to targeted structural completion. Our central insight is that structural completion should be decoupled from deterministic regions, with computation concentrated exclusively on areas exhibiting geometric ambiguity. Specifically, FocusGS addresses the localization challenge by deriving a 3D Geometric Ambiguity Manifold to accurately isolate localized areas prone to occlusion and high geometric uncertainty. To overcome the subsequent manifold completion challenge, we design a lightweight targeted structure completion module that selectively instantiates and optimizes continuous Gaussian queries strictly within this unstructured, sparse topological subspace. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FocusGS achieves a superior efficiency-quality trade-off, advancing state-of-the-art performance on driving-centric benchmarks while naturally reducing the total number of Gaussians by ~74% and decreasing rendering time by ~34%.

title: DiCE-CIR: Direct Composition Learning for Efficient Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
authors: Gwang-Ho Na, Ho-Joong Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image from a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and an edit text describing the desired modification. Recent ZS-CIR studies have relied on projection-based methods that map a reference image into pseudo-word tokens in the text embedding space. However, such methods require additional projection and re-encoding steps, increasing training complexity, reducing efficiency, and introducing a discrepancy between training and inference. In this paper, we propose DiCE-CIR, a direct composition learning method that predicts composed query representations by directly composing a reference image and an edit text. To enable scalable training without manually annotated triplets, we automatically construct compositional training samples from large-scale image-caption pairs using a large language model. Based on these samples, we train a lightweight composition module with objectives that promote alignment with the target, edit-consistent semantic transformation, and retrieval discriminability. We conduct extensive experiments on ZS-CIR benchmarks and show that DiCE-CIR achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIRCO and competitive performance on CIRR while maintaining high computational efficiency.

title: Correctness, confidence, and context: Framing software assurance in the AI age
authors: Mary Shaw
abstract:
Software engineering has a complicated relationship with "correctness". We recognize the challenges of full formal rigor as well as many required properties beyond functional correctness. Although we satisfice in practice, we are still stuck in the mindset that we could reason our way to correctness, if only we had enough information.
  Generative AI has introduced a new dimension to assurances: its foundation is statistical rather than formal. Traditional software engineering establishes confidence through rigorous reasoning, domain knowledge and expert judgment. In contrast, generative AI's results are sophisticated predictions, in Valiant's words "probably approximately correct". This inherently limits assurances about the results are to probabilistic assertions. Further, the nuances and implicit associations that guide human judgment are not accessible to its training sets, so that tacit knowledge cannot be incorporated in its models.
  We have many approaches for developing assurances that a software system does what it's expected to do, though most of them focus on the specification of the code rather than the requirements for the system, let alone fitness for purpose. We have failed to develop a systematic understanding of the relative merits of the various approaches. I hope that generative AI will finally force us to tackle this.
  To that end, I will challenge us to think systematically about our assurance techniques. We need ways to make informed, reasoned choices about cost-effective combinations of approaches to devel-oping confidence in our systems.
  We call ourselves software engineers. Let's act like engineers.
comment: 9 pages, 11 figures, text for invited keynote at FSE 2026 in Montreal

title: Elastic Gang: Per-Token Membership Change for a Hard-Barriered LLM Inference Gang Co-Scheduled with OS Processes
authors: Daeyeon Son
abstract:
On-device LLM decoding is a hard-barriered CPU-SIMD computation that wants every core for milliseconds per token, while the rest of the OS wants those same cores continuously. A barriered gang cannot simply be dropped into a preemptive scheduler: an unannounced departure deadlocks a barrier, and an unannounced arrival silently corrupts logits. I present the elastic gang of Anima OS, a bare-metal x86-64 Rust kernel in which the inference gang is a first-class schedulable entity whose core membership may change between any two tokens. The core mechanism is an ACK-latched epoch protocol that never waits on a named core: a seqlock-style generation-tagged latch composed with RCU/epoch-style membership consent, so each token's participant set is the intersection of the cores the gang requested and the cores that acked the current epoch. An un-acked core is outside this token and joins at most one token later. Displaced general processes migrate and keep running; cores return to them the moment a generation ends.
  On a real AMD Zen 5 machine (8C/16T), inference output is bit-exact under verified per-token membership change on both a 135M and a 7B model, the property that makes elasticity safe in a kernel whose safety gate reads logits. Against fair static core partitions, elastic membership Pareto-dominates: at intermediate inference duty cycles it delivers 1.75x (25%), 1.52x (50%), and 1.28x (75%) the general throughput of a static 8-core split at equal or better inference throughput, recovers all eight stranded cores when inference is idle, and converges to the split at saturation. Returning a lent core costs 0.22 us (p50); acquiring a busy, tenant-occupied core costs one scheduling quantum (~16 ms): a running tenant is never preempted mid-slice. Decode throughput saturates at gang width 8, so ceding cores past the knee is nearly free: elasticity auto-sizes the gang online.

title: Who Responds When the Driver Is Gone? A Framework for Human Intent Understanding
authors: Xuewen Luo, Ding Fan, Ruiqi Chen, Ye Cao, Xiujin Liu, Bo Yu, Fengze Yang, Chenxi Liu
abstract: As autonomous vehicles progress toward fully driverless mobility, a critical question emerges: who understands and responds to passengers when the human driver is absent? Existing autonomous driving systems primarily optimize predefined navigation and control objectives from external scene observations, but they remain limited in perceiving and reasoning about in-cabin human intent. In this paper, we propose Intent2Drive, a unified framework for holistic human intent understanding and human-aligned planning. Instead of treating passenger intent as explicit commands alone, Intent2Drive models intent as a latent cognitive state shaped by language, personal attributes, emotional and physical conditions, behavioral signals, and situational context. To support this formulation, we construct a Holistic Intent Dataset (HID) that provides structured supervision over both explicit and implicit intent cues. Built upon HID, our Theory-of-Mind-inspired Human Intent Reasoner (HIR) infers a Latent Human State (LHS) and further translates it into a planner-compatible Human Intent Objective (HIO). We then introduce a Hierarchical Intent-Conditioned Planner (HICP) that incorporates HIO into route-level and trajectory-level planning, enabling driving behaviors to remain aligned with passenger needs across different planning horizons. Extensive experiments show that Intent2Drive improves structured human intent inference and HIO construction while preserving competitive closed-loop planning performance. These results demonstrate a promising step toward passenger-responsive autonomous driving systems that can reason about, interpret, and act upon human intent in driverless mobility.

title: GlaKG: A Biomarker-Centric Fundus Knowledge Graph for Explainable Glaucoma Diagnosis and Risk Assessment
authors: Cheng Huang, Jia Zhang, Yi Jiang, Yang Liu, Karanjit Kooner, Yadi Liu, Tsengdar Lee, Yang Xie, Wenqi Shi, Guanghua Xiao
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness worldwide, yet most automated diagnosis systems rely on opaque deep-learning models that offer little clinical interpretability. We present GlaKG, a biomarker-centric fundus knowledge graph that integrates structural biomarkers, clinically grounded rules, and image features to produce traceable reasoning for glaucoma diagnosis and risk stratification. GlaKG encodes six entity types (Fundus Image, Optic Disc, Neural Rim, Pathology, Diagnosis, Risk Level), eight relation types, and 11 clinically validated rules into a unified graph, so that every prediction is accompanied by an explicit reasoning chain linking biomarker evidence to activated clinical rules. To keep knowledge-based reasoning strictly separate from label information, we adopt a post-processing fusion framework that combines ResNet50 image embeddings with a normalized KG reasoning-chain score via a tunable weight alpha, with all fitting confined to the training split. On a publicly available, AI-annotated fundus dataset, GlaKG reaches F1 = 0.9953 for binary glaucoma classification and 0.930 accuracy with 0.922 weighted F1 for four-class risk stratification; we report openly that the dataset's biomarker annotations are highly label-correlated, and therefore frame these figures as an upper bound attainable with clean structured biomarkers rather than as leakage-free image-only performance. Feature-importance analysis shows KG-derived and biomarker features contributing near-equally (51.1% vs. 48.9%), and the reasoning chain flags borderline cases by exposing low chain scores rather than failing silently. GlaKG's central contribution is therefore a clinically auditable reasoning framework that complements raw predictive performance by explicitly exposing the biomarker evidence and rule activations behind each decision.

title: Adaptive Space-efficient Collectives for Dynamic and Unstructured Sparsity on GPU Platforms
authors: Lannie Dalton Hough, Emir Gencer, Hoffmann Muki, Abhinav Bhatele
abstract: High-performance collective communication primitives are necessary for a variety of high performance computing (HPC) and machine learning (ML) workloads. State-of-the-art collective communication libraries such as NCCL optimize exclusively for dense data. However, when sending sparse data, we can reduce communication volume by not sending zeros. Unfortunately, explicitly handling sparsity introduces challenges such as format conversion overheads and densification during collectives that involve reductions. In this paper, we introduce sparsity-exploiting algorithms for three collectives that address these challenges: all-gather, reduce-scatter, and all-reduce. Our collective implementations are backed by a new bitvector-based format, Pici, designed for low overhead and fast (de)compression at moderate sparsities. Further, our algorithms adapt to the level of sparsity in data, modifying its representation during the course of the collective. At 99% input sparsity, our collectives achieve up to 5.25x, 2.5x, and 2.66x speedups over NCCL for all-gather, reduce-scatter, and all-reduce, respectively.
comment: Accepted at SC 2026. Pre-camera-ready author manuscript. Final version is forthcoming

title: Video Generation Models Are Inherent Lighting Estimators
authors: Ziqi Cai, Shuchen Weng, Kaiqi Liu, Zifeng Wang, Zhiquan Zhang, Minggui Teng, Han Jiang, Boxin Shi
abstract: Recovering dynamic environment maps from a single in-the-wild video is crucial for photorealistic rendering, yet remains a challenge. Recent video generation models can produce photorealistic scenes with complex lighting, possessing an inherent understanding of lighting. In this paper, we introduce V-LITE (Video generation models are inherent lighting estimators), a framework that unlocks this internal knowledge by reframing lighting estimation as a guided video inpainting task. Inspired by VFX industry practices, we insert a synthetic chrome ball into the scene to compel the model to generate physically plausible reflections from the surrounding spatio-temporal context. To bridge the gap from LDR-native models to the HDR domain, we design an HDR-aware VAE and employ an efficient LoRA-based fine-tuning strategy. We then construct a mixed dataset comprising high-fidelity HDR images to provide realistic HDR priors, and in-the-wild HDR videos to provide dynamic spatio-temporal context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that V-LITE produces temporally coherent HDR environment maps, revealing that modern video diffusion models are not merely synthesizers but also powerful, inherently capable estimators of physical scene lighting.

title: ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Cross-Scenario Defect Detection and Fine-Grained Severity Grading for High-Precision Manufacturing
authors: Wei Sun, Weixia Zhang, Linhan Cao, Mingkai Lu, Xiongkuo Min, Xiaoping Zhang, Patrick Le Callet, Guangtao Zhai, Hongxing Chen, Wenqi Wu, Zhenhao Hu, Shanshan Lin, Guanjie Huang, Kai Xie, Rui Xin, Zilong Zhao, Runmin Cong, Ningjing Li, Siqi Ma, Yi Jin Ong, Tianfei Zhou, Shunzhou Wang, Zhiyang Chen, Hao Fang, Chen Zhang, Tze-Hsiang Tang, Dikai Li, Xianjin Wu, Avinash Kumar Sharma, Zhaoyang Wang, Haiyong Chen, Binyi Su, Atik Shahariar
abstract: This paper presents the IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME) 2026 Grand Challenge on Cross-Scenario Defect Detection and Fine-Grained Severity Grading for High-Precision Manufacturing. The challenge is motivated by two key limitations of existing industrial defect inspection systems: (1) current deep learning-based methods often suffer significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen production scenarios, and (2) most benchmarks neglect severity-aware assessment, which is critical for risk control and yield optimization. To address these limitations, we design two complementary tracks: Track 1 (Cross-Scenario Defect Detection) targets accurate defect detection, localization, and classification across diverse unseen production environments; Track 2 (Fine-Grained Severity Grading) requires assigning each detected defect an industry-standard severity level, including Acceptable, Marginal NG, NG, and Gross NG. We construct a large-scale industrial dataset of high-resolution microscopic images spanning seven representative defect categories, comprising over 3,800 images with pixel-level instance annotations for Track 1 and over 2,600 images with severity-grade labels for Track 2. The challenge attracted 86 registered participants with 130 submissions; during the final testing phase, 21 teams submitted results and 12 teams provided models with technical reports. The resulting benchmark, together with the diverse and effective solutions contributed by participating teams, sets a new standard for industrial defect analysis research.

title: AnyStyle: A Single LoRA is Sufficient for Image-Guided Style Transfer
authors: Yongwen Lai, Chaoqun Wang
abstract: Image-guided style transfer aims to apply the artistic characteristics of a style image to a content image while preserving its semantic structure and layout. Despite advances in diffusion-based methods, existing approaches often face challenges in disentangling content and style, particularly when independently optimized adapters are naively combined, causing conflicts between adapters and limiting controllability over the content-style balance in inference. We further demonstrate that training-free structural guidance directly derived from the content image through the internal attention of pre-trained model outperforms a dedicated content LoRA adapter in terms of structural fidelity and computational efficiency. Building on these observations, we propose AnyStyle, a streamlined framework for image-guided style transfer. The framework adopts a unified single-adapter paradigm for coherent style capture from the style image and incorporates training-free structural guidance from the content image, thus avoiding complex entanglement between multiple adapters and improving controllability and stability. Extensive experiments show that our method delivers competitive quantitative performance and significantly improved perceptual quality. Code is available at https://github.com/Yvan1001/AnyStyle.

title: A Physics-Regulated Neural Framework for Learning 3D Grain Growth Dynamics
authors: Zhihui Tian, Kang Yang, Michael Tonks, Amanda R. Krause, Joel B. Harley
abstract: Grain growth is governed by the reduction in grain boundary energy and exhibits well-established statistical scaling laws. Developing data-driven surrogates that preserve these physical invariants while remaining computationally scalable remains challenging, especially in 3D. We present 3D-PRIMME (Physics-Regulated Interpretable Machine Learning for Microstructure Evolution) for learning three-dimensional grain growth dynamics. The model is trained using only two consecutive time steps yet accurately reproduces the linear coarsening law and preserves topological statistics over extended time scales. Despite being trained on a $100^3$ grid points with 512 grains, the learned evolution operator is applied to domains up to $1024^3$ grid points with 550000 grains without retraining, maintaining consistent kinetics and grain topology across orders-of-magnitude increases in system size. These results demonstrate that 3D-PRIMME learns a scale-independent and temporally stable local evolution rule, enabling efficient and robust large-scale surrogate prediction of 3D microstructure evolution.

title: Does It Fail to See or Fail to Know? Attributing Errors in Vision-Language Models
authors: Khang Nhat Hoang Vo, Artem Vazhentsev, Artem Shelmanov, Timothy Baldwin, Yova Kementchedjhieva
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on visual question answering with high-quality images but struggle when questions require knowledge beyond what is clearly and directly visible. In such settings, uncertainty quantification should not only indicate whether the model is likely to fail but also diagnose why it is uncertain, across dimensions such as perception, entity recognition, and knowledge retrieval. While prior work has focused on individual failure modes in isolation or treated incorrect answers as monolithic failures, we propose a unified framework for disentangling these failure modes and investigate whether pre-generation signals can predict these failure sources. Across a range of datasets and model families, we find a consistent pattern in VLM errors: some failures arise from visual or recognition bottlenecks, while others persist after the relevant entity is identified. Our main finding is that these failure sources can be predicted before decoding: recognition-related failures are best captured by visual-token representations, while failures that remain after recognition are better captured by prompt-conditioned hidden states. This pre-generation signal enables efficient failure-source prediction before the model produces an answer, allowing uncertain cases to be routed to targeted interventions such as image repair, entity recognition support, or external retrieval.

title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Mean What They Say? On the Role of Faithfulness in Embodied Reasoning
authors: Matthew Foutter, Matteo Cercola, Lena Wild, Yunshan Wang, Michelle Li, Daniele Gammelli, Marco Pavone
abstract: Embodied Chain-of-Thought has emerged as a promising mechanism to enhance robot decision-making and interpretability in black-box Vision-Language Action (VLA) models. However, whether this verbalized Chain-of-Thought truthfully reflects the policy's underlying decision process remains poorly understood. We distinguish between functional reasoning, in which reasoning improves task performance, and faithful reasoning, in which reasoning truly reflects the policy's internal decision process. We argue that SoTA alignment strategies offer a necessary but insufficient notion of faithfulness, admitting reasoning whose intermediate steps can mask the causal links in action prediction through confounding factors (e.g., reasoning that is ungrounded in the environment and internally disconnected or inconsistent), restricting policy generalization. We study this gap through a human evaluation of a SoTA reasoning model for autonomous driving, revealing an inconsistent coupling between reasoning quality and downstream trajectory improvement. We then operationalize a behavioral surrogate for embodied faithfulness through a learned critic, Pinocchio, scoring observation grounding and stepwise coherence, and use this critic as a dense reward signal in post-training an embodied policy with reinforcement learning. Across withheld driving benchmarks, our post-trained planner improves faithfulness by 4% and 18% over SoTA alignment and trajectory error post-training baselines, respectively, while maintaining competitive downstream task performance. Finally, on a synthetic out-of-distribution test set, post-training for faithfulness improves policy responsiveness to rare counterfactual scenarios by 1.6x that of a SoTA policy, suggesting that faithful reasoning traces contribute to more robust, generalizable, and interpretable embodied intelligence. Project page: https://mjf-su.github.io/pinocchio/

title: Classification of $σ$-validity
authors: Eiji Yamada
abstract: In their 2018 paper, Agotnes, van Ditmarsch, and Wang extended the notions of success and self-refutation in public announcements to true lies, impossible lies, and $σ$-validity in general, where $σ$ is a finite or infinite sequence of $0$s and $1$s. For example, successful formulas and self-refuting formulas are $11$-valid and $10$-valid, respectively. They then posed a conjecture on the classification of such sequences in terms of $σ$-validity. In this paper, we disprove the conjecture and give corrected classifications for multi-agent K45, single-agent KD45, and multi-agent S5 after reformulating the statement more explicitly. We leave the multi-agent KD45 case with more than one agent open. The results indicate that there is an asymmetry between truthful announcements and false announcements: the former are stable while the latter are unstable. In particular, successful formulas remain true forever while impossible lies can be true at some point when repeatedly announced. Also, although self-refuting formulas can become true again after following the truth pattern $10$, $100$-valid formulas are destructive in the sense that they remain false forever once they become false. On the other hand, true lies are fragile in the sense that truths created by lying can become false again.

title: TubeLite: Lightweight Multi-Actor Spatio-Temporal Action Detection
authors: Ali Soltaninezhad, Melissa Cote, Alejandro Rico Espinosa, Tunai Porto Marques, Alexandra Branzan Albu
abstract: Spatio-temporal action detection in videos requires jointly localizing actors in space and identifying action boundaries over time. A common challenge is constructing temporally stable action tubes, as frame-level detectors often suffer from jitter, fragmentation, and imprecise temporal localization. Many recent approaches address this by introducing heavy spatio-temporal transformers or optical-flow-based pipelines, leading to high computational cost and limited scalability. We propose TubeLite, a lightweight framework for spatio-temporal action detection that focuses on stable tube construction and boundary-aware temporal modeling. TubeLite represents each actor as a tube, defined as a sequence of bounding boxes associated with a single actor over time, and explicitly enforces temporal consistency at both the spatial and semantic levels. The method combines low-jitter actor detection, Gaussian-weighted actor feature extraction, efficient short-term temporal propagation, and a boundary-focused temporal prediction head, while avoiding optical flow and large-scale temporal attention. Despite its compact design, TubeLite achieves strong video-level localization performance. It improves Video-mAP@0.5 by 4.5 and 7.1 percentage points over the best compared method on the MultiSports and UCF101-24 datasets, respectively, with substantially fewer parameters and floating-point operations than transformer-based alternatives, demonstrating that effective spatio-temporal action detection can be obtained through principled, lightweight temporal modeling.

title: ToolFailBench: Diagnosing Tool-Use Failures in LLM Agents
authors: Harsh Soni
abstract: Tool calling is central to modern language model agents, but aggregate benchmark scores often hide where tool use fails. A model that never calls a needed tool and a model that calls the tool but ignores the result can look similar under final task accuracy. We introduce ToolFailBench, a diagnostic benchmark for measuring tool-use failures across 1,000 tasks in finance, medicine, law, cybersecurity, and real estate. Tool-required tasks return values the model wouldn't guess, forcing it to trust the tool while control tasks attach the same tools but should be answered directly. We label each trace with Tool-Skip, Result-Ignore, Output-Fabrication, and Unnecessary-Tool-Use, using a rule classifier and two LLM judges aggregated by majority vote. Across 19 headline models, the best reaches 86.33% Clean Tool-Use Rate, showing that faithful tool use is not saturated. More importantly, models with similar aggregate scores fail in different ways: most stay disciplined on no-tool controls, while Llama-3.1 models show an Always-Call pattern, and at the same parameter scale Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B differ by 89 percentage points on control-task accuracy. Tool-use evaluation should measure not only whether agents call tools, but whether they use tool outputs correctly and avoid tools when none is needed.
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. Published at the Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) and the Workshop on Failure Modes of Agentic AI (FAGEN) at ICML 2026

title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
authors: Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Nikita Bondarev, Anton Morgunov, Arkadii Lin, Maksim Kuznetsov, Rim Shayakhmetov, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Alex Aliper, Alex Zhavoronkov
abstract: Synthesis planning aiming to find pathways of reactions for a target molecule is one of the most important and challenging tasks in drug discovery. Recent progress has produced both specialized deep-learning retrosynthesis systems and general-purpose large language models, but objective comparison remains difficult due to the lack of flexible, chemically interpretable benchmarking protocols. In the current study, we are introducing the URSA (Utilitarian RetroSynthesis Assessment) evaluation framework that provides the opportunity to benchmark the synthetic routes not only from a formal perspective, such as convergence to commercially available starting materials, but also from a chemical plausibility perspective, mimicking the way expert chemists evaluate the reactions and routes. The study covers a comprehensive evaluation of both conventional end-to-end retrosynthesis solutions and LLMs for the synthesis planning task on a set of novel, diverse target molecules with undisclosed synthetic routes, which represent realistic tasks in the daily drug design routine. We find that while LLMs can support high-level strategic planning, they currently underperform specialized retrosynthesis models in reliably solving synthesis planning tasks.

title: PAST-TIDE: Prototype-Anchored Statement Tuning with Topic-Invariant Normalization for Stance Detection
authors: Md. Shakhoyat Rahman Shujon, MD Jahid Hasan Jim, Md. Milon Islam, Md Rezwanul Haque, Fakhri Karray
abstract: We introduce PAST-TIDE, our stance detection system addressing both subtasks of the StanceNakba Shared Task at NakbaNLP@LREC-COLING 2026. The main idea is statement tuning. We redefine stance as cloze-style masked language modeling (MLM), letting a verbalizer map label words to stance categories through the pre-trained MLM head rather than appending a randomly initialized classification head. We complement this with prototypical contrastive learning, which uses learnable class prototypes for batch-size independent contrastive training, and topic-conditional layer normalization for cross-topic Arabic stance detection. PAST-TIDE achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.75 for Subtask A and 0.74 for Subtask B on the official leaderboard, indicating that minimal architectural additions to a pre-trained model can remain competitive in low-resource settings.
comment: Published in The Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)

title: A Reliable Context-Aware and Temporal Planning Framework for Autonomous Driving
authors: Argho Dey, Yunfei Yin, Swachha Ray, Md Minhazul Islam, Zheng Yuan, Sijing Xiong, Hongyu Liu, Zhiqiu Huang
abstract: Safe operation of autonomous vehicles in dense urban traffic depends on perception and planning that remain reliable when onboard sensing is degraded. In real driving conditions, camera observations are frequently corrupted by occlusion, motion blur, illumination change, and sensor noise, and when such degraded observations are aggregated indiscriminately over time, trajectory planning becomes unstable and collision risk rises for both the ego vehicle and surrounding road users. Recent Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) approaches unify perception and planning through a shared spatial representation, but most fuse temporal information across frames without assessing the reliability of the underlying observations. We present a Reliable Context-Aware and Temporal Planning framework for Autonomous Driving (RCT-AD) that explicitly models feature quality and temporal consistency to support safer, more consistent planning. A Reliable Context Awareness module scores per-frame reliability and selectively retains trustworthy features through a quality-gated First-In-Last-Out (FILO) memory mechanism, reconstructing degraded observations from reliable historical context so that corrupted inputs do not destabilize the scene representation. A Temporal Trajectory Planner captures long-term dependencies and multi-agent interactions to produce smoother, safety-aware trajectories, while a joint detection-and-segmentation head injects semantic and motion cues into the shared BEV space to strengthen scene understanding. Experiments on the nuScenes autonomous driving benchmark show that RCT-AD improves perception accuracy, motion prediction, and planning robustness over recent end-to-end baselines, achieving 61.5 nuScenes Detection Score, 52.9 mean Average Precision, and 52.3 mean Intersection over Union, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency suitable for real-time deployment.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. 12 pages, 6 figures

title: From Open Loop to Closed Loop: A Test-Time Iterative Optimization Framework for Reference-Consistent Image Generation
authors: Baixuan Zhao, Xinyu Zhang, Huayu Zheng, Shuaicheng Liu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu
abstract: While controllable image generation has made significant strides by incorporating visual reference conditions, existing methods predominantly operate as open-loop systems. They inject control signals in a strictly feed-forward manner, failing to guarantee strict fidelity to the reference due to the absence of active feedback and error correction mechanisms. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel test-time iterative optimization framework that reformulates reference-consistent generation as a closed-loop dynamic tracking problem. By treating the pre-trained generative model as a control plant, our framework employs a sensor-controller architecture driven by a modified Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) algorithm. This mechanism iteratively optimizes the latent control signals at test time based on the sensed discrepancy between the generated output and the reference target. Notably, this approach is entirely training-free, model-agnostic, and integrates seamlessly around existing diffusion pipelines. Extensive evaluations across ID-preserving, pose-controlled, and depth-controlled generation tasks validate the universality of our method. Empirical results demonstrate improvements over computation-matched open-loop baselines, achieving relative performance gains of up to 25.36\% for facial similarity, alongside spatial error reductions of up to 27.71\% for pose alignment and 28.50\% for depth consistency. More broadly, this work offers a new conceptual perspective: it demonstrates that controllable generation can be effectively managed as a dynamic feedback system, bringing the rigorous principles of classical control theory into the optimization of generative models. Code is available at https://github.com/zzdrill/From-Open-Loop-to-Closed-Loop.
zh_title: 从开环到闭环：用于参考一致性图像生成的测试时迭代优化框架
translation: 尽管通过引入视觉参考条件，可控图像生成已经取得了显著进展，但现有方法主要作为开环系统运行。它们以严格的前馈方式注入控制信号，由于缺乏主动反馈和纠错机制，无法保证对参考目标的严格保真度。为了解决这一根本局限性，我们提出了一种新型的测试时迭代优化框架，将参考一致性生成重新表述为闭环动态跟踪问题。通过将预训练的生成模型视为控制对象，我们的框架采用了由改进的比例-积分-微分（PID）算法驱动的传感器-控制器架构。该机制在测试时，根据检测到的生成输出与参考目标之间的差异，迭代优化潜在的控制信号。值得注意的是，该方法完全不需要训练，且与模型无关，可以无缝集成到现有的扩散流水线中。在保持身份（ID-preserving）、姿态控制和深度控制生成任务上的广泛评估证实了我们方法的通用性。实验结果表明，该方法相比计算量相当的开环基线有所改进，在人脸相似度上实现了高达25.36%的相对性能提升，同时在姿态对准上减少了高达27.71%的空间误差，在深度一致性上减少了28.50%的空间误差。更广泛地说，这项工作提供了一个新的概念视角：它表明可控生成可以作为动态反馈系统得到有效管理，将经典控制理论的严谨原理引入到生成模型的优化中。代码可在 https://github.com/zzdrill/From-Open-Loop-to-Closed-Loop 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种创新的测试时迭代优化框架，通过引入经典PID控制算法将图像生成重构为闭环动态跟踪系统，实现了无需训练、模型无关的高保真度参考一致性图像生成。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于跨学科地将经典的PID控制理论引入到现代扩散模型的图像生成控制中，将“生成”视为“控制”过程，将开环前馈系统转变为闭环反馈系统。其主要优势在于完全无需训练（training-free）且与模型无关（model-agnostic），具有极高的实用价值和即插即用属性。潜在的局限性在于，测试时的迭代优化（test-time optimization）通常会增加推理阶段的计算开销和时间延迟。
motivation: 现有的可控图像生成方法多为开环系统，以严格的前馈方式注入控制信号，由于缺乏主动反馈和纠错机制，无法保证生成结果与参考目标之间的严格保真度。
method: 提出一个测试时迭代优化框架，将参考一致性生成重构为闭环动态跟踪问题。该框架将预训练的生成模型视为控制对象，采用由改进的比例-积分-微分（PID）算法驱动的传感器-控制器架构。在测试时，该机制根据检测到的生成输出与参考目标之间的差异，迭代优化潜在的控制信号。该方法完全无需训练、与模型无关，且能无缝集成到现有的扩散流水线中。
results: 在保持ID、姿态控制和深度控制生成任务上的广泛评估表明，该方法比计算量相当的开环基线有显著改进：人脸相似度相对提升高达25.36%，姿态对齐的空间误差减少高达27.71%，深度一致性空间误差减少高达28.50%。
conclusion: 本研究提供了一个全新的概念视角，证明了可控图像生成可以作为动态反馈系统进行有效管理，成功将经典控制理论的严谨原理引入到生成模型的优化中。

title: Solve the Missing First Step: Can VLMs Standardize Raw Heterogeneous Medical Data?
authors: Xin Chen, Dongliang Xu, Cunhao Zhu, Xudong Luo, Haoyang Lyu, Xiaoxiao Sun, Serena Yeung-Levy, Yue Yao
abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to medical AI, existing benchmarks mainly focus on evaluating their diagnosis ability over given medical images and texts, implicitly assuming that standardized medical images, texts or question-answer pairs are already prepared. However, this assumption does not hold when we apply VLMs in real clinical practice, where medical data is often raw, heterogeneous, and fragmented across different sources. In this paper, we study this missing step, i.e., raw medical data standardization. Specifically, models are given raw dataset folders and evaluated on their ability to identify source formats, convert raw medical images into VLM-compatible visual inputs, extract relevant textual information, and organize the results into structured image-text pairs. To construct this Medical Data Standardization Benchmark (MDS-Bench), we manually annotate 1,939 raw medical data standardization tasks covering diverse clinical practice, radiology modalities, annotation formats, and directory layouts. Extensive experiments show that even the best performing VLMs, i.e., Gemini 3 Flash, achieve only 48.6% end-to-end success rate. Our research highlights raw medical data standardization as a critical bottleneck for medical AI diagnosis in real practice.
zh_title: 解决缺失的第一步：视觉语言模型（VLM）能否标准化原始异构医疗数据？
translation: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地应用于医疗人工智能，现有的基准测试主要集中在评估它们对给定医疗图像和文本的诊断能力，这隐含地假设了标准化的医疗图像、文本或问答对已经准备就绪。然而，当我们在实际临床实践中应用VLM时，这一假设并不成立，因为医疗数据通常是原始的、异构的，并且分散在不同的来源中。在本文中，我们研究了这一缺失的步骤，即原始医疗数据的标准化。具体而言，模型被给定原始数据集文件夹，并评估它们识别源格式、将原始医疗图像转换为VLM兼容的视觉输入、提取相关文本信息以及将结果组织成结构化图像-文本对的能力。为了构建这一医疗数据标准化基准（MDS-Bench），我们手动标注了1,939个原始医疗数据标准化任务，涵盖了不同的临床实践、放射学模态、标注格式和目录布局。广泛的实验表明，即使是表现最好的VLM（即 Gemini 3 Flash），也仅达到了48.6%的端到端成功率。我们的研究强调，原始医疗数据标准化是现实实践中医疗AI诊断的一个关键瓶颈。
tldr: 本文提出了MDS-Bench基准，用于评估VLM标准化原始异构医疗数据的能力，实验发现即使是最先进的模型在此任务上的端到端成功率也仅为48.6%，表明数据标准化是医疗AI实际落地的关键瓶颈。
ai_comments: 本文切中了一个非常实际但常被学术界忽视的痛点，即医疗AI在实际部署前的数据清洗与标准化工作（“缺失的第一步”）。MDS-Bench的提出为评估VLM在处理真实世界复杂文件结构和多模态异构数据方面的能力提供了重要基准，具有很强的实用价值。局限性在于，目前仅指出了现有模型在该任务上的不足，尚未提出更有效的专有解决方法。
motivation: 现有的医疗AI评估主要关注已标准化数据的诊断能力，但在实际临床中，医疗数据往往是原始、异构且碎片化的。因此，需要解决如何将这些原始医疗数据标准化为VLM可处理格式这一“缺失的第一步”。
method: 构建了医疗数据标准化基准（MDS-Bench），包含1,939个手动标注的原始医疗数据标准化任务。通过给模型提供原始数据集文件夹，评估其在识别源格式、转换图像为VLM兼容输入、提取文本信息以及组织结构化图像-文本对方面的端到端能力。
results: 实验表明，即使是性能最好的视觉语言模型（Gemini 3 Flash），在MDS-Bench上的端到端成功率也仅为48.6%。
conclusion: 原始医疗数据的标准化是实际应用中医疗AI诊断的一个关键瓶颈，当前最先进的视觉语言模型在此任务上的表现仍有待大幅提升。

title: Probe-EM: Targeted Neuron Tracing via Training-Free Semantic Verification
authors: Liuyun Jiang, Yanchao Zhang, Jinyue Guo, Chuanyue Chen, Haiyang Yan, Ye Yuan, Jing Liu, Hua Han
abstract: Establishing large-scale, high-resolution neural connectivity maps is fundamental to elucidating the structural basis of brain function. However, when processing terabyte- or petabyte-scale electron microscopy data, over-segmentation inherent in automated reconstruction algorithms remains a critical bottleneck, requiring extensive manual proofreading spanning person-years. To alleviate the heavy reliance on annotated data and the limited flexibility of conventional tracing methods, we propose a training-free, targeted neuron tracing framework. Specifically, we introduce a skeleton-guided Heuristic Spatial Search paradigm that leverages geometric priors to iteratively reconstruct neuronal morphologies through a probing-verification cycle. To achieve robust zero-shot semantic verification, we further develop a Dimension-Aware Semantic Verification strategy built upon the foundation model NeuroSAM 2. This strategy resolves intra-slice splits via Planar Ensemble Consensus and inter-slice splits via Axial Spatio-Temporal Propagation. Notably, we integrate the proposed workflow into the Neuroglancer visualization platform, enabling an interactive human-in-the-loop proofreading system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms supervised baselines and reduces manual proofreading time by 33.4%. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HeadLiuYun/Probe-EM.
zh_title: Probe-EM：基于免训练语义验证的目标神经元追踪
translation: 建立大规模、高分辨率的神经连接图谱是阐明大脑功能结构基础的关键。然而，在处理太字节（TB）或拍字节（PB）级的电子显微镜数据时，自动重建算法中固有的过度分割问题仍然是一个关键瓶颈，需要耗费数人年的大量人工校对。为了减轻对标注数据的严重依赖以及传统追踪方法有限的灵活性，我们提出了一种免训练的目标神经元追踪框架。具体而言，我们引入了一种骨架引导的启发式空间搜索范式，该范式利用几何先验通过“探测-验证”循环迭代重建神经元形态。为了实现鲁棒的零样本语义验证，我们进一步开发了一种基于基础模型 NeuroSAM 2 的维度感知语义验证策略。该策略通过平面集成共识解决片内分裂，并通过轴向时空传播解决片间分裂。值得注意的是，我们将所提出的工作流程集成到了 Neuroglancer 可视化平台中，实现了一个交互式的人机协同校对系统。实验结果表明，所提方法优于有监督的基线方法，并使人工校对时间减少了 33.4%。源代码已公开在 https://github.com/HeadLiuYun/Probe-EM。
tldr: 本文提出了 Probe-EM，一种无需训练的目标神经元追踪框架，通过启发式空间搜索与基于 NeuroSAM 2 的语义验证相结合，将电子显微镜重建的人工校对时间缩短了 33.4%。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种免训练（training-free）且零样本（zero-shot）的目标神经元追踪方案，巧妙地将骨架引导的启发式空间搜索与基于大模型（NeuroSAM 2）的维度感知语义验证相结合，并成功将其集成至 Neuroglancer 平台中实现人机协同。其重要性在于大幅降低了大规模电镜重建中的人工校对成本（减少了33.4%），对连接组学研究具有极高的实用价值。局限性在于其效果可能仍受到底层基础模型（NeuroSAM 2）分割精度的制约，且对于极度复杂的神经形态，启发式搜索策略可能存在累积误差。
motivation: 在处理TB或PB级电子显微镜数据时，自动重建算法固有的过度分割导致了极高的人工校对成本；同时，传统的追踪方法高度依赖标注数据且缺乏灵活性。
method: 提出了一种免训练的目标神经元追踪框架 Probe-EM，主要包含：（1）骨架引导的启发式空间搜索范式，利用几何先验通过“探测-验证”循环迭代重建神经元形态；（2）基于基础模型 NeuroSAM 2 的维度感知语义验证策略，通过平面集成共识解决片内分裂，通过轴向时空传播解决片间分裂；（3）将该工作流集成至 Neuroglancer 平台，构建了交互式人机协同校对系统。
results: 实验结果表明，该方法在性能上优于有监督的基线方法，并成功减少了 33.4% 的人工校对时间。
conclusion: 本文提出的 Probe-EM 框架成功实现了免训练、零样本的目标神经元追踪，能够有效缓解自动重建中的过度分割问题，大幅提高校对效率并降低人工成本。

title: AI Agent Pull Requests on GitHub: Frequency, Structure, and Merge Conflict Rates
authors: George Xu, Arjun Subramanian, Nithilan Karthik
abstract: AI coding agents can create and submit pull requests (PRs) to a common repository at the same time; however, there is little research on the frequency of such concurrent submissions or the cost associated with them. In this study, we use the AIDev-pop dataset (33,596 PRs across 2,807 repositories) to perform the first large-scale empirical analysis of concurrency among agent-authored PRs. We find that under exact temporal overlap, 40.2% of repositories have co-active agent-authored PR pairs, and these co-active pairs account for 79.4% of all PRs submitted by an AI agent. When examining co-activity within a conventional one-week collaboration period, these percentages increase to 53.4% and 95.0%, respectively. For the vast majority of co-active PR pairs, both PRs were authored by the same agent (intra-agent), whereas only 0.5% of co-active pairs were cross-agent, and these were located in only 122 of the 2,807 total repositories examined (approximately 4.3%). Furthermore, we replayed actual three-way git merge operations on 747 unique co-active pairs (one per repository) to determine the rate of textual conflict when merging the two PRs in each pair. We found that the rate of textual conflict was significantly greater for cross-agent pairs than for intra-agent pairs: 41.7% versus 19.8%, respectively, with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals. Finally, we developed a classification system based upon the output of git's conflict detection, and determined that the majority of conflicts result from changes to source code files (84.4% of conflicted files) rather than dependency manifest files, and that nearly 42% of the conflicts we observed were structural (modify/delete or add/add). Because these metrics capture only the textual layer, they represent a conservative lower bound on the cost associated with uncoordinated AI teammates working together.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21186464
zh_title: GitHub上的AI Agent拉取请求：频率、结构与合并冲突率
translation: AI编程Agent可以同时向公共仓库创建并提交拉取请求（PR）；然而，目前关于这种并发提交的频率以及与之相关的成本的研究还很少。在这项研究中，我们使用AIDev-pop数据集（包含2,807个仓库中的33,596个PR）对Agent撰写的PR之间的并发性进行了首次大规模实证分析。我们发现，在精确的时间重叠下，40.2%的仓库拥有共同活跃的Agent撰写PR对，这些共同活跃的PR对占AI Agent提交的所有PR的79.4%。当在常规的一周协作期内检查共同活跃度时，这些百分比分别增加到53.4%和95.0%。对于绝大多数共同活跃的PR对，两个PR都由同一个Agent（同Agent）撰写，而只有0.5%的共同活跃对是跨Agent的，这些仅分布在所研究的2,807个总仓库中的122个中（约4.3%）。此外，我们在747个独特的共同活跃PR对（每个仓库一个）上重放了实际的三路Git合并操作，以确定合并每个PR对中的两个PR时的文本冲突率。我们发现，跨Agent对的文本冲突率显著高于同Agent对：分别为41.7%和19.8%，且95%置信区间不重叠。最后，我们基于git冲突检测的输出开发了一个分类系统，并确定大多数冲突源于对源代码文件的修改（占冲突文件的84.4%），而不是依赖清单文件，并且我们观察到的近42%的冲突是结构性的（修改/删除或添加/添加）。由于这些指标仅捕获了文本层面，它们代表了无协调的AI队友共同工作所带来成本的保守下限。
tldr: 本研究对AI Agent提交的拉取请求进行了首次大规模分析，发现并发提交非常普遍，且跨Agent协作在无协调时的合并冲突率高达41.7%（远高于同Agent的19.8%），其中大部分冲突发生在源代码文件中。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：本研究是首次针对AI Agent撰写的拉取请求（PR）进行的大规模并发与合并冲突实证分析，填补了多智能体软件工程领域的空白。
2. 重要性：研究不仅量化了AI Agent并发提交PR的普遍性，还揭示了跨Agent协作在无协调状态下高昂的合并成本（41.7%的冲突率），为未来多智能体协同开发框架的设计提供了关键的数据支撑。
3. 局限性：如作者所述，该研究仅关注了文本层面的Git合并冲突，属于保守的下限估计，未探讨更深层次的语义冲突（如编译错误或逻辑漏洞）。
motivation: 虽然AI编程Agent已经能够向公共代码仓库并发创建和提交拉取请求（PR），但目前学术界和工业界对于这种并发提交的发生频率，以及由于缺乏协调而导致的合并冲突等相关成本，还缺乏系统的大规模实证研究。
method:
1. 数据集分析：使用包含2,807个仓库中33,596个PR的AIDev-pop数据集，对Agent撰写的PR之间的并发性（共同活跃度）进行首次大规模实证分析。
2. 合并重放：在747个独特的共同活跃PR对上重放了实际的三路Git合并（three-way git merge）操作，以测量文本冲突率。
3. 冲突分类：基于Git冲突检测的输出开发了一个分类系统，对冲突文件的类型（源代码 vs. 依赖清单）和冲突结构（如修改/删除、添加/添加）进行定量分析。
results:
1. 并发频率：在精确时间重叠下，40.2%的仓库存在共同活跃的Agent PR对（占Agent提交PR总数的79.4%）；在一周协作期内，这些比例分别上升至53.4%和95.0%。
2. 跨Agent比例：绝大多数共同活跃PR对由同一Agent撰写，跨Agent（cross-agent）的共同活跃PR对仅占0.5%，分布在4.3%的仓库中。
3. 冲突率：跨Agent PR对的文本冲突率显著高于同Agent PR对（41.7% vs. 19.8%）。
4. 冲突结构：84.4%的冲突文件属于源代码文件（而非依赖清单文件），且有近42%的冲突属于结构性冲突（修改/删除或添加/添加）。
conclusion: 无协调的AI Agent在共同工作时，其并发提交拉取请求（PR）的比例极高。跨Agent协作导致的文本合并冲突率显著高于同Agent内部的冲突率。由于本研究仅捕捉了文本层面的冲突，该结果代表了无协调AI队友协同工作时相关合并成本的保守下限，凸显了未来构建AI Agent间协调机制的必要性。

title: Hierarchical Scaffolding Enables Human-Like Cognitive Selectivity under Data Scarcity
authors: Juhyoung Park, Jaehyuk Bae, Hyeonbo Yang, Se-Bum Paik
abstract: Modern machine learning systems demand extensive datasets for visual recognition. Conversely, humans learn with high efficiency despite severe data limitations, often by acquiring broad categorical structures before refining finer distinctions. Inspired by this contrast, we introduce SCALA (Scaffolded Cognitive Architecture for Learning under limited dAta), a hierarchical learning framework grounded in cognitive psychology that guides models from coarse conceptual structures to fine-grained recognition. Our model exhibits human-like cognitive selectivity by effectively prioritizing task-relevant features while suppressing background distractors, a mechanism that induces a fundamental shift in representation learning. This shift is characterized by accelerated cluster formation, reduced intra-class dispersion, and enhanced semantic separability. Empirically, SCALA achieves significant accuracy improvements under severe data scarcity. Furthermore, this hierarchical scaffolding promotes robust generalization to unseen classes and accelerates the acquisition of novel categories. Collectively, our results establish SCALA as a powerful framework for achieving human-level sample efficiency and resilient category generalization in data-constrained environments.
zh_title: 分层脚手架在数据稀缺下实现类人的认知选择性
translation: 现代机器学习系统在视觉识别方面需要庞大的数据集。相反，尽管存在严重的数据限制，人类仍能以极高的效率进行学习，这通常是通过在细化微观区别之前先获取宽泛的类别结构来实现的。受此对比的启发，我们引入了SCALA（用于受限数据下学习的脚手架认知架构），这是一种基于认知心理学的分层学习框架，能够引导模型从粗糙的概念结构走向细粒度的识别。我们的模型通过有效地优先处理与任务相关的特征并抑制背景干扰，展示了类似于人类的认知选择性，这种机制引发了表示学习的根本性转变。这种转变的特征是加速了聚类的形成、减少了类内分散，并增强了语义可分性。在实证方面，SCALA在严重的数据稀缺下实现了显著的准确性提升。此外，这种分层脚手架促进了对未见类别的鲁棒泛化，并加速了新类别的获取。总的来说，我们的研究结果将SCALA确立为一个在数据受限环境中实现人类水平样本效率和强韧类别泛化能力的强大框架。
tldr: 本文提出SCALA框架，一种受认知心理学启发的层次化学习方法，通过模拟人类“先粗后细”的认知路径，在极度缺乏数据的情况下实现了高样本效率、类人的特征选择性以及强大的类别泛化能力。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：巧妙地将认知心理学中人类“由粗到细”的学习机制（分层脚手架）引入机器学习，为解决小样本学习和数据稀缺问题提供了一种极具启发性的新视角。
2. 重要性：该方法不仅提高了模型在极端数据限制下的识别准确率，还显著增强了对未知类别的泛化能力，有助于缓解深度学习对海量标注数据的过度依赖。
3. 局限性：摘要未详细说明如何自动构建或获取这些粗粒度的概念结构（是否需要人工预定义的类别层次结构），且该机制在处理非视觉任务或更复杂的多模态任务时的普适性仍有待验证。
motivation: 现代机器学习系统在视觉识别中需要庞大的数据集，而人类在极度缺乏数据的情况下依然能高效学习（通常先获取宽泛的类别结构，再细化微观区别）。受此启发，作者旨在设计一种能克服数据稀缺并具有人类水平样本效率的学习框架。
method: 提出了SCALA（受限数据下学习的脚手架认知架构），这是一种基于认知心理学的分层学习框架。该框架引导模型从粗糙的概念结构过渡到细粒度的识别，通过优先处理任务相关特征并抑制背景干扰，实现类人的认知选择性。
results:
1. 在严重的数据稀缺下，SCALA实现了显著的准确率提升。
2. 促使表示学习发生根本性转变，表现为加速聚类形成、减少类内分散以及增强语义可分性。
3. 促进了对未见类别的鲁棒泛化，并加速了对新类别的获取。
conclusion: SCALA被证实是一个强大的框架，能够在数据受限的环境中实现人类水平的样本效率和强韧的类别泛化能力。

title: Integrated Altruistic and Fairness Preference Induces Advanced Mutual Cooperation in Sequential Social Dilemmas
authors: Yu Wei, Yukiko Ogura, Yoshiyuki Ohmura, Ildefons Magrans de Abril, Hoshinori Kanazawa, Yasuo Kuniyoshi
abstract: Inducing cooperation among distributed agents is still a difficult problem in the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), particularly in social dilemma situations. There, individual interests are misaligned with the common good and individual rationality leads to suboptimal group outcomes. In contrast, humans are able to achieve cooperation with one another in such situations. A common explanation for such cooperative behavior is that individuals have social preferences. In order to achieve cooperation in MARL, we design a new utility function integrating altruistic preferences (incentive for other's reward) and fairness preferences (incentive for equality) from social psychology and behavioral economics, namely, Altruistic and Fairness Preference (AFP), a reward-sharing mechanism which converts one's own and other's rewards to incentives for cooperative behavior. We performed comparative experiments with standard RL and inequity aversion agents in two challenging sequential social dilemma games, and showed that AFP agents successfully achieved mutual cooperation with more collective rewards and higher equity than the baselines. To further understand the progression of AFP during training, we subsequently explore the effects of altruistic preferences and fairness preferences on agents' behavior. The results suggest that altruistic preferences encourage agents to contribute to the public goods, and fairness preferences induce mutual behavior between agents.
zh_title: 融合利他与公平偏好在序列社会困境中诱导高级相互合作
translation: 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）领域，特别是在社会困境情况下，诱导分布式智能体之间的合作仍然是一个难题。在这些情况下，个人利益与共同利益不一致，个人理性会导致次优的群体结果。相比之下，人类在这些情况下能够实现相互合作。对这种合作行为的一个常见解释是，个体具有社会偏好。为了在MARL中实现合作，我们结合社会心理学和行为经济学，设计了一种融合了利他偏好（对他人奖励的激励）和公平偏好（对平等性的激励）的新型效用函数，即“利他与公平偏好（AFP）”，这是一种将自身和他人奖励转化为合作行为激励的奖励共享机制。我们在两个具有挑战性的序列社会困境博弈中，与标准强化学习和不平等规避智能体进行了对比实验，结果表明，与基线相比，AFP智能体成功实现了相互合作，获得了更多的集体奖励和更高的公平性。为了进一步理解训练过程中AFP的演变，我们随后探讨了利他偏好和公平偏好对智能体行为的影响。结果表明，利他偏好鼓励智能体为公共利益做出贡献，而公平偏好则诱导智能体之间的互惠行为。
tldr: 本文提出了一种融合利他和公平偏好的新型效用函数（AFP），通过奖励共享机制在多智能体强化学习的社会困境中成功实现了高收益、高公平的相互合作。
ai_comments: 本论文将社会心理学和行为经济学中的人类社会偏好引入多智能体强化学习（MARL），创新性地将利他偏好与公平偏好相结合。其优势在于通过简单的奖励共享机制，同时解决了集体收益最大化（通过利他偏好促进公共贡献）和分配公平性（通过公平偏好促进互惠）的问题，并在序列社会困境中取得了优于传统不平等规避等基线方法的效果。局限性在于，摘要中未提及该机制在更大规模智能体或动态变化环境中的可扩展性。
motivation: 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，由于个体利益与公共利益不一致，个体理性往往导致次优的群体结果，使得在社会困境中诱导分布式智能体合作变得非常困难。而人类能够通过社会偏好达成合作，这启发了将社会偏好引入MARL的研究。
method: 提出了一种名为“利他与公平偏好（AFP）”的新型效用函数。该函数融合了来自社会心理学和行为经济学的利他偏好（对他人奖励的激励）和公平偏好（对平等性的激励），作为一种奖励共享机制，将自身和脑他人的奖励转化为合作行为的激励。
results: 在两个挑战性的序列社会困境博弈实验中，AFP智能体比标准强化学习和不平等规避（inequity aversion）智能体成功实现了更好的相互合作，获得了更多的集体奖励（collective rewards）以及更高的公平性（equity）。
conclusion: 结合利他偏好和公平偏好的AFP机制能有效解决多智能体强化学习中的社会困境。其中，利他偏好鼓励智能体为公共利益做出贡献，而公平偏好则诱导智能体之间产生互惠行为。两者结合能诱导产生更高级的相互合作。

title: F-ACVAE: A Federated Adaptive Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder for Privacy-Preserving Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks
authors: Mohammad Ansarimehr, Somayeh Changiz, Ehsan Baghishani, Ali Mousavi
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Internet of things (IoT) devices has significantly expanded the cyber-attack surface, necessitating robust and privacy-preserving intrusion detection systems (IDS). However, centralized learning approaches often suffer from severe performance degradation due to high-dimensional traffic data, extreme class imbalance, and highly non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data across heterogeneous edge devices. To address these challenges, this paper proposes F-ACVAE, a federated adaptive conditional variational autoencoder framework that enables collaborative model training across distributed IoT devices without sharing raw data. F-ACVAE incorporates selective parameter aggregation, where local encoders remain private while globally shared components are synchronized to preserve discriminative latent structures. To further enhance stability under extreme non-IID settings and feature distribution shifts, we introduce a novel constrained momentum Gaussian aggregation (CMGA) strategy that combines update clamping with momentum-based smoothing to mitigate client drift. Extensive experiments on the N-BaIoT dataset demonstrate that F-ACVAE achieves an average accuracy and macro F1-score of 99\%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, the selective aggregation mechanism reduces communication overhead by approximately 62\%, making the framework particularly suitable for resource-constrained IoT environments. These results highlight the effectiveness of F-ACVAE in achieving high detection performance while ensuring privacy preservation and communication efficiency.
zh_title: F-ACVAE：一种用于物联网网络隐私保护入侵检测的联邦自适应条件变分自编码器
translation: 物联网（IoT）设备的迅速普及极大地扩大了网络攻击面，因此需要鲁棒且隐私保护的入侵检测系统（IDS）。然而，集中式学习方法常常由于高维流量数据、极端类别不平衡以及异构边缘设备上高度非独立同分布（non-IID）数据而导致性能严重下降。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出F-ACVAE，一个联邦自适应条件变分自编码器框架，该框架能够在不共享原始数据的情况下，实现分布式物联网设备之间的协作模型训练。F-ACVAE整合了选择性参数聚合，其中本地编码器保持私有，而全局共享组件被同步以保留判别性潜在结构。为了进一步增强在极端非独立同分布设置和特征分布偏移下的稳定性，我们引入了一种新颖的约束动量高斯聚合（CMGA）策略，该策略结合了更新钳制和基于动量的平滑来缓解客户端漂移。在N-BaIoT数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，F-ACVAE实现了99%的平均准确率和宏F1分数，优于现有最先进的基线。此外，选择性聚合机制将通信开销减少了大约62%，使得该框架特别适用于资源受限的物联网环境。这些结果突出了F-ACVAE在实现高检测性能同时确保隐私保护和通信效率方面的有效性。
tldr: F-ACVAE是一种联邦学习框架，通过选择性参数聚合和约束动量高斯聚合策略，在不共享原始数据的情况下，实现高精度、隐私保护和通信高效的物联网入侵检测。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入联邦学习和自适应条件变分自编码器，有效解决了物联网入侵检测中隐私保护和数据异构性的关键挑战。选择性参数聚合和约束动量高斯聚合策略是其创新点，显著提高了模型性能并降低了通信开销，对资源受限的物联网环境具有重要意义。
motivation: 物联网设备激增导致网络攻击面扩大，需要鲁棒且隐私保护的入侵检测系统。然而，集中式学习方法在处理高维数据、极端类别不平衡和异构边缘设备上的非独立同分布数据时，性能会严重下降。
method: 本文提出F-ACVAE，一种联邦自适应条件变分自编码器框架。它通过选择性参数聚合，使本地编码器保持私有，同时同步全局共享组件。为增强非独立同分布设置下的稳定性，引入约束动量高斯聚合（CMGA）策略，结合更新钳制和基于动量的平滑来缓解客户端漂移。
results: 在N-BaIoT数据集上，F-ACVAE实现了99%的平均准确率和宏F1分数，优于现有基线。选择性聚合机制将通信开销减少了约62%。
conclusion: F-ACVAE在实现高检测性能的同时，确保了隐私保护和通信效率，特别适用于资源受限的物联网环境。

title: Minimum distances of LDPC codes in 5G standard
authors: V.R. Danilko, I.Yu. Mogilnykh, Ya.A. Tikhomolov
abstract: We propose several approaches for bounding the minim\-um distances of the family of quasi-cyclic LDPC codes in the 5G NR standard. In particular, we show that the high-rate [9984, 8448] and the low-rate [25344, 8448] BG1 5G LDPC codes have minimum distances in the ranges {8..14} and {22..57}, respectively. Also we propose a new early termination approach based on circulant modular reduction, which significantly lowers syndrome calculation complexity for the LDPC decoder.
translation: 我们提出了几种用于界定5G NR标准中准循环LDPC码族最小距离的方法。特别是，我们展示了高码率[9984, 8448]和低码率[25344, 8448]的BG1 5G LDPC码的最小距离范围分别为{8..14}和{22..57}。此外，我们还提出了一种基于循环矩阵模约简的新型早停方法，该方法显著降低了LDPC译码器的伴随式计算复杂度。
tldr: 本文确定了5G标准中高/低码率LDPC码的最小距离范围，并提出了一种基于循环矩阵模约简的译码早停方法以降低计算复杂度。
ai_comments: 该研究针对5G NR标准中实际使用的LDPC码给出了具体的最小距离范围，具有很强的实用参考价值。此外，提出的基于循环矩阵模约简的早停方法在降低译码复杂度方面非常实用，有助于提升5G接收机的硬件实现效率。不过摘要中未提供具体的理论推导细节。
motivation: 旨在确定5G NR标准中准循环LDPC码的最小距离界限，并降低LDPC译码过程中的伴随式计算复杂度。
method: 提出了几种估计准循环LDPC码最小距离界限的方法，并提出了一种基于循环矩阵模约简（circulant modular reduction）的新型早停（early termination）方法。
results: 确定了高码率[9984, 8448]和低码率[25344, 8448]的BG1 5G LDPC码的最小距离范围分别为{8..14}和{22..57}；提出的早停方法显著降低了LDPC译码器的伴随式计算复杂度。
conclusion: 本文提出的方法成功界定了5G LDPC码的最小距离范围，且提出的早停方法能有效降低译码器的伴随式计算复杂度。

title: Learning Probabilistic Prompt for Continual Learning
authors: Hyekang Park, Sanghoon Lee, Geon Lee, Jongyoun Noh, Bumsub Ham
abstract: Continual learning aims to progressively learn from a sequence of tasks, each containing a disjoint subset of classes, while preserving previously learned knowledge. Prompt-based continual learning methods propose to learn a small set of parameters, i.e., prompts, by associating them with a query feature of an input image. These methods optimize the prompts, attempting to represent diverse patterns of images. However, we have observed that existing prompt-based methods suffer from a prompt collapse problem, that is, the prompts tend to be highly similar to each other, thereby failing to capture the diverse data distributions in continual learning scenarios. To address this issue, we propose in this paper a novel prompt-based continual learning framework that captures diverse patterns of images across a sequence of tasks. To this end, we model each prompt as a probabilistic distribution and construct a mixture of these distributions, from which we sample diverse prompts. This enables our model to effectively capture highly diverse image distributions in the continual learning process. We also present a distribution regularization loss to prevent abrupt changes in the prompt distributions throughout the training process. We show extensive experimental results for continual learning on standard benchmarks, including ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100, and CUB-200, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework.
zh_title: 持续学习中的概率提示学习
translation: 持续学习旨在从一系列任务中逐步学习，每个任务包含不相交的类别子集，同时保留先前学习的知识。基于提示的持续学习方法提出通过将一小组参数（即提示）与输入图像的查询特征相关联来学习它们。这些方法优化提示，试图表示图像的多样模式。然而，我们观察到现有基于提示的方法存在提示崩溃问题，即提示倾向于彼此高度相似，从而未能捕获持续学习场景中多样化的数据分布。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种新颖的基于提示的持续学习框架，该框架能够捕获一系列任务中图像的多样模式。为此，我们将每个提示建模为概率分布，并构建这些分布的混合，从中采样多样化的提示。这使得我们的模型能够有效捕获持续学习过程中高度多样化的图像分布。我们还提出了一种分布正则化损失，以防止在整个训练过程中提示分布发生突然变化。我们在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100和CUB-200等标准基准上展示了持续学习的广泛实验结果，证明了我们框架的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种新的概率提示学习框架，通过将提示建模为概率分布并引入分布正则化损失，有效解决了现有提示学习方法在持续学习中遇到的提示崩溃问题，从而捕获多样化的图像分布。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入概率提示和分布正则化损失，为解决持续学习中基于提示方法的“提示崩溃”问题提供了一个新颖的视角。将提示从离散参数转换为概率分布，增加了模型的表达能力和捕获数据多样性的潜力，这在持续学习的动态环境中尤为重要。
motivation: 现有基于提示的持续学习方法存在“提示崩溃”问题，即提示之间趋于高度相似，无法捕获持续学习场景中多样化的数据分布。
method: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于提示的持续学习框架。该框架将每个提示建模为概率分布，并构建这些分布的混合，从中采样多样化的提示。此外，还引入了分布正则化损失，以防止训练过程中提示分布的突然变化。
results: 在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100和CUB-200等标准基准数据集上的广泛实验结果表明了该框架的有效性。
conclusion: 该论文提出了一种新颖的概率提示学习框架，通过将提示建模为概率分布并引入分布正则化损失，成功解决了现有提示方法中的提示崩溃问题，有效捕获了持续学习中多样化的图像分布，并在多个基准测试中展现了优越性能。

title: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies
authors: Yunchao Zhang, Yijia Weng, Ruizhe Liu, Ming Hu, Leonidas Guibas, Yanchao Yang
abstract: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations. Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations. This four-dimensional objective -- spatial geometry changing through time -- forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns. GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks. Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding. Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context. Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success. Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.
zh_title: 几何感知运动潜变量用于学习鲁棒的操控策略
translation: 学习用于机器人操控的运动潜变量严重依赖于从视觉序列中提取运动模式，然而有效的动作抽象需要理解三维几何变换。在此，我们引入了GeoMoLa（几何感知运动潜变量），它通过预测操控过程中点云如何演变，而不是重建视觉观测，来学习离散运动潜码。这种四维目标——空间几何随时间的变化——迫使潜表征编码实际的物理运动，而不是外观模式。GeoMoLa仅使用单视角RGB-D输入就实现了最先进的性能，而现有方法需要多视角重建，并在各种操控基准上取得了成功。我们的消融实验表明，几何预测是驱动性能的关键，定量地验证了操控依赖于空间理解。此外，学习到的代码展现了有效的运动抽象：将它们应用于新场景会产生物理上一致的变换，而不管视觉上下文如何。我们的真实世界实验也证实了这种鲁棒性能力，在几何推理决定成功的杂乱环境中，通过最少的演示实现了鲁棒的操控。因此，我们证明了用于机器人控制的有效运动潜变量可以更好地通过理解运动的三维效应而不是像素级模式来产生。
tldr: 本文提出GeoMoLa，通过预测点云随时间的变化（四维目标）来学习离散运动潜码，实现了仅需单视角RGB-D输入的高鲁棒性机器人操控。
ai_comments: 该论文创新地将三维点云的时空演变（4D目标）引入到运动潜变量的学习中，摆脱了对多视角重建和单纯视觉外观重建的依赖。这种对物理运动和空间几何的显式建模极大地提升了操控策略的泛化能力与鲁棒性，特别是在单视角输入和杂乱环境下的表现，为具身智能中的动作表征学习提供了新的思路。
motivation: 传统的机器人操控运动潜变量学习过度依赖于从视觉序列中提取运动模式，但有效的动作抽象需要理解三维几何变换，而非仅仅重建视觉外观。
method: 提出GeoMoLa（几何感知运动潜变量）方法，通过预测操控过程中点云如何随时间演变（四维目标：空间几何随时间的变化），而不是重建视觉观测，来学习离散的运动潜码，从而迫使潜表征编码实际的物理运动而非外观模式。
results: GeoMoLa仅使用单视角RGB-D输入就达到了最先进的性能（而现有方法需要多视角重建），在多种操控基准上取得成功。消融实验证实几何预测是提升性能的关键。在真实世界实验中，该方法在杂乱环境中仅需极少演示即可实现鲁棒操控，并展现出良好的运动抽象和泛化能力。
conclusion: 用于机器人控制的有效运动潜变量可以更好地通过理解运动的三维效应（而非像素级模式）产生。

title: Aerial Manipulation: Contact, Medium Coupling, and the Geometry of Readiness
authors: Antonio Franchi
abstract: Aerial robots are increasingly moving from remote observation toward physical interaction with objects, surfaces, structures, loads, and surrounding flows. This review argues that aerial manipulation cannot be understood as classical manipulation simply mounted on a flying base. Because flying agents remain aloft through continuous momentum and energy exchange with the surrounding medium, support, locomotion, stabilization, and task-directed interaction are intrinsically coupled. Building on broad views of manipulation as intentional environmental regulation through physical interaction, we propose a medium-aware interpretation of aerial manipulation in which interaction may be mediated by contact, by the surrounding fluid, or by both. The review organizes biological and robotic examples into a repertoire of interaction modes and a capability ladder, then develops an actuation-geometric viewpoint in which redundancy induces task-equivalent fibers. Internal motion along these fibers can trade energy for active readiness, aerodynamic promptness, and passive medium coupling. This perspective clarifies why aerial manipulation is difficult, why biological flyers remain broader than robotic systems, and how future platforms may command forces while also shaping how the medium acts back on them.
zh_title: 空中操纵：接触、介质耦合与就绪几何学
translation: 空中机器人正越来越多地从远程观测转向与物体、表面、结构、负载及周围流体的物理交互。本综述认为，空中操纵不能简单地理解为安装在飞行底座上的经典操纵。因为飞行体通过与周围介质持续的动量和能量交换来保持悬空，所以支撑、移动、稳定和任务导向的交互是内在耦合的。基于将操纵视为通过物理交互进行有意环境调节的广泛观点，我们提出了一种对空中操纵的介质感知解释，其中交互可以通过接触、周围流体或两者共同介导。该综述将生物和机器人实例组织成交互模式库和能力阶梯，然后开发了一种驱动几何视角，其中冗余引入了任务等效纤维。沿着这些纤维的内部运动可以权衡能量，以获得主动就绪性、气动敏捷性和被动介质耦合。这一视角阐明了为什么空中操纵如此困难，为什么生物飞行器比机器人系统更具通用性，以及未来的平台如何在指挥力的同时塑造介质对它们的反作用。
tldr: 本文指出空中操纵因与周围介质的持续能量交换而高度耦合，不能简单等同于飞行底座加机械臂；为此提出了一种介质感知的空中操纵框架，并从驱动几何学视角解释了其复杂性及未来发展方向。
ai_comments: 这篇综述论文从一个非常新颖的“介质感知”和“几何学”视角重新审视了空中操纵。它突破了“飞行平台+机械臂”简单叠加的传统认知，强调了流体介质在交互中的核心耦合作用。文章提出的驱动几何学和任务等效纤维概念，为解决空中操纵的强耦合和控制冗余问题提供了深刻的理论洞察，对未来仿生空中机器人和高动态物理交互平台的设计具有重要启发。
motivation: 空中机器人正从远程观测转向与物体、表面及流体等进行物理交互。然而，空中操纵不能简单地被理解为安装在飞行底座上的经典操纵，因为飞行器通过与周围介质的持续动量和能量交换来保持悬空，这导致支撑、移动、稳定和任务导向的交互之间存在内在的强耦合。
method: 提出了一种“介质感知”的空中操纵阐释（交互可通过接触、周围流体或两者共同介导），整理了生物和机器人的实例以构建交互模式库和能力阶梯，并开发了一种驱动几何学视角（冗余导致任务等效纤维），通过沿着这些纤维的内部运动来权衡能量，以实现主动就绪性、气动敏捷性和被动介质耦合。
results: 建立了一个交互模式库和能力阶梯，并提出了一个驱动几何学视角。这一视角阐明了为什么空中操纵如此困难，为什么生物飞行器比目前的机器人系统具有更广泛的能力，以及未来平台如何在控制力的同时塑造介质对它们的反作用。
conclusion: 空中操纵需要一种介质感知的视角和几何方法，未来的空中平台可以通过这种方法在控制力的同时，塑造周围介质对自身的作用。

title: FORGE: Research-Trajectory Hijacking Attacks on Deep Research Agents
authors: Yue Pan, Ziheng Zhang, Junxiang Lei, Changhao Jia, Qingyi Si, Hongcheng Guo
abstract: Deep research agents decompose open-ended queries into subtasks, retrieve web evidence over multiple rounds, and synthesize long-form reports. This workflow creates a planning-layer poisoning surface: adversarial documents that enter the retrieval pool can steer follow-up questions and turn a local injection into report-level contamination. We present FORGE (Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation), a two-level attack that combines intra-document reasoning fabrication with inter-document chain coordination to hijack subtask planning. We further introduce the PRISM metric, which weights infected report claims by cognitive type, and Root Query Anchoring, a lightweight defense that ties recursive follow-up generation to the root query. Across 25 queries, Network FORGE reaches 26.4% PRISM with five injected documents and exhibits depth migration, in which recursive synthesis shifts poisoned content from overt framing into factual premises. On the 10-query defense subset, RQA (Root Query Anchoring) reduces PRISM from 38.5% to 18.3%.
zh_title: FORGE：针对深度研究代理的研究轨迹劫持攻击
translation: 深度研究代理将开放式查询分解为子任务，多轮检索网络证据，并合成长篇报告。这种工作流创建了一个规划层中毒表面：进入检索池的对抗性文档可以引导后续问题，并将局部注入转化为报告级别的污染。我们提出了FORGE（Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation），这是一种两级攻击，结合了文档内推理伪造和文档间链协调来劫持子任务规划。我们进一步引入了PRISM指标，该指标根据认知类型对受感染的报告声明进行加权，以及Root Query Anchoring，这是一种轻量级防御机制，将递归的后续生成与根查询联系起来。在25个查询中，Network FORGE通过注入五个文档达到了26.4%的PRISM值，并表现出深度迁移，其中递归合成将中毒内容从公开框架转移到事实前提中。在10个查询的防御子集中，RQA（Root Query Anchoring）将PRISM从38.5%降低到18.3%。
tldr: FORGE是一种两级攻击，可以劫持深度研究代理的子任务规划，通过注入恶意文档来污染报告。我们还提出了PRISM指标和Root Query Anchoring防御机制。
ai_comments: 这篇论文揭示了深度研究代理在处理开放式查询时可能面临的一种新型安全威胁，即通过操纵检索内容来劫持其研究轨迹。FORGE攻击的设计巧妙，特别是结合了文档内伪造和文档间协调，以及深度迁移现象的发现，都具有重要的研究价值。提出的PRISM指标为量化攻击效果提供了新的视角。同时，轻量级的RQA防御机制也为未来构建更安全的代理提供了初步思路。这项工作对于理解和缓解大型语言模型在复杂任务中的安全风险具有重要意义。
motivation: 深度研究代理在处理开放式查询时，通过分解子任务、多轮检索网络证据和合成报告来工作。这种工作流在规划层创建了一个中毒表面，即对抗性文档可以进入检索池，引导后续问题，并将局部注入转化为报告级别的污染。
method: 我们提出了FORGE（Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation），这是一种两级攻击，结合了文档内推理伪造和文档间链协调来劫持子任务规划。我们还引入了PRISM指标，该指标根据认知类型对受感染的报告声明进行加权，以及Root Query Anchoring（RQA），这是一种轻量级防御机制，将递归的后续生成与根查询联系起来。
results: 在25个查询中，Network FORGE通过注入五个文档达到了26.4%的PRISM值，并表现出深度迁移，其中递归合成将中毒内容从公开框架转移到事实前提中。在10个查询的防御子集中，RQA将PRISM从38.5%降低到18.3%。
conclusion: FORGE攻击能够有效劫持深度研究代理的子任务规划并污染最终报告，而Root Query Anchoring防御机制可以显著降低这种攻击的影响。

title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
authors: Qiang Liu, Taian Guo, Ruizhi Qiao, Xing Sun
abstract: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Conversely, while employing customized dense process rewards provides richer signals and accelerates convergence, these surrogate rewards may exhibit potential misalignment with the ground-truth outcome rewards. This inconsistency can bias the training direction and ultimately degrade the model's final performance. In this work, we propose Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a method designed to leverage the rich information from dense process rewards to facilitate training with outcome rewards. By utilizing a reward-swap mechanism, RSPO ensures the diversity of sampled trajectories while guaranteeing consistency between the optimization objective and the true outcome rewards, thereby elevating the performance ceiling of the model. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. By applying our method to various reinforcement learning algorithms, including GRPO, PPO, and GiGPO, we demonstrate that RSPO achieves consistent performance improvements across different baselines and benchmarks.
zh_title: RSPO：针对多轮LLM智能体的奖励交换策略优化
translation: 强化学习在训练大语言模型（LLM）处理多轮交互任务方面具有巨大潜力。然而，在以稀疏结果奖励为特征的长程、多轮任务中，直接使用结果奖励进行训练往往由于信号稀疏和缺乏细粒度反馈而导致收敛缓慢。此外，模型可能无法学习到在训练期间未被采样的成功轨迹，从而限制了其性能。相反，虽然采用定制的密集过程奖励可以提供更丰富的信号并加速收敛，但这些替代奖励可能与真实的最终结果奖励存在潜在的不一致。这种不一致会使训练方向产生偏差，并最终降低模型的最终性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了奖励交换策略优化（RSPO），这是一种旨在利用密集过程奖励的丰富信息来促进结果奖励训练的方法。通过利用奖励交换机制，RSPO在确保采样轨迹多样性的同时，保证了优化目标与真实结果奖励之间的一致性，从而提高了模型的性能上限。我们在两个具有挑战性的智能体基准测试WebShop和ALFWorld上进行了广泛的实验。通过将我们的方法应用于包括GRPO、PPO和GiGPO在内的各种强化学习算法，我们证明了RSPO在不同的基准和基线测试中均取得了持续的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出了RSPO方法，通过奖励交换机制结合了密集过程奖励的丰富信息与结果奖励的一致性，显著提升了多轮LLM智能体在稀疏奖励任务中的训练效率和最终性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“奖励交换”机制，这一设计巧妙地结合了密集过程奖励在探索和收敛速度上的优势，以及结果奖励在目标一致性上的保障，解决了多轮LLM智能体训练中稀疏奖励与奖励函数失配（Reward Misalignment）的经典难题。其重要性在于能够普适地应用于多种主流RL算法（如PPO、GRPO等）。局限性在于，摘要中未提及该方法对过程奖励函数设计质量的依赖程度，以及在更广泛、更复杂的开放域任务中的泛化能力。
motivation: 在长程、多轮交互任务中，直接使用稀疏的结果奖励训练LLM智能体会导致收敛缓慢且难以学到未采样的成功轨迹；而使用定制的密集过程奖励虽能加速收敛，但过程奖励与真实结果奖励之间可能存在不一致（失配），从而导致训练偏差并降低模型最终性能。
method: 提出了一种名为“奖励交换策略优化”（Reward-Swap Policy Optimization, RSPO）的方法。该方法引入了奖励交换机制，利用密集过程奖励的丰富信息来促进基于结果奖励的训练，在保证采样轨迹多样性的同时，确保了优化目标与真实结果奖励之间的一致性。
results: 在WebShop和ALFWorld两个具有挑战性的智能体基准测试上进行了广泛实验。将RSPO应用于GRPO、PPO和GiGPO等多种强化学习算法中，均在不同的基线和基准上实现了持续且显著的性能提升。
conclusion: RSPO通过奖励交换机制，成功实现了在利用密集过程奖励加速训练、丰富采样多样性的同时，保持优化目标与真实结果奖励的一致性，为多轮LLM智能体在长程稀疏奖励任务中的优化提供了一种高效且通用的解决方案。

title: Reference-Induced Consensus for Selective Posed-Reference Visual Localization
authors: Wonseok Kang, Jaehyun Kim, Jeongmin Lee, Tae-Wan Kim
abstract: We present RIC-Loc (Reference-Induced Consensus localization), a scene-training-free posed-reference localizer that is SfM-point-map-free in its main estimator: it uses known reference poses, but not precomputed SfM 3D map points, query-to-map 2D-3D matches, or query-to-map PnP. A frozen VGGT pass predicts local camera poses, depth, and query-reference tracks for a query and selected references. Each reference induces one map-frame SE(3) query-pose hypothesis, robust consensus estimates the pose, and the preserved hypothesis structure yields two reliability scores: spatial dispersion and a track-conditioned covariance score. On the covariance-eligible set, the two scores are complementary for held-out, ground-truth-free failure detection across indoor, outdoor, and large-scale low-texture benchmarks: the joint policy is strongest in textured scenes and the covariance score in the low-texture regime, and the hypothesis-derived scores consistently outperform the standard retrieval-score gap and random rankings. Without per-scene training the consensus estimator remains accurate -- competitive with structure-based localization indoors and improving over a comparable feed-forward baseline -- giving an effective selective operating regime for posed-reference localization. Code is available at https://github.com/SNU-DLLAB/ric_loc.
zh_title: 参考诱导共识的选择性位姿参考视觉定位
translation: 我们提出了RIC-Loc（参考诱导共识定位），这是一种无需场景训练的位姿参考定位器，其主要估计器不依赖于SfM点图：它使用已知的参考位姿，但不需要预计算的SfM 3D地图点、查询到地图的2D-3D匹配或查询到地图的PnP。一个冻结的VGGT通道预测查询和选定参考的局部相机位姿、深度和查询-参考轨迹。每个参考都会诱导一个地图帧SE(3)查询位姿假设，鲁棒共识估计位姿，并且保留的假设结构产生两种可靠性评分：空间离散度和轨迹条件协方差评分。在协方差合格集合上，这两种评分对于室内、室外和大规模低纹理基准测试中的未持有、无地面真值故障检测是互补的：联合策略在纹理场景中表现最强，而协方差评分在低纹理场景中表现突出，并且假设衍生的评分始终优于标准检索评分差距和随机排名。在没有每场景训练的情况下，共识估计器保持准确性——在室内与基于结构的定位方法具有竞争力，并优于可比的前馈基线——为位姿参考定位提供了一个有效的选择性操作机制。代码可在https://github.com/SNU-DLLAB/ric_loc获取。
tldr: RIC-Loc是一种无需场景训练和SfM点图的位姿参考定位器，它利用已知的参考位姿和VGGT预测的相机位姿、深度和查询-参考轨迹，通过共识估计查询位姿，并提供两种可靠性评分，在多种场景下表现出竞争力。
ai_comments: RIC-Loc的创新之处在于其“无需场景训练”和“SfM点图无关”的特性，这大大降低了视觉定位系统的部署复杂性和对预处理数据的依赖。通过引入参考诱导共识机制和两种互补的可靠性评分，该系统在处理不同纹理和场景（包括低纹理环境）时展现出强大的鲁棒性和故障检测能力，为位姿参考定位提供了一个高效且实用的解决方案。其性能与基于结构的方法相当，并且优于前馈基线，显示出其在实际应用中的潜力。
motivation: 传统的视觉定位方法通常依赖于预计算的SfM 3D点图、2D-3D匹配或PnP，这些方法可能需要场景训练。本文旨在开发一种无需这些复杂步骤的、场景训练无关的位姿参考定位器。
method: RIC-Loc (Reference-Induced Consensus localization) 是一种无需场景训练的位姿参考定位器，其主要估计器不依赖SfM点图。它使用已知的参考位姿，但不使用预计算的SfM 3D地图点、查询到地图的2D-3D匹配或查询到地图的PnP。一个冻结的VGGT（Visual Geometry Group Transformer）通道预测查询和选定参考的局部相机位姿、深度和查询-参考轨迹。每个参考都会诱导一个地图帧SE(3)查询位姿假设，鲁棒共识估计位姿，并且保留的假设结构产生两种可靠性评分：空间离散度和轨迹条件协方差评分。
results: 在协方差合格集合上，两种评分对于室内、室外和大规模低纹理基准测试中的未持有、无地面真值故障检测是互补的：联合策略在纹理场景中表现最强，而协方差评分在低纹理场景中表现突出。假设衍生的评分始终优于标准检索评分差距和随机排名。在没有每场景训练的情况下，共识估计器保持准确性——在室内与基于结构的定位方法具有竞争力，并优于可比的前馈基线——为位姿参考定位提供了一个有效的选择性操作机制。
conclusion: RIC-Loc提供了一种有效的、无需场景训练的位姿参考定位方法，通过结合参考诱导假设和两种互补的可靠性评分，在各种纹理和场景条件下实现了准确且鲁棒的定位，并能够有效检测故障。

title: Dashboard2Code: Evaluating Multimodal Models on Reconstructing Interactive Dashboards
authors: Tianhao Niu, Ziyu Han, Qiguang Chen, Shiqi Zhou, Baocai Shan, Hengjie Fang, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
abstract: Automatic data visualization generation has advanced rapidly with multi-modal large language models, yet existing efforts largely focus on static charts and overlook the interactive dashboards commonly used for real-world data exploration. We introduce Dashboard2Code, a novel task that requires a model to proactively explore an interactive dashboard, acquire and integrate feedback from its own interactions (e.g., clicking and filtering), and generate code that reproduces the target dashboard. To support comprehensive evaluation, we present DashboardMimic, the first Plotly+Dash benchmark for Dashboard2Code, comprising 180 carefully designed and manually verified dashboard-code pairs spanning three difficulty levels and covering eight common real-world interaction patterns. We further propose an automated evaluation framework tailored to dashboards that combines code semantic analysis with dynamic interaction-based testing to assess visual and interaction consistency, showing strong agreement with human judgments. Experiments across a range of open- and closed-source multi-modal models reveal that even the strongest systems struggle on high-complexity dashboards and that a substantial performance gap remains between open-source and closed-source models on the Dashboard2Code task.
zh_title: Dashboard2Code：评估多模态模型重建交互式仪表盘的能力
translation: 随着多模态大语言模型的发展，自动数据可视化生成取得了快速进展，但现有的研究主要集中在静态图表上，忽略了现实世界数据探索中常用的交互式仪表盘。我们引入了Dashboard2Code，这是一项新颖的任务，要求模型主动探索交互式仪表盘，获取并整合其自身交互（例如点击和过滤）的反馈，并生成能够重现目标仪表盘的代码。为了支持全面评估，我们推出了DashboardMimic，这是针对Dashboard2Code的首个Plotly+Dash基准测试，包含180个精心设计且经人工验证的仪表盘-代码对，涵盖三个难度级别和八种常见的现实世界交互模式。我们还进一步提出了一个专为仪表盘定制的自动评估框架，该框架将代码语义分析与基于动态交互的测试相结合，以评估视觉和交互的一致性，结果显示其与人类判断具有很强的一致性。在一系列开源和闭源多模态模型上的实验表明，即使是最强大的系统在面对高复杂度的仪表盘时也显得力不从心，并且在Dashboard2Code任务上，开源模型与闭源模型之间仍存在实质性的性能差距。
tldr: 本文提出了Dashboard2Code任务及DashboardMimic基准，用于评估多模态模型通过主动交互重建交互式仪表盘的能力，实验表明现有最强模型在此任务上仍面临巨大挑战。
ai_comments: 这项研究填补了从静态图表生成迈向动态交互式仪表盘重建的空白，具有很强的现实应用价值。其设计的DashboardMimic基准涵盖了多种难度和交互模式，且提出的自动评估框架结合了静态语义与动态交互测试，比单纯的代码对比或图像对比更具说服力。局限性在于目前主要基于Plotly+Dash框架，未来可拓展至更多主流的仪表盘开发工具。
motivation: 现有的自动数据可视化生成研究主要集中在静态图表上，忽视了现实数据探索中不可或缺且广泛使用的交互式仪表盘。
method:
1. 引入新任务Dashboard2Code：要求模型主动探索仪表盘、获取交互反馈并生成重构代码。
2. 构建DashboardMimic基准：首个针对该任务的Plotly+Dash数据集，包含180个精心设计、涵盖3个难度级别和8种交互模式的仪表盘-代码对。
3. 提出自动评估框架：结合代码语义分析与基于动态交互的测试，评估视觉和交互的一致性。
results: 实验表明，即使是最先进的多模态模型在面对高复杂度仪表盘时也表现挣扎，且开源模型与闭源模型在Dashboard2Code任务上仍存在显著的性能差距。
conclusion: 交互式仪表盘的自动重建（Dashboard2Code）对当前多模态模型提出了极高挑战，所提出的DashboardMimic基准和评估框架能够有效评估这一能力，且评估结果与人类判断高度一致。

title: What You See Is What You Get: Observation-Aligned Supervision for Chart-to-Code Generation
authors: Tianhao Niu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
abstract: Chart-to-code generation is commonly trained with supervised fine-tuning on reference plotting scripts, implicitly treating the gold code as a fully observable target. We argue that this assumption is often invalid: many chart programs contain latent raw variables that cannot be uniquely recovered from the rendered image. For example, a boxplot exposes summary statistics rather than original samples, a pie chart reveals proportions rather than arbitrary raw values, and a histogram shows bin-level mass rather than individual observations. Supervising models to reproduce such non-identifiable quantities encourages hallucination and over-specified code generation. We introduce Observation-Aligned supervision, a rewriting framework that replaces latent raw-data targets with quantities constrained by the visual observation: box statistics for boxplots, wedge percentages for pie charts, and bin weights for histograms. Applying this framework to chart-to-code training data from two sources, we obtain the Observation-Aligned supervision target data. Experiments across multiple VLMs on ChartMimic and ChartX demonstrate consistent improvements in observable value recovery, including under both-executable evaluation. Our results suggest that improving chart-to-code models requires not only more data or advanced learning objectives or algorithms, but also supervision targets that respect what is identifiable from the chart image.
zh_title: 所见即所得：图表到代码生成中的观察对齐监督
translation: 图表到代码生成通常通过对参考绘图脚本进行监督微调来训练，隐式地将黄金代码视为完全可观测的目标。我们认为这个假设通常是无效的：许多图表程序包含无法从渲染图像中唯一恢复的潜在原始变量。例如，箱线图暴露的是汇总统计数据而不是原始样本，饼图揭示的是比例而不是任意原始值，直方图显示的是箱级质量而不是单个观察值。监督模型重现这些不可识别的数量会鼓励幻觉和过度指定的代码生成。我们引入了观察对齐监督，这是一个重写框架，用视觉观察所约束的数量来替换潜在的原始数据目标：箱线图的箱体统计数据，饼图的扇形百分比，以及直方图的箱体权重。将此框架应用于来自两个来源的图表到代码训练数据，我们获得了观察对齐的监督目标数据。在ChartMimic和ChartX上，跨多个视觉语言模型（VLMs）进行的实验表明，可观测值恢复方面取得了持续改进，包括在可执行评估下。我们的结果表明，改进图表到代码模型不仅需要更多数据或先进的学习目标或算法，还需要监督目标能够尊重图表图像中可识别的内容。
tldr: 当前图表到代码生成模型在监督训练中常假设黄金代码完全可观测，但图表往往包含不可唯一恢复的潜在变量。本文提出了“观察对齐监督”框架，用视觉可约束的量替换潜在原始数据目标，实验证明其能显著改善可观测值恢复，减少幻觉和过度指定代码的生成。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于重新审视了图表到代码生成任务中的监督范式。它深刻地指出了现有方法中“黄金代码完全可观测”这一隐含假设的缺陷，并提出了一种基于“所见即所得”原则的创新性解决方案。通过将监督目标与图表视觉上可识别的信息对齐，该方法有效地解决了模型幻觉和代码过度指定的问题，为该领域的研究开辟了新的视角。其重要性在于，它不仅仅关注于模型或数据量的提升，而是从根本上优化了监督信号的质量，这对于提升生成代码的准确性和鲁棒性至关重要。
motivation: 图表到代码生成通常通过监督微调在参考绘图脚本上进行训练，并隐含地将黄金代码视为完全可观测的目标。然而，这个假设通常是无效的，因为许多图表程序包含无法从渲染图像中唯一恢复的潜在原始变量（例如，箱线图显示汇总统计数据而非原始样本）。这种对不可识别数量的监督会鼓励幻觉和过度指定的代码生成。
method: 本文引入了“观察对齐监督”框架，这是一个重写框架，它用视觉观察所约束的量（如箱线图的箱体统计数据、饼图的扇形百分比、直方图的柱状权重）来替换潜在的原始数据目标。将此框架应用于来自两个来源的图表到代码训练数据，获得了观察对齐的监督目标数据。
results: 在ChartMimic和ChartX上，跨多个视觉语言模型（VLMs）进行的实验表明，可观测值恢复方面取得了持续改进，包括在可执行评估下。
conclusion: 结果表明，改进图表到代码模型不仅需要更多数据或先进的学习目标或算法，还需要监督目标能够尊重图表图像中可识别的内容。

title: RustMizan: A Compilable, Contamination-Aware Benchmarking Framework for Rust Vulnerabilities
authors: Tarek Elsayed, Shiping Yang, Eunsong Koh, Sanika Goyal, Vincent Huang, Paul Ngo, Nathan Young, Mohammad Omidvar Tehrani, Alvyn Kang, Arnell Kang, Zeyu Chen, Angélica Moreira, Xuan Feng, Angel X. Chang, Nick Sumner, Steven Y. Ko
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to vulnerability analysis, but existing benchmarks have not kept pace. They typically rely on small non-compilable snippets, focus on binary classification (vulnerable or not), and do not account for the risk that publicly-released datasets are part of model training corpora. We introduce RustMizan, a benchmarking framework for Rust vulnerability analysis that addresses these gaps. RustMizan contains compilable code variants at the crate, file, and function levels, with annotations for binary vulnerability detection, CWE classification, and function- and line-level localization. A paired mutation framework produces semantics-preserving code mutants for contamination testing and robustness probing. Across four frontier models in an agentic setup with command-line access, binary classification sits in the 56-65% range, but line localization F1 stays near 20%, and adversarial cues drop line F1 by about 27%.
zh_title: RustMizan：一个可编译、污染感知型Rust漏洞基准测试框架
translation: LLM代理越来越多地应用于漏洞分析，但现有基准测试未能跟上。它们通常依赖于小型不可编译的代码片段，侧重于二元分类（有漏洞或无漏洞），并且没有考虑到公开数据集是模型训练语料库一部分的风险。我们引入了RustMizan，一个用于Rust漏洞分析的基准测试框架，解决了这些差距。RustMizan包含在crate、文件和函数级别的可编译代码变体，并带有二元漏洞检测、CWE分类以及函数和行级定位的注解。一个配对的变异框架会生成语义保持的代码变异体，用于污染测试和鲁棒性探测。在具有命令行访问权限的代理设置中，对四个前沿模型进行测试，二元分类的准确率在56-65%之间，但行级定位的F1分数保持在20%左右，并且对抗性线索使行级F1分数下降了约27%。
tldr: RustMizan是一个新的Rust漏洞分析基准测试框架，解决了现有基准测试的不足，提供了可编译的代码、多级注解和污染测试机制。实验显示LLM模型在二元分类上表现一般，但在行级定位和对抗性测试下表现更差。
ai_comments: RustMizan的创新之处在于其提供了可编译的、多粒度注解的Rust代码，并引入了污染感知和鲁棒性测试机制，这对于评估LLM在实际漏洞分析任务中的能力至关重要。它解决了现有基准测试的局限性，特别是数据污染问题。研究结果也揭示了当前LLM模型在细粒度漏洞定位和对抗性场景下的不足，为未来的研究指明了方向。
motivation: 现有针对LLM代理的漏洞分析基准测试未能跟上发展，主要问题包括：依赖小型不可编译代码片段、仅关注二元分类（有无漏洞），以及未考虑公开数据集可能已被用于模型训练的污染风险。
method: 本文引入了RustMizan，一个用于Rust漏洞分析的基准测试框架，旨在解决现有基准测试的不足。RustMizan包含在crate、文件和函数级别的可编译代码变体，并带有二元漏洞检测、CWE分类以及函数和行级定位的注解。此外，它还集成了一个配对的变异框架，用于生成语义保持的代码变异体，以进行污染测试和鲁棒性探测。
results: 在具有命令行访问权限的代理设置中，对四个前沿模型进行测试，结果显示二元分类的准确率在56-65%之间。然而，行级定位的F1分数保持在20%左右，并且对抗性线索（adversarial cues）导致行级F1分数下降了约27%。
conclusion: LLM代理在Rust漏洞的二元分类上表现尚可，但在更细粒度的行级定位和对抗性场景下表现不佳，表明现有模型在复杂漏洞分析任务上仍有显著提升空间。

title: SparseOcc++: Geometry-Aware Sparse Latent Representation for Semantic Occupancy Prediction
authors: Pin Tang, Zhongdao Wang, Guoqing Wang, Xiangxuan Ren, Chao Ma
abstract: Vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction is essential for autonomous driving, yet dense voxel representations waste computation on largely empty space, while BEV and TPV projections compromise fine-grained 3D structure. Fully sparse representations offer an attractive alternative, but existing methods, including SparseOcc, entangle scene completion with semantic prediction by indiscriminately propagating high-dimensional features into empty regions and applying voxel-wise classification. This creates excessive activations, computational overhead, and geometric ambiguity. We present SparseOcc++, a geometry-aware sparse framework that explicitly decouples scene completion from semantic segmentation.
