Ample sets of hypercubes, introduced by A. Dress in 1995, constitute a combinatorial structure with rich properties and important examples. Ample sets can be characterized in a multitude of combinatorial, graph-theoretical, recursive, and geometrical ways, and they are equivalent to lopsided sets introduced by J. Lawrence in 1983.
  In this paper, we define and investigate ample sets of Cartesian products $U=U_1\times\cdots\times U_m$. This is done using minor-subproducts of $U$, which correspond to products of partitions of factors: each minor-subproduct is obtained by partitioning each $U_i$ into blocks and contracting blocks into singletons. For a minor-subproduct $M$ and a set $S$, we define the notions of shattering of $M$ by $S$, of copy of $M$ in $S$, of projection $S_M$ of $S$ on $M$, and of strong-projection $S^M$ of $S$ on $M$. We call a set $S$ \emph{ample} if for any minor-subproduct $M$ that is shattered by $S$, there exists a copy of $M$ included in $S$.
  We prove that several characterizations of ample sets can be extended to ample sets of Cartesian products. In particular, we show that ampleness of $S$ is equivalent to the ampleness of the complement $S^*$, to superisometricity (isometricity of $S^M$ for any minor-subproduct $M$), and commutativity $(S^M)_{M'}=(S_{M'})^M$ for all minor-subproducts $M,M'$ with disjoint supports. We also provide more efficient characterizations of ampleness, in particular, by showing that $S$ is ample iff S is isometric and both $S_e$ and $S^e$ are ample for some elementary minor-subproduct, iff the intersection of S with any interval [u,v] with u,v in S is ample in the classical sense. We characterize ampleness by push downs and provide a decomposition theorem, allowing us to prove that their prism complexes are contractible. We provide new examples of ample sets arising from payoff games, prism-like polyhedra, and quasi-median graphs.

title: The Delayed Stabilizer ZX-Calculus
authors: Cole Comfort, Giovanni de Felice
abstract: Many stabilizer quantum error-correcting codes are built from a finite pattern repeated across space or time, such as lattice codes, translation-invariant graph states, and quantum convolutional codes. Ordinary stabilizer ZX-diagrams capture only finite truncations of such systems, obscuring the repeated structure that defines them. We introduce the delayed stabilizer ZX-calculus, a finite graphical language for these infinite, translation-invariant processes. It extends the odd-prime-dimensional stabilizer ZX-calculus with a single new generator, the delay, which feeds data from one time step to the next. We equip the calculus with two semantics. In the first semantics, we interpret the behaviour of a delayed ZX-diagram as an equivalence class of sequences of quantum channels; where two sequences are identified if they have the same information content. We show that the behaviour of a delayed ZX-diagram uniquely determines an infinite stabilizer group. In the second semantics, we interpret the delay as a formal variable, encoding the translation-invariant families of Pauli operators as generating functions. This allows us to represent a delayed ZX-diagram in terms of a tableau of generating functions, from which the infinite stabilizer group can be recovered. Finally, we give a complete axiomatization of the delayed stabilizer ZX-calculus, featuring generalised Euler decomposition and colour change rules. Using generalised forms of local complementation and pivoting, we reduce every diagram to a unique normal form. This establishes soundness, universality, and completeness for the generating tableau semantics.

title: A quasi-incompressible Cahn-Hilliard-Darcy model for two immiscible fluids in porous media
authors: Daozhi Han, Sayantan Sarkar
abstract: We derive a quasi-incompressible Cahn-Hilliard-Darcy phase-field model (qCHD) with the logarithmic Flory-Huggins free energy density function for two-phase flows in porous media. The model satisfies an energy-dissipation law. In the formal sharp interface limit, the qCHD model gives rise to the classical Muskat's problem. By exploiting estimates of the pressure from Darcy's equations, we establish global existence of weak solutions in both 2D and 3D to the qCHD model.

title: Frozen-Tree Sampling Refutes Quantum Advantage of Random Circuit Sampling
authors: Sangchul Oh
abstract: Random circuit sampling of bitstrings from a Haar-random quantum state is widely believed to be classically intractable, and has therefore been implemented as a primary benchmark for demonstrating quantum advantage. Here, we challenge this premise by proposing an efficient classical frozen-tree sampling algorithm that exploits the conditional scale invariance of Haar-random quantum states [Oh, arXiv:2602.19448]. The frozen-tree sampler draws bitstrings of $n$ qubits in $O(n)$ time per sample. Moreover, its output probability $p_F(x)$ is statistically identical to the probability $p_C(x)$ of a random quantum circuit, since both are independent instances of the same Dirichlet distribution. Consequently, no statistical test acting on samples alone can distinguish the classical frozen-tree sampler from a quantum random circuit. The claimed quantum advantage of random circuit sampling therefore does not withstand scrutiny: its hardness lies not in sampling from the Dirichlet distribution, which is classically efficient, but in identifying a specific circuit realization.

title: Fast, Parallel, Query-Efficient Binary Classification
authors: Ishani Karmarkar, Liam O'Carroll, Aaron Sidford
abstract: We study the fundamental classification problem of computing a separating hyperplane for a binary-labeled dataset of size $n$ with normalized $d$-dimensional features. Letting $Φ\in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ denote the feature matrix and $γ$ the margin of the maximum-margin separating hyperplane, we present a randomized algorithm that solves this problem in $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3}\, \operatorname{nnz}(Φ) + γ^{-2(ω+1)/3})$-sequential running time (work), $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-parallel (computational) depth, and accesses $Φ$ only through $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-matrix-vector queries (matvecs). We also present a second, faster randomized algorithm with a $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3}\, \operatorname{nnz}(Φ) + γ^{-2})$-sequential running time that uses $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-matvecs to $Φ$, but achieves only $\tilde{O}(γ^{-4/3})$-parallel depth. Both algorithms match the near-optimal deterministic matvec complexity recently established by Kornowski and Shamir [2025], Karmarkar et al. [2026] and achieve improved sequential runtime and parallel depth, albeit at the expense of using randomness.

title: A Cross-Platform Analysis of High-Performance Quantum Error Correction Codes
authors: Bryan Pan, Yufeng Xin
abstract: The theory of quantum error correction was established decades ago. Yet the limitation of the quantum computing platforms in terms of noise level and available physical qubit count persists, which greatly hinders the development of scalable quantum computing systems. In this paper, we present analytical estimates of logical error rates of advanced QEC codes across leading hardware platforms and distributed quantum computing systems using a simple but unified framework. The analysis captures two dominant contributors to logical error: code structure and two-qubit gate overhead. The framework provides a fast estimate of logical error rates and identification of dominating factors in different hardware platforms, such as circuit volume, routing overhead, inter-QPU operations, or asymmetric noise protection. We show that several qualitative trends observed in larger-scale simulations can be reproduced and interpreted analytically within this framework. We further demonstrate that the framework can be used to find the sweet spot design region of distributed QEC, which is critical for the design of distributed quantum computing systems.

title: When arrow patterns meet classical patterns
authors: Shishuo Fu, Zhenghe Yang
abstract: Seeking to bridge the structural divide between a permutation's cycle notation and its one-line notation, Berman and Tenner introduced a novel notion of permutation pattern known as the arrow pattern. Recently, Archer and Laudone initiated a systematic study of arrow pattern avoidance, leaving behind three intriguing conjectures. In this paper, we resolve all three conjectures. First, we enumerate all six subclasses of permutations that simultaneously avoid a classical pattern of length 3 and a fixed arrow pattern of length 3, thereby confirming the first two conjectures. Second, we settle the third conjecture (which involves a different arrow pattern) by providing two independent proofs. These proofs rely on a restriction of Biane's bijection to non-nesting involutions and Krattenthaler's bijection from 321-avoiding permutations to Dyck paths, respectively.

title: A Policy Decomposition Framework for Dynamic Order Fulfillment Operations
authors: Gal Neria, Michal Tzur, Marlin W. Ulmer
abstract: Modern supply chains span diverse operational environments, ranging from e-commerce distribution networks to customized production-to-order manufacturing lines. Across these settings, operational efficiency depends on coordinating two highly interdependent stages: order preparation and downstream delivery. Although these stages are traditionally managed in isolation, real-world fulfillment systems must satisfy stringent delivery expectations under dynamic stochastic order arrivals. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Dynamic Order Fulfillment Problem (DOFP), a new problem class unifying logistical challenges previously studied separately. We model DOFP as a Markov decision process whose state and decision spaces are partitioned into preparation and delivery sub-spaces, linked by synchronization constraints. While recent approaches attempt to optimize both fulfillment stages simultaneously over myopic rolling horizons, our framework isolates and optimizes the downstream delivery policy, treating preparation strictly as a state-level constraint filter. To solve this, we develop the Decomposition-Driven Framework with Value Function Approximation (DDF-VFA), which utilizes a novel policy-level decomposition. This design partitions the search into a delivery-stage master problem and a preparation-stage compatibility subproblem, iteratively refined via feedback loops. DDF-VFA executes this strategy by combining a large-neighborhood search over partial delivery decisions with a neural-network value function approximation for the cost-to-go. Numerical illustrations on two example variants using real-world datasets show that DDF-VFA consistently outperforms benchmarks that optimize the two stages independently or jointly without decomposition. Finally, the framework naturally scales to accommodate additional real-world complexities such as batched or multi-stage preparation.

title: Governing Generative AI Across Financial Institutions: An SR 26-2-Compatible Framework for Generative AI Risk Control
authors: Yiqing Wang, Yixin Kang, Luyun Lin, Siqi Mao
abstract:
The release of SR 26-2 marks a significant modernization of U.S. model risk management by replacing SR 11-7 with a more risk-based and materiality-sensitive supervisory framework. However, generative and agentic AI are excluded, creating an important governance challenge for banking organizations and other financial institutions. Although generative AI may not directly estimate credit risk or make underwriting decisions, its outputs can materially affect the surrounding control environment through monitoring interpretation, policy analysis, or adverse-action language drafting. These uses may influence how regulated financial decisions are explained, challenged, documented, and governed.
  This paper proposes the Generative AI Control Framework (GAICF), an SR 26-2-compatible governance framework for generative AI-enabled financial workflows. The framework translates core model risk management principles into a layered control structure for generative AI applications that operate outside the formal model boundary but remain embedded within regulated banking processes. GAICF provides a practical approach for financial institutions seeking to align emerging generative AI governance practices with the risk-based supervisory expectations reflected in SR 26-2.

title: Sequential cable constructions and linear rank-width
authors: Antonios Kalampakas
abstract: We introduce split-free cable terms and cable plays, a sequential graph-construction language whose live cables impose uniform GF(2)-row behaviour across the current cut. Every play of width w gives a birth-order layout whose cutrank is at most half of w, rounded down, so the sequential split-free width is at least twice the linear rank-width. At the first nontrivial level we prove an exact characterization: a connected graph with at least two vertices has linear rank-width at most one exactly when it admits a stream, equivalently a singleton-birth play of width at most four. We show that unrestricted term width and sequential width differ unboundedly on trees, calibrate the construction on the net graph, and formulate an affine upper-bound conjecture relating sequential split-free width to linear rank-width. For the rank-two case we prove a two-accumulator scheduling criterion that yields width-six plays under a natural future-uniformity hypothesis.

title: DELTA-TTS: Adapting Autoregressive Model into Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech
authors: Junwon Moon, Seungbeom Kim, Yejin Lee, Hoseong Ahn, Sewoong Park, Heeseung Kim, Kyuhong Shim
abstract: Autoregressive (AR) text-to-speech (TTS) models generate discrete speech tokens sequentially, which makes inference slow and can degrade robustness by propagating local errors and hallucinations. This limitation stems from their left-to-right AR commitment: each token must be determined before future speech-token context is available. However, such ordering is not an inherent requirement for TTS, as the full input text is available before synthesis. In this paper, we introduce DELTA-TTS, a lightweight LoRA-based adaptation framework that converts a pretrained AR TTS model into a discrete diffusion language model (dLLM) for confidence-ordered speech-token decoding. To better capture the local structure of speech, DELTA-TTS incorporates a convolution module that injects local acoustic context, together with a $1/t$-weighted training objective and a time-shifted inference schedule that defer low-confidence positions to later steps. Trained on only $585$ hours of LibriTTS, DELTA-TTS achieves a $\textbf{1.75}\%$ WER on Seed-TTS test-en, outperforming its AR backbone while generating tokens $\textbf{3.3}\times$ faster. Further analysis shows that DELTA-TTS produces sharper text--speech alignment, increases overall decoding confidence, and mitigates hallucinations observed in AR generation.

title: FedProIn: Mitigating Client Drift for Learnable Prototypes in Federated Medical Imaging
authors: Harsh Kumar, Tarun Kumar Garg, Vaanathi Sundaresan
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is severely hindered by statistical heterogeneity due to variations in scanners, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. Such non-IID data induces client drift during local optimization, leading to unstable convergence and suboptimal global models when parameter-based aggregation is applied. We propose a prototype-based, influence-aware federated learning framework (FedProIn) that uses multiple learnable class prototypes to capture shared semantic structures across heterogeneous clients. We introduce feature divergence loss and prototype contrastive loss to mitigate client drift by decomposing it into feature drift and prototype drift. In addition, we propose a normalized influence aggregation strategy that adaptively weights client prototypes according to their contribution to the global representation, reducing the impact of biased or low-quality updates. Experimental results on two publicly available medical datasets, HAM10000 and Matek-19, demonstrate that FedProIn achieves accuracies of (83.5% IID, 81.1% non-IID) on HAM10000 and (96.2% IID, 95.8% non-IID) on Matek-19, respectively, outperforming existing baselines in both conditions. Our code is available at https://github.com/harsh-kmr/FedProIn.

title: Anytime Plug-and-Play Control with Contract-Based Distributed MPC
authors: Sabrina Bodmer, Danilo Saccani, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Andrea Carron
abstract: A central challenge in many mobile multi-robot applications is that communication topologies are inherently time-varying. Agents may enter or exit the network and such changes cannot generally be restricted a priori. This work introduces a distributed multi-agent control algorithm based on local communication that supports anytime agent joining and leaving the communication network without centralized coordination. The method scales efficiently with the number of agents by relying on a distance-based neighbor definition and on contracts derived from predicted trajectories. The resulting contract constraints guarantee collision avoidance and constraint satisfaction. We validate the proposed method in an autonomous multi-agent driving scenario, demonstrating effective collision avoidance in high-speed, dynamic environments with agents moving in opposite directions, in both simulated and real-world experiments.
zh_title: 基于合同分布式MPC的随时即插即用控制
translation: 许多移动多机器人应用中的一个核心挑战是通信拓扑本质上是时变的。智能体可能会进入或退出网络，且此类变化通常无法先验地进行限制。本工作引入了一种基于局部通信的分布式多智能体控制算法，支持智能体在没有集中协调的情况下随时加入和离开通信网络。该方法通过依赖基于距离的邻居定义以及从预测轨迹中导出的合同，能够随智能体数量的高效扩展。所得的合同约束保证了避障和约束满足。我们在自主多智能体驾驶场景中验证了所提方法，在模拟和真实世界实验中，展示了在智能体反向运动的高速、动态环境中有效的避障能力。
keywords: 分布式模型预测控制 (Distributed MPC)
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于合同机制的分布式MPC算法，支持多智能体在无集中协调的情况下随时加入或离开网络，并在高速动态环境中保证了安全的避障。
ai_comments: 该论文成功将“即插即用”概念与分布式MPC相结合，利用基于预测轨迹的“合同”机制解决了多智能体系统在动态通信拓扑下的避障安全问题。其创新之处在于无需任何集中式协调即可保证系统的安全约束，且在真实世界和仿真环境中均得到了验证，具有很强的实用价值。然而，摘要中未详细说明在高频动态接入/退出或高通信延迟情况下，合同协商的实时性和系统稳定性能否得到保障。
motivation: 在移动多机器人应用中，通信拓扑具有固有的时变性，智能体会随机进入或离开网络，且这些变化无法提前预测或限制，因此需要一种无需集中协调、支持随时即插即用的分布式控制算法。
method: 提出一种基于局部通信的分布式多智能体控制算法。该方法依赖于基于距离的邻居定义，并利用从预测轨迹中导出的“合同”（contracts）来约束智能体的行为。这些合同约束在数学上保证了碰撞避免和约束满足，从而允许智能体在没有集中协调的情况下随时加入或退出网络。
results: 在自主多智能体驾驶场景中（包含智能体反向行驶的高速、动态环境）进行了仿真和真实世界物理实验，结果表明该方法能够实现高效且安全的避障。
conclusion: 基于合同的分布式MPC方法能够有效应对多智能体系统中动态变化的通信拓扑，提供了一种高扩展性、无需集中协调且能保证安全避障的即插即用控制方案。

title: Robust Receding Horizon Games with Additive Uncertainty
authors: Dinesh Patra, Tanish Jain, Ashish R. Hota
abstract: We study a receding horizon game in which multiple agents drive linear systems subject to additive disturbances, private state and input constraints, and shared coupling constraints. We propose a robust game-theoretic control framework that combines tube-based constraint tightening with a finite-horizon generalized Nash equilibrium problem (GNEP), equipped with a discrete algebraic Riccati equation (DARE)-based terminal cost and a decoupled positively invariant terminal set. The framework guarantees recursive feasibility for every bounded disturbance realization. Exploiting the potential-game structure induced by tracking costs, we further establish asymptotic convergence of each agent's nominal state to a steady-state variational generalized Nash equilibrium (vGNE), and show that each agent's actual state converges to a neighborhood of the vGNE determined by the minimal robust positively invariant set.
zh_title: 具有加性不确定性的鲁棒滚动时域博弈
translation: 我们研究了一种滚动时域博弈，其中多个智能体驱动受到加性扰动、私有状态和输入约束以及共享耦合约束影响的线性系统。我们提出了一种鲁棒的博弈论控制框架，该框架将基于管道的约束收紧方法与有限时域广义纳什均衡问题（GNEP）相结合，并配备了基于离散代数里卡蒂方程（DARE）的终端成本和解耦的正不变终端集。该框架保证了在任意有界扰动实现下的递归可行性。利用跟踪成本诱导的势博弈结构，我们进一步建立了每个智能体标称状态向稳态变分广义纳什均衡（vGNE）的渐近收敛性，并表明每个智能体的实际状态收敛到由最小鲁棒正不变集确定的vGNE的邻域内。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合管道约束收紧与有限时域广义纳什均衡的鲁棒滚动时域博弈框架，解决了含扰动和耦合约束的多智能体系统的递归可行性与收敛性问题。
ai_comments: 该论文成功地将管道式模型预测控制（Tube-MPC）的鲁棒约束收紧技术与多智能体广义纳什均衡博弈（GNEP）相结合。其创新之处在于，在存在加性扰动和共享耦合约束的复杂环境下，不仅保证了系统的递归可行性，还巧妙地利用势博弈结构证明了系统状态向变分广义纳什均衡（vGNE）邻域的收敛性，这在分布式控制和博弈论领域具有重要的理论与应用价值。
motivation: 在多智能体系统中，智能体运行的线性系统面临着加性扰动、私有状态与输入约束以及共享耦合约束等多重挑战，需要设计一种能够同时应对不确定性和复杂约束的鲁棒博弈控制框架。
method: 提出了一种鲁棒博弈论控制框架。该框架将基于管道（tube-based）的约束收紧方法与有限时域广义纳什均衡问题（GNEP）相结合，并配备了基于离散代数里卡蒂方程（DARE）的终端成本和解耦的正不变终端集。
results: 该框架保证了在任意有界扰动实现下的递归可行性。此外，利用由跟踪成本诱导的势博弈结构，证明了每个智能体的标称状态渐近收敛到稳态变分广义纳什均衡（vGNE），且实际状态收敛到由最小鲁棒正不变集确定的vGNE邻域内。
conclusion: 该研究表明，所提出的鲁棒滚动时域博弈框架在面对加性不确定性和耦合约束时，既能保证控制系统的递归可行性，又能确保智能体状态收敛至变分广义纳什均衡（vGNE）或其邻域，为多智能体协同控制提供了坚实的理论支撑。

title: Light Coils: MRI with Fully Optical Data and Power Transmission
authors: Zining Liu, Morteza Teymoori, Jakob Gerlach, Reza Aghabagheri, Henning Helmers, Michael Bock, Caglar Ataman, Ali Oezen
abstract: In MRI, dense receiver coil arrays with a high number of coil elements are used to efficiently detect and encode the signal. Further increasing the number of coils is hampered by electrical cabling and massive electronics that introduce electromagnetic coupling, integration complexity and even safety constraints. Here we introduce the novel Light Coils concept, a fully optical MRI receive architecture in which data transmission, front-end power delivery, and coil detuning are all implemented optically, thereby reducing the massive galvanic cabling to a few optical fibers. For signal encoding, Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZM) are used to convert the MR signal from each coil onto a C-band optical carrier. The preamplifiers are driven via a power-over-fiber (PoF) system that uses a high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) cell for optical-to-electrical power conversion. A pulse-sequence-triggered optical path controls active detuning. Jointly optimizing modulator bias, optical power and front-end gain under realistic receiver chain conditions, Light Coils can match the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of conventional RF coil systems with galvanic cables at MZM input powers of 5-10mW and photonic power converter inputs of 80-100mW. At a clinical 3T MRI system, we show in vivo human brain imaging with a single-channel Light Coil element with an image quality and SNR comparable to a conventional coaxial readout using the identical coil element. Extending the concept to a four-channel array using dense wavelength-division multiplexing over a single fiber, we demonstrate wavelength-selective routing with inter-channel optical isolation exceeding 28dB, reduced noise correlation compared with the galvanic reference, and parallel imaging. These results establish a scalable route towards lightweight, modular, and potentially ultra-dense MRI receive arrays based on integrated photonics and power-over-fiber.
comment: Submitted to Nature Communications in Article format
zh_title: 光线圈：具有全光学数据和电力传输的磁共振成像（MRI）
translation: 在磁共振成像（MRI）中，使用具有大量线圈单元的高密度接收线圈阵列来高效地检测和编码信号。然而，由于电缆和庞大的电子设备会引入电磁耦合、增加集成复杂性甚至带来安全限制，进一步增加线圈数量受到了阻碍。在这里，我们引入了新型的“光线圈”（Light Coils）概念，这是一种全光学的MRI接收架构，其中数据传输、前端功率输送和线圈去谐均通过光学方式实现，从而将庞大的金属电缆减少到仅几根光纤。为了进行信号编码，使用马赫-曾德尔调制器（MZM）将来自每个线圈的MR信号转换到C波段光载波上。前置放大器通过光纤输电（PoF）系统驱动，该系统使用高效率的光伏（PV）电池进行光电功率转换。脉冲序列触发的光路控制主动去谐。在实际接收链路条件下联合优化调制器偏置、光功率和前端增益，Light Coils在MZM输入功率为5-10mW、光电功率转换器输入为80-100mW时，能够达到与使用金属电缆的传统射频（RF）线圈系统相匹配的信噪比（SNR）。在临床3T MRI系统上，我们展示了使用单通道Light Coils单元的活体人脑成像，其图像质量和SNR与使用相同线圈单元的传统同轴读取相当。将该概念扩展到使用单根光纤上密集波分复用的四通道阵列，我们展示了波长选择性路由，通道间光隔离度超过28dB，与金属电缆参考相比降低了噪声相关性，并实现了并行成像。这些结果为基于集成光子学和光纤输电构建轻量化、模块化且具有潜在超高密度的MRI接收阵列奠定了可扩展的路线。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“Light Coils”的全光学MRI接收架构，通过光纤实现信号传输、前端供电和去谐，消除了传统电缆，并在3T MRI系统上实现了与传统系统性能相当的高质量成像。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于首次实现了完全利用光学手段（包括数据传输、供电和去谐）的MRI接收线圈系统，彻底摆脱了传统金属电缆的束缚，解决了电磁耦合和安全隐患。通过波分复用技术展示了极高的多通道扩展性，对未来高密度MRI系统的发展具有重要意义。然而，该系统在光电转换效率、偏置优化和组件成本方面可能存在一定限制，在大规模临床普及前仍需进一步验证其长期稳定性和经济可行性。
motivation: 在MRI中，增加接收线圈通道数量会受到传统金属电缆和庞大电子设备的限制，这会引入电磁耦合、增加集成复杂性并带来安全隐患。因此，需要一种能够消除金属电缆的新型接收架构。
method: 提出了一种名为“Light Coils”的全光学MRI接收架构：使用马赫-曾德尔调制器（MZM）将MR信号调制到C波段光载波上进行数据传输；利用光纤输电（PoF）系统和高效率光伏（PV）电池为前置放大器提供前端电力；通过脉冲序列触发的光路控制主动去谐。此外，利用单根光纤上的密集波分复用（DWDM）技术将该概念扩展到四通道阵列。
results: 在MZM输入功率为5-10mW、光电转换器输入为80-100mW时，Light Coils的信噪比（SNR）可媲美传统金属电缆系统。在临床3T MRI系统上实现了单通道活体人脑成像，图像质量和SNR与传统同轴电缆相当。四通道阵列展示了波长选择性路由，通道间光隔离度超28dB，且噪声相关性低于传统参考系统，并成功实现了并行成像。
conclusion: 本研究成功证明了基于集成光子学和光纤输电的“光线圈”架构是可行且高效的，为构建轻量化、模块化以及超高密度的MRI接收阵列开辟了一条极具前景的可扩展途径。

title: AI-RAN on NPUs: Baseband Processing Without Baseband Chips
authors: Shilong Zhang, Luping Xiang, Jienan Chen, Kun Yang
abstract: AI-RAN aims to unify artificial intelligence and radio access network workloads on a shared compute substrate. While this paradigm has so far been demonstrated primarily on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), it remains unclear whether Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which are AI accelerators optimized for inference, can also support wireless baseband processing. Here, we provide the first affirmative answer by resolving the fundamental mismatch between baseband workloads and NPU architecture. A computational isomorphism exists: matrix and vector engines NPUs dedicate to inference inherently cover physical-layer operations. Yet NPU architectures are natively shaped for dense-tensor AI inference, not baseband. This architectural mismatch surfaces as opposing optimization objectives: traditional baseband minimizes arithmetic operations, whereas NPU performance demands maximizing engine utilization. We close this gap by reconstructing communication algorithms onto AI compute primitives, prioritizing engine utilization over arithmetic count. We validate this with a complete OFDM transceiver on an Ascend 310B1 edge NPU, demonstrating end-to-end over-the-air transmission via USRP X300 at 3.0 GHz.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to npj Wireless Technology
zh_title: NPU上的AI-RAN：无需基带芯片的基带处理
translation: AI-RAN旨在将人工智能和无线接入网（RAN）工作负载统一在共享的计算底座上。虽然这种范式迄今为止主要在图形处理器（GPU）上得到展示，但目前尚不清楚针对推理进行优化的AI加速器——神经网络处理器（NPU）是否也能支持无线基带处理。在这里，我们通过解决基带工作负载与NPU架构之间的根本不匹配，首次给出了肯定的回答。存在一种计算同构性：NPU专用于推理的矩阵和向量引擎本质上涵盖了物理层操作。然而，NPU架构天生是为稠密张量AI推理而设计的，而不是为基带设计的。这种架构上的不匹配表现为相反的优化目标：传统基带旨在最小化算术运算，而NPU的性能则要求最大化引擎利用率。我们通过将通信算法重构到AI计算原语上，优先考虑引擎利用率而非算术运算次数，从而弥补了这一差距。我们在昇腾 310B1 边缘 NPU 上使用完整的 OFDM 收发器验证了这一点，并通过 USRP X300 在 3.0 GHz 下演示了端到端的空中传输。
tldr: 本文首次证明了NPU可以支持无线基带处理，通过将通信算法重构为AI计算原语，在昇腾310B1 NPU上成功实现了完整的OFDM收发器端到端空中传输。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次打破了NPU仅用于AI推理的局限，将其成功应用于无线通信的基带处理。其核心贡献在于发现了NPU与物理层操作的计算同构性，并通过“重构算法以迎合硬件（优先考虑引擎利用率而非减少运算量）”的独特思路解决了架构不匹配问题。该工作对于推动AI与无线通信在边缘硬件上的深度融合（AI-RAN）具有重要开拓意义，不过在实际部署中的吞吐量、延迟以及与专用ASIC芯片相比的能效比仍需进一步探讨。
motivation: AI-RAN旨在共享计算底座上统一AI和无线接入网（RAN）工作负载。虽然目前该范式主要在GPU上实现，但尚不清楚专为AI推理优化的神经网络处理器（NPU）是否也能支持无线基带处理。
method: 利用NPU的矩阵和向量引擎与物理层操作之间的计算同构性，将传统的通信算法重构为AI计算原语。在优化策略上，打破传统基带最小化算术运算的限制，转而优先考虑最大化NPU引擎的利用率，从而解决基带工作负载与NPU架构之间的不匹配。
results: 在昇腾（Ascend）310B1边缘NPU上成功实现并验证了一个完整的OFDM收发器，并通过USRP X300在3.0 GHz频率下完成了端到端的空中传输。
conclusion: NPU能够有效支持无线基带处理。通过将通信算法重构为AI计算原语，可以克服硬件架构的不匹配，从而实现无需专用基带芯片的AI-RAN基带处理。

title: Robust Bayes-Assisted Conformal Prediction
authors: Kianoosh Ashouritaklimi, Stefano Cortinovis, François Caron
abstract: Bayes-assisted conformal prediction combines the strengths of Bayesian modelling with exact, distribution-free frequentist coverage guarantees. Although conformal validity is preserved even when the Bayesian working model (BWM) is misspecified, the size of the resulting prediction sets can degrade substantially when the prior is poorly aligned with the observed data. We address this limitation by introducing RoBAS (Robust Bayes-Assisted Shrinkage): a Bayes-assisted framework for constructing robust nonconformity scores, with two instantiations: one induced by a heavy-tailed BWM, and a closed-form empirical Bayes shrinkage score. The resulting scores adapt to the quality of the working information encoded in the prior: when this information is reliable, they exploit it to produce efficient prediction sets; when it is weak or inaccurate, they revert to the Distance-To-Average (DTA) score, a robust non-informative baseline. We evaluate the proposed scores on tabular and image regression tasks where the training distribution may differ from the calibration and test distributions, while the calibration and test data themselves remain exchangeable. We find that they are competitive with widely used scores in the absence of such shift, while substantially reducing interval widths in shifted settings.
comment: Accepted to AISTATS 2026. 44 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
zh_title: 鲁棒贝叶斯辅助共形预测
translation: 贝叶斯辅助共形预测结合了贝叶斯建模的优势与精确、无分布的频率学覆盖保证。尽管即使贝叶斯工作模型（BWM）被错误指定，共形有效性也能保持，但当先验与观测数据对齐不佳时，所得预测集的大小会显著退化。我们通过引入RoBAS（Robust Bayes-Assisted Shrinkage）来解决这一局限性：一个用于构建鲁棒非一致性分数的贝叶斯辅助框架，具有两种实例化：一种由重尾BWM诱导，另一种是闭式经验贝叶斯收缩分数。由此产生的分数能适应先验中编码的工作信息的质量：当此信息可靠时，它们利用它来生成高效的预测集；当信息弱或不准确时，它们则回归到距离平均值（Distance-To-Average, DTA）分数，一个鲁棒的非信息基线。我们在表格和图像回归任务上评估了所提出的分数，其中训练分布可能与校准和测试分布不同，而校准和测试数据本身保持可交换性。我们发现，在没有这种偏移的情况下，它们与广泛使用的分数具有竞争力，同时在偏移设置中显著减小了区间宽度。
tldr: 提出RoBAS框架，通过鲁棒非一致性分数改善贝叶斯辅助共形预测在先验信息不准确时预测集过大的问题，在分布偏移下能有效缩小预测区间。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了RoBAS框架，通过自适应的鲁棒非一致性分数，有效提升了贝叶斯辅助共形预测在先验信息不准确或分布偏移情况下的效率和鲁棒性。它在保持共形预测理论保证的同时，通过结合经验贝叶斯和重尾模型思想，解决了实际应用中先验选择困难的问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。
motivation: 贝叶斯辅助共形预测在贝叶斯工作模型（BWM）错误指定时仍能保持有效性，但当先验信息与观测数据对齐不佳时，其预测集的大小会显著退化。本研究旨在解决这一局限性。
method: 引入RoBAS（Robust Bayes-Assisted Shrinkage）框架，用于构建鲁棒的非一致性分数。该框架包含两种实例化方法：一种由重尾BWM诱导，另一种是闭式经验贝叶斯收缩分数。这些分数能根据先验信息的质量进行自适应：当信息可靠时，利用它生成高效的预测集；当信息弱或不准确时，则回归到鲁棒非信息基线（Distance-To-Average, DTA）分数。
results: 所提出的分数在没有分布偏移的情况下与广泛使用的分数具有竞争力。在存在分布偏移的情况下，它们能显著减小预测区间的宽度。评估是在训练分布可能与校准和测试分布不同的表格和图像回归任务上进行的，同时校准和测试数据本身保持可交换性。
conclusion: RoBAS框架通过引入鲁棒的非一致性分数，有效解决了贝叶斯辅助共形预测在先验信息不可靠时预测集过大的问题，尤其在存在分布偏移的场景下能显著提升预测效率。

title: Unified convergence analysis for gradient descent optimization methods in the training of deep neural networks
authors: Shokhrukh Ibragimov, Arnulf Jentzen
abstract: Gradient based optimization methods are nowadays the methods of choice for training deep neural networks (DNNs) in artificial intelligence (AI) systems. In practically relevant DNN training problems, one does usually not apply the standard gradient descent (GD) optimization method but instead one employs suitable sophisticated GD optimization methods, which incorporate adaptivity and/or acceleration techniques, such as the famous Adam optimizer. It is a key contribution of this work to provide a general unified convergence analysis for GD optimization methods in the training of DNNs with analytic activations such as the softplus and the popular Gaussian error linear unit (GeLU) activation. Our general unified convergence result applies to a large class of gradient based optimization methods such as the standard GD, the momentum, the Nesterov accelerated gradient (NAG), the RMSprop, the Adam, the Adamax, the Nadam, the Nadamax, the Adan, the AdaBelief, the AMSGrad, and the Yogi optimizers. Our analysis employs the theory of Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) inequalities to establish convergence to critical points in the training of DNNs. To the best of our knowledge, the generality of our convergence analysis is also just in the special situation of the Adam optimizer a new contribution to the literature on the analysis of AI optimization algorithms.
zh_title: 深度神经网络训练中梯度下降优化方法的统一收敛性分析
translation: 基于梯度的优化方法是当今人工智能（AI）系统中训练深度神经网络（DNN）的首选方法。在实际相关的DNN训练问题中，人们通常不使用标准的梯度下降（GD）优化方法，而是采用结合了自适应和/或加速技术的合适的复杂GD优化方法，例如著名的Adam优化器。这项工作的一个关键贡献是，为使用解析激活函数（如softplus和流行的正态分布误差线性单元（GeLU）激活函数）的DNN训练中的GD优化方法提供了一个通用的统一收敛性分析。我们的通用统一收敛结果适用于一大类基于梯度的优化方法，例如标准GD、动量法（momentum）、Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）、RMSprop、Adam、Adamax、Nadam、Nadamax、Adan、AdaBelief、AMSGrad和Yogi优化器。我们的分析利用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL)不等式理论来建立DNN训练中向临界点收敛的性质。据我们所知，即使仅在Adam优化器的特殊情况下，我们收敛性分析的通用性也是对AI优化算法分析文献的一项新贡献。
tldr: 本文利用KL不等式理论，为包括Adam、RMSprop、NAG在内的一大类梯度下降优化方法在解析激活函数DNN训练中的收敛性提供了首个通用的统一分析。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于利用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) 不等式理论，为极宽泛的一类梯度下降优化算法（包括自适应和加速算法，如Adam、NAG等）在深度神经网络训练中的收敛性提供了一个统一的分析框架。其重要性在于填补了多种优化器在非凸DNN训练中缺乏统一理论保证的空白。局限性在于该分析主要针对解析激活函数（如softplus和GeLU），而对于非解析激活函数（如最常用的ReLU）的适用性在摘要中未提及。
motivation: 在实际的深度神经网络（DNN）训练中，人们通常使用结合了自适应或加速技术的复杂梯度下降（GD）优化方法（如Adam），而非标准梯度下降。然而，这些多样化的优化方法缺乏一个通用的、统一的收敛性理论分析。
method: 本研究采用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) 不等式理论，对在含有解析激活函数（如softplus和GeLU）的深度神经网络（DNN）训练中，包括标准GD、动量法、NAG、RMSprop、Adam等在内的一大类梯度下降优化方法进行统一的收敛性分析，以确立其向临界点收敛的性质。
results: 提出了一种通用的统一收敛性分析结果，该结果适用于包括标准GD、动量法、NAG、RMSprop、Adam、Adamax、Nadam、Nadamax、Adan、AdaBelief、AMSGrad和Yogi在内的多种主流梯度优化器。即便仅针对Adam优化器这一特例，该研究的通用收敛性分析也是对现有AI优化算法理论文献的新贡献。
conclusion: 本文成功利用KL不等式理论，为一大类梯度下降优化算法在含有解析激活函数的DNN训练中的收敛性提供了统一的理论保证，证明了其能够收敛到临界点。

title: Self-Reference in Large Language Models: The Introspection Threshold for Recursive Self-Improvement
authors: Jiang Zhang, Bing Yuan, Qian Zhang
abstract: The pursuit of self-evolving AI raises a critical question: when is autonomous self-improvement sustainable rather than degenerative? Drawing an analogy to von Neumann's complexity threshold for self-reproducing automata, we argue that sustainable recursive self-improvement in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires a functional analogue: introspection -- the system's capacity to simulate its own operations and target modifications. Grounded in Kleene's Second Recursion Theorem, we demonstrate the theoretical existence of such introspective programs. However, an empirical review reveals that while current LLMs exhibit quasi-introspection (e.g., partial metacognition), they fall short of true introspection due to structural bottlenecks: a lack of complete self-access, the feedforward nature of the Transformer, and computational class constraints that prevent fixed-point iteration. We conclude by outlining architectural paths to cross this complexity threshold and discussing the associated safety implications.
zh_title: 大语言模型中的自我指涉：递归自我提升的反思阈值
translation: 追求自我进化的人工智能提出了一个关键问题：自主自我提升何时是可持续的，而不是退化的？类比冯·诺依曼关于自我复制自动机的复杂度阈值，我们认为大语言模型（LLM）中可持续的递归自我提升需要一个功能上的类似物：反思（introspection）——即系统模拟自身运行并进行针对性修改的能力。基于克莱尼第二递归定理，我们证明了这种反思程序在理论上的存在性。然而，实证审查表明，尽管当前的LLM展现出准反思（例如部分元认知），但由于结构性瓶颈，它们仍未能达到真正的反思，这些瓶颈包括：缺乏完整的自我访问、Transformer的前馈特性以及阻碍不动点迭代的计算类限制。最后，我们概述了跨越这一复杂度阈值的架构路径，并讨论了相关的安全启示。
tldr: LLM要实现可持续的自我提升必须具备“反思”能力。虽然理论上可行，但当前的Transformer架构因前馈性、缺乏自我访问等限制，仅能实现“准反思”，无法达到真正的反思阈值。
ai_comments: 本文将经典的可计算性理论（如克莱尼第二递归定理和冯·诺依曼复杂度阈值）与现代大语言模型（LLM）的自我进化问题相结合，视角独特且具有深刻的理论意义。它指出了当前Transformer架构在实现真正“自进化”上的本质瓶颈，为未来超越Transformer的新型AI架构设计提供了理论指引。不过，论文更偏向于理论探讨，缺乏具体的工程实现细节。
motivation: 探索在追求自我进化的AI过程中，自主自我提升在何种条件下是可持续的，而不是退化（退化性）的。
method: 类比冯·诺依曼关于自我复制自动机的复杂度阈值，基于克莱尼第二递归定理（Kleene's Second Recursion Theorem）进行理论论证，并对当前LLM的结构进行实证审查。
results: 1. 理论上证明了能够模拟自身并进行针对性修改的“反思程序”的存在性；2. 实证表明，当前LLM由于缺乏完全自我访问、Transformer的前馈特性以及计算类限制（阻碍不动点迭代），仅表现出“准反思”而无法达到真正的反思。
conclusion: 论文总结了跨越这一反思复杂度阈值的潜在架构路径，并探讨了与之相关的安全影响。

title: Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification for Causal Mediation Analysis
authors: Harsh Shrivastava, Yuta Kawakami, Junpei Komiyama, Jin Tian
abstract: This paper studies the problem of identifying the treatment that maximizes the expected natural direct potential outcome (NDPO), which captures the potential outcome of an intervention while excluding the pathway transmitted through a mediator that researchers may wish to remove from evaluation. We first establish population-level identification of the expected NDPO in a causal bandit setting using observable interventional distributions. We then develop a fixed-confidence best-arm identification (BAI) algorithm based on the Track-and-Stop (TaS) framework, employing a cutting-set method to solve the resulting semi-infinite optimization problem. The proposed algorithm achieves sample-efficient identification with a high-probability correctness guarantee. We prove that it satisfies $δ$-correctness and asymptotic optimality. Finally, we validate the approach through empirical evaluations on a large-scale real-world advertising dataset (IPinYou).
zh_title: 用于因果中介分析的固定置信度最佳臂识别
translation: 本文研究了识别最大化预期自然直接潜在结果（NDPO）的治疗方法的问题，NDPO捕捉了干预的潜在结果，同时排除了研究人员希望从评估中移除的通过中介传输的路径。我们首先在因果赌博机设置中，利用可观测的干预分布，建立了预期NDPO的总体层面识别。然后，我们开发了一种基于Track-and-Stop (TaS) 框架的固定置信度最佳臂识别（BAI）算法，采用切割集方法来解决由此产生的半无限优化问题。所提出的算法实现了样本高效识别，并具有高概率正确性保证。我们证明它满足δ-正确性和渐近最优性。最后，我们通过对大规模真实世界广告数据集（IPinYou）的经验评估验证了该方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于因果中介分析的固定置信度最佳臂识别算法，旨在找到最大化自然直接潜在结果的治疗方法，并证明了其效率，在一项真实世界数据集上进行了验证。
ai_comments: 该论文将固定置信度最佳臂识别方法创新性地应用于因果中介分析，特别是为了最大化自然直接潜在结果。其在样本效率、δ-正确性和渐近最优性方面的理论保证，结合在真实世界数据集上的实证验证，突显了其在实践中的相关性和理论上的严谨性。利用Track-and-Stop框架和切割集方法解决半无限优化问题是其关键的方法学创新。
motivation: 识别能够最大化预期自然直接潜在结果（NDPO）的治疗方法，NDPO捕捉了干预的潜在结果，同时排除了研究人员希望从评估中移除的通过中介传输的路径。
method: 1. 在因果赌博机设置中，利用可观测的干预分布，建立了预期NDPO的总体层面识别。2. 开发了一种基于Track-and-Stop (TaS) 框架的固定置信度最佳臂识别（BAI）算法。3. 采用切割集方法来解决由此产生的半无限优化问题。
results: 1. 所提出的算法实现了样本高效识别，并具有高概率正确性保证。2. 证明它满足δ-正确性和渐近最优性。3. 通过对大规模真实世界广告数据集（IPinYou）的经验评估验证了该方法。
conclusion: 本文成功提出并验证了一种样本高效且理论上正确的固定置信度最佳臂识别算法，用于因果中介分析中最大化自然直接潜在结果（NDPO）。

title: MOSAIC: Interpretable Multi-Token Cross-Attention of Biophonetic and Self-Supervised Representations for Unified Voice Anti-Spoofing
authors: Yugwon Won
abstract: The dominant trend in voice anti-spoofing fuses self-supervised (SSL) backbones (e.g., WavLM) with handcrafted features, yet such fusion typically lacks transparency in cue-to-layer interactions, and simple concatenation limits cross-modal learning. We propose MOSAIC (Multi-token Oriented Speech Anti-spoofing via Integrated Cross-attention), an interpretable multi-token cross-attention framework that splits a 152-dimensional biophonetic feature vector into six semantic-group query tokens (Praat, phase, LFCC mean/std, sub-band mean/std) and attends them over thirteen mean-std pooled WavLM-Large transformer layers as keys/values. The resulting 6x13 attention matrix visualizes cue-to-layer alignment; a z-score analysis of the per-token activations shows that biophonetic/phase tokens activate more on bona fide speech while spectral/channel tokens activate more on spoofed speech -- yielding per-cue, per-layer attribution that extends prior fusion approaches. Trained jointly with focal loss, a dual LA/PA domain-adversarial classifier, and a bona-fide-only VAE regularizer, MOSAIC attains EER 1.93% / 1.98% on ASVspoof 2019 LA / PA -- a single unified model that approaches the PA-specialized SOTA (LFCC-CMR, 1.34%) while remaining competitive on LA -- and 9.28% / 6.21% / 40.09% on ASVspoof 2021 LA / DF / PA.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
zh_title: MOSAIC：用于统一语音防欺骗的可解释生物语音与自监督表征多Token交叉注意力机制
translation: 语音防欺骗的主流趋势是将自监督（SSL）主干网络（如WavLM）与手工特征相融合，然而这种融合通常在“线索到层”的交互上缺乏透明度，且简单的拼接限制了跨模态学习。我们提出了MOSAIC（通过集成交叉注意力的多Token导向语音防欺骗），这是一个可解释的多Token交叉注意力框架。该框架将152维的生物语音特征向量分割为六个语义组查询Token（Praat、相位、LFCC均值/标准差、子带均值/标准差），并在13个经过均值-标准差池化的WavLM-Large Transformer层（作为键/值）上对它们进行注意力计算。生成的6x13注意力矩阵可视化了线索与层的对齐；对每个Token激活进行的z-score分析表明，生物语音/相位Token在真实语音上激活更多，而频谱/通道Token在欺骗语音上激活更多，从而实现了超越以往融合方法的逐线索、逐层归因。通过联合焦点损失、双LA/PA领域对抗分类器以及仅针对真实语音的VAE正则化器进行训练，MOSAIC在ASVspoof 2019 LA / PA上达到了1.93% / 1.98%的等错误率（EER）——这是一个单一的统一模型，在逼近PA专用SOTA（LFCC-CMR, 1.34%）的同时，在LA上仍保持竞争力；在ASVspoof 2021 LA / DF / PA上的EER分别为9.28% / 6.21% / 40.09%。
tldr: 提出MOSAIC框架，通过将生物语音特征解耦为多Token并与WavLM层进行交叉注意力计算，实现了兼具高可解释性与强劲性能的统一语音防欺骗系统。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种可解释的多Token交叉注意力机制（MOSAIC），将手工设计的生物语音特征解耦为语义Token，并与自监督WavLM的各层进行显式对齐，从而打破了传统拼接融合的“黑盒”限制。其局限性在于，虽然在2019 LA/PA上表现优异，但在ASVspoof 2021 PA（物理接入）任务上的EER依然高达40.09%，表明在极度复杂的真实物理信道下，模型的鲁棒性仍有较大提升空间。
motivation: 目前语音防欺骗的主流趋势是将自监督（SSL）主干网络与手工特征进行融合，但这种融合方式通常在线索与层之间的交互上缺乏透明度，且简单的特征拼接限制了跨模态学习的效果。
method: 提出MOSAIC框架。该方法将152维的生物语音特征向量划分为6个语义组查询Token（包括Praat、相位、LFCC均值/标准差、子带均值/标准差），并与WavLM-Large的13个Transformer层（经均值-标准差池化后作为键/值）进行交叉注意力计算。利用生成的6x13注意力矩阵可视化线索与层的对齐，并结合焦点损失（focal loss）、双LA/PA领域对抗分类器以及仅针对真实语音的VAE正则化器进行联合训练。
results: MOSAIC在ASVspoof 2019 LA和PA数据集上分别取得了1.93%和1.98%的等错误率（EER），在接近PA专用SOTA（LFCC-CMR, 1.34%）的同时，在LA上也保持了极强的竞争力。在ASVspoof 2021 LA / DF / PA数据集上的EER则分别为9.28% / 6.21% / 40.09%。
conclusion: 摘要中未明确提及（Not mentioned in abstract）。但实验结果表明，MOSAIC作为一个统一模型，不仅在多个基准测试上取得了极具竞争力的防欺骗性能，还通过注意力矩阵和激活分析实现了深入的逐线索、逐层属性归因。

title: Optimal Mixture-of-Experts Model Averaging for Conditional Generative Models
authors: Shijin Gong, Baihua He, Xinyu Zhang
abstract: Conditional generative models have emerged as powerful tools for sampling from target conditional distributions, driving substantial advances across a wide range of scientific and applied domains. As these models proliferate, practitioners often face multiple plausible generators whose performance can vary with the task, data, or input condition. We propose an optimal model averaging framework for conditional generative models, allowing candidate generators to be combined even when they are accessible only through conditional samples without tractable densities. Specifically, we use a sample-based maximum mean discrepancy between conditional distributions, which first leads to a static model averaging method, StaticMA, assigning fixed weights to different candidates. In addition, we develop MoEMA (mixture-of-experts model averaging), an input-adaptive method that parameterizes covariate-dependent weights through a softmax neural-network gate. We establish in-sample and out-of-sample asymptotic optimality for the proposed methods, together with consistency of the estimated adaptive weight function under regularity conditions. The framework applies directly to Euclidean responses and extends to unstructured data by combining our formulation with fixed representation maps. Across a broad set of simulations and real-data studies spanning tabular, image, and text modalities, MoEMA generally improves over competing baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed methods.
zh_title: 条件生成模型的最优混合专家模型平均
translation: 条件生成模型已成为从目标条件分布中进行采样的强大工具，推动了广泛科学和应用领域的重大进展。随着这些模型的激增，从业者经常面临多个看似合理的生成器，它们的性能可能会随着任务、数据或输入条件的变化而变化。我们提出了一种针对条件生成模型的最优模型平均框架，允许在仅能通过条件样本进行访问（没有可计算的概率密度）的情况下组合候选生成器。具体而言，我们使用条件分布之间基于样本的最大均值差异（MMD），这首先引出了一种静态模型平均方法（StaticMA），用于为不同的候选模型分配固定权重。此外，我们开发了 MoEMA（混合专家模型平均），这是一种输入自适应方法，通过 Softmax 神经网络门控来参数化依赖于协变量的权重。我们确立了所提方法在样本内和样本外的渐近最优性，以及在正则性条件下估计的自适应权重函数的一致性。该框架直接适用于欧氏响应，并通过将我们的公式与固定表示映射相结合来扩展到非结构化数据。在涵盖表格、图像和文本模态的广泛模拟和真实数据研究中，MoEMA 的表现普遍优于竞争基线，证明了我们所提方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最大均值差异（MMD）的条件生成模型最优平均框架，包含静态融合方法 StaticMA 和基于神经网络门控的自适应融合方法 MoEMA，在提供理论最优性保证的同时显著提升了多模态数据上的生成表现。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：巧妙地利用基于样本的最大均值差异（MMD），解决了条件生成模型在没有显式概率密度（likelihood-free）情况下的模型平均难题。
2. 实用性强：MoEMA 引入了输入自适应的门控机制，能够根据输入条件动态调整各生成器的权重，非常适合处理在不同子领域表现各异的混合生成器。
3. 理论完备：不仅提出了算法，还证明了样本内和样本外的渐近最优性以及权重函数的一致性，为该框架奠定了坚实的理论基础。
motivation: 随着条件生成模型的广泛应用，从业者面临着多个性能各异的候选生成器（其表现受任务、数据或输入条件影响）。然而，这些生成器通常只能通过条件样本访问，缺乏可计算的显式概率密度，这使得传统的模型平均方法难以直接应用。
method:
1. 提出基于样本的条件分布最大均值差异（MMD）的最优模型平均框架。
2. 提出 StaticMA（静态模型平均）方法，为不同的候选生成器分配固定权重。
3. 提出 MoEMA（混合专家模型平均）方法，利用 Softmax 神经网络门控动态参数化依赖于协变量的自适应权重。
4. 将该框架与固定表示映射结合，使其能够从欧氏响应扩展到非结构化数据。
results:
1. 建立了所提方法（StaticMA 和 MoEMA）在样本内和样本外的渐近最优性。
2. 证明了在正则性条件下估计的自适应权重函数的一致性。
3. 在涵盖表格、图像和文本模态的广泛模拟和真实数据研究中，MoEMA 的表现普遍优于现有的竞争基线。
conclusion: 本文提出的最优模型平均框架（特别是自适应的 MoEMA 方法）能够有效融合多个候选条件生成器，并在理论上具有渐近最优性，在实际的多模态应用中也显著优于现有基线方法。

title: Deep Learning for Dynamic Programming with Recursive Utility
authors: Xianhua Peng, Wu Guo
abstract: We propose the first deep learning algorithm, the Certainty Equivalent Learning (CEL) algorithm, for solving high-dimensional discrete-time dynamic programming problems with recursive utility. Dynamic programming with recursive utility is numerically challenging because the recursive utility does not have an explicit representation and the Bellman equation contains a certainty equivalent that is difficult to evaluate. The CEL algorithm learns this certainty-equivalent value directly with neural networks and jointly approximates value functions, policy functions, and certainty-equivalent functions. The CEL algorithm is mesh-free and simulation-based, allowing high-dimensional state and control spaces, and does not rely on Euler equations, first-order conditions, or differentiability of the state transition function. The CEL algorithm also works for dynamic programming problems with expected utility as expected utility is a special case of recursive utility. We apply the CEL to discounted linear exponential quadratic Gaussian control, small-noise robust control, Epstein-Zin DSGE, and multivariate strategic asset allocation problems. Compared with closed-form and VFI-based benchmarks, the CEL delivers accurate value and policy approximations, remains effective in high-dimensional problems, achieves accuracy comparable to VFI in the small-noise robust-control case, and produces out-of-sample Bellman errors and Euler or first-order residuals that are in the range from 1.0e-4 to 1.0e-3 for most problems.
zh_title: 具有递归效用的动态规划的深度学习方法
translation: 我们提出了首个用于解决具有递归效用的高维离散时间动态规划问题的深度学习算法——确定性等价学习（CEL）算法。具有递归效用的动态规划在数值计算上极具挑战性，因为递归效用没有显式的表示形式，且贝尔曼方程中包含一个难以评估的确定性等价。CEL算法利用神经网络直接学习该确定性等价，并联合逼近价值函数、策略函数和确定性等价函数。CEL算法是无网格且基于模拟的，允许高维状态和控制空间，并且不依赖于欧拉方程、一阶条件或状态转移函数的可微性。由于期望效用是递归效用的一种特例，CEL算法也适用于具有期望效用的动态规划问题。我们将CEL应用于折扣线性指数二次高斯控制、小噪声鲁棒控制、Epstein-Zin DSGE以及多变量策略性资产配置问题。与闭式解和基于价值函数迭代（VFI）的基准相比，CEL提供了精确的价值和策略逼近，在高维问题中保持有效，在小噪声鲁棒控制案例中实现了与VFI相当的精度，并且对大多数问题产生的样本外贝尔曼误差及欧拉或一阶残差在1.0e-4到1.0e-3之间。
tldr: 本文提出了首个用于求解高维递归效用动态规划问题的深度学习算法（CEL），该算法通过神经网络直接学习确定性等价，免于网格划分，在高维状态和控制空间中展现出高精度的求解能力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次将深度学习应用于递归效用的动态规划求解，通过引入“确定性等价学习（CEL）”算法，直接利用神经网络逼近难以评估的确定性等价部分。该方法具有无网格、基于模拟、无需状态转移函数可微性或一阶条件等优点，成功克服了高维诅咒。局限性在于，摘要未详细讨论神经网络在大规模非线性系统中的训练稳定性和超参数敏感性。
motivation: 具有递归效用的动态规划在数值求解上面临巨大挑战，因为递归效用没有显式表示，且其贝尔曼方程中包含一个难以评估的确定性等价（certainty equivalent）。传统的网格法在面对高维状态和控制空间时会遇到维度灾难。
method: 提出确定性等价学习（CEL）算法。该算法利用神经网络直接学习确定性等价，并联合逼近价值函数、策略函数和确定性等价函数。该算法是无网格（mesh-free）且基于模拟的，不依赖于欧拉方程、一阶条件或状态转移函数的可微性。
results: 在折扣线性指数二次高斯控制、小噪声鲁棒控制、Epstein-Zin DSGE和多变量策略性资产配置等问题上的应用表明，CEL相比于闭式解和基于VFI（价值函数迭代）的基准，能提供精确的价值和策略逼近，在高维问题中依然有效。其在小噪声鲁棒控制案例中达到了与VFI相当的精度，且大多数问题的样本外贝尔曼误差和欧拉/一阶残差在1.0e-4到1.0e-3之间。
conclusion: CEL算法是一种高精度、高效率且适用于高维离散时间递归效用（及期望效用）动态规划问题的深度学习方法，成功克服了传统数值方法在高维和复杂结构下的计算瓶颈。

title: A sharp lower bound for some reciprocal Rado numbers
authors: Collier Gaiser, Mojtaba Ramezanpour
abstract: Let $f_r(k)$ be the smallest $n$ such that every $r$-coloring of $\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$ has a monochromatic solution to the equation \[\frac{1}{x_1}+\frac{1}{x_2}+\cdots+\frac{1}{x_k}=\frac{1}{x_{k+1}}, \] where $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_k$ are not necessarily distinct. In this paper, we prove that $f_r(2)\geq 4^r/2$ for all $r\geq1$, and $f_r(k)\geq(2^r-1)k^r$ for all $k\geq3$ and $r\geq1$. When $r=2$, we show that, if $k=3\cdot2^m$ for some positive integer $m$, then $f_2(k)=3k^2$; and if $k=p^m$ for some odd prime number $p$ and positive integer $m$, then $f_2(k)\geq3k^2+1$. We also provide new computational results for $f_2(k)$ and $f_3(k)$, as well as a generalization of our lower bounds for $f_2(k)$ to equations with general coefficients.
zh_title: 某些倒数Rado数的紧确下界
translation: 令 $f_r(k)$ 为最小的 $n$，使得 $\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$ 的任意 $r$-着色都包含方程 $\frac{1}{x_1}+\frac{1}{x_2}+\cdots+\frac{1}{x_k}=\frac{1}{x_{k+1}}$ 的单色解，其中 $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_k$ 不一定互不相同。在本文中，我们证明了对于所有 $r\geq1$，有 $f_r(2)\geq 4^r/2$；对于所有 $k\geq3$ 且 $r\geq1$，有 $f_r(k)\geq(2^r-1)k^r$。当 $r=2$ 时，我们表明：如果对于某个正整数 $m$ 有 $k=3\cdot2^m$，则 $f_2(k)=3k^2$；如果对于某个奇素数 $p$ 和正整数 $m$ 有 $k=p^m$，则 $f_2(k)\geq3k^2+1$。我们还提供了关于 $f_2(k)$ 和 $f_3(k)$ 的新计算结果，并将我们对 $f_2(k)$ 的下界推广到了具有一般系数的方程中。
tldr: 本文证明了倒数Rado数 $f_r(k)$ 的一系列新下界，并在双色情况下针对特定形式的 $k$ 确定了确切值或更紧确的界限。
ai_comments: 本文在倒数Rado数的研究上取得了重要进展，通过精细的数论分类讨论，为该问题提供了非常紧确的下界。特别是对于r=2的情况，在特定条件下给出了确切的等式值，这在拉姆齐理论和Rado数的研究中是难能可贵的。未来的研究方向可以进一步探索更一般的r和k值下的紧确界。
motivation: 倒数Rado数 $f_r(k)$ 的计算和下界估计是组合数论与拉姆齐理论中的重要问题，本文旨在为某些特定参数下的 $f_r(k)$ 确定更紧确的下界。
method: 通过数学证明、数论分析以及构造特定的染色方案，推导并证明了 $f_r(k)$ 在不同参数下的下界公式，并针对 $r=2$ 的特殊情况进行了精确的分类讨论与数值计算。
results:
1. 证明了对于所有 $r\geq1$，$f_r(2)\geq 4^r/2$；对于所有 $k\geq3, r\geq1$，$f_r(k)\geq(2^r-1)k^r$。
2. 当 $r=2$ 时，若 $k=3\cdot2^m$（$m$ 为正整数），则 $f_2(k)=3k^2$；若 $k=p^m$（$p$ 为奇素数，$m$ 为正整数），则 $f_2(k)\geq3k^2+1$。
3. 提供了 $f_2(k)$ 和 $f_3(k)$ 的新计算结果，并将 $f_2(k)$ 的下界推广到了一般系数方程。
conclusion: 本文成功为倒数Rado数 $f_r(k)$ 建立了一系列新的、更紧确的下界，并展示了在特定参数下的确切值，同时将该结果成功推广到了更一般系数的方程中。

title: MambaRefine-CD: MambaVision with Region-Boundary Temporal Refinement
authors: Dineth Perera, Thaariq Firdous, Oshadha Samarakoon, Roshan Godaliyadda, Parakrama Ekanayake, Vijitha Herath
abstract: Binary change detection in remote sensing requires both complete changed-region localization and accurate boundary delineation. We present MambaRefine-CD, a region-boundary temporal refinement framework built on a shared MambaVision encoder. The proposed D-RBI module constructs temporal evidence from paired features, absolute differences, and signed differences, then separates it into region and Sobel-conditioned boundary streams. Region features are enhanced with CRAM-lite and decoded by an adaptive receptive-field FPN, while the finest boundary stream guides a bounded residual refinement of the coarse prediction. Experiments on DSIFN-CD and WHU-CD show strong changed-class F1 and IoU under verified evaluation settings, and ablations support the contribution of signed temporal evidence and the full region-boundary refinement pipeline.
zh_title: MambaRefine-CD：基于区域-边界时序细化的MambaVision遥感变化检测
translation: 遥感中的二值变化检测需要完整的变化区域定位和精确的边界描绘。我们提出了MambaRefine-CD，这是一个建立在共享MambaVision编码器上的区域-边界时序细化框架。所提出的D-RBI模块从成对特征、绝对差异和有符号差异中构建时序证据，然后将其分离为区域流和Sobel条件的边界流。区域特征通过CRAM-lite进行增强，并由自适应感受野FPN进行解码，而最精细的边界流则引导粗预测的有界残差细化。在DSIFN-CD和WHU-CD上的实验表明，在经验证的评估设置下，该方法具有强大的变化类别F1和IoU，且消融实验支持了有符号时序证据和完整区域-边界细化流水线的贡献。
tldr: 提出MambaRefine-CD框架，利用共享MambaVision编码器和区域-边界双流时序细化，实现了高精度的遥感变化区域定位与边界描绘。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将最新的MambaVision架构引入到遥感变化检测任务中。其核心创新在于D-RBI模块对有符号时序差异的显式建模，以及区域与边界的双流解耦与细化设计，这为解决变化检测中的边界模糊和空洞问题提供了新颖且有效的解决方案。局限性在于摘要中未提及计算开销、推理速度以及参数量等实际部署指标。
motivation: 遥感图像的二值变化检测任务需要同时解决两个关键挑战：完整地定位变化区域以及精确地描绘变化的边界。
method:
提出MambaRefine-CD框架，基于共享的MambaVision编码器，包含以下关键设计：
1. 提出D-RBI模块，从配对特征、绝对差异和有符号差异中构建时序证据，并将其分离为区域流和Sobel约束的边界流；
2. 使用CRAM-lite增强区域特征，并通过自适应感受野FPN进行解码；
3. 利用最精细的边界流引导粗预测的有界残差细化。
results: 在DSIFN-CD和WHU-CD数据集上的实验表明，在经验证的评估设置下，该方法取得了强大的变化类别F1分数和IoU指标。消融实验也证实了有符号时序证据以及完整的区域-边界细化管线的有效性。
conclusion: 通过解耦区域与边界特征并进行针对性的时序细化，MambaRefine-CD能够有效解决遥感变化检测中的区域完整定位与边界精细化问题，显著提升了检测性能。

title: Deadline-Bound Finite-Object Delivery over Intermittent LEO Satellite Contact Plans under Residual-Service Accounting
authors: Houtianfu Wang, O. Tansel Baydas, Hanlin Cai, Haofan Dong, Ozgur B. Akan
abstract: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) relay networks deliver finite objects -- sensing tiles, telemetry blocks, model updates, and checkpoints -- over intermittent inter-satellite and space-to-ground contact plans. Partial delivery is insufficient when the complete object misses its deadline. When an object is split across candidate paths, a path-private evaluation can count the same contact service more than once and silently under-count completion. We develop a residual-service-aware delivery layer that consumes candidate paths from contact-plan route generation and tests whether the complete object can be delivered before its deadline under per-edge first-in-first-out residual service. Under controlled shared-contact contention, path-private evaluation under-counts completion by up to 154 s and can report finite completion for a fixed plan with no residual-service completion. For edge-disjoint complementary contacts, the layer reduces to fixed-path service; we derive a sufficient service-budget condition under which two-way striping strictly enlarges the feasible payload region. We verify a restricted exhaustive reference, characterize runtime over a 20-180-satellite procedural contact model, and show that bounded two-way striping reduces mean and median gaps to the restricted reference by about 40%, while P90 and worst-case gaps remain unchanged.
zh_title: 基于残余服务核算的间歇性LEO卫星联系计划下有截止期限的有限对象交付
translation: 低地球轨道 (LEO) 中继网络通过间歇性的卫星间和星地联系计划交付有限对象——传感瓦片、遥测块、模型更新和检查点。当完整对象未能在其截止日期前交付时，部分交付是不足的。当一个对象被分割到候选路径中时，路径私有评估可能会多次计算相同的联系服务，并悄无声息地低估完成情况。我们开发了一个残余服务感知的交付层，该层从联系计划路由生成中获取候选路径，并测试在每边缘先进先出残余服务下，完整对象是否能在其截止日期前交付。在受控的共享联系竞争下，路径私有评估低估完成情况高达154秒，并且可以在没有残余服务完成的固定计划下报告有限完成。对于边缘不相交的互补联系，该层简化为固定路径服务；我们推导了一个充分的服务预算条件，在此条件下，双向分条严格扩大了可行负载区域。我们验证了一个受限的穷举参考，描述了在20-180颗卫星的程序性联系模型上的运行时，并表明有界双向分条将与受限参考的平均和中位差距减少约40%，而P90和最差情况差距保持不变。
tldr: 该研究开发了一种残余服务感知的交付层，用于在间歇性LEO卫星网络中，在截止期限内可靠地交付有限对象，解决现有路径私有评估中重复计算联系服务的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的残余服务感知交付层，有效解决了LEO卫星网络中有限对象交付的复杂性，特别是解决了传统路径评估中服务重复计算的问题。其创新点在于引入了残余服务概念，并验证了双向分条在提高交付效率和扩大可行负载区域方面的优势。对于未来LEO网络的数据传输和任务规划具有重要意义。
motivation: LEO中继网络在间歇性联系计划下交付有限对象时，如果完整对象未在截止期限前交付，部分交付是不足的。当对象在候选路径中分割时，路径私有评估可能重复计算联系服务并错误地低估完成情况。
method: 开发了一个残余服务感知的交付层，该层从联系计划路由生成中获取候选路径，并测试在每边缘先进先出残余服务下，完整对象是否能在截止期限前交付。研究了受控共享联系竞争和边缘不相交互补联系两种情况。
results: 在受控共享联系竞争下，路径私有评估低估完成情况高达154秒，并可能在没有残余服务完成的固定计划下报告有限完成。对于边缘不相交互补联系，该层简化为固定路径服务，并推导出了一个充分的服务预算条件，在此条件下，双向分条严格扩大了可行负载区域。在20-180颗卫星的程序性联系模型中，有界双向分条将与受限参考的平均和中位差距减少约40%，而P90和最差情况差距保持不变。
conclusion: 开发的残余服务感知交付层能够有效解决间歇性LEO卫星网络中有限对象交付的挑战，特别是通过有界双向分条显著提高了交付效率和可行负载区域。

title: Quadrature-Aware Complex-Linear Neural Operator for Boundary-to-Field Prediction in Resonant Acoustics
authors: Muhammad Idrees Khan, Hua-Dong Yao
abstract: Repeated prediction of acoustic fields from spatially distributed boundary excitation is computationally expensive when each source realization requires a new wave simulation. This work introduces a quadrature-aware complex-linear boundary operator (CLBO) that maps complex normal velocity on a vibrating surface to complex pressure at receiver locations. The model couples learned source and receiver basis functions through an explicit complex surface-quadrature contraction, so the boundary excitation enters linearly by construction. This preserves complex superposition, homogeneity, and zero response to zero excitation, while representing the source through coordinates, normals, and quadrature weights rather than a fixed flattened input vector. Reference data were generated using a verified three-dimensional multiple-relaxation-time (MRT) lattice Boltzmann solver and stored in a solver-agnostic boundary-to-field format. CLBO was compared with a fixed-sensor complex DeepONet under matched case splits and optimization settings, with additional tests of structural consistency, receiver-coordinate interpolation, source discretization, source-family holdout, label efficiency, physics-informed ablations, unseen source mixtures, and computational cost. Across five training seeds, CLBO achieved a mean complex relative field error of 0.184 +/- 0.00771, compared with 0.367 +/- 0.00742 for DeepONet. Its measured source-superposition error was 1.31 x 10^-7, and its mean error on newly simulated mixed-source cases was 0.237, compared with 0.415 for DeepONet. Inference was 1.83 x 10^4 faster than the reference calculation for the reported query size. These results show that enforcing the known complex-linear boundary-to-field structure improves physical consistency and generalization under distributed acoustic excitation.
zh_title: 谐振声学中边界到场预测的求积感知复线性神经算子
translation: 当每个声源实现都需要进行新的波动模拟时，从空间分布的边界激励中重复预测声场在计算上是非常昂贵的。本研究引入了一种求积感知复线性边界算子（CLBO），用于将振动表面上的复法向速度映射到接收器位置的复声压。该模型通过显式的复表面求积收缩来耦合学习到的源和接收器基函数，因此边界激励在构建上呈线性进入。这保持了复数叠加性、齐次性以及对零激励的零响应，同时通过坐标、法线和求积权重（而非固定的扁平化输入向量）来表示声源。参考数据是使用经验证的三维多松弛时间（MRT）格子玻尔兹曼求解器生成的，并以与求解器无关的边界到场格式存储。在匹配的案例划分和优化设置下，将 CLBO 与固定传感器的复数 DeepONet 进行了对比，并对结构一致性、接收器坐标插值、声源离散化、声源族留出、标签效率、物理启发消融、未见声源混合和计算成本进行了额外测试。在五个训练种子中，CLBO 实现了 0.184 +/- 0.00771 的平均复相对场误差，而 DeepONet 为 0.367 +/- 0.00742。其测得的声源叠加误差为 1.31 x 10^-7，在新模拟的混合声源案例上的平均误差为 0.237，而 DeepONet 为 0.415。对于报告的查询规模，推理速度比参考计算快 1.83 x 10^4 倍。这些结果表明，强制执行已知的复线性边界到场结构可以提高分布式声学激励下的物理一致性和泛化能力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种求积感知复线性边界算子（CLBO），通过在架构中显式嵌入复表面求积收缩，实现了物理一致的声场预测，其误差仅为DeepONet的一半，且推理速度比传统求解器快四个数量级。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将物理上的复线性（Complex-Linear）和表面求积（Surface Quadrature）结构显式嵌入到神经算子的网络架构设计中，从而在保证物理一致性（例如近乎完美的叠加原理和零激励零响应）的同时，大幅提升了泛化性能和标签效率。这种“物理结构启发”的设计比纯黑盒的算子（如DeepONet）更具解释性和鲁棒性。其局限性可能在于对复杂几何边界的求积权重、坐标和法线有较强依赖，在极度复杂的离散边界上可能需要额外的预处理。
motivation: 在谐振声学中，当每个声源实现都需要进行新的波动模拟时，从空间分布的边界激励中重复预测声场具有极高的计算成本。
method: 提出了一种求积感知复线性边界算子（CLBO）。该模型通过显式的复表面求积收缩（complex surface-quadrature contraction）来耦合学习到的源和接收器基函数，使边界激励在线性构建中引入。它利用坐标、法线和求积权重来表示声源，而非固定的扁平化输入向量，从而保持了复数叠加性、齐次性和零响应等物理特性。
results: 在五个训练种子中，CLBO 实现了 0.184 ± 0.00771 的平均复数相对场误差（DeepONet 为 0.367 ± 0.00742）；其测得的声源叠加误差极低，仅为 1.31 x 10^-7；在未见过的混合声源案例上平均误差为 0.237（DeepONet 为 0.415）；其推理速度比参考数值计算快 1.83 x 10^4 倍。
conclusion: 强制执行已知的复数线性边界到场结构，能够显著提高分布式声学激励下神经算子的物理一致性、泛化能力和计算效率。

title: On Pairwise Quantile Regression -- Statistical Guarantees and Applications
authors: Romain Thérézien, Stephan Clémençon, Fantin Girard, Hamza El-Abdouni
abstract: Quantile regression provides a powerful tool for summarizing the conditional distribution of a real valued random variable (r.v.) of interest $Y$ as a function of covariates $Z$ in cases where it shows a large dispersion with high probability, going beyond the situation where standard least square regression is informative/predictive. This article aims to extend this methodology to the pairwise case, when the variable to be explained takes the form of a similarity function between two independent observations, such as pixelated ID photos, as input data of biometric systems) and the explanatory variables take the form of a pair of covariates of the observations, such as the age or the hair color. We establish theoretical guarantees for solutions of this statistical learning problem, considered here as empirical minimizers of a pairwise version of the pinball loss. Leveraging sharp concentration results for $U$-processes, we prove generalization bounds and identify mild conditions under which fast learning rates can be achieved. Confirming the probabilistic analysis, experiments based on simulation data also provide solid empirical evidence of the validity of the methodology promoted here for pairwise quantile regression. Finally, its usefulness from an application perspective is demonstrated by a detailed study aimed at analyzing errors in similarity scoring for facial recognition.
zh_title: 关于成对分位数回归——统计保证与应用
translation: 分位数回归提供了一种强有力的工具，用于在感兴趣的实值随机变量 $Y$ 表现出高概率大分散度的情况下，将其条件分布总结为协变量 $Z$ 的函数，这超越了标准最小二乘回归具有信息量/预测性的情况。本文旨在将这一方法扩展到成对（pairwise）情况，即待解释的变量形式为两个独立观测值之间的相似度函数（例如作为生物识别系统输入数据的像素化证件照），而解释变量形式为观测值的一对协变量（例如年龄或发色）。我们为该统计学习问题的解建立了理论保证，在此将其视为成对版本针球损失（pinball loss）的经验极小化器。利用U-过程的紧致集中结果，我们证明了泛化界，并确定了可以实现快速学习率的温和条件。为了证实概率分析，基于模拟数据的实验也为本文所推广的成对分位数回归方法的有效性提供了坚实的经验证据。最后，通过一项旨在分析人脸识别相似度评分误差的详细研究，展示了该方法在应用角度的实用性。
tldr: 本文将分位数回归扩展到成对数据，利用U-过程理论建立了泛化界与快速收敛率的统计保证，并通过模拟实验及人脸识别应用证实了该方法的有效性。
ai_comments: 本工作将传统的分位数回归成功推广到了成对（pairwise）设置中，这在生物特征识别和比对等实际场景中非常常见。其主要创新点在于利用U-过程（U-processes）的集中不等式克服了成对数据非独立同分布带来的技术挑战，给出了严谨的统计泛化界和快速收敛率保证。局限性在于摘要中未提及在高维协变量下的计算效率和具体优化算法。
motivation: 传统的分位数回归主要针对单观测值的条件分布建模。然而在实际应用中（如生物识别系统），待解释变量往往是两个独立观测值之间的相似性（成对数据），而解释变量是这两个观测值的协变量对，因此需要将分位数回归扩展到成对的场景。
method: 提出成对分位数回归（Pairwise Quantile Regression）方法，将其定义为成对版本针球损失（pairwise pinball loss）的经验极小化问题。在理论分析中，利用U-过程（U-processes）的紧致集中不等式来推导泛化界，并确定实现快速学习率的条件。
results: 在理论上，成功建立了该方法的泛化界，并指出了实现快速学习率的温和条件；在实验上，通过模拟数据验证了该方法的有效性，并通过人脸识别中相似度评分误差分析的实际应用展示了其高度实用性。
conclusion: 本文成功将分位数回归推广至成对情况，并在理论上证明了其泛化界与快速收敛率，同时在模拟和实际人脸识别误差分析中验证了其有效性，为成对数据的条件分布估计提供了坚实的统计工具。

title: Generative wave propagator
authors: Shijun Cheng, Tariq Alkhalifah
abstract: Seismic wavefield simulation is fundamental to seismology, but conventional finite-difference (FD) methods remain limited by numerical dispersion and stability constraints, which often require dense spatial grids and small time steps and thereby severely limit the effectiveness of iterative inversion workflows. We introduce a conditional diffusion-based wavefield propagator that advances seismic wavefields recursively from one time step to the next. Instead of learning an unconditional data distribution of wavefield evolution, the model is conditioned by a short history of recent wavefield time steps (snapshots), the velocity model, and the wavefield time step index, allowing it to represent the conditional transition between adjacent physical states. By training the network to directly predict the clean next wavefield snapshot, this strong physical conditioning makes it possible to replace the iterative reverse diffusion process with a single network evaluation for each predicted snapshot. To improve stability over long recursive rollouts, we further introduce a causal time-weighted loss, in which adaptive weights, accumulated as exponential moving averages of per-snapshot training errors, emphasize training directions that are consistent with the forward propagation sequence and reduce the amplification of one-step prediction errors. Because the learned propagator is tied to the temporal spacing of the training snapshots rather than to the FD stability limit, it can advance the wavefield using a physical time step ten times larger than that required by the underlying solver. Experiments on the Overthrust, SEG/EAGE, and Marmousi models show that the proposed method accurately reproduces wavefield snapshots and shot gathers and achieves an end-to-end speedup of 2.17 x over a GPU-accelerated tenth-order staggered-grid FD implementation under matched hardware conditions.
translation: 地震波场模拟是地震学的基础，但传统的有限差分（FD）方法仍然受到数值频散和稳定性限制，这通常需要密集的空间网格和小的时步，从而严重限制了迭代反演工作流的有效性。我们引入了一种基于条件扩散的波场传播器，它以递归方式将地震波场从一个时间步推进到下一个。该模型不是学习波场演化的无条件数据分布，而是以近期波场时间步（快照）的短历史、速度模型和波场时间步索引为条件，使其能够表示相邻物理状态之间的条件转换。通过训练网络直接预测下一个干净的波场快照，这种强大的物理条件作用使得每次预测的快照都可以用一次网络评估来代替迭代逆扩散过程。为了提高长期递归展开的稳定性，我们进一步引入了一种因果时间加权损失，其中自适应权重作为每个快照训练误差的指数移动平均值积累，强调与正向传播序列一致的训练方向，并减少一步预测误差的放大。由于学习到的传播器与训练快照的时间间隔相关联，而不是与FD稳定性限制相关联，因此它可以使用比底层求解器所需时间步长大十倍的物理时间步长来推进波场。在Overthrust、SEG/EAGE和Marmousi模型上的实验表明，所提出的方法能够准确重现波场快照和炮集，并在匹配的硬件条件下，与GPU加速的十阶交错网格FD实现相比，实现了2.17倍的端到端加速。
tldr: 一种基于条件扩散模型的地震波场传播器，比传统有限差分法更快，能使用更大的时间步长，并显著加速模拟过程。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将条件扩散模型应用于地震波场传播，特别是利用物理条件作用和因果时间加权损失来提高稳定性和效率。能够使用大得多的时间步长是地震反演的一个重要优势。
motivation: 传统的有限差分（FD）方法受到数值频散和稳定性限制，需要密集的空间网格和小的时间步长，这严重限制了迭代反演工作流的效率。
method: 提出了一种基于条件扩散的波场传播器，通过递归方式将地震波场从一个时间步推进到下一个。该模型以近期波场时间步（快照）的短历史、速度模型和波场时间步索引为条件。通过训练网络直接预测下一个干净的波场快照，使得每次预测只需一次网络评估，取代了迭代逆扩散过程。为提高长期递归展开的稳定性，引入了因果时间加权损失。
results: 该方法能准确重现波场快照和炮集。与GPU加速的十阶交错网格有限差分实现相比，实现了2.17倍的端到端加速。它可以使用比底层求解器所需时间步长大十倍的物理时间步长来推进波场。
conclusion: 所提出的生成式波传播器为地震波场模拟提供了一种比传统有限差分方法更高效、更稳定的替代方案，从而能够加速迭代反演工作流。

title: Tightening the Score Matching Gap for Diffusion Models
authors: Benjamin Dupuis, Tyler Farghly, Maxime Haddouche, Alain Durmus, Umut Simsekli
abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) are a state-of-the-art generative method to approximately sample from an unknown distribution. Their training and evaluation primarily rely on an Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), which relates the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of model samples to the score matching loss along the path, which serves as a tractable surrogate. The difference between sample quality and the score matching loss produced by this bound leads to the \emph{score matching gap}, which is known to be tight in the worst-case but not descriptive of sample quality in general. In this work, we provide a theoretical analysis of this gap, developing tighter bounds for three metrics: KL divergence, reverse KL divergence, and Wasserstein distance, effectively exploiting the regularity of the class of score estimators. Our results suggest that the quality of the score approximation has more impact on closing the score matching gap for low noise scales. To obtain these bounds, our key technical insight is to exploit the contraction properties of the backward processes. In particular, we rely on entropy flows, logarithmic Sobolev inequalities and reflection couplings, rigorously linking the ergodicity of the Langevin diffusion to the score matching gap problem.
zh_title: 收紧扩散模型的得分匹配间隙
translation: 扩散模型（DMs）是一种最先进的生成方法，用于从未知分布中近似采样。它们的训练和评估主要依赖于证据下界（ELBO），该下界将模型样本的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度与路径上的得分匹配损失联系起来，后者作为一个易于处理的替代指标。由该下界产生的样本质量与得分匹配损失之间的差异导致了“得分匹配间隙”（score matching gap），已知该间隙在最坏情况下是紧的，但在一般情况下并不能刻画样本质量。在这项工作中，我们对这一间隙进行了理论分析，为三种度量指标（KL散度、反向KL散度和Wasserstein距离）开发了更紧的界，从而有效地利用了得分估计器类别的正则性。我们的结果表明，得分逼近的质量对于在低噪声尺度下收紧得分匹配间隙有更大的影响。为了获得这些界，我们的关键技术见解是利用反向过程的收缩特性。特别是，我们依赖于熵流、对数索博列夫不等式和反射耦合，将Langevin扩散的遍历性与得分匹配间隙问题严谨地联系起来。
tldr: 本文通过利用反向过程的收缩特性，为扩散模型的“得分匹配间隙”推导出了关于KL散度、反向KL散度和Wasserstein距离更紧的理论边界。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于引入了统计物理和随机分析中的经典工具（如熵流、对数索博列夫不等式和反射耦合），系统地分析了扩散模型中的“得分匹配间隙”。通过为KL散度、反向KL散度和Wasserstein距离提供更紧的理论边界，该研究不仅填补了扩散模型样本质量理论评估的空白，还指出低噪声阶段得分估计精度的关键性，对未来优化扩散模型的训练与采样算法具有重要的理论指导价值。
motivation: 扩散模型的训练和评估主要依赖于证据下界（ELBO），这导致了样本质量与得分匹配损失之间存在“得分匹配间隙”（score matching gap）。尽管该间隙在最坏情况下是紧的，但在一般情况下无法准确描述样本质量。因此，本文旨在对该间隙进行深入的理论分析，以寻求更紧的边界。
method: 本文通过利用得分估计器类别的正则性，针对KL散度、反向KL散度和Wasserstein距离这三个指标开发了更紧的界。其核心技术方法是利用反向过程的收缩特性，具体依赖于熵流（entropy flows）、对数索博列夫不等式（logarithmic Sobolev inequalities）和反射耦合（reflection couplings），从而将Langevin扩散的遍历性与得分匹配间隙问题严谨地联系起来。
results: 理论分析结果表明，得分逼近的质量在低噪声尺度下对于缩小得分匹配间隙具有更显著的影响。
conclusion: 本文成功建立了扩散模型得分匹配间隙更紧的理论边界，并将Langevin扩散的遍历性理论与得分匹配问题严谨地结合在一起，深化了对扩散模型生成质量的理论认知。

title: Noise-Aware Synthesis of Quantum LDPC Encoder Circuits via Two-Sided Hamming Descent
authors: Aditya Sodhani, Keshab K. Parhi
abstract:
Quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes are a promising route to fault-tolerant quantum computation, but their use requires efficient preparation of encoded states. Standard encoder constructions generate circuits through fixed algebraic procedures, yet the resulting circuit can contain substantial redundancy. We formulate LDPC encoder preparation as a circuit-resynthesis problem: given the linear-reversible matrix implemented by the encoder's CNOT block, we seek a lower-cost equivalent circuit that can be routed efficiently on the target hardware and which mitigates noise. We propose a novel optimization approach referred as two-sided Hamming descent and a noise-aware optimization pipeline for this task.
  Across several families of Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) LDPC encoders, including Bivariate Bicycle, hypergraph-product, and entanglement-assisted codes, the proposed pipeline produces substantially smaller and shallower encoder circuits than the standard constructions and the synthesis baselines considered, cutting gate counts by 53.8% in aggregate across the benchmark and by up to 68% on the Bivariate Bicycle family. The gains remain visible after routing, where the two-qubit depth is reduced by up to 71% and translate into higher-fidelity state preparation under circuit-level noise. On the Bivariate Bicycle family, live-range scheduling further reduces routed preparation failure by up to 13.7% without adding two-qubit gates to the selected circuit. These results indicate that encoder-matrix resynthesis, combined with hardware-calibrated selection and scheduling, is an effective compiler-level tool for preparing quantum LDPC code states.
zh_title: 经由双向汉明下降的量子LDPC编码器电路的噪声感知合成
translation: 量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码是实现容错量子计算的有希望的途径，但其使用需要高效地制备编码态。标准的编码器构造通过固定的代数程序生成电路，然而由此产生的电路可能包含大量冗余。我们将LDPC编码器制备表述为一个电路再合成问题：给定编码器CNOT块实现的线性可逆矩阵，我们寻求一个成本更低、可在目标硬件上高效路由并能缓解噪声的等效电路。我们提出了一种新颖的优化方法，称为双向汉明下降，以及一个用于此任务的噪声感知优化流程。在几种Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) LDPC编码器家族中，包括双变量自行车码、超图积码和纠缠辅助码，所提出的流程比标准构造和所考虑的合成基线产生了显著更小和更浅的编码器电路，在整个基准测试中，门计数总共减少了53.8%，在双变量自行车码家族中最高减少了68%。这些增益在路由后仍然可见，其中双量子位深度最高减少了71%，并转化为电路级噪声下更高保真度的态制备。在双变量自行车码家族上，活范围调度进一步将路由制备失败率降低了高达13.7%，而没有增加所选电路的双量子位门。这些结果表明，编码器矩阵再合成，结合硬件校准的选择和调度，是制备量子LDPC码态的一种有效的编译器级工具。
tldr: 本文提出了一种噪声感知优化方法，通过双向汉明下降对量子LDPC编码器电路进行再合成，显著减小了电路尺寸和深度，提高了编码态制备的保真度。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过将LDPC编码器制备重新框架为电路再合成问题，并引入噪声感知优化和双向汉明下降，展示了在实现高效容错量子计算方面的重大创新。它解决了现有编码器构造中冗余和噪声缓解不足的关键问题，并通过显著的性能提升（如门计数和深度减少）证明了其重要性，特别是在实际硬件部署中。
motivation: 量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码是实现容错量子计算的有希望的途径，但其使用需要高效地制备编码态。标准的编码器构造方法生成的电路存在大量冗余，且未考虑目标硬件的路由和噪声缓解。
method: 本文将LDPC编码器制备表述为一个电路再合成问题：给定编码器CNOT块实现的线性可逆矩阵，目标是寻找一个成本更低、可在目标硬件上高效路由并能缓解噪声的等效电路。为此，提出了一种新颖的优化方法，称为双向汉明下降（two-sided Hamming descent），以及一个噪声感知优化流程。
results: 与标准构造和合成基线相比，所提出的流程为多种CSS LDPC编码器（包括双变量自行车码、超图积码和纠缠辅助码）生成了显著更小、更浅的编码器电路。在基准测试中，门计数总体减少了53.8%，在双变量自行车码家族上最高减少了68%。路由后，双量子位深度最高减少了71%，并转化为电路级噪声下更高保真度的态制备。在双变量自行车码家族上，活范围调度（live-range scheduling）进一步将路由制备失败率降低了高达13.7%，而没有增加双量子位门。
conclusion: 编码器矩阵再合成，结合硬件校准的选择和调度，是制备量子LDPC码态的一种有效的编译器级工具。

title: Constrained Flow Matching via Lagrangian Dual Flows
authors: Vince Kurtz, Alexander Davydov
abstract: Flow matching is a powerful tool for generative modeling, but emerging applications in robotics, planning, and physics require inference-time constraints on generated outputs. Such constraints are often complex and highly nonlinear. As a result, methods designed for linear constraints like image inpainting are rarely sufficient, and projection or optimization-based alternatives can be prohibitively expensive. In this paper, we introduce Lagrangian Dual Flows, a new family of constrained generation techniques based on Lagrangian dual dynamics. By simply flowing a dual co-state alongside generated samples, we can guarantee nonlinear constraint satisfaction without expensive optimization subproblems, pseudoinverses, or projection steps during the denoising process. The resulting constrained generation algorithms are simple, effective, and open new theoretical connections between flow matching and primal-dual methods in numerical optimization.
zh_title: 基于拉格朗日对偶流的受约束流匹配
translation: 流匹配是生成模型的一种强大工具，但机器人在、规划和物理等新兴应用中，要求在推理阶段对生成的输出施加约束。这些约束通常是复杂且高度非线性的。因此，专为线性约束设计的方法（如图像修复）极少能满足需求，而基于投影或优化的替代方案可能成本高昂。在本文中，我们引入了拉格朗日对偶流，这是一类基于拉格朗日对偶动力学的全新受约束生成技术。通过在生成样本的同时简单地流动一个对偶共态，我们可以在去噪过程中保证非线性约束的满足，而无需昂贵的优化子问题、伪逆或投影步骤。由此产生的受约束生成算法简单、有效，并开拓了流匹配与数值优化中原始-对偶方法之间的新理论联系。
tldr: 本文提出拉格朗日对偶流，通过在流匹配过程中引入并演化对偶共态，无需任何昂贵的投影或优化计算即可高效实现满足非线性约束的样本生成。
ai_comments: 本论文极具创新性地将数值优化中的拉格朗日对偶理论引入到生成式流匹配中，解决了推理阶段非线性硬约束难以高效满足的痛点。其核心思想是通过引入并演化对偶共态，避免了去噪过程中昂贵的投影和优化计算，既保证了约束的严格满足，又维持了生成的高效性，在机器人规划和物理系统模拟等领域具有广阔的应用前景。
motivation: 在机器人、规划和物理等新兴应用中，生成模型在推理时需要满足复杂的非线性约束。现有的针对线性约束的方法（如图像修复）无法应对，而基于投影或优化的替代方案计算成本又过于高昂。
method: 提出拉格朗日对偶流（Lagrangian Dual Flows），这是一类基于拉格朗日对偶动力学的受约束生成技术。该方法在生成样本的同时流动一个对偶共态（dual co-state），从而在去噪过程中无需进行复杂的优化子问题求解、伪逆计算或投影步骤。
results: 该方法能够保证非线性约束的满足，且在去噪过程中避免了昂贵的优化子问题、伪逆或投影步骤，生成过程简单且高效。
conclusion: 拉格朗日对偶流算法简单、有效，不仅解决了流匹配中的非线性约束生成问题，还成功在流匹配与数值优化中的原始-对偶方法之间建立了新的理论联系。

title: Weakly Guided and Autoregressive Beamformer Parameterization for Generalizable Moving Speaker Extraction in Higher-Order Ambisonics
authors: Jakob Kienegger, Tal Peer, Sina Khanagha, Timo Gerkmann
abstract: Linear spatial filters (beamformers) enable robust, generalizable and interpretable speech enhancement with performance guarantees under ideal parameterization. Modern beamformers are often parameterized by deep neural networks, whose performance degrades in dynamic scenarios with multiple moving speakers of unknown directions. We propose a data-driven beamforming pipeline, which only requires an estimate of the target's initial direction. Building on a higher-order ambisonics representation, we show that neural temporal-spectral processing can be decoupled from linear spatial processing, and thereby achieve generalizable and array-agnostic enhancement. By incorporating autoregression into a frame-wise causal framework, we maintain consistent performance throughout fast speaker motion and long recordings. Evaluation on synthetic data demonstrates robust enhancement under challenging conditions with closely spaced and crossing speakers. Real-world recordings in a dynamic office meeting scenario complement these findings and show generalizability across varying ambisonics orders.
comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Acoustic Signal Enhancement (IWAENC) 2026
zh_title: 高阶全景声中用于可泛化移动说话人提取的弱引导自回归波束形成器参数化
translation: 线性空间滤波器（波束形成器）在理想参数化下，能够实现鲁棒、可泛化和可解释的语音增强，并提供性能保证。现代波束形成器通常由深度神经网络参数化，但在具有未知方向的多个移动说话人的动态场景中，其性能会下降。我们提出了一种数据驱动的波束形成流水线，它仅需要目标说话人的初始方向估计。基于高阶全景声表示，我们展示了神经时谱处理可以与线性空间处理解耦，从而实现可泛化和阵列无关的增强。通过将自回归整合到帧级因果框架中，我们能够在快速说话人运动和长时间录音中保持一致的性能。对合成数据的评估表明，在说话人紧密和交叉等挑战性条件下，实现了鲁棒的增强。动态办公室会议场景中的真实世界录音补充了这些发现，并显示出对不同全景声阶数的可泛化性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的波束形成方法，通过弱引导和自回归参数化，在高阶全景声表示下，实现了对移动说话人的鲁棒且可泛化的语音增强，即使在挑战性动态场景下也能保持性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将高阶全景声表示下的时谱处理与空间处理解耦，并引入自回归机制，有效解决了传统深度学习波束形成器在动态多移动说话人场景下的性能下降问题。其弱引导和阵列无关的特性，以及在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性，使其在实际应用中具有重要价值和泛化潜力。
motivation: 现代波束形成器在面对未知方向的多个移动说话人等动态场景时，性能会下降。本研究旨在解决这一问题，实现对移动说话人的鲁棒、可泛化语音增强。
method: 提出了一种数据驱动的波束形成流水线，仅需目标说话人的初始方向估计。该方法基于高阶全景声表示，将神经时谱处理与线性空间处理解耦，并引入自回归的帧级因果框架，以处理快速说话人运动和长录音。
results: 在合成数据上的评估表明，在说话人紧密和交叉等挑战性条件下，实现了鲁棒的增强。真实世界录音（动态办公室会议场景）证实了这些发现，并展示了对不同全景声阶数的可泛化性。
conclusion: 通过解耦时谱和空间处理，并结合自回归机制，本方法在高阶全景声表示下，能对移动说话人实现鲁棒、可泛化的语音增强，并在动态复杂场景中保持一致性能。

title: An open, reproducible branch-and-cut for the capacitated profitable tour problem: a component study
authors: Simon Spoorendonk
abstract: We present an open, reproducible branch-and-cut (B&C) algorithm for the capacitated profitable tour problem (CPTP) and its open s-t path variant, the capacity-constrained elementary shortest-path problem. The solver re-implements the formulation and cut families of Jepsen et al. (2014) on a fully open mixed-integer programming stack (HiGHS; Huangfu and Hall, 2018), and adds bound-based preprocessing, domain propagation, and reduced-cost variable fixing. We claim no new method; the contribution is twofold. First, an open, reproducible artifact: to our knowledge the first branch-and-cut for this problem class on a fully open stack, with the formulation, every separator, and all benchmark scripts released, so the results below can be rerun and the solver reused and extended as a baseline. Second, a component study on this common modern stack, benchmarked against a dynamic-programming/labelling reference, that decomposes which components pay off and where the running time goes. We find that the capacity-class cuts account for essentially the entire benefit (adding them to a connectivity-only baseline lifts the number of instances solved from 52 to 64 of 76 and shrinks the search tree more than tenfold), while comb and rounded generalized-large-multistar cuts, reduced-cost fixing, and bound-based propagation add nothing measurable. We also report a negative result: the shortest-path-incompatibility (SPI) cut, a variant of the node-precedence inequalities of García (2009), finds no violated inequality on any instance. The solver and all experiments are released as open, reproducible software (Spoorendonk, 2026).
zh_title: 一个开源、可复现的容量限制有盈利巡回问题的分支割平面算法：组件研究
translation: 我们针对容量限制有盈利巡回问题（CPTP）及其开源s-t路径变体（容量限制初等最短路径问题），提出了一种开源、可复现的分支割平面（B&C）算法。该求解器在完全开源的混合整数规划技术栈（HiGHS; Huangfu and Hall, 2018）上，重新实现了 Jepsen 等人（2014）的数学规划公式和割平面族，并加入了基于边界的预处理、定义域传播以及缩减成本变量固定。我们并未声称提出了新的方法，其贡献主要体现在两个方面：第一，提供了一个开源、可复现的工件——据我们所知，这是该问题类在完全开源技术栈上的首个分支割平面算法，其公式、每个分离器以及所有基准测试脚本均已发布，因此下述结果可以重现，且该求解器可作为基准进行重用和扩展；第二，在这一通用的现代技术栈上进行了一项组件研究，并以动态规划/标号算法作为参考基准，拆解了哪些组件能带来收益以及运行时间的具体去向。我们发现，容量类割平面几乎贡献了全部的性能提升（将它们加入到仅含连通性的基准方法中后，求解的实例数量从 76 个中的 52 个提升至 64 个，并将搜索树缩小了十倍以上），而梳状割平面、舍入广义大多星割平面、缩减成本固定和基于边界的传播则没有带来任何可衡量的提升。我们还报告了一个负面结果：最短路径不相容（SPI）割平面（García, 2009 年节点前驱不等式的一种变体）在任何实例中均未找到被违反的不等式。该求解器及所有实验均已作为开源、可复现的软件发布（Spoorendonk, 2026）。
keywords: 容量限制有盈利巡回问题
tldr: 本文针对容量限制有盈利巡回问题，推出了首个完全开源且可复现的分支割平面求解器，并通过组件研究证实，仅容量类割平面对性能有显著贡献，而其他多种传统优化组件并无明显效果。

motivation: 针对容量限制有盈利巡回问题（CPTP），目前缺乏在完全开源的混合整数规划（MIP）技术栈上实现的、开源且可复现的分支割平面（B&C）算法；同时，需要通过组件研究来厘清在现代技术栈中哪些算法组件能真正提升性能。

title: Boundary-layer asymptotics for Gaussian-smoothed singular measures
authors: Nicolas Brosse, Arnak S. Dalalyan
abstract: We study the small-noise asymptotics of Euclidean heat regularizations of probability measures supported on manifolds with corners. Near a boundary or corner stratum, the relevant regime is a conical boundary layer in which the observation point approaches the stratum at the same scale as the Gaussian smoothing parameter. After rescaling this layer, the support is replaced to leading order by its inward tangent cone. We prove a two-term expansion for the heat-regularized density in this regime. The leading coefficient is the Gaussian mass of the linearized cone, weighted by the density on the support and by the adapted corner Jacobian; the first correction records the variation of the density, the Jacobian, and the quadratic geometry of the embedding. A localization argument then yields the corresponding expansion for the full heat regularization, with the nonlocal contribution exponentially small. From this density expansion we derive logarithmic asymptotics and uniform expansions for the score, the log-Hessian, and the scale derivative of the score. These formulas show how lower-dimensional support, boundary faces, corners, and curvature are encoded in the singular differential structure of small-noise Gaussian regularizations.
zh_title: 高斯平滑奇异测度的边界层渐近分析
translation: 我们研究了在具有角点的流形上支持的概率测度的欧几里得热正则化的小噪声渐近分析。在边界或角点层附近，相关的机制是圆锥边界层，其中观测点以与高斯平滑参数相同的尺度接近该层。在重新调整该层后，支持被其内向切锥取代到主导阶。我们证明了在该机制下热正则化密度的两项展开式。主导系数是线性化锥体的高斯质量，由支持上的密度和适应的角点雅可比加权；第一个校正项记录了密度、雅可比和嵌入的二次几何的变化。然后，一个局部化论证得到了完整热正则化的相应展开式，其中非局部贡献呈指数级小。从这个密度展开式中，我们推导出了分数、对数Hessian和分数尺度导数的对数渐近式和均匀展开式。这些公式展示了低维支持、边界面、角点和曲率如何编码在小噪声高斯正则化的奇异微分结构中。

title: Causal ASCEND: Scalable Two-tier Causal Discovery on High Dimensional Multi-omics Data
authors: Stephen Asiedu, David Watson
abstract: Biological systems exhibit a hierarchical structure, characterised by directed flow from upstream regulators to downstream effects. Although this ordering provides a natural scaffold for causal inference, most causal discovery and GRN methods either ignore the tiered organisation or condition on all upstream variables, which becomes infeasible for high-dimensional omics data. We present ASCEND (Ancestral Scalable Causal discovEry via iNherited Descent), a constraint-based framework that leverages known two-tiered structure to enable genome-scale causal discovery. ASCEND introduces a divide-and-conquer strategy that maintains dynamically updated ancestral conditioning sets for each downstream variable, dramatically reducing the number of conditional independence tests required, and achieves polynomial-time complexity where traditional approaches face exponential blow-up. Through extensive simulations and real biological data, we demonstrate that ASCEND accurately recovers ancestral relationships, scales properly and much faster, and outperforms existing gene regulatory network inference methods in both causal precision and computational efficiency. The algorithm's ability to resolve directionality makes it particularly suited for integrating multi-omic data where upstream regulators (e.g., SNPs, methylation sites) and downstream responses (e.g., gene expression) are measured jointly.
