title: Free-form Association Tasks Reveal Stereotype Hallucination in Large Language Models
authors: Xinrui Chloe Zhao, Douglas Guilbeault, Amir Goldberg
abstract: Recent studies argue that LLMs can predict human stereotypical judgments. Yet whether LLMs emulate the cognitive processes underlying human stereotypes, or merely retrieve learned associations to solve prediction tasks, remains unclear. Prior work examines LLMs' stereotypes in either (i) controlled judgment tasks like multiple choice surveys, or (ii) contexts constrained by conventionalized and predictable group biases. Here, we compare the structure of the stereotypes that humans and LLMs exhibit in the interpretation of free-form stimuli, namely abstract art and Rorschach blots, which lack pre-established cultural meanings. We recruit participants across five social domains (gender, partisanship, personality, urbanicity, and lifestyle) and elicit both first-order (direct personal interpretations) and second-order responses (predictions about how members of social groups will interpret the stimuli); we replicate this design with two multimodal models (GPT-4o mini and Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct). Humans and LLMs differ not only in magnitude but in the qualitative nature of their stereotypes. Human first-order responses display heterogeneity with minimal group structure. When predicting group responses, humans engage in "stereotype exaggeration" by moderately amplifying first-order tendencies while preserving diversity. By contrast, LLMs exhibit homogeneous first-order responses, and yet generate stark second-order stereotypes that neither amplify existing first-order tendencies nor reflect actual human group differences, a process we term "stereotype hallucination." LLMs continued to hallucinate stereotypes even when fine-tuned on the response data of actual participants. These findings suggest significant limitations in the use of LLMs to model and predict human behavior in novel contexts involving diverse interpretations.
zh_title: 自由联想任务揭示了大语言模型中的刻板印象幻觉
translation: 近期的研究认为大语言模型（LLM）可以预测人类的刻板印象判断。然而，LLM究竟是在模拟人类刻板印象背后的认知过程，还是仅仅为了完成预测任务而检索已学习的关联，目前尚不清楚。既往工作主要在受控判断任务或受传统偏见约束的语境下评估LLM的刻板印象。本文比较了人类和LLM在解释自由形式刺激（即缺乏预设文化含义的抽象艺术和Rorschach墨迹图）时所表现出的刻板印象结构。我们招募了涵盖五个社会领域（性别、党派倾向、性格、城市化程度和生活方式）的参与者，并收集了一阶（直接个人解读）和二阶（预测群体成员如何解读）反应；我们使用两个多模态模型（GPT-4o mini和Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct）重复了该设计。结果显示，人类和LLM不仅在刻板印象的程度上有差异，在性质上也有质的区别。人类的一阶反应表现出异质性且几乎没有群体结构；在预测群体反应时，人类会通过适度放大一阶倾向同时保持多样性来进行“刻板印象夸大”。相比之下，LLM表现出同质化的一阶反应，却生成了强烈的二阶刻板印象，这些刻板印象既不放大现有的一阶倾向，也不反映真实的人类群体差异，我们将此过程称为“刻板印象幻觉”。即使在基于参与者实际反应数据进行微调后，LLM仍会持续出现刻板印象幻觉。这些发现表明，在涉及多样化解释的新颖语境中，利用LLM来模拟和预测人类行为存在显著局限性。
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在处理抽象刺激时会产生“刻板印象幻觉”，即生成与人类真实认知模式无关的虚假群体偏见，且这种现象无法通过简单的微调消除。
ai_comments: 该研究通过对比人类与大模型在无预设意义的抽象刺激（抽象艺术与墨迹图）下的反应，揭示了模型在模拟人类刻板印象机制上的根本缺陷。其创新之处在于定义了“刻板印象幻觉”这一概念，并证明了简单微调无法解决该问题，这对使用大模型进行社会科学建模的可靠性提出了重要警示。
motivation: 现有研究仅在受限任务中评估LLM的刻板印象，尚不清楚LLM是真正模拟了人类的认知过程，还是仅仅在检索已学习的关联。研究旨在通过无预设意义的刺激，深入探讨LLM刻板印象的本质。
method: 研究采用自由联想任务，要求人类参与者和多模态大模型（GPT-4o mini, Llama-3.2-11B）对缺乏预设文化含义的抽象刺激（抽象艺术和Rorschach墨迹图）进行一阶（个人解读）和二阶（预测群体解读）反应，并对比两者在五种社会维度下的差异。
results: 人类表现出异质性的一阶反应和基于适度放大的二阶反应；而LLM表现出同质化的一阶反应，以及既不符合一阶倾向也不反映真实人类差异的强烈的“刻板印象幻觉”，且微调无法消除此现象。
conclusion: 大模型在模拟人类刻板印象时并非简单的认知模拟，而是表现出一种与人类本质不同的“刻板印象幻觉”，这限制了其在预测人类行为方面的有效性。

title: Learning Where to Look: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Cancer Detection
authors: Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi, Sina Namazi, Armin Saadat, Lyuyang Wang, Obed Dzikunu, Paul F. R. Wilson, Zhuoxin Guo, Brian Wodlinger, Parvin Mousavi, Purang Abolmaesumi
abstract: Micro-ultrasound ($μ$US) is a new, emerging, and promising imaging modality for prostate cancer (PCa) detection, but accurate identification of suspicious tissue remains highly dependent on clinical experience, leading to substantial inter-observer variability. Machine-learning assistance can reduce this variability; however, training reliable deep models is challenging because supervision is sparse and noisy -- typically limited to core-level histopathology outcomes (e.g., cancer grade and its percentage in a biopsy core) without pixel-level lesion annotations and under severe class imbalance. We introduce Prost-RL, which reframes $μ$US PCa detection as a spatially aware, policy-driven inference problem by learning where to look before decoding. Prost-RL integrates a lightweight reinforcement-learning policy into a foundation-model encoder-decoder to generate interpretable spatial attention maps that act as soft prompts for both cancer-likelihood heatmap prediction and image-level classification. We further propose Adaptive Policy Optimization (APO) to stabilize hybrid supervised-RL training and a noise-robust objective combining symmetric cross-entropy with negative-entropy regularization to mitigate weak-label noise and encourage sharp localization. On a cohort of 6,607 biopsy cores from 693 patients across five clinical sites, Prost-RL achieves $79.0\pm3.5$ AUROC with $64.6\pm6.3$% sensitivity at 80% specificity for core-level detection (+2.1 AUROC and +4.5 sensitivity points over the strongest baseline), and $79.3\pm5.8$ AUROC for clinically significant cancer classification. The learned policy highlights biopsy-aligned regions, providing transparent, spatially grounded evidence alongside quantitative risk predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/DeepRCL/Prost-RL.
zh_title: 学习观察位置：一种用于鲁棒性微超声前列腺癌检测的强化学习框架
translation: 微超声（μUS）是一种新兴且有前景的前列腺癌（PCa）检测成像模态，但对可疑组织的准确识别仍然高度依赖临床经验，导致了显著的观察者间差异。机器学习辅助可以减少这种差异；然而，训练可靠的深度模型具有挑战性，因为监督信息稀疏且带有噪声——通常仅限于核心级组织病理学结果（例如活检核心中的癌症分级及其百分比），缺乏像素级病变标注，且存在严重的类别不平衡。我们引入了 Prost-RL，通过在解码前学习“观察位置”，将μUS PCa检测重构为一种空间感知、策略驱动的推理问题。Prost-RL 将轻量级强化学习策略集成到基础模型编码器-解码器中，以生成可解释的空间注意力图，作为癌症可能性热图预测和图像级分类的软提示。我们进一步提出了自适应策略优化（APO）来稳定混合监督-强化学习训练，以及结合对称交叉熵与负熵正则化的噪声鲁棒性目标函数，以缓解弱标签噪声并鼓励清晰的定位。在一个来自五个临床中心、涉及693名患者的6,607个活检核心队列中，Prost-RL 在核心级检测中实现了 79.0±3.5 AUROC，在80%特异性下敏感性为 64.6±6.3%（比最强基准分别提高了 2.1 AUROC 和 4.5 个敏感性点），在临床显著性癌症分类中实现了 79.3±5.8 AUROC。所学的策略突出了与活检对齐的区域，在提供定量风险预测的同时，提供了透明、空间落地的证据。代码地址：https://github.com/DeepRCL/Prost-RL。
tldr: Prost-RL 通过强化学习策略引导模型聚焦关键区域，有效解决了微超声前列腺癌检测中因弱标注和标签噪声导致的性能瓶颈，实现了更准确且可解释的诊断。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入强化学习策略来解决微超声图像中缺乏像素级标注和标签噪声的问题，不仅提升了检测性能，还提供了可解释的注意力图，这对临床决策支持具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将检测建模为策略驱动的推理过程，有效地连接了稀疏标注与精确的定位需求。
motivation: 微超声成像中前列腺癌的识别高度依赖临床经验且存在显著的观察者间差异；现有深度学习模型在缺乏像素级标注、标签稀疏且存在噪声以及严重类别不平衡的情况下难以训练。
method: 提出 Prost-RL 框架，将检测重构为策略驱动的推理问题；集成轻量级强化学习策略以生成空间注意力图；提出自适应策略优化（APO）以稳定训练；采用结合对称交叉熵和负熵正则化的目标函数以处理弱标签噪声。
results: 在包含693名患者的6,607个活检核心数据集上，Prost-RL 达到了 79.0±3.5 AUROC，在80%特异性下敏感性为 64.6±6.3%，在临床显著性癌症分类上达到了 79.3±5.8 AUROC，均优于现有基准方法。
conclusion: Prost-RL 提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的微超声前列腺癌检测框架，有效应对了临床实践中的弱标注和噪声问题，在多中心数据集上展现了优于现有基准的性能。

title: Linguistic Distancing on Social Media: Indicators of Emotion Regulation Across Age Groups
authors: Daniela Teodorescu, Saif M. Mohammad, Alona Fyshe
abstract: Managing our emotional responses to events is key to emotional well-being, a process referred to as emotion regulation in psychology. Previous work has established that the degree to which we distance events is a type of emotion regulation. When we psychologically distance from events there can be markers in our language. These markers have been referred to as linguistic distancing. We build upon a previous metric to operationalize linguistic distancing, and explore how it changes across the lifespan. We explore this systematically by analyzing large amounts of social media text, a venue where people express their emotions. By investigating how distancing varies across age groups we can better understand how emotion regulation varies with age and provide initial benchmarks on social media data. We provide additional evidence further strengthening the hypothesis that linguistic distancing occurs in proportionally more instances with age. These findings align with past work in psychology which indicate improved well-being with older age. Better understanding how linguistic distancing changes with age is important because it functions as a marker of well-being and can inform effective health interventions. We provide a foundation for further exploring emotion regulation through linguistic distancing in text data.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Computational Affective Science Workshop

title: Loc2Repair: A Framework for Evaluating the Impact of File-Level Issue Localization in Repo-Level LLM Repair
authors: Mohammad Nour Al Awad, Sergey Ivanov
abstract: Repository-grounded automated repair is often reported as a single end-to-end capability, which hides distinct failure modes such as poor file targeting, incorrect patch synthesis, and failed iterative debugging. We present Loc2Repair, a modular evaluation framework for controlled analysis of repository-grounded repair pipelines, and use it to isolate file-level issue localization as an upstream variable. Loc2Repair decouples localization and repair under a shared runtime, artifact schema, and evaluation harness, allowing researchers to combine different localization models and repair backbones under matched conditions. Using three repair backbones on SWE-bench Verified, we compare baseline repair without explicit localization, repair guided by predicted localization from two localizers, and repair guided by gold modified-file sets. Explicit localization consistently improves resolved rate across all backbones: pooled performance increases from 44.7% for baseline repair to 48.9% and 49.1% with predicted localization, and to 52.4% with gold localization. Localization also reduces mean elapsed time overall: in pooled paired analysis, mean elapsed time decreases by 100.94 s and 52.25 s for the two predicted-localization settings, and by 154.45 s with gold guidance, although token effects remain heterogeneous across models. Overall, Loc2Repair shows file-level localization is a consistent repair lever, improving effectiveness and mean latency in pooled analysis, while gold-guided failures expose headroom beyond localization.
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Generative Code Intelligence Workshop (GeCoIn 2026), co-located with the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), Bremen, Germany, August 15--17, 2026

title: HyPOLE: Hyperproperty-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observation
authors: Arshia Rafieioskouei, Tzu-Han Hsu, Matthew Lucas, Borzoo Bonakdarpour
abstract: Formal specification is a powerful tool to guide the learning process and provides significant advantages over reward shaping: (1) mathematical rigor; (2) expressiveness to specify objectives and constraints, and (3) the ability to define tactics to achieve objectives. However, these benefits remain largely unexplored in the context of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). This paper introduces HyPOLE, a novel framework for MARL under partial observability, where learning is guided by the expressive power of the so-called hyperproperties and, in particular, the temporal logic HyperLTL. We integrate Centralized Training for Decentralized Execution (CTDE) techniques with HyPOLE to synthesize decentralized policies, and our evaluation on SMAC, MessySMAC, and WildFire benchmark demonstrates clear advantages over baselines.

title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
authors: Yang Zou, Zijian Ding, Yizhou Sun, Jason Cong
abstract: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. On 9 out of 11 challenging real-world benchmarks, which are 5-10x longer than the most complex cases studied in prior work, AgRefactor outperforms or matches the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM-based baseline built on the same framework backbone. Further agentic performance optimization yields a 6.51x geometric mean speedup over the SoTA pragma tuning tool and a 1.20x speedup over optimized open-source designs with less than 20% extra resources. AgRefactor is fully-automated and open-sourced.
zh_title: AgRefactor：用于HLS兼容性与性能提升的自我进化代理工作流
translation: 高层次综合 (HLS) 提供了一条从概念到硅片的快速路径，但由于严格的语言支持限制以及软件与硬件编程实践之间的鸿沟，将实际软件转换为可综合的 HLS 代码仍然具有挑战性。现有的自动化和基于 LLM 的重构方法部分解决了这个问题，但它们往往缺乏灵活性，难以扩展，且计算成本高昂。我们引入了 AgRefactor，这是一种用于将软件重构为 HLS 兼容程序的多代理 LLM 工作流。AgRefactor 结合了一个自我进化的记忆系统，能够跨任务积累和检索事实与战略知识，从而提高了在未知程序上的鲁棒性和效率。为了降低成本并增强可扩展性，它集成了自动化重构工具，使代理能够平衡 LLM 驱动的重写与高效的基于工具的转换。在 11 个具有挑战性的真实基准测试（比之前工作中研究的最复杂案例长 5-10 倍）中，AgRefactor 在 9 个测试中表现优于或持平于最先进的自动化重构工具以及基于相同框架构建的强力 LLM 基线。进一步的代理性能优化在 pragma 调优工具的基础上实现了 6.51 倍的几何平均速度提升，并以不到 20% 的额外资源开销实现了 1.20 倍于优化开源设计的速度。AgRefactor 是全自动且开源的。
tldr: AgRefactor通过结合LLM代理与自动化工具，实现了高效、可扩展的软件至HLS代码重构，显著提升了硬件设计的开发效率和性能。
ai_comments: AgRefactor通过引入“自我进化记忆系统”和“工具辅助代理”机制，巧妙地平衡了LLM的灵活性与传统自动化工具的效率，解决了HLS代码转换中长期存在的扩展性和计算成本问题，是AI辅助硬件设计领域的重要进展。
motivation: 现有HLS代码重构方法在复杂真实场景中面临灵活性不足、扩展性差和计算成本高的问题，难以将通用软件高效转换为高性能的HLS代码。
method: 提出一种基于LLM的多代理工作流AgRefactor，核心包括：1. 自我进化记忆系统，用于积累和检索跨任务的策略知识；2. 集成自动化重构工具，平衡LLM重写与工具驱动的转换；3. 代理式性能优化，用于pragma参数调优。
results: 在11个基准测试中的9个上超越了现有技术；在性能优化方面，实现了6.51倍的几何平均速度提升，并以不到20%的额外资源开销实现了1.20倍于开源设计的加速。
conclusion: AgRefactor证明了通过结合LLM代理与传统自动化工具，能够显著提升HLS代码转换的效率和硬件性能，且具有良好的扩展性。

title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
authors: Koorosh Roohi, Javad Rajabi, Andrew Fleet, Babak Taati
abstract: Photomosaics are large images whose local regions are seen as independent tiles while their overall arrangement forms a coherent scene. Generating them at high resolution, with every tile convincing in its own right, is computationally expensive, since the canvas must hold many detailed tiles at once. We present PhotoQuilt, a training-free framework that generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution. Diffusion models struggle to satisfy both scales at once, as direct high-resolution generation is costly and tends toward one smooth image rather than a mosaic, while patch-based tiling keeps local detail but loses global structure. PhotoQuilt resolves this with a bootstrapped tiled denoising procedure. We first produce a global composition at low resolution to fix the layout, then upscale it in latent space and re-inject noise to restore generative capacity. Denoising proceeds within fixed tiles, so each forms its own image while the shared global structure holds them in one layout. Because tile generation is handled separately, PhotoQuilt scales to large canvases without quadratic attention cost. Experiments show that PhotoQuilt outperforms current baselines on both global structure and local realism.

title: Local Gevrey regularity and Quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature for PDEs parameterized on non-compact domains
authors: Dinh Dũng, Tùng Lê, Alexey Chernov
abstract: We establish local Gevrey regularity for the weak solution to parametric divergence-form diffusion elliptic PDEs, assuming the diffusion coefficient itself possesses local Gevrey parametric regularity over a non-compact domain. Here "local Gevrey regularity" means that the regularity is determined in a neighborhood of each parametric point and depends on that point. Explicit bounds on parametric derivatives of the weak solution are proved in the $H^1$-norm. Building on this local Gevrey framework, we develop a novel theoretical treatment of the dimension truncation error for infinite-dimensional integration. We prove convergence rates of quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature for the finite-dimensional Gaussian-weighted integration of integrands having local Gevrey regularity. Together with the finite element discretization error, the errors arising from dimension truncation and quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature yield a complete error analysis and convergence rates for the fully discrete approximation of a bounded linear functional of the weak solution. Numerical experiments confirming the theoretical convergence rates are presented.

title: A Tunable Incentive Mechanism for Binary Aggregation Without Verification
authors: Chien-Chih Chen, Wojciech Golab
abstract: Binary aggregation without verifiable ground truth arises when agents' reports must be aggregated without access to gold-standard labels. This paper studies a tunable reward--penalty mechanism for binary aggregation without verification. Agents choose between a conforming strategy, which reports an informative private signal, and a non-conforming strategy, which follows a deterministic prior-informed report rule. For this mechanism, we derive cost-adjusted sufficient conditions for incentive compatibility and individual rationality as bounds on the reward--penalty ratio. The analysis identifies feasible ratio regions, cases in which ratio adjustment restores feasibility, and parameter regimes in which no ratio satisfies both constraints under the modeled construction. We also state a conditional all-conforming Nash equilibrium result within the restricted strategy set. Entropy-based scaling and stake-weighted redistribution are treated as extensions, with stake-weighted redistribution inducing agent-specific incentive constraints. Numerical checks support the closed-form Tier 1 quantities and illustrate threshold sensitivity.

title: AgentBound: Verifiable Behavioral Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
authors: Anuj Kaul, Qianlong Lan, Pranay Gupta
abstract:
Autonomous AI agents increasingly perform consequential actions on behalf of human principals, including financial transactions, external communications, and enterprise workflows. Existing agent infrastructure relies on identity federation and delegated authorization to authenticate workloads and control resource access, but it cannot determine whether an authorized action should be executed under the current behavioral and operational context.
  We present AgentBound, a runtime governance framework that provides verifiable behavioral oversight for autonomous AI agents. AgentBound evaluates each proposed action using three independent authorities: delegated authorization, owner-signed behavioral constitutions, and site action contracts. Their judgments are conservatively composed through a formal decision model to determine whether an action should be permitted, reviewed, or denied before execution.
  To provide accountability, AgentBound generates cryptographically verifiable governance receipts that bind every action to the exact delegation, policy, and semantic artifacts governing the decision, enabling independent replay verification and policy provenance. The framework also introduces standing delegation for long-running agents, allowing periodic workloads to operate under continuously refreshed governance policies while preserving revocability and bounded authority.
  We present the formal foundation, system architecture, governance receipt protocol, and AgentBound-Bench, a benchmark framework for evaluating governance correctness, authority composition, and accountability. Rather than replacing model alignment, AgentBound complements it by providing a deterministic governance layer between authorization and execution, transforming governance from a process that must be trusted into one that can be independently verified.

title: From Propositional to Perceptual Asymmetry: Extending Frictive Policy Optimization to Asymmetric Partial Information Dialogue
authors: Yifan Zhu, Kyeongmin Rim, James Pustejovsky
abstract: Frictive Policy Optimization (FPO; Pustejovsky et al., 2025) treats friction in collaborative dialogue -- misalignment, misunderstanding, repair -- as an epistemic signal essential to common-ground construction, rather than noise to be minimized. However, FPO and its implementations assume shared perceptual contexts, where friction arises from differently interpreted propositions over the same scene, which we define as propositional asymmetry. We extend FPO to perceptual asymmetry, where participants hold asymmetric partial information and the same referring expression yields different denotations depending on whose information state grounds the reference. We evaluate this through cross-corpora analysis and LLM probing on referentially asymmetric dialogue tasks, primarily the HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991). We find that FPO's friction functional is empirically valid only when evaluated from within each participant's information horizon: different landmark configurations produce qualitatively distinct grounding failure modes, with a small class of ambiguous configurations driving a disproportionate share of misunderstandings through trajectories that appear successful but silently diverge. The LLM probe confirms that having the "right perspective" matters more than having all perspectives: the informed single viewpoint outperforms omniscient access to both participants' contexts. We propose two annotation refinements: subtype decomposition of pending grounding states and accommodation-aware alignment classification.
comment: 11 pages. To appear in Proceedings of SIGDIAL 2026

title: Ethics and Social Responsibility in AI-Assisted Interviewing: An LLM-in-the-Loop Study of AI-Generated Follow-Up Questions
authors: He Zhang, Yueyan Liu, Xin Guan, Jie Cai, John M. Carroll
abstract: Semi-structured interviews rely on timely, context-sensitive follow-up questions, yet interviewers' cognitive load and limited domain familiarity can constrain probing depth. We report findings from an LLM-in-the-loop Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) study that simulates an AI follow-up assistant in live interviewing while preserving human oversight. In our setup, a co-interviewer selectively relayed and could edit AI-generated follow-up questions (AGQs) produced in real time by GPT-4o, enabling a realistic approximation of deployment without fully automating the interaction. Across 17 interviewers with varied qualitative-method expertise, participants raised five interlocking concerns: (1) harmful or discriminatory language and unpredictable interaction harms, (2) undermining interviewees' sense of respect through divided attention and missing nonverbal cues, (3) technology-based participation inequality, (4) unclear responsibility when harms occur, and (5) privacy, disclosure, and compliance risks when AI listens, records, or transcribes sensitive content. We translate these concerns into design and governance implications for safer, more respectful, and more accountable AI-assisted interviewing.
comment: This work has been accepted to CHIWORK '26

title: When Regulation Has Memory: Hysteresis and Control Burden in Artificial Agency
authors: Veronique Ziegler
abstract:
Adaptive agents are usually judged by what they do, but an agent can appear stable while the internal effort required to keep it stable is increasing. This hidden regulatory burden matters for artificial agents operating under noise, delay, or changing demands: two systems may reach similar internal states while one requires much more corrective control to get there.
  Here, we study whether that burden depends on history. Using a computational model of adaptive uncertainty regulation, we drive an artificial agent through a continuous change in its uncertainty target and then reverse the change without resetting the agent. This creates a simple test for carryover: does the controller respond only to the current target, or does the path by which the agent reached that target still matter?
  The simulations show a clear history-dependent effect. The adaptive gain required to regulate the agent forms a reproducible hysteresis loop, meaning that the same target can require different levels of control depending on whether the agent is moving toward or returning from a more demanding regime. The timing of regulation also matters. When stabilization is available before disturbance exposure, the agent generally requires less adaptive gain than when it can only recover after disturbance has already acted.
  The state-level coherence measure also shows path dependence, but the timing effect is much clearer in regulatory gain. The main difference is therefore not that anticipatory regulation produces a completely different state. Rather, it reaches comparable regulated behavior with lower modeled control demand. These results suggest that adaptive agents should be evaluated not only by whether they remain organized, but by how much regulation they must recruit to do so.

title: Towards Critical IR Theories and Practices
authors: Bhaskar Mitra
abstract: Belkin and Robertson urged us, half a century ago, to develop a theoretical foundation for understanding what constitutes societal good that can inform information retrieval (IR) research and serve as a basis for determining when we should limit our scientific inquiry in the face of demands that are contradictory to societal good. In this article, I argue that to achieve this, IR should embrace critical theories and practices in our work, and shift away from the dominant liberal frame through which much of the IR community today view societal concerns in context of our research. Unlike the liberal frame, the critical frame explicitly adopts nondomination as its stated goal which can clarify our conceptualization of societal good within the field, provide necessary theoretical underpinning that Belkin and Robertson urged the community to develop, and serve as a basis for critical appraisals of our progress in enacting desired societal change.

title: GPU-First Heisenberg-Picture Tensor Network Dynamics for the 2D Transverse-Field Ising Model
authors: Paolo D'Alberto
abstract: We present CppSim, a C++/GPU 2D Ising simulator for Heisenberg-picture tensor network time evolution on GPUs. The key computational contributions are: first, a zero-malloc GPU workspace that pre-allocates all buffers at startup; second, a custom GPU tensor permutation kernel replacing host-side index shuffling with a pure device-to-device operation, yielding a 7.6x trotter speedup; third, a hybrid QR strategy selecting Cholesky-QR for tall-skinny matrices and Householder-QR otherwise; fourth, adaptive Belief Propagation with log-space Bethe partition function evaluation and explicit sign tracking.
zh_title: 针对二维横场伊辛模型的GPU优先海森堡绘景张量网络动力学
translation: 我们展示了CppSim，这是一个用于在GPU上进行海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器。其关键的计算贡献包括：第一，在启动时预分配所有缓冲区的零内存分配（zero-malloc）GPU工作空间；第二，一个自定义的GPU张量排列内核，它用纯设备到设备的操作取代了主机端的索引改组，实现了7.6倍的Trotter加速；第三，一种混合QR策略，对高瘦矩阵选择Cholesky-QR，对其他矩阵则选择Householder-QR；第四，具有对数空间Bethe配分函数评估和显式符号跟踪的自适应信念传播。
tldr: 本文介绍了CppSim，一个高效的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器，通过零内存分配、自定义张量排列核（实现7.6倍加速）、混合QR策略和自适应信念传播，实现了GPU上高性能的海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化。
ai_comments: 该论文针对二维横场伊辛模型的张量网络模拟进行了深度的GPU底层优化。其创新点在于将多种高性能计算（HPC）技术（如零内存分配、硬件级张量排列、混合QR算法）与物理算法（海森堡绘景、信念传播）有机结合。尤其是7.6倍的Trotter加速，展示了定制化GPU内核在张量网络收缩和排列中的巨大潜力。局限性在于该方法目前主要针对二维伊辛模型，其向更通用、更复杂的张量网络拓扑结构的推广能力还有待在未来工作中进一步验证。
motivation: 旨在开发一种高效的、GPU优先的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器（CppSim），用于在GPU上进行海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化，以克服传统模拟在计算效率和内存管理上的瓶颈。
method: 提出了CppSim模拟器，其关键计算贡献包括：1) 启动时预分配所有缓冲区的零内存分配（zero-malloc）GPU工作空间；2) 自定义GPU张量排列内核，将主机端索引改组替换为纯设备到设备的物理操作；3) 针对高瘦矩阵选择Cholesky-QR、其余选择Householder-QR的混合QR策略；4) 具有对数空间Bethe配分函数评估和显式符号跟踪的自适应信念传播（Belief Propagation）。
results: 成功开发了CppSim模拟器，其中自定义的GPU张量排列内核将主机端索引改组替换为纯设备到设备的操作，实现了7.6倍的Trotter加速。
conclusion: CppSim通过一系列针对GPU架构优化的计算策略，为二维伊辛模型的海森堡绘景张量网络动力学模拟提供了一个极具性能优势的高效解决方案。

title: The Organizational Behavior of Agentic AI: Collective Intelligence in Human-Agent Workflows
authors: Canhui Liu
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed not as a single assistant but as a collective of planners, solvers, reviewers, memory managers, tool users, and orchestrators. These systems are entering organisational workflows under familiar labels such as teams, managers, committees, markets, and workflows. This article asks whether such agent collectives exhibit organisational behaviour in a sense that is analytically comparable to, yet distinct from, human organisational behaviour. I argue that agentic AI is a partial organisational analogue. It resembles a human organisation because it differentiates work, coordinates interdependence, performs recurrent routines, crosses boundaries, and produces collective outcomes. It differs because these patterns are not sustained by motivation, identity, trust, employment, socialisation, or moral accountability. They are sustained by context architecture: prompts, memory, traces, schemas, tools, validators, and permissions. The article develops contextual transaction cost as the central mechanism linking these similarities and differences. Computational theorising, synthetic task simulations, real LLM agent traces, and robustness analyses show that human-imitation forms often underperform when they add lossy handoffs, correlated deliberation, and verification burdens, whereas shared-state and adaptive forms perform better when they make context durable, inspectable, and task-contingent. The article contributes to organisation studies by theorising agentic AI as an emerging object of organising and by specifying the interface conditions under which human and agentic organisational behaviour can jointly support collective intelligence.
zh_title: 代理AI的组织行为：人机工作流中的集体智慧
translation: 代理人工智能（Agentic AI）正越来越多地被部署，它不仅是单一的助手，而是由规划者、解决者、审查者、内存管理者、工具使用者和协调者组成的集体。这些系统正以团队、经理、委员会、市场和工作流等熟悉的标签进入组织工作流。本文探讨了这些代理集体是否表现出在分析上与人类组织行为具有可比性但又有所不同的组织行为。作者认为，代理AI是一种部分组织的模拟物。它类似于人类组织，因为它区分工作、协调相互依赖关系、执行循环例程、跨越边界并产生集体成果。但它的不同之处在于，这些模式并不是由动机、身份、信任、雇佣、社会化或道德责任来维持的。相反，它们是由上下文架构（提示词、内存、追踪、模式、工具、验证器和权限）维持的。本文开发了“上下文交易成本”作为联系这些相似性和差异性的核心机制。计算理论化、合成任务模拟、真实的LLM代理追踪和稳健性分析表明，当模仿人类的形式增加有损交接、相关联的审议和验证负担时，它们往往表现不佳；而当共享状态和自适应形式使上下文具有持久性、可检查性和任务依赖性时，它们的表现更好。本文通过将代理AI理论化为一个新兴的组织对象，并指定了人类和代理组织行为可以共同支持集体智慧的接口条件，从而对组织研究做出了贡献。
tldr: 本文探讨了代理AI集体的组织行为，指出其由“上下文架构”而非人类社会机制维持，并表明共享状态和自适应的AI组织形式比模仿人类的形式表现更好。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于跨学科地将传统组织行为学（OB）理论应用于多智能体（Multi-Agent）系统，提出了“上下文交易成本”这一核心机制，以解释AI集体行为与人类组织行为的异同。这一研究对于未来设计高效的人机协同工作流具有重要的理论和实践指导意义。其局限性可能在于，目前的结论主要依赖于计算理论、合成模拟和LLM追踪，在真实人类组织中的长期实证效果仍待进一步验证。
motivation: 随着代理AI以团队、经理、委员会等形式被部署到组织工作流中，本文旨在探讨这些代理集体是否表现出在分析上与人类组织行为可比但又有所不同的组织行为。
method: 本文提出了“上下文交易成本”（contextual transaction cost）作为连接人机组织行为异同的核心机制，并采用了计算理论化、合成任务模拟、真实的LLM代理追踪以及稳健性分析等方法进行研究。
results: 研究表明，模仿人类组织形式的AI集体在增加有损交接、相关联的审议和验证负担时往往表现不佳；相反，共享状态（shared-state）和自适应（adaptive）的形式在使上下文具有持久性、可检查性和任务依赖性时表现更好。
conclusion: 代理AI是人类组织的部分模拟物，通过将代理AI理论化为一种新兴的组织对象，并明确人类与代理组织行为共同支持集体智慧的接口条件，为组织研究做出了重要贡献。

title: Multisensory Continual Learning: Adapting Pretrained Visuomotor Policies to Force
authors: Jaden Clark, Changhao Wang, Yihuai Gao, Seongheon Hong, Hojung Choi, Mark Cutkosky, Yifan Hou, Shuran Song
abstract: Robot manipulation often relies on sensory feedback beyond vision, particularly in contact-rich settings where force, tactile, or audio signals reveal interaction states that are not directly observable from images. However, these modalities are often hardware- and task-specific, and large-scale multisensory robot datasets remain scarce. As a result, it is impractical to pretrain policies with every sensor they may encounter. We study multisensory continual learning: adapting a pretrained robot policy to new tasks with newly introduced modalities while preserving performance under the original sensor suite. We propose MuSe, which incorporates limited multisensory data into pretrained vision-only policies through multi-stage fusion, multisensory future prediction, and experience replay over pretraining data. We instantiate MuSe by augmenting a pretrained vision-only policy with force-torque sensing and evaluate it on real-world manipulation tasks. Our experiments show that MuSe performs strongly on contact-rich finetuning tasks while preserving, and in some cases improving, performance on the original pretraining tasks. These results suggest that a modest multisensory dataset can improve general robot capabilities beyond the finetuning distribution. Project website: https://jadenvc.github.io/multisensory-continual-learning/
zh_title: 多模态持续学习：使预训练的视觉运动策略适应力反馈
translation: 机器人操作通常依赖于视觉之外的感官反馈，特别是在接触密集的场景中，力、触觉或音频信号可以揭示图像中无法直接观察到的交互状态。然而，这些模态通常是特定于硬件和任务的，且大规模的多感官机器人数据集仍然稀缺。因此，用机器人可能遇到的每种传感器来预训练策略是不切实际的。我们研究了多感官持续学习：使预训练的机器人策略适应引入新模态的新任务，同时保持在原始传感器套件下的性能。我们提出了 MuSe，它通过多阶段融合、多感官未来预测以及在预训练数据上的经验回放，将有限的多感官数据融入到预训练的纯视觉策略中。我们通过用六维力矩感知增强预训练的纯视觉策略来实例化 MuSe，并在真实世界的操控任务中对其进行评估。我们的实验表明，MuSe 在接触密集的微调任务上表现强劲，同时保留（在某些情况下甚至提高）了在原始预训练任务上的性能。这些结果表明，一个适度的多感官数据集可以提高超出微调分布的通用机器人能力。
tldr: 本文提出了MuSe，一种通过多阶段融合、未来预测和经验回放将力矩传感器等新模态融入预训练视觉策略的持续学习方法，在提升接触密集型任务表现的同时保留了原有任务的能力。
ai_comments: 该论文切中了当前机器人具身智能领域的一个重要痛点：多模态数据的稀缺性与硬件多变性。其创新点在于将持续学习引入多感官策略微调中，不仅解决了新模态（如力觉）的引入问题，还通过经验回放避免了灾难性遗忘。局限性在于，目前仅在视觉和力觉融合上进行了实机验证，对于更多模态（如听觉、触觉阵列）的扩展效果以及异构传感器的兼容性还有待进一步探索。
motivation: 机器人操作通常需要视觉以外的感官反馈（如力、触觉、声音），但这些模态具有硬件和任务特异性，且大规模多模态机器人数据集稀缺，导致无法在预训练阶段就包含所有可能遇到的传感器。因此，需要研究如何让预训练机器人策略适应引入新模态的新任务，同时保持在原有传感器组合下的性能。
method: 提出MuSe框架，通过多阶段融合（multi-stage fusion）、多感官未来预测（multisensory future prediction）以及在预训练数据上的经验回放（experience replay），将有限的多感官数据整合到预训练的纯视觉策略中。在实验中，通过为预训练的纯视觉策略增加力矩感知来进行实例化。
results: 在真实世界的操作任务中进行评估，结果表明MuSe在接触密集的微调任务上表现强劲，同时保留（甚至在某些情况下提高了）在原始预训练任务上的性能。
conclusion: 适度的多感官数据集不仅能使策略适应新模态任务，还可以提高超出微调分布范围的通用机器人能力。

title: Wait, am I Being Fair? Characterizing Deductive Stereotyping and Mitigating It with Fair-GCG
authors: Naihao Deng, Yilun Zhu, Joan Nwatu, Clayton Scott, Rada Mihalcea
abstract: Warning: This paper contains several toxic and offensive statements. While reasoning generally improves fairness in recent large language models (LLMs), failures persist. In this work, we identify a failure mode, deductive stereotyping, in which models apply population-level statistical regularities to individual cases, producing logically coherent yet socially biased inferences. We provide a statistical interpretation of this phenomenon. To steer models toward fairness-aware reasoning, we propose a reasoning-time injection framework. We further introduce Fair-GCG to systematically discover effective injection phrases. Injection phrases discovered by Fair-GCG improve performance across multiple fairness benchmarks, generalize from smaller to larger LLMs, improves reasoning-level fairness, reduces bias in open-ended generation, and transfer to real-world fairness-sensitive tasks.
zh_title: 等等，我是公平的吗？刻画演绎刻板印象并使用 Fair-GCG 进行缓解
translation: 警告：本文包含一些有毒和冒犯性的言论。虽然推理通常能提高最新大型语言模型（LLM）的公平性，但失效情况依然存在。在这项工作中，我们确定了一种失效模式，即演绎刻板印象（deductive stereotyping），在这种模式中，模型将群体层面的统计规律应用于个体案例，从而产生逻辑上连贯但具有社会偏见的推论。我们对这一现象提供了统计学解释。为了引导模型进行公平感知推理，我们提出了一种推理时注入框架。我们进一步引入了 Fair-GCG，以系统地发现有效的注入短语。由 Fair-GCG 发现的注入短语提高了在多个公平性基准上的性能，实现了从较小 LLM 到较大 LLM 的泛化，提高了推理层面的公平性，减少了开放式生成中的偏见，并能迁移到现实世界中对公平敏感的任务。
tldr: 本文定义了大型语言模型中的“演绎刻板印象”这一失效模式，并提出了 Fair-GCG 框架，通过在推理阶段注入短语来引导模型进行公平感知推理，显著降低了社会偏见。
ai_comments: 本文敏锐地捕捉到了大语言模型在进行逻辑推理时可能产生的“演绎刻板印象”这一隐蔽偏见，并从统计学角度给出了合理解释。提出的 Fair-GCG 框架通过在推理时注入特定短语来引导公平性，是一种轻量且实用的缓解方案，具有很强的泛化能力和实际应用价值。
motivation: 尽管推理通常能提高大语言模型（LLM）的公平性，但偏见失效依然存在。作者旨在识别并解决一种被称为“演绎刻板印象”的失效模式，即模型将群体层面的统计规律错误地应用于个体案例，从而产生逻辑连贯但带有社会偏见的推论。
method:
1. 提供了演绎刻板印象（deductive stereotyping）的统计学解释。
2. 提出了一种推理时注入框架（reasoning-time injection framework）来引导模型进行公平感知推理。
3. 引入了 Fair-GCG 方法，用于系统性地发现能有效引导公平推理的注入短语。
results: Fair-GCG 发现的注入短语在多个公平性基准上提高了性能，能够从较小的 LLM 泛化到较大的 LLM，提高了推理层面的公平性，减少了开放式生成中的偏见，并能成功迁移到现实世界中对公平敏感的任务中。
conclusion: 提出的 Fair-GCG 框架和推理时注入方法能有效缓解大语言模型中的演绎刻板印象，提升模型在多种任务和基准上的公平性表现。

title: Measuring Judgment Quality in Natural-Language Explanations: Evidence from Forecasting Tournaments
authors: Christopher W. Karvetski, Sheldon S. Huang, Simas Kučinskas, Nadja Flechner, Jingyu Hu, Philip Tetlock, Ezra Karger
abstract: Decision-makers routinely rely on expert judgments accompanied by written explanations, yet explanation quality is difficult to measure at scale. Forecasting tournaments offer a natural testing ground: probabilistic judgments are paired with natural-language rationales and scored against realized outcomes. We introduce Explanation Quality Markers (EQMs), a set of sixty theory-guided reasoning patterns scored by large language models (LLMs). In a pre-registered analysis of over 55,000 forecast-rationale pairs from a multiyear forecasting tournament, EQMs predict accuracy at both the forecast and forecaster levels, consistently outperforming pre-LLM text-analysis methods. More than 90% of statistically significant pattern-level EQM-accuracy correlations match our directional hypotheses. The signal is asymmetric: EQMs identify likely underperformers more reliably than they distinguish the very best forecasters. Benchmarked against traditional indicators of forecasting skill, EQMs are the strongest predictor at the forecast level and competitive at the forecaster level, though weaker than prior accuracy. Human ratings of rationale quality are less consistently correlated with accuracy and place disproportionate weight on rationale length. Results transfer to an independent forecasting study. EQMs provide a scalable, interpretable method for extracting judgment-relevant information from written explanations.
zh_title: 衡量自然语言解释中的判断质量：来自预测竞赛的证据
translation: 决策者通常依赖附带书面解释的专家判断，但解释的质量难以进行大规模衡量。预测竞赛提供了一个天然的试验场：概率判断与自然语言理由相匹配，并根据实际结果进行评分。我们引入了解释质量标记（EQMs），这是一套由大型语言模型（LLMs）评分的、包含60个理论指导推理模式的指标。在对来自多年预测竞赛的55,000多个“预测-理由”对进行的预注册分析中，EQMs在预测和预测者层面上均能预测准确性，且持续优于大模型之前的文本分析方法。超过90%的具有统计学意义的模式级EQM与准确性相关性符合我们的方向性假设。这种信号是不对称的：EQMs识别可能表现不佳者的可靠性，高于其区分极优秀预测者的可靠性。与传统的预测技能指标相比，EQMs在预测层面是首要的预测指标，在预测者层面也具有竞争力，尽管弱于先前的准确性历史。人类对理由质量的评分与准确性的相关性较弱，且过度关注理由的长度。研究结果可推广至一项独立的预测研究。EQMs提供了一种可扩展、可解释的方法，用于从书面解释中提取与判断相关的信息。
tldr: 本研究提出了一套基于大语言模型的解释质量标记（EQMs），能够比传统方法和人类更准确、更具规模地通过专家的书面理由来预测其预测的准确性。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于利用大语言模型（LLM）自动评估理论指导的推理模式（EQMs），从而解决了长期以来专家书面解释质量难以大规模量化评估的难题。其重要性在于，通过预测竞赛的客观结果验证了该评估方法的有效性，并揭示了人类评估（倾向于偏好冗长文本）的局限性。局限性在于，该方法在识别“表现不佳者”时比识别“顶尖预测者”更为可靠，说明其在筛选极少数最优决策时可能存在一定的局限性。
motivation: 决策者在日常工作中高度依赖专家的书面解释，但在大规模场景下，如何客观、量化地衡量这些解释的质量一直是一个难题。预测竞赛由于能将概率判断、自然语言理由与实际结果进行对比，提供了一个理想的测试平台。
method: 引入了解释质量标记（EQMs），这是一套包含60个由理论指导的推理模式的指标，并使用大语言模型（LLMs）进行评分。研究对一项多年预测竞赛中超过55,000个“预测-理由”对进行了预注册分析，并在一项独立的预测研究中进行了交叉验证。
results:
1. EQMs在预测和预测者两个层面上均能有效预测准确性，且持续优于LLM出现前的传统文本分析方法；
2. 超过90%的显著相关性符合研究团队的方向性假设；
3. 信号具有不对称性，EQMs识别潜在表现不佳者的可靠性高于区分最优秀预测者；
4. 在预测层面，EQMs是比传统指标更强的预测器，在预测者层面也具有竞争力；
5. 相比之下，人类对解释质量的评分与实际准确性的相关性较弱，且过度看重解释的长度。
conclusion: EQMs提供了一种可扩展且具有可解释性的方法，能够有效从书面解释中提取出与决策判断质量高度相关的信息，具有良好的跨研究推广性。

title: Estimating Supply Incrementality in Two-sided Marketplaces: A Causal Machine Learning Approach
authors: Yufei Wu, Daniel Schmierer, Dan Zylberglejd
abstract: In two-sided marketplaces with heterogeneous products, it is important to understand the causal relationship between additional supply and marketplace outcomes, such as the total quantity transacted or transaction value in the marketplace. This paper studies a causal machine learning approach to estimating this relationship across product segments. We use the Airbnb marketplace as an example, focusing on the impact of additional listing supply on total bookings, but the methodology applies to other two-sided marketplaces. Our approach combines double/debiased machine learning with a hierarchical Bayesian framework that leverages pre-existing knowledge as priors. We construct tractable and informative features for the model by leveraging measures of product segment similarity from the geospatial literature. We find that such a model provides plausible estimates of the marketplace returns to additional supply and strong out of sample performance.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the KDD 2025 Workshop on Causal Inference and Machine Learning in Practice (not presented)
zh_title: 评估双边市场中的供给增量：一种因果机器学习方法
translation: 在具有异质性产品的双边市场中，理解新增供给与市场结果（例如市场中的总交易量或交易价值）之间的因果关系至关重要。本文研究了一种因果机器学习方法，用于估计跨产品细分市场的这种关系。我们以Airbnb市场为例，重点关注新增房源供给对总预订量的影响，但该方法同样适用于其他双边市场。我们的方法将双重/去偏机器学习与利用预先存在知识作为先验的分层贝叶斯框架相结合。我们通过利用地理空间文献中的产品细分相似性度量，为模型构建了易于处理且信息丰富的特征。我们发现，该模型对新增供给带来的市场回报提供了合理的估计，并表现出强大的样本外性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合双重机器学习与分层贝叶斯框架的因果推断方法，用于评估Airbnb等双边市场中新增供给对总交易量的因果效应。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将先进的因果推断方法（双重机器学习）与分层贝叶斯框架结合，并巧妙地引入地理空间相似性度量来构建特征，从而解决了双边市场中异质性产品供给对整体市场产生溢出或替代效应的评估难题。局限性在于，其特征构建高度依赖于地理空间属性，对于非地理位置主导的虚拟双边市场，其特征提取方法可能需要重新设计。
motivation: 在拥有异质性产品的双边市场中，准确评估新增供给与市场最终结果（如总交易量或交易价值）之间的因果关系至关重要。
method: 结合了双重/去偏机器学习（Double/Debiased Machine Learning）与分层贝叶斯框架（利用既有知识作为先验），并通过引入地理空间文献中的产品细分相似性度量来构建易于处理且信息丰富的特征。
results: 在Airbnb市场（评估新增房源对总预订量的影响）的实际应用中，该模型提供了对新增供给市场回报的合理估计，并展现出优异的样本外预测性能。
conclusion: 该因果机器学习方法能够对双边市场中新增供给带来的回报提供合理的估计，具有强大的样本外性能，并可推广至其他异质性产品的双边市场。

title: Multistage Defer Trees for Hybrid Interpretability: If at First You Can't Succeed, Tree Again
authors: Zakk Heile, Hayden McTavish, Margo Seltzer, Cynthia Rudin
abstract: Recent work has shown that well-optimized individual decision trees can match complex black box models in some settings, primarily in noisy domains. For the remaining settings, however, complex ensembled compositions of trees often achieve higher accuracy at the cost of interpretability, leaving practitioners with difficult modeling decisions along an accuracy-interpretability tradeoff. Ideally, we would like to classify as much of the data as possible with one or a small number of trees, achieving interpretability for most samples while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy. We introduce Multistage Defer Trees: a sequence of sparse decision trees that each make predictions for most samples, while deferring a small proportion to the next tree in the sequence or, ultimately, to a black box. We demonstrate that we can train this model class to match the performance of complex tree-based ensembles while routing most samples through only one or a small number of sparse decision trees. We discuss a range of techniques for training these models while maintaining simplicity. Our method expands the accuracy--interpretability frontier in settings where single-tree methods remain insufficient, demonstrating that even when complex models are necessary, they need not be fully opaque.
zh_title: 用于混合可解释性的多阶段推迟树：如果起初无法成功，那就再次建树
translation: 最近的研究表明，在某些（主要是噪声）领域，经过良好优化的单个决策树可以与复杂的黑盒模型相媲美。然而，在其余场景中，复杂的集成树模型通常能获得更高的准确率，但代价是牺牲了可解释性，这使得从业者在准确率与可解释性的权衡中面临艰难的模型选择。理想情况下，我们希望用一个或少数几个树来对尽可能多的数据进行分类，从而在保持最先进准确率的同时，实现大多数样本的可解释性。我们引入了“多阶段推迟树”（Multistage Defer Trees）：这是一系列稀疏决策树，每个树对大多数样本进行预测，同时将一小部分样本推迟到序列中的下一个树，或者最终推迟到黑盒模型。我们证明了可以训练此类模型以匹配复杂集成树模型的性能，同时将大多数样本仅路由通过一个或少数几个稀疏决策树。我们讨论了在保持简单性的同时训练这些模型的一系列技术。在单树方法仍然不足的设置中，我们的方法扩展了准确率-可解释性的前沿，表明即使在必须使用复杂模型的情况下，它们也无需完全不透明。
tldr: 提出了一种“多阶段推迟树”方法，通过顺序连接稀疏决策树并在必要时推迟到黑盒模型，实现了在保持高准确率的同时提高大部分样本的可解释性。
ai_comments: 该方法极具创新性，巧妙地将“推迟（deferral）”机制引入到决策树序列中，实现了局部可解释性与全局高准确率的有机结合。其重要性在于为实际应用中面临的“准确率-可解释性”双重困境提供了一种实用的分流解决方案。局限性在于，摘要中未详细探讨推迟阈值的确定方法以及黑盒模型与树模型之间的协同训练难度，这可能在实际部署中带来额外的计算或调参开销。
motivation: 在非噪声领域中，复杂的集成模型虽然准确率高但缺乏可解释性，而单个决策树虽然可解释但准确率不足。研究者希望在保持高准确率的同时，让尽可能多的样本通过简单、可解释的树模型进行分类，从而在准确率和可解释性之间取得更好的权衡。
method: 提出“多阶段推迟树（Multistage Defer Trees）”。该方法由一系列稀疏决策树组成，每个树为大多数样本做出预测，而将一小部分难以分类的样本推迟（defer）到序列中的下一棵树，或者最终推迟到黑盒模型中。
results: 该模型能够达到与复杂集成树模型相匹配的性能，同时使大多数样本仅通过一个或少数几个稀疏决策树进行路由。
conclusion: 该方法拓展了在单树方法不足的场景下的“准确率-可解释性”前沿，证明了即使在必须使用复杂模型的情况下，模型也无需完全不透明。

title: A Three-Phase Foundation Model for Tax-Aware Personalized Portfolio Management
authors: Ramin Pishehvar
abstract: We present a three-phase deep reinforcement learning system for personalized portfolio management that addresses three limitations shared by all prior financial RL work: 1) ticker lock-in, 2) monolithic objectives , and 3) static user models. Phase 1 pretrains a ticker-identity-free cross asset encoder via self-supervised learning on a multi-asset corpus, augmented by a frozen parallel branch using Chronos, a T5-based time series foundation model, fused via a learned gating mechanism. To our knowledge, this is the first application of a time series foundation model to portfolio management RL. The encoder generalizes to any publicly traded asset via a 50-dimensional observable metadata vector that requires no retraining for new tickers. Phase 2 fine-tunes a MoE (Mixture of Experts) portfolio actor critic with PPO under an objective-conditioned reward that simultaneously serves six distinct investment goals sampled per episode: short-term alpha, short-term gain, long-term gain, capital preservation, tax-loss harvesting, and long-term-gains-only. A MoE architecture assigns each objective to a specialized expert head (momentum, growth, defensive, tax-aware), and a learned intent router blends experts based on the active objective and current market regime, which eliminates cross-objective gradient conflict. Phase 3 adds a lightweight personalization layer further adapted at inference time to each individual via a 76-parameter LoRA module fine-tuned on real brokerage transaction history, inferring investment objectives from revealed trading behavior rather than questionnaires. A natural language intent parser converts free-form goals directly into structured investment objective parameters.
zh_title: 考虑税务的个性化投资组合管理三阶段基础模型
translation: 我们提出了一个用于个性化投资组合管理的三阶段深度强化学习系统，该系统解决了先前所有金融强化学习工作所共有的三个局限性：1）股票代码锁定，2）单一目标，以及3）静态用户模型。第一阶段通过在多资产语料库上进行自监督学习，预训练一个无股票身份的跨资产编码器，并通过学习到的门控机制融合了一个使用Chronos（一种基于T5的时间序列基础模型）的冻结并行分支。据我们所知，这是时间序列基础模型在投资组合管理强化学习中的首次应用。该编码器通过一个50维的可观测元数据向量，可以泛化到任何公开交易的资产，而无需对新股票进行重新训练。第二阶段使用PPO算法在目标条件奖励下微调混合专家（MoE）投资组合Actor-Critic，该奖励同时服务于每个回合采样的六个不同投资目标：短期阿尔法、短期收益、长期收益、资本保护、税收损失收割和仅限长期收益。MoE架构将每个目标分配给专门的专家头（动量、增长、防御、税务意识），并且学习到的意图路由器根据活动目标和当前市场状态融合专家，从而消除了跨目标的梯度冲突。第三阶段添加了一个轻量级的个性化层，在推理时通过在真实经纪交易历史微调的76参数LoRA模块进一步适应每个个体，从显现的交易行为而非问卷中推断投资目标。自然语言意图解析器将自由形式的目标直接转换为结构化的投资目标参数。
tldr: 本文提出了一个三阶段深度强化学习系统，通过跨资产编码器、多目标混合专家（MoE）架构和LoRA个性化微调，实现了无资产绑定、多目标协同且具备税务意识的个性化投资组合管理。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将时间序列基础模型（Chronos）与强化学习结合应用于投资组合管理，并采用混合专家（MoE）架构解决多目标冲突，设计非常精巧。此外，利用LoRA进行轻量级用户个性化微调和自然语言解析器转换投资意图，极大地增强了模型在实际金融场景中的实用性与用户友好度。
motivation: 现有的金融强化学习（RL）方法存在三个主要局限性：股票代码锁定（ticker lock-in，无法泛化到新资产）、单一的目标函数（monolithic objectives，无法同时满足多种投资目标）以及静态的用户模型（static user models，无法根据用户行为动态调整）。
method:
提出一个三阶段深度强化学习系统：
1. 第一阶段：通过自监督学习在多资产语料库上预训练一个无股票身份的跨资产编码器，并融合了基于T5的时间序列基础模型Chronos；
2. 第二阶段：使用PPO算法在目标条件奖励下微调混合专家（MoE）投资组合Actor-Critic网络，利用意图路由器融合不同专家头以消除梯度冲突；
3. 第三阶段：通过在真实经纪交易历史微调的76参数LoRA模块添加轻量级个性化层，并使用自然语言意图解析器将自由形式的目标直接转换为结构化投资参数。
results: 该系统成功实现了无需重新训练即可泛化到任何公开交易资产的编码器；通过MoE架构消除了跨目标的梯度冲突；并能够直接从用户的真实交易行为（而非问卷）中推断投资目标，实现了自由形式语言到结构化投资目标的直接转换。摘要中未提及具体的数值实验结果。
conclusion: 该三阶段基础模型成功解决了先前金融强化学习在股票绑定、单一目标和静态用户模型上的局限，实现了一种高度灵活、可泛化、且具备税务意识和动态个性化的投资组合管理系统。

title: Ricci-Notation Tensor Framework for Numerical Algebraic Geometry via Any-Degree Unitary-Triangular Factorization
authors: Dileepan Joseph
abstract: The unitary-triangular (QR) factorization of linear algebra may be used to robustly and efficiently solve a linear system. Toward a comparable numerical method to solve a polynomial system of higher degree, this paper proposes an any-degree unitary-triangular (Qr) factorization, which for a degree-one system reduces to the QR factorization. The work develops a tensor framework, i.e., codesigned algebra and software, where polynomial system coefficients are represented by a vector-shaped sparse tensor, a multidimensional array whose number of Ricci-notation indices, called the tensor degree, equals the highest monomial degree of the system. With the proposed Qr factorization, the coefficient tensor decomposes into a product of unitary and triangular factors that, in general, also have Ricci-notation indices and sparse entries. The unitary factor defines a unitary transform, a generalization of the related linear algebra concept to tensor algebra, that can triangularize a polynomial system while preserving its solution set, whether zero- or positive-dimensional. The work extends the author's Ricci-notation tensor framework, providing new algebra and new software to model, construct, and factorize polynomial systems in this manner. After applying the approach to numerically triangularize two zero-dimensional systems, chosen for educational value, results are compared to the Gröbner-basis (GB) method for triangularizing polynomial systems symbolically. One problem is of degree three, with three equations and unknowns, and the other of degree two, with four equations and unknowns. Although it resembles GB triangularization, the proposed Qr factorization has a completely different pedigree associated with numerical methods.
zh_title: 通过任意度酉-三角分解的数值代数几何Ricci-符号张量框架
translation: 线性代数中的酉-三角（QR）分解可用于鲁棒高效地解决线性系统。为了获得一种可比较的数值方法来解决更高次的多项式系统，本文提出了一种任意度酉-三角（Qr）分解，对于一次系统，它退化为QR分解。这项工作开发了一个张量框架，即协同设计的代数和软件，其中多项式系统系数由向量形的稀疏张量表示，这是一个多维数组，其Ricci-符号索引的数量（称为张量度）等于系统的最高单项式次数。通过所提出的Qr分解，系数张量分解为酉因子和三角因子的乘积，这些因子通常也具有Ricci-符号索引和稀疏条目。酉因子定义了一个酉变换，是相关线性代数概念向张量代数的推广，它可以三角化多项式系统，同时保留其解集，无论是零维还是正维。这项工作扩展了作者的Ricci-符号张量框架，提供了新的代数和新的软件，以这种方式建模、构建和分解多项式系统。在将该方法应用于数值三角化两个为教育价值而选择的零维系统后，将结果与用于符号三角化多项式系统的Gröbner基（GB）方法进行了比较。一个问题是三次的，有三个方程和未知数，另一个是二次的，有四个方程和未知数。尽管它类似于GB三角化，但所提出的Qr分解具有与数值方法相关的完全不同的渊源。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于高次多项式系统的任意度酉-三角（Qr）分解，并开发了一个Ricci-符号张量框架，以数值三角化多项式系统，其结果与Gröbner基方法进行了比较。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入任意度酉-三角分解和Ricci-符号张量框架，为数值代数几何提供了一种新颖的数值方法来处理高次多项式系统。其创新点在于将线性代数中的QR分解推广到任意次多项式，并将其整合到张量代数中。这可能为解决传统符号方法计算复杂的问题开辟新途径，尤其是在大规模或高次多项式系统中具有潜在应用价值。
motivation: 为了解决高次多项式系统，需要一种可与线性代数中的QR分解相媲美的鲁棒高效的数值方法。
method: 论文提出了一种任意度酉-三角（Qr）分解，它将多项式系统系数表示为向量形的稀疏张量。此张量通过Qr分解为酉因子和三角因子，酉因子定义了一个酉变换，可以三角化多项式系统并保留其解集。该方法扩展了Ricci-符号张量框架，提供了新的代数和软件。
results: 该方法成功应用于数值三角化两个零维系统，并将结果与符号三角化Gröbner基（GB）方法进行了比较。尽管与GB三角化相似，但Qr分解具有完全不同的数值方法渊源。
conclusion: 本文提出的任意度酉-三角（Qr）分解及其Ricci-符号张量框架为数值代数几何提供了一种新的方法，能够数值三角化多项式系统，其性能与Gröbner基方法进行了对比验证。

title: Dense Structural Priors for Sparse Functional Landmark Localization in Surgical Videos
authors: Chenyan Jing, Hao Ding, Lalithkumar Seenivasan, Jacob M. Delgado López, Mathias Unberath
abstract: Vision foundation models such as SAM 3 can provide transferable object-level structure across diverse surgical video conditions, but segmentation outputs do not explicitly encode the action-conditioned semantics that define functional surgical landmarks. Estimating instrument extent and geometry differs from localizing the tip or anchor relevant to clipping, grasping, or dissecting. We investigate vision foundation model-enabled sparse action-aware landmark localization, using zero-shot, point-prompted structural masks to provide dense instrument-level context without manual pixel-level mask annotations. We propose a lightweight refinement framework that uses SAM 3 as a structural prior. A coarse multi-frame network predicts tip and anchor prompts, generating non-oracle masks that are fused with visual and heatmap features to refine functional landmark predictions. We compare direct mask-augmented supervision, prediction-derived mask-prior refinement, and auxiliary mask supervision to examine how vision foundation model-derived structure should enter a precision-oriented localization system. Experiments on 7,867 clips from 60 surgical videos spanning YouTube, Cholec80, HeiChole, SurgVU, and CRCD evaluate the approach under heterogeneous conditions. Without manual pixel-level mask annotations for training, the proposed model achieves overall F1 scores of 72.4% for tip and 58.0% for anchor localization. Directly imposing masks on heatmap targets biases learning toward broad tool regions, whereas prediction-derived priors and auxiliary supervision provide effective intermediate structural guidance for action-dependent landmark prediction.
zh_title: 密集结构先验用于手术视频中稀疏功能性地标定位
translation: 视觉基础模型（如SAM 3）可以在不同的手术视频条件下提供可迁移的物体级结构，但分割输出并未明确编码定义功能性手术地标的动作条件语义。估计器械的范围和几何形状不同于定位与夹持、抓取或解剖相关的尖端或锚点。我们研究了由视觉基础模型支持的稀疏动作感知地标定位，使用零样本、点提示的结构掩码来提供密集的器械级上下文，而无需手动像素级掩码标注。我们提出了一个轻量级的细化框架，使用SAM 3作为结构先验。一个粗略的多帧网络预测尖端和锚点提示，生成非预言掩码，这些掩码与视觉和热图特征融合以细化功能性地标预测。我们比较了直接掩码增强监督、预测衍生掩码先验细化和辅助掩码监督，以检查视觉基础模型衍生的结构应如何进入面向精度的定位系统。在涵盖YouTube、Cholec80、HeiChole、SurgVU和CRCD的60个手术视频中的7,867个片段上进行的实验评估了该方法在异构条件下的表现。在没有手动像素级掩码标注训练的情况下，所提出的模型在尖端定位方面取得了72.4%的F1分数，在锚点定位方面取得了58.0%的F1分数。直接将掩码强加到热图目标上会使学习偏向广泛的工具区域，而预测衍生的先验和辅助监督为动作依赖的地标预测提供了有效的中间结构指导。
tldr: 本文提出一个轻量级框架，利用视觉基础模型（如SAM 3）作为结构先验，通过零样本、点提示的结构掩码，实现手术视频中动作感知的功能性地标（尖端和锚点）的精确稀疏定位，无需手动像素级掩码标注。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将强大的视觉基础模型（如SAM 3）引入到手术视频的功能性地标定位任务中，并巧妙地利用其生成的零样本结构掩码作为“密集结构先验”，从而避免了传统方法中对大量像素级手动标注的需求。这种方法在保持高精度的同时，显著降低了数据标注成本，对于手术导航和自动化具有重要意义。文章还探讨了不同结构先验集成方式的有效性，为未来的研究提供了指导。
motivation: 视觉基础模型（如SAM 3）提供物体级结构，但其分割输出不显式编码定义功能性手术地标的动作条件语义。例如，估计器械范围和几何形状与定位与夹持、抓取或解剖相关的尖端或锚点不同。因此，需要一种方法来利用这些基础模型的结构信息，同时实现对功能性地标的精确、动作感知的定位，而无需昂贵的手动像素级掩码标注。
method: 本文提出了一个轻量级细化框架，使用SAM 3作为结构先验。该框架利用零样本、点提示的结构掩码提供密集器械级上下文，无需手动像素级掩码标注。一个粗略的多帧网络预测尖端和锚点提示，生成非预言（non-oracle）掩码。这些掩码与视觉和热图特征融合，以细化功能性地标预测。研究了直接掩码增强监督、预测衍生掩码先验细化和辅助掩码监督三种方式，来探讨视觉基础模型衍生的结构如何应用于面向精度的定位系统。
results: 在包含YouTube、Cholec80、HeiChole、SurgVU和CRCD的60个手术视频中的7,867个片段上进行了实验。在没有手动像素级掩码标注训练的情况下，所提出的模型在尖端定位方面取得了72.4%的F1分数，在锚点定位方面取得了58.0%的F1分数。结果表明，直接将掩码强加到热图目标上会导致学习偏向广泛的工具区域，而预测衍生的先验和辅助监督为动作依赖的地标预测提供了有效的中间结构指导。
conclusion: 本文成功提出并验证了一种利用视觉基础模型（如SAM 3）作为结构先验的轻量级框架，实现了手术视频中稀疏功能性地标（尖端和锚点）的精确、动作感知定位，且无需手动像素级掩码标注。研究表明，预测衍生的先验和辅助监督比直接掩码增强监督更能有效利用结构信息进行精确的地标预测。

title: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
authors: Ke Zhang, Patricio Gallardo Candela, Sudhir Murthy, Yi Xie, Zhi Wang, Maziar Raissi
abstract: Theorem-proving benchmarks evaluate proof search against fixed formal statements, but natural-language-to-Lean formalization must generate the formal statement itself. In this setting, compilation is only a validity check: a Lean declaration may type-check while omitting hypotheses, changing domains, or expressing a vacuous claim. We study faithful statement formalization as both an evaluation problem and a bottleneck-attribution problem. On a 400-entry graduate-level benchmark spanning real analysis, complex analysis, topology, and algebra, our protocol combines Lean compilation, cross-model semantic judging, and human expert calibration. The resulting picture is different from compile-rate evaluation: a full tool-augmented agent reaches 89.5% compilation but only 60.5% consensus faithfulness, exposing a 29.0-point compile-pass but consensus-unfaithful gap. Targeted human audits support the metric as a conservative decision boundary: across available case-level audits, 96.0% of consensus-positive outputs are human-confirmed faithful, while 82.4% of compile-pass consensus-negative outputs are human-confirmed semantic failures. Under this metric, existing one-shot formalizer models and prover-oriented Lean models remain low, suggesting that formal validity, proof-oriented Lean competence, and faithful statement generation should be reported separately. We then use a full $2^3$ factorial design to decompose three recurring interventions in formalization pipelines: parametric expert drafting, Mathlib/context search, and Lean elaboration feedback. Elaboration feedback is the largest validity intervention, but it also exposes a larger compile-pass semantic-failure bucket; search mainly improves grounding and selectivity; and fine-tuned drafting is largely substitutable in this tool stack once feedback and grounding are available.
zh_title: 超越编译：评估忠实的自然语言到Lean定理陈述形式化
translation: 定理证明基准测试通常针对固定的形式化陈述来评估证明搜索，但自然语言到Lean的形式化必须生成形式化陈述本身。在这种情况下，编译仅仅是一种有效性检查：一个Lean声明可能会通过类型检查，但却遗漏了假设、改变了定义域或表达了一个空洞的声称。我们研究了忠实的陈述形式化，将其作为一个评估问题和瓶颈归因问题。在一个包含400个条目、跨越实分析、复分析、拓扑和代数的的研究生水平基准测试上，我们的协议结合了Lean编译、跨模型语义判定和人类专家校准。其得到的结果与仅评估编译率大不相同：一个完整的工具增强型智能体达到了89.5%的编译率，但仅有60.5%的共识忠实度，暴露了29.0个百分点的“编译通过但共识不忠实”的差距。有针对性的人类审计支持该指标作为一个保守的决策边界：在可用的案例级审计中，96.0%的共识正向输出被人类证实为忠实，而82.4%的编译通过但共识负向输出被人类证实为语义失败。在此指标下，现有的单样本形式化模型和面向证明的Lean模型表现仍然较低，这表明形式有效性、面向证明的Lean能力和忠实的陈述生成应该分别予以汇报。然后，我们使用一个完整的 $2^3$ 析因设计来分解形式化流水线中三种经常出现的干预措施：参数化专家起草、Mathlib/上下文搜索以及Lean阐释反馈。阐释反馈是最大的有效性干预，但也暴露了更大的“编译通过但语义失败”的区间；搜索主要改善了接地和选择性；一旦反馈和接地可用，微调起草在这一工具栈中很大程度上是可以替代的。
tldr: 本文指出自然语言到Lean形式化中“编译通过”不等于“语义忠实”，并提出了一种结合自动评判与人类校准的评估协议，揭示了高达29%的“编译通过但语义错误”差距，并对形式化流水线中的关键干预措施进行了析因分析。
ai_comments: 该论文具有很高的创新性和实用价值。其创新性在于首次系统性地探讨了自然语言到Lean形式化过程中“编译通过并不等同于语义忠实”的现象（即存在29.0%的编译通过但语义错误的差距），并提出了一套结合大模型语义判定和人类校准的评估协议。其重要性在于为未来形式化数学的研究指明了方向，强调了形式有效性、证明能力和忠实陈述生成应当解耦并分别评估。局限性在于，虽然引入了跨模型语义判定，但其在更大规模或更前沿的数学领域中的泛化能力和判定准确性仍有待检验，且人类专家校准的成本较高。
motivation: 现有的定理证明基准主要评估针对固定形式化陈述的证明搜索，但在将自然语言翻译为Lean时，必须生成形式化陈述本身。在这种情况下，仅靠编译通过（类型检查）只能作为有效性检查，无法保证其没有遗漏假设、改变定义域或表达空洞的声称。因此，迫切需要一种能够评估“忠实形式化”的协议，并找出形式化流水线中的性能瓶颈。
method: 在包含400个研究生水平数学问题的基准测试上，提出并应用了一种结合了Lean编译器、跨模型语义判定（cross-model semantic judging）和人类专家校准的评估协议。此外，采用完整的 $2^3$ 析因设计（factorial design），对形式化流水线中的三种关键干预措施（参数化专家起草、Mathlib/上下文搜索、Lean阐释反馈）进行了分解和定量分析。
results:
1. 工具增强型智能体虽然达到了89.5%的编译率，但仅有60.5%的共识忠实度，存在29.0个百分点的“编译通过但语义不忠实”的差距。
2. 人类审计证实了该指标的可靠性：96.0%的共识正样本被证实为忠实，而82.4%的编译通过但共识负样本被证实为语义失败。
3. 现有一发（one-shot）形式化模型和面向证明的Lean模型在此指标上得分较低。
4. 析因分析表明，阐释反馈是提升有效性的最大干预手段，但也暴露了更大的语义失败区间；搜索主要改善了接地和选择性；而在有反馈和接地的情况下，微调起草在很大程度上是可以替代的。
conclusion: 仅仅依靠编译率无法准确评估自然语言到Lean形式化的质量。形式有效性、面向证明的Lean能力和忠实的陈述生成应当作为独立的指标进行汇报。在现有的形式化流水线中，阐释反馈能最大程度提升有效性，而搜索主要改善接地性，微调起草在有反馈和搜索支持时是可替代的。

title: Auditing Generalization in AI-Generated Video Detection: A Six-Control Protocol and the VidAudit Toolkit
authors: Mert Onur Cakiroglu, Zhihe Lu, Mehmet Dalkilic, Hasan Kurban
abstract: AI-generated video detection benchmarks such as GenVidBench and AIGVDBench are the de facto leaderboards, yet most evaluation protocols leave uncontrolled confounds that can inflate reported generalization. As an existence proof, a three-feature clip-length classifier reaches a leave-one-generator-out (LOGO) AUC of 0.998 on GenVidBench under unaudited evaluation, while measuring nothing about motion. A 20-paper survey finds none applying all six standard controls that would catch this, so we combine them into an audited protocol and apply it to six representative feature sources (three published detectors and three repurposed signal sources), re-running it cross-dataset on AIGVDBench. The audit both debunks and certifies: the trivial classifier collapses to near chance (0.529), a CLIP baseline is caught carrying dataset identity, and the 2025 forensic detector WaveRep clears the floor at out-of-distribution LOGO AUC 0.996 with chance-level real-vs-real coherence. At a deployable FPR of 0.1%, multiple high-AUC methods fall to single-digit recall and the leaderboard order changes, so we recommend an audited tuple (AUC, above-floor margin, operating-point recall, and calibration) over a single number. As a white-box positive control, we add TemporalSpec (codec motion vectors); via cross-substrate feature fusion (XSFF), a second substrate adds genuine complementarity that survives the audit. We release VidAudit, to our knowledge the largest unified and audited detector collection for this task, providing 14 detectors behind one plugin API, a leaderboard, and Croissant metadata, available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/vidaudit. Together, the protocol and toolkit move evaluation from leaderboard rank toward whether a result measures what it claims.
zh_title: 审计AI生成视频检测中的泛化性：一个六控制协议和VidAudit工具包
translation: AI生成视频检测基准（如GenVidBench和AIGVDBench）是事实上的排行榜，然而大多数评估协议留下了未控制的混杂因素，这可能会虚高所报告的泛化能力。作为存在性证明，一个仅包含三个特征的片段长度分类器在未经审计的评估下，在GenVidBench上达到了0.998的留一生成器（LOGO）AUC，而它实际上没有测量任何关于运动的信息。一项针对20篇论文的调查发现，没有一篇论文应用了能捕获这一问题的全部六种标准控制，因此我们将它们组合成一个审计协议，并将其应用于六个代表性的特征源（三个已发表的检测器和三个重新利用的信号源），在AIGVDBench上进行跨数据集的重新运行。该审计既证伪了虚高结果，也证实了真正优秀的检测器：琐碎分类器崩溃至接近随机水平（0.529），CLIP基线被发现携带了数据集身份信息，而2025年的取证检测器WaveRep在分布外LOGO AUC达到0.996的同时，保持了随机水平的真对真一致性。在可部署的0.1%误报率（FPR）下，多个高AUC方法的召回率降至个位数，排行榜顺序发生改变，因此我们建议使用审计元组（AUC、高于底线边际、工作点召回率和校准度）而不是单一数字。作为白盒阳性对照，我们添加了TemporalSpec（编解码器运动向量）；通过跨基质特征融合（XSFF），第二种基质添加了在审计中存活下来的真正互补性。我们发布了VidAudit，据我们所知，这是该任务中最大的统一且经过审计的检测器集合，在一个插件API后提供了14个检测器、一个排行榜和Croissant元数据，可在https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/vidaudit获取。总之，该协议和工具包将评估从排行榜排名转向了结果是否衡量了其所声称的内容。
tldr: 本文揭示了AI生成视频检测评估中因混杂因素导致的泛化性能虚高问题，提出了一个六控制审计协议及VidAudit工具包，以实现更真实、严谨的检测器性能评估。
ai_comments:
1. 警示性强：本文敏锐地指出了当前AI生成视频检测领域普遍存在的评估漏洞（如无意义的非运动特征导致虚高AUC），对学术界的评测规范具有重要的警示和纠偏作用。
2. 实用性高：不仅提出了六控制审计协议，还开源了包含14个检测器的VidAudit工具包，为后续研究提供了统一且规范的评测基准。
3. 局限性：虽然提出了更严格的审计协议，但在实际应用中，如何标准化这些控制措施以适应快速迭代的生成技术，仍需要社区的广泛共识。
motivation: 现有的AI生成视频检测基准（如GenVidBench和AIGVDBench）虽然被广泛使用，但其评估协议中存在未控制的混杂因素（如片段长度等非运动特征），导致报告的泛化性能被严重虚高。现有的研究中几乎没有论文完整应用了能够捕获这些混杂因素的标准控制。
method:
1. 提出了一个包含六种标准控制的审计协议（Audited Protocol），用于消除评估中的混杂因素。
2. 将该协议应用于6个代表性特征源（3个已发表的检测器和3个重新利用的信号源），并在AIGVDBench上进行跨数据集的重新运行与审计。
3. 引入了TemporalSpec（编解码器运动向量）作为白盒阳性对照，并通过跨基质特征融合（XSFF）增强其鲁棒性。
4. 推荐使用审计元组（AUC、高于底线边际、工作点召回率和校准度）代替传统的单一评估指标。
5. 开发并开源了VidAudit工具包，集成了14个检测器、统一的插件API、排行榜和Croissant元数据。
results:
1. 审计协议成功去除了虚高水分：一个在未审计时AUC达0.998的简单片段长度分类器，在审计后性能暴跌至接近随机的0.529。
2. 揭示了基线缺陷：发现CLIP基线模型携带了数据集的身份信息。
3. 证实了优秀模型：2025年的鉴识检测器WaveRep通过了审计，在分布外LOGO AUC上达到了0.996。
4. 改变了评测格局：在0.1%的低误报率下，多个高AUC方法的召回率降至个位数，导致排行榜重新洗牌。
conclusion: 本文提出的六控制审计协议和VidAudit工具包，成功将AI生成视频检测的评估重点从单纯的“排行榜排名”转向了“评估结果是否真正衡量了其所声称的特征”，显著提升了该领域泛化性评估的科学性和可信度。

title: WarpI2I: Image Warping for Image-to-Image Translation
authors: Shen Zheng, Anurag Ghosh, Gaurav Parmar, Srinivasa Narasimhan
abstract: Image-to-image (I2I) translation has achieved strong results in tasks like human relighting and driving scene translation using latent diffusion models (LDMs). However, compact LDMs often struggle to preserve fine-grained structures because the encoder compresses high-resolution inputs into a spatially downsampled latent space. To address this issue, we propose a simple saliency-guided warp-unwarp framework that reallocates spatial representation toward salient regions before encoding, enabling better preservation of structural details without increasing latent resolution. The warped image is processed by the original diffusion model and then mapped back via an inverse warp. In addition, we propose a simple and efficient outpainting-based synthetic data generation pipeline to produce high-quality paired data for image relighting. Our method is model-agnostic, requires no architectural modification, and introduces negligible computational overhead. Experiments on human relighting, driving scene relighting, and translation demonstrate improved structural preservation, lighting faithfulness, and image quality, with our framework extending naturally to video via frame-by-frame application with good temporal stability. Project Webpage: https://shenzheng2000.github.io/WarpI2I.github.io
zh_title: WarpI2I：用于图像到图像翻译的图像扭曲
translation: 图像到图像（I2I）翻译在使用潜在扩散模型（LDMs）的人体重照明和驾驶场景翻译等任务中取得了显著成果。然而，紧凑型LDMs通常难以保留细粒度结构，因为编码器将高分辨率输入压缩到空间下采样的潜在空间中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个简单的显著性引导的扭曲-反扭曲框架，该框架在编码前将空间表示重新分配到显著区域，从而在不增加潜在分辨率的情况下更好地保留结构细节。扭曲后的图像由原始扩散模型处理，然后通过反向扭曲映射回来。此外，我们提出了一个简单高效的基于外绘的合成数据生成流程，用于生成高质量的图像重照明配对数据。我们的方法是模型无关的，无需架构修改，并引入可忽略的计算开销。在人体重照明、驾驶场景重照明和翻译上的实验表明，该方法改善了结构保留、光照保真度和图像质量，并且我们的框架可以自然地通过逐帧应用扩展到视频，具有良好的时间稳定性。项目网页：https://shenzheng2000.github.io/WarpI2I.github.io
tldr: 提出WarpI2I框架，通过显著性引导的图像扭曲-反扭曲处理，在不增加潜在空间分辨率的情况下，帮助紧凑型潜在扩散模型更好地保留图像到图像翻译中的精细结构细节，并提出高效的合成数据生成方法，适用于图像重照明等任务。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入一个巧妙的图像扭曲-反扭曲预处理步骤，有效地解决了紧凑型潜在扩散模型在处理高分辨率图像时结构细节丢失的常见问题，而无需修改模型架构或显著增加计算成本，体现了其创新性。其模型无关的特性和在视频处理上的潜力也增加了其实用价值。
motivation: 紧凑型潜在扩散模型（LDMs）在图像到图像（I2I）翻译中难以保留细粒度结构，因为编码器将高分辨率输入压缩到空间下采样的潜在空间中。
method: 提出一个简单的显著性引导的扭曲-反扭曲（warp-unwarp）框架。该框架在编码前将空间表示重新分配到显著区域，从而在不增加潜在分辨率的情况下更好地保留结构细节。扭曲后的图像由原始扩散模型处理，然后通过反向扭曲映射回来。此外，提出一种基于外绘的简单高效的合成数据生成流程，用于生成高质量的图像重照明配对数据。该方法是模型无关的，无需架构修改，并引入可忽略的计算开销。
results: 在人体重照明、驾驶场景重照明和翻译任务上的实验表明，该方法改善了结构保留、光照保真度和图像质量。该框架可以自然地通过逐帧应用扩展到视频，具有良好的时间稳定性。
conclusion: WarpI2I框架通过其独特的显著性引导扭曲机制和高效的数据生成流程，有效解决了紧凑型LDMs在I2I翻译中结构细节保留不足的问题，并在多种任务中展示了优越的性能和广泛的适用性。

title: Evaluating Interactivity: Toward Automated Assessment of AI-Generated Explorable Explanations
authors: Xiaozao Wang, Zhewei Wang, Hongyi Wen
abstract: While large language models now enable rapid generation of interactive learning materials, evaluating the interaction quality of these explorable explanations remains an open challenge. Existing benchmarks largely focus on code executability or visual fidelity, providing limited insight into dynamic interaction behaviors such as learner-controlled state transitions and context-sensitive system responses, which are factors that critically shape learners' conceptual understanding. We present EE-Eval, an automated evaluation framework that formalizes interactivity as a finite space of learner-controllable states and transitions, represented as a Finite State Machine (FSM). By extracting FSMs from AI-generated explorable explanations, EE-Eval externalizes implicit interaction logic into an explicit, machine-interpretable graph. Evaluation is performed by comparing each generated FSM to an ideal FSM that encodes pedagogical intent, using a combination of graph-based metrics and embedding-based comparison of states, actions, and feedback to measure their structural and semantic similarity. Across thousands of generated explorable explanations spanning 127 concepts and produced by 6 AI models, EE-Eval consistently differentiates interaction quality beyond surface-level criteria such as functional correctness or visual quality, and exhibits substantially stronger alignment with human judgments of interactivity and pedagogical effectiveness than existing baselines. By framing interactivity as testable behavioral models rather than an emergent byproduct of LLM generation, EE-Eval transforms evaluation into a reflective diagnostic tool, enabling pedagogically grounded and actionable human-AI collaboration in creating interactive educational content.
zh_title: 评估交互性：迈向AI生成可探索解释的自动化评估
translation: 尽管大型语言模型现在能够快速生成交互式学习材料，但评估这些可探索解释的交互质量仍然是一个开放的挑战。现有基准主要关注代码可执行性或视觉保真度，对学习者控制的状态转换和上下文敏感的系统响应等动态交互行为提供的洞察有限，而这些行为是影响学习者概念理解的关键因素。我们提出了EE-Eval，一个自动化评估框架，它将交互性形式化为学习者可控状态和转换的有限空间，表示为有限状态机（FSM）。通过从AI生成的可探索解释中提取FSM，EE-Eval将隐式交互逻辑外部化为显式的、机器可解释的图。评估通过结合图基指标和基于嵌入的状态、动作和反馈比较，将每个生成的FSM与编码教学意图的理想FSM进行比较，以衡量其结构和语义相似性。在数千个跨越127个概念、由6个AI模型生成的探索性解释中，EE-Eval持续地区分超越表面级别标准（如功能正确性或视觉质量）的交互质量，并且与人类对交互性和教学有效性的判断表现出比现有基线更强的一致性。通过将交互性构建为可测试的行为模型，而非LLM生成的附带产物，EE-Eval将评估转化为一种反思性诊断工具，从而在创建交互式教育内容方面实现以教学为基础且可操作的人机协作。
tldr: EE-Eval是一个自动化评估框架，通过将交互性形式化为有限状态机（FSM），并与理想FSM进行比较，以评估AI生成可探索解释的交互质量，其结果与人类判断高度一致。

motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能快速生成交互式学习材料，但评估这些可探索解释的交互质量仍是一个开放性挑战。现有基准主要关注代码可执行性或视觉保真度，对学习者控制的状态转换和上下文敏感的系统响应等动态交互行为提供的洞察有限，而这些行为是影响学习者概念理解的关键因素。
method: EE-Eval框架将交互性形式化为学习者可控状态和转换的有限空间，表示为有限状态机（FSM）。通过从AI生成的可探索解释中提取FSM，将隐式交互逻辑外部化为显式的、机器可解释的图。评估通过比较每个生成的FSM与编码教学意图的理想FSM进行，结合图基指标和基于嵌入的状态、动作和反馈比较，以衡量其结构和语义相似性。
results: EE-Eval在数千个跨越127个概念、由6个AI模型生成的探索性解释中，能够持续地区分超越表面级别标准（如功能正确性或视觉质量）的交互质量。它与人类对交互性和教学有效性的判断表现出比现有基线更强的一致性。
